> Each EMA test tends to have more penetration of the EMA than the prior one, and at some point one will likely break a major trendline. Once that happens, the correction will probably have at least a second leg. For example, in a bear, the pullback after the trendline break usually forms a Higher Low and then runs above the high of the first leg.


市场直到太平洋时间上午9:10、在第3根K线低点之后的那段上涨行情里，才测试了均线（图 4.9中的第2根K线与均线差了一个最小报价单位，但那已经是一次足够好的测试，可以在那里做低2的空）。永远都要为测试极值寻找一个顺势入场。第4根K线是一根均线缺口K线，也是一次失败的ii形态突破；在那里做空入场能拿到一笔剥头皮交易者的利润，但没能走出新低。


> The market did not test the EMA until 9:10 A.M. PST on the rally after the after Bar 3 low (Bar 2 in Figure 4.9 missed the EMA by one tick, but it was a good enough test to take the Low 2 short there). Always look for a With Trend entry for a test of the extreme. Bar 4 was an EMA Gap Bar and a failed ii breakout, and a short entry there yielded a scalper's profit but not a new low.


由于上涨到第4根K线的那段行情突破了微型趋势线（从第2根K线顶部到第3根K线底部），并且只勉强突破了主要趋势线（从第1根和第2根K线画出）就反转了，这段逆势的动能并不起眼，尽管上涨到第4根K线的那段上涨行情里出现了一串小幅多头趋势K线。第5根K线试图在趋势线突破之后形成一个更高的低点和新一轮多头行情，但这段上涨行情失败了。一些多头在第7根K线跌破第5根K线时平掉了仓位，不过买盘不错，形成了第7根K线这个反转K线。第7根K线上方的高2做多（在这段更大的、可能是两段式的多头回调里，高1位于第5根K线上方）在第8根K线的突破回调处失败了，市场最终跌到一个新的低点。第7根K线低点下方的止损猎杀，结果走出一根空头趋势K线，因为第二批入场的多头被迫卖出离场。


> Because the rally to Bar 4 broke a minor trendline (from the Bar 2 top to the Bar 3 bottom) and only barely broke the major trend line (from Bars 1 and 2) before reversing, the Countertrend momentum was not impressive, despite the string of small bull trend bars in the rally to Bar 4. Bar 5 tried to form a Higher Low and a new bull after the trendline break, but the rally failed. Some longs covered on the Bar 7 move to below Bar 5, but there was good buying, forming the Bar 7 reversal bar. The High 2 long above Bar 7 (the High 1 was above Bar 5 in this larger two-legged possible bull pullback) failed at the Bar 8 Breakout Pullback, and the market finally sank to a new low. The stop run below the Bar 7 low resulted in a bear trend bar as the second-chance longs were forced to sell out.


![图 4.9](figures/fig-04-09.png)


**图 4.9　2HM 示例1**


尽管当天的前半段空头力量很强，多头还是突破了好几条空头趋势线，并且在向第11根K线的止损猎杀式暴跌形成双底（还形成了一次最终旗形失败反转）之后，终于能够把市场推上去。这基本上是一个空头趋势性交易区间交易日，而这类交易日往往会在收盘前上涨到最后一个交易区间之上，因为交易区间意味着双向交易，所以当天因此不太可能收在极值上。


> Despite the bear strength in the first half of the day, the bulls broke several bear trendlines and were finally able to move the market up after the stop run plunge down to Bar 1 1 that formed a Double Bottom (and a Failed Final Flag reversal). This was basically a bear Trending Trading Range Day, which often will rally above the final trading range by the end of the day, since trading ranges indicate two-sided trading, and the day would therefore be unlikely to close on its extreme.


RIMM 在图 4.10中一直到当天开盘后三个半小时才在第5根K线处触及均线，那是一轮由三根空头趋势K线构成的急跌。然而，从第1根到第2根K线的上涨行情里大约有20根多头趋势K线、中间只有一根回调K线，这是不寻常的行为，而不寻常的行为无法持续，因此是一种高潮。它呈抛物线形状，并且在第2根K线处出现了一次趋势通道线突破失败（那条线没有画出，但有好几种画法）。在一段高潮式行情之后，交易者不应在下一次回踩均线时顺势入场，除非这次回调已经持续了很久（至少一个小时左右）而且这个建仓形态很强。第5根到第7根K线之间的窄幅交易区间，不是寻找任何一个方向入场机会的地方，而且它可能是空头回调的中段，就像高潮之后常见的那样——高潮之后应当预期一段两段式的修正。它也可能是在向第5根K线急跌之后一段空头通道的开始（一次急速与通道顶部反转），不过第4根K线的高点并不像急速与通道反转中典型情况那样具有高潮特征。你需要等待窄幅交易区间被突破，而且突破要靠一根或几根强趋势K线来完成，然后再去找突破失败或突破回调的入场机会。当一段高潮演变成窄幅交易区间之后，最好去看别的股票，因为风险回报比很差。在强趋势日里非常常见的是，会出现一段很强的逆势恐慌行情，把人们吓得离场，而这通常发生在上午11:00到11:30（太平洋时间）之间，尽管它也可能更早或更晚出现。一旦你明白自己是被一段强逆势行情骗了，趋势已经朝它原来的极值走了很远，你和其他那些被关在场外、贪心的交易者就会去追它，把它推得更远。是什么造成了这段行情？机构从这波急冲中受益，因为它让他们能以好得多的价格加仓，并预期趋势会一直恢复走到收盘。如果你是一位想在收盘前建仓的机构交易者，想以好得多的价位入场，并且你知道只要能借某个传闻扫掉一些止损就行，你就会想尽办法去助推任何传闻。传闻或消息是什么、是不是某家机构为了赚钱散布出来的，都不重要。重要的是，这次止损猎杀给交易者一个机会，让他们搭机构便车、从这次失败的趋势反转里赚到钱。


> RIMM did not touch the EMA in Figure 4.10 until three and a half hours into the day at Bar 5 on a three bear trend bar plunge. However, the 20 or so bull trend bars in the rally from Bars 1 to 2 with only one Pullback Bar is unusual behavior, and unusual behavior is not sustainable and therefore a form of a climax. It had a parabolic shape and there was a failed trend channel line breakout at Bar 2 (the line is not shown but there were a couple ways to draw one). After a climactic move, traders should not look to enter With Trend on an EMA pullback unless the pullback has been long (at least an hour or so) and the setup is strong. The Tight Trading Range between Bars 5 and 7 is not a place to look for entries in either direction and could be the middle of the bear pullback, as is often the case after a climax where a two-legged correction should be expected. It could also be the start of a bear channel after the spike down to Bar 5 (a Spike and Channel Top reversal), although the high at Bar 4 was not as climactic as is typical in Spike and Channel reversals. You need to wait for a breakout of the Tight Trading Range where the breakout is by one or more strong trend bars, and then look to enter on a failed breakout or a Breakout Pullback. It is best to look to trade other stocks after a climax devolves into a Tight Trading Range, because the risk reward ratio is poor. Very commonly on strong trend days there will be a strong Countertrend panic move that will scare people out of their positions and this normally happens between 11:00 and 11:30 A.M. PST, although it can come earlier or later. Once it is clear that your were fooled by a strong Countertrend move, the trend will have gone a long way back towards its old extreme, and you and the other greedy traders who were trapped out will chase it, making it go further. What causes the move? Institutions benefit from the spike because it allows them to add on at much better prices, expecting the trend to resume into the close. If you were an institutional trader who wanted to load up going into the close and you wanted to enter at much better prices and you know that if stops could be run on some rumor, you would be looking to contribute to any rumor in any way that you could. It doesn't matter what the rumor or news item is or whether some institution spread it to make some money. All that matters is that the stop run gives traders an opportunity to piggy-back on the institutions and make a profit off the failed trend reversal.

**图 4.10　2HM 示例2**


图 4.11中有两个2HM 交易日，两个都出现了尾盘止损猎杀。第5根K线是11:25（太平洋时间）止损猎杀之后的入场，它同时也是一个缺口2做多。注意那根空头趋势K线有多强：实体大，收盘价靠近它的低点。这会让所有软手都以为市场已经转成空头。聪明的交易者会把这看成它本来就是的绝佳买入机会。


> Here are two 2HM days in Figure 4.1 1, both with late stop runs. Bar 5 is the entry after the 1 1:25 PST stop run and it is also a Gap 2 long. Notice how strong the bear trend bar was with a large body and a close near its low. This will make all weak hands think that the market has turned into a bear. Smart traders will look at this as the great buying opportunity that it is.


第10根K线是12:15（太平洋时间）止损猎杀之后的一笔做空，它也是一次均线缺口入场。在这两天里，均线缺口反向操作都是在均线被测试两次或更多次之后形成的，这是可以预料的。在逆势交易者能把市场多次带回均线之后，他们有了信心去加大赌注，结果就是一次远远跌破均线的走势。不过，第一次这样的跌破通常失败，为预期中的趋势恢复提供了一次很好的反向操作机会。


> Bar 10 is a 12: 15 PST stop run short that is also an EMA Gap entry. On both days, the EMA Gap fades developed after two or more tests of the EMA, which is to be expected. After the Countertrend traders were able to bring the market back to the EMA multiple times, they developed the confidence to press their bets, resulting in a break well beyond the EMA. However, the first such break usually fails, providing a great fade for the expected trend resumption.

![图 4.12](figures/fig-04-12.png)


**图 4.12　11:30 PST 陷阱**


在一个空头式的开盘即趋势交易日、随后又无力站上均线之后，交易者都在预期一次上午11:30（太平洋时间）的陷阱，今天它准时出现了。图 4.12中的第3根K线也是空头里的第一根均线缺口K线。通常这个陷阱是一段强逆势行情，让满怀希望的多头大举买入，结果市场迅速反转跌回去，迫使他们平仓。不过今天，从第2根K线起的上涨行情由大十字星构成，看上去是铁丝网的样子，说明交易者对上下两个方向都紧张。如果没有信念，交易者怎么会被套住呢？嗯，第3根K线前的那根K线试图形成一个双顶熊旗，而第3根K线升到第1根K线高点之上，把这个形态破坏了。这使很多交易者放弃看空，逼得空头平仓。所以与其说是把多头诱进交易，不如说是把空头困在场外，但这仍然是一个陷阱，因此空头这一侧仍然有燃料。那些空头全都想重新进场，他们帮着把市场推了下去。第3根K线往下那一段行情很弱，这与第2根K线往上那一段行情很弱是一致的，但结果和预期的一样……收在当天低点。这是一个趋势恢复式的空头交易日，但由于恢复开始得太晚，走出的行情段比开盘时的抛售更小。趋势往往有两段行情。如果在反转之后，第一段行情（逆势方，因为新趋势尚未确认）的动能很强，多空双方都会怀疑它会不会是可能出现的许多段行情中的第一段，从而形成一段新趋势。正因如此，多空双方都会预期对原趋势极值的测试会失败，而顺势（顺着原趋势）交易者会迅速离场。举例来说，如果在一段持续很久的空头之后出现一段强劲上涨，这段上涨升到均线之上、也升破了空头最后一个更低的高点，并且这段上涨里有很多多头趋势K线，那么多空双方都会认为会有一低点被测试，而且测试的低点会守在空头低点之上。一旦这第一段上涨的动能减弱，多头就会部分或全部止盈，空头则会做空，以防空头能维持对市场的控制。空头不确定自己的趋势是否已经结束，因此愿意建立新的空头仓位。市场会往下走，因为在出现更多看涨的价格行为之前，买方不愿买入。当多头在测试低点的回调中重新进场时，新进场的空头会迅速离场，因为他们不想在这笔交易上亏钱。空头回补自己的空头仓位，会为向上的推力再添一把力。市场随后会形成一个更高的低点。除非这一段行情在第一段上涨的顶部附近走弱（可能形成双顶熊旗），否则空头不会再考虑做空。如果确实走弱了，新进场的多头会因为不想亏损而迅速离场，空头则会变得更激进，因为他们感觉到这第二段上涨已经失败。最终会有一方胜出。不过，这种交易在所有的市场里整天都在上演，制造出大量两段式的行情。


> On a bear Trend from the Open day followed by an inability to get above the EMA, traders were expecting an 11:30 A.M. PST trap, and it occurred today exactly on time. Bar 3 in Figure 4.12 was also the first EMA Gap Bar in a bear. Usually the trap is a strong Countertrend leg, getting hopeful longs to buy aggressively only to get forced into liquidation as the market quickly reverses back down. Today, however, the rally from Bar 2 was composed of large dojis and had a Barb Wire look, indicating that traders were nervous in both directions. If there was no conviction, then how could traders get trapped? Well, the bar before Bar 3 attempted to form a Double Top Bear Flag, and Bar 3 spoiled it by going above the Bar 1 high. This made many traders give up on the bear case, forcing the shorts to liquidate. So it was not so much trapping the bulls into the trade as it was trapping the bears out, but it is still a trap, and therefore there still was fuel for the short side. Those shorts all wanted back in, and they helped push the market down. The weakness of the down leg from Bar 3 is consistent with the weakness of the up leg from Bar 2, but the result was as expected . . . a close on the low of the day. This was a bear Trend Resumption day, but since the resumption started so late, it resulted in a smaller leg than the selloff at the open. Trends often have two legs. If the momentum on the first leg (Countertrend, since the new trend is not yet confirmed) after the reversal is strong, both the bulls and bears will wonder if it will be the first of possibly many legs, creating a new trend. Because of this, both bulls and bears will expect that a test of the old trend's extreme will fail and the With Trend (with the old trend) traders will be quick to exit. For example, if there is a strong move up after a protracted bear and the up move goes above the EMA and above the last lower high of the bear, and there were many bull trend bars in this up move, both bulls and bears will assume that there will be a test of the low that will hold above the bear low. Once the momentum of this first up leg wanes, bulls will take partial or full profits, and bears will short, just in case the bears are able to maintain control of the market. The bears are not certain if their trend is over and will be willing to initiate new short positions. The market will work down since buyers will be reluctant to buy until there is more bullish price action. As bulls come back in on the pullback that is testing the low, the new bears will be quick to exit because they don't want to take a loss on the trade. The buying by the bears covering their shorts will add to the upward pressure. The market will then form a Higher Low. The bears will not consider shorting again unless this leg falters near the top of the first up leg (a possible Double Top Bear Flag). If it does, the new bulls will be quick to exit because they won't want a loss, and the bears will become more aggressive since they will sense that this second leg up has failed. Eventually, one side will win out. However, this kind of trading goes on all day long in all markets and creates a lot of two-legged moves.


从开盘下跌到第6根K线的空头走势由两段行情构成，而第二段又细分成两段更小的行情。上涨到第9根K线的行情也是两段式的，图 4.13中下跌到第12根K线的行情同样如此。


> The Bear from the Open down to Bar 6 occurred in two legs, and the second leg subdivided into two smaller legs. The move up to Bar 9 was also in two legs as was the move down to Bar 12 in Figure 4.13.


第12根K线是对这轮多头行情起点的一次完美的突破回测。它的低点正好等于第6根信号K线的高点，用一个最小报价单位扫掉了第6根K线做多者的保本止损。每当出现一次完美或近乎完美的突破回测，市场随后走出一个大致等距运动的概率就非常高（可以预期从第12根K线低点起的那段上涨，其点数和第6根到第9根K线的那段上涨相等）。


> Bar 12 was a perfect Breakout Test of the start of the bull move. Its low exactly equaled the high of the Bar 6 signal bar, running the breakeven stops of the Bar 6 longs by one tick. Whenever there is a perfect or near-perfect Breakout Test, the odds are very high that the market will make an approximate Measured Move (expect the move up from the Bar 12 low to be equal in points to the move from Bars 6 to 9).


曾经有一段两段式的上涨行情走到第15根K线，但当它的高点被超越时，市场在一根多头趋势K线里快速拉升，因为新进场的空头不得不从第15根K线做空建仓形态上那个失败的低2里买回自己的仓位。第9根K线与第3根K线构成了一个双顶熊旗，而它在从第16根K线起的那段上涨中失败，也助推了这次多头突破。这一天同时也是一个头肩底。


> There was a two-legged move up to Bar 15, but when its high was surpassed, the market ran up quickly in a bull trend bar as the new shorts had to buy back their positions from the failed Low 2 off the Bar 15 short setup. Bar 9 formed a Double Top Bear Flag with Bar 3, and its failure on the rally up from Bar 16 also contributed to the bull breakout. The day was also a Head and Shoulders Bottom.


和所有的形态一样，它们不必分毫不差。图 4.14中第1根和第4根K线形成了一个常见的双底牛旗（第4根K线的低点高出1美分）。这类旗形常常出现在趋势日的首次回调里。


> As with all patterns, they do not have to be exact. Bars 1 and 4 in Figure 4.14 formed a common Double Bottom Bull Flag (the Bar 4 low was one penny higher). These flags are often seen in the First Pullback of a trend day.


第3根和第5根K线形成了一个双顶，但它的高点在三根K线之后被超越了，构成一次失败形态。第7根K线处有一次突破回调，带来了一段大幅上涨。


> Bars 3 and 5 formed a Double Top, but its high was exceeded three bars later, creating a failure. There was a Breakout Pullback at Bar 7 that led to a large up move.


![图 4.13](figures/fig-04-13.png)


**图 4.13　行情往往以两段式出现**


![图 4.14](figures/fig-04-14.png)


**图 4.14　USO 中的双顶与双底**


出现了好几个由两三根K线构成的双底和双顶（第2、7、8、11根K线）。第12根和第13根K线形成了实际上算一个双顶，但你怎么称呼它并不重要。重要的是你要做空它。第13根K线是从第11根K线往上的一条小型多头趋势线被跌破之后出现的一个略微更高的高点。而且，它是在第12根K线于越过横穿第9根K线高点所画的趋势通道线、随后反转下跌之后出现的第二次入场（那条通道线是第6根到第10根K线之间那条多头趋势线的平行线）。


> There were several two-and three-bar Double Bottoms and Tops (Bars 2, 7, 8, and 11). Bars 12 and 13 formed what is effectively a Double Top, but it doesn't matter what you call it. What matters is that you short it. Bar 13 was a slightly Higher High after the breaking of a small bull trendline up from Bar 1 1. Also, it was a second entry after Bar 12 reversed down following an overshoot of the trend channel line drawn across the Bar 9 high (the channel was a parallel of the bull trendline between Bars 6 and 10).


这同时也是一个急速与通道式的多头交易日，以及一个开盘即趋势的多头交易日。


> This is also a Spike and Channel Bull day and a Trend from the Open Bull.


AAPL 在5分钟图上是一只走势很规矩的股票。它在第2根K线处形成了一个常见的双顶熊旗（比图 4.15中第1根K线的高点低1美分），并且远超了交易区间高度两倍的近似目标位。第2根K线也是空头里一段两段式上涨到均线的顶部，形成一个空头 M2S（均线处的低2，也就是均线做空的二次入场）。很多股票里的趋势对均线都很有敬意，也就是说均线全天都在提供以有限风险顺着趋势方向入场的机会。第2根K线之后四根K线处，出现了一次双顶回调做空。


> AAPL is a well-behaved stock on the 5-minute chart. It formed a common Double Top Bear Flag at Bar 2 (one cent below the high of Bar 1 in Figure 4. 15) and more than met the approximate target of twice the height of the trading range. Bar 2 was also the top of a two-legged move up to the EMA in a bear, forming a bear M2S (a Low 2 at the EMA, or a Moving average Short 2nd entry). Trends in many stocks are very respectful of the EMA, which means that the EMA provides opportunities all day long to enter in the direction of the trend with limited risk. Four bars after Bar 2, there was a Double Top Pullback short.


![图 4.15](figures/fig-04-15.png)


**图 4.15　双顶熊旗**


判断多头行情或交易区间里的一次回调是否已经结束，有一个可靠的信号：当前这根K线的高点至少向上延伸到了前一根K线高点之上一个最小报价单位。由此引出一个有用的概念——数这种情况出现了多少次。在多头趋势或交易区间里的一段横盘或向下走势中，第一根高点高于前一根K线高点的K线就是一个高1，它结束了这段横盘或下跌走势的第一段行情，尽管这一段行情在更大的回调里可能变成一小段行情。如果市场没有转成一段多头波段，而是继续横盘或向下，就把下一次出现的高点高于前一根K线高点的K线标为高2，它结束了第二段行情。高1和高2之间至少要有一次很小的趋势线突破，以表明趋势交易者仍然活跃。没有这个突破，就暂时不要去找买入机会，因为高1和高2更可能只是同一段下跌行情的一部分。在一段强劲的上涨走势里，高2的入场可以高于高1的入场；在一段强劲的下跌走势里，低2的入场可以低于低1的入场。有些回调会继续形成高3或高4。超过高4之后，市场很可能已经不再处于多头行情中的回调，而是进入了空头波段。在下一笔交易下单之前，先等更多的价格行为展开。


> A reliable sign that a pullback in a bull or in a trading range has ended is when the current bar's high extends at least one tick above the high of the prior bar. This leads to a useful concept of counting the number of attempts that this occurs. In a sideways or downward move in a bull trend or a trading range, the first bar whose high is above the high of the prior bar is a High 1, and this ends the first leg of the sideways or down move, although this leg may become a small leg in a larger pullback. If the market does not turn into a bull swing and instead continues sideways or down, label the next occurrence of a bar with a high above the high of the prior bar as a High 2, ending the second leg. There needs to be at least a tiny trendline break between the High 1 and the High 2 to indicate that the trend traders are still active. Without this, do not yet look to buy since the High 1 and High 2 are more likely to be just part of the same first leg down. In a strong upswing, the High 2 entry can be higher than that of the High 1, and in a strong downswing a Low 2 entry can be lower than that of the Low 1. Some pullbacks can continue to form a High 3 or a High 4. Beyond a High 4, it is likely that the market is no longer pulling back in a bull move and instead is in a bear swing. Wait for more price action to unfold before placing a trade.


当空头趋势或横盘市场在做横向或向上的修正时，第一根低点低于前一根K线低点的K线就是一个低1，它结束了这段修正的第一段行情，而这段行情甚至可以短到只有那一根K线。随后出现的依次叫低2、低3和低4。如果低4失败了（有一根K线向上延伸到了低4的高点之上），这个价格行为表明空头已经失去控制，市场要么会变成双向交易、多空交替掌控，要么多头会取得控制权。无论哪种情况，空头要最好地证明自己重新掌控局面，就得用强劲的动能突破一条多头趋势线。


> When a bear trend or a sideways market is correcting sideways or up, the first bar with a low below the low of the prior bar is a Low 1, ending the first leg of the correction, which can be as short as that single bar. Subsequent occurrences are called Low 2, Low 3, and Low 4. If the Low 4 fails (a bar extends above the high of the Low 4), the price action indicates that the bears have lost control and either the market will become two-sided, with bulls and bears alternating control, or the bulls will gain control. In any case, the bears can best demonstrate that they have regained control by breaking a bull trendline with strong momentum.


在你数这些回调的时候，你会常常看到市场继续它的修正而不是反转，这种情况下你就必须改变自己的视角。如果你认为自己身处一个交易区间、只是刚创了一个强劲的新高，然后看到旧高点之上出现一个低2（一个做空建仓形态），但市场没有下跌，反而继续上涨，你就应当开始寻找高1和高2的入场。很可能多头的力量已经足够强，让你只做多头。你应当把寻找低1和低2做空的事往后推，直到空头展现出足够的实力、使一段可交易的下跌行情变得可能（比如一次趋势线突破之后跟着对摆动高点的一次失败测试）。


> As you are counting these pullbacks, you will often see the market continue its correction instead of reversing, in which case you have to change your perspective. If you think that you are in a trading range with simply a strong new high and then see a Low 2 above the old high (a sell setup), but instead of falling, the market continues up, you should begin to look for High 1 and 2 entries. It is likely that the bull strength is sufficient for you to be only trading longs. You should defer looking for Low 1 and 2 shorts until the bears demonstrate enough strength to make a tradable down move likely (like a trendline break followed by a failed test of the swing high).


注意，在横盘的价格行为里，通常能在大约10根K线的过程中同时看到高1、高2、低1和低2，尽管高2是看涨的、低2是看跌的。由于市场在横盘，多空双方谁都不能长时间控制价格行为，所以双方各自都会试图夺取控制权，而随着各自试图占据上风，多头或空头的形态就会形成，这是合情合理的。


> Notice that in a sideways price action, it is common to see a High 1, High 2, Low 1, and Low 2 all present in the course of 10 bars or so, even though a High 2 is bullish and a Low 2 is bearish. Since the market is sideways, neither the bulls nor the bears are controlling the price action for more than a brief period, so it makes sense that each will try to wrest control, and as each tries to assert itself, bull or bear patterns will form.


这套编号有一些变体，但目标仍然是帮助识别两段式修正。举例来说，在强多头里，一段两段式回调可以形成，并且只带一个高1，但在功能上它就是一段两段式回调。如果出现一根（或两根）空头收盘的K线，这可以代表第一段下跌，即使下一根K线没有向上延伸到那根空头K线的高点之上。如果那根下一根K线是多头收盘，但它的高点仍然低于趋势高点，那么只要接下来一根左右的K线又是空头趋势K线，它就变成第一段下跌的终点。如果下一根K线向下延伸到了它的低点之下，就去接下来几根K线里找一根向上延伸到它前一根K线高点之上的K线，结束这两段下跌。把每一根K线都看成一个潜在的信号K线，并在它高点之上一个最小报价单位挂一张买入止损单。一旦成交，你现在就有了一个高2的变体。严格来说这根入场K线只是高1，但要把它当作高2来处理。回调开始处那根空头K线后面跟着一根多头收盘的K线。在更小的时间级别上，这几乎肯定是一小段下跌行情，跟着一段上涨行情变成一个更低的高点，然后又向下一推，结束第二段行情——高2就在那里结束。


> There are variations on this numbering, but the goal is still to help spot two-legged corrections. For example, in a strong bull, a two-legged pullback can form and have just a High 1, but functionally be a two-legged pullback. If there is a bear close (or two), this can represent the first leg down even if the next bar does not extend above the high of the bear bar. If that next bar has a bull close but its high is still below the trend high, it then becomes the end of the first down leg if the next bar or so is again a bear trend bar. If the next bar extends below its low, look for a bar within the next few bars that extends above the high of its prior bar, ending the two legs down. View each bar as a potential signal bar, and place a buy stop at one tick above its high. Once filled, you now have a variant of a High 2. This entry bar is strictly speaking just a High 1 but treat it as a High 2. That bear bar at the start of the pullback was followed by a bar with a bull close. On a smaller time frame, this was almost certainly a small down leg followed by an up leg that became a Lower High, and then finally another push down to where the High 2 ended the second leg.


再往下说失败的高4/低4，还有一个变体。如果高4或低4的信号K线特别小，特别是当它是一根十字星时，有时入场K线会迅速反转成一根外包K线，扫掉那些刚刚入场的交易者的保护性止损。当信号K线很小时，通常最好把你的保护性止损放在信号K线之外一个最小报价单位以上的位置（也许是三个最小报价单位，但在 Emini 里距你的入场点总共不超过八个最小报价单位），以避免被来回甩，同时仍然把这个形态视为有效，尽管严格来说它失败了，而且只差了一个最小报价单位左右。记住，一切都是主观的，交易者永远在寻找接近完美的东西，从不会指望完美，因为完美很罕见。最后，5分钟图上的复杂修正，在更高级别的图上往往看起来只是简单的高1/低1或高2/低2修正。不值得去看更高级别的图，因为那些交易在5分钟图上已经很明显，而你还会有分心的风险——去找罕见的信号，却漏掉太多5分钟图上的信号。


> There is also a variation for a failed High/Low 4. If the signal bar for the High 4 or Low 4 is particularly small, especially if it is a doji, sometimes the entry bar will quickly reverse into an outside bar, running the protective stops of the traders who just entered. When the signal bar is small, it is often best to place your protective stop at more than 1 tick beyond the signal bar (maybe three ticks, but no more than a total of eight ticks from your entry in the Emini), to avoid a whipsaw, and still treat the pattern as valid even though technically, it failed, albeit by only a tick or so. Remember, everything is subjective, and a trader is always looking for something close to perfect, never expecting perfection because perfection is rare. Finally, complex corrections on the 5-minute chart often appear as simple High/Low 1 or 2 corrections on higher timeframe charts. It is not worth looking at the higher timeframe charts since the trades are evident on the 5-minute, and you risk distracting yourself looking for rare signals and missing too many 5-minute signals.


最可靠的高1和低1入场，出现在微型趋势线发生假突破的时候，因为微型趋势线只出现在趋势最强劲的片段里。这种构成多头高1回调或空头低1回调的一到两根K线的假突破，是一笔概率很高的顺势剥头皮。另一个你需要接受这类入场的时候，是在市场远远越过均线之后出现一次回到均线的高1回调（多头里）或低1回调（空头里），即使当时并没有微型趋势线。


> The most reliable High 1 and Low 1 entries occur when there is a false breakout of a Micro Trendline because Micro Trendlines are only present in the strongest segments of trends. The one-or two-bar false breakout that creates the High 1 pullback in a bull or Low 1 pullback in a bear is a high-probability With Trend scalp. The other time when you need to take these entries is when there is a strong move well beyond the EMA and then a High 1 pullback (in a bull) or a Low 1 pullback (in a bear) to the EMA, even without a Micro Trendline being present.


趋势有呈趋势排列的高点和低点。在多头里，每个低点通常高于前一个低点（一个更高的低点），每个高点都变得更高（一个更高的高点）；在空头趋势里，则是更低的高点和更低的低点。总的来说，更高的高点和更高的低点这两个说法，专用于多头趋势看起来已经成立或正在发展中的情形；而更低的低点和更低的高点则意味着空头可能正在当道。这些说法意味着至少已经有一次小级别的趋势线突破，于是你在考虑在多头（一次回调）或空头（逆势，但也许是反转）里买入一个更高的低点，或者在多头或空头里卖出一个更低的高点。做逆势交易时，除非反转很强，否则你应该对大部分或全部仓位剥头皮。


> Trends have trending highs and lows. In a bull, each low is usually above the prior low (a Higher Low) and each high gets higher (a Higher High), and in bear trends, there are Lower Highs and Lower Lows. In general, the terms Higher High and Higher Low are reserved for situations in which a bull trend appears to be in place or in the process of developing, and a Lower Low, and a Lower High imply that a bear might be in effect. These terms imply that there will have been at least a minor trendline break so you are considering buying a Higher Low in a bull (a pullback) or a bear (countertrend but maybe a reversal) and selling a Lower High in a bull or a bear. When trading countertrend, you should scalp most or all of your position unless the reversal is strong.


在图 4.16中，一个高1（H1）出现在多头行情里下跌或横盘的那一段，它是第一根高点高于前一根K线的K线。如果随后出现一个低于前一根K线的高点，那么下一次出现更高的高点就是一个高2。高3是第三次出现，高4是第四次。数到四以上就不再提供可靠的交易，因为回调很可能已经延伸得足够远，可以看作一段反方向的趋势了。


> In Figure 4.16, a High 1 (HI) occurs in a down or sideways leg of a bull move, and it is the first bar with a high above that of the prior bar. If there is then a high that is lower than the prior bar, the next occurrence of a Higher High is a High 2. A High 3 is the third occurrence and a High 4 is the fourth. Counting beyond four does not offer reliable trades since it is likely that the pullback has extended far enough to be considered a trend in the opposite direction.


而同样，一个低1（L1）出现在下跌或横盘的市场里，而低2、低3和低4与它们对应的高2、高3和高4相当。


> Likewise, a Low 1 (Ll) occurs in an down or sideways market, and a Low 2, 3, and 4 are comparable to their High 2, 3, and 4 counterparts.


![图 4.16](figures/fig-04-16.png)


**图 4.16　数K线**


虽然图上标注了很多这样的点，但当市场明显在向上走趋势时，你不应该去找机会做空大部分低1和低2建仓形态。


> Although many are labeled, when the market is clearly trending up, you should not be looking to sell most Low 1 and Low 2 setups.


有时，一个高2和一个低2可以出现在同一个横盘市场里。变体有很多，但图上标注了很多符合基本定义的例子。


> Sometimes, a High 2 and Low 2 can occur in the same sideways market. There are many variations, but many of those meeting the basic definition are labeled on the chart.


这个难以计数的交易日（但相对容易交易）展示出数回调行情段的许多微妙之处。当第一段行情很陡、它的修正只有几根K线那么长（到图 4.17中的第2根K线，见上），然后形成一个高2，而且又是只隔了一两根K线（这里是第3根K线），此时不会有重要的趋势线被突破，所以你不应该去找机会买入一个高2。第1根和第2根K线构成了微型趋势线做空的建仓形态，它们表明空头动能很强。


> This difficult day to count (but fairly easy to trade) shows many subtleties to counting the legs of pullbacks. When the first leg is steep and its correction is only a couple of bars long (to Bar 2 in Figure 4. 17, above) and then a High 2 forms, again after only a bar or two (here, Bar 3), no significant trendline will be broken so you should not be looking to buy a High 2. Bars 1 and 2 set up Micro Trendline shorts, which indicate strong bearish momentum.


即使已经有过两次向上尝试，第一次尝试还是太弱了。在你的买入建仓形态之前，你总是希望看到一次力量的展示。否则，就假设市场仍然处于它的第一段下跌中。如果第3根K线之后那根K线升到第3根K线高点之上，那仍然算一次做多入场，但如果第一段下跌（高1）之后的那段上涨行情显示出更多力量，这笔买入总是更好。


> Even though there have been two attempts to go up, the first attempt was too weak. You always want a show of strength before your buy setup. Otherwise, assume that the market is still in its first leg down. If the bar after Bar 3 went above the Bar 3 high, it would still be a long entry, but the buy is always better if the rally after the first leg down (the High 1) shows more strength.


![图 4.17](figures/fig-04-17.png)


**图 4.17　数K线的变体**


市场有时会再次下跌，并在穿透一条趋势通道线、再反转向上之后形成一个高3。这是一个楔形反转（三段行情，加上一次趋势通道线突破的失败形态）。它发生在第4根K线。注意，第2根和第3根K线都没有升到它们各自前一根K线之上，但它们各自实际上都结束了一小段下跌行情。在1分钟图上，几乎肯定有一段小幅修正性的上涨行情形成了这些5分钟图上的多头趋势K线。


> The market sometimes drops again and forms a High 3 after penetrating a trend channel line and reversing up. This is a Wedge reversal (three legs and a failed breakout of a trend channel line). This occurred at Bar 4. Note that neither Bar 2 nor Bar 3 went above their prior bars, but they each effectively ended a small leg down. On a 1-minute chart, there was almost certainly a small corrective rally that formed these 5-minute bull trend bars.


第4根K线是空头楔形的终点，并在下一根K线上构成一个高3做多。尽管你不喜欢看到自己的做多入场K线变成一根空头趋势K线，但入场K线下方那个止损并没有被打到。


> Bar 4 was the end of the bear Wedge and set up a High 3 long on the next bar. Although you do not like to see your long entry bar tum into a bear trend bar, the stop below the entry bar was not hit.


所有的计数在跟随一次更长、更强趋势线的突破之后，都会变得更有意义。如果在前一段行情上没有重要的趋势线被突破（像第2根K线那样），那么下一段行情的反转就不会有多大信念（第3根K线），你应当等待更多的价格行为（比如第4根K线处的楔形底部）。


> All counts gain more significance when they follow a break of a longer and stronger trendline. If no meaningful trendline is broken on the prior leg (like Bar 2), then the next leg's reversal will not have much conviction (Bar 3), and you should wait for additional price action (like the Wedge bottom at Bar 4).


第5根K线可以看成一个低1，也可以看成一个低2，但当图面不清晰时，你怎么称呼它并不重要，因为你在做空之前必须等一次趋势线突破和清晰局面。而且，在楔形底部之后，你不应该去找做空机会，直到市场走完两段上涨（在这里，第7根K线处的低4就已经等同于两段上涨了）。一旦市场升到第5根K线之上，现在就出现了一个失败的低2，而这通常会导致再走出两段上涨。


> Bar 5 can be viewed as a Low 1 or as a Low 2, but when the chart is not clear, it doesn't matter what you call it because you must wait for a trendline break and clarity before shorting. Also, following a Wedge bottom, you should not be looking to sell until the market has made two legs up (here, the Low 4 at Bar 7 was as good as two legs up). Once the market went above Bar 5, there was now a failed Low 2 and this usually results in two more legs up.


第6根K线严格来说是一个低2，但由于在低1处没有出现有意义的空头趋势线突破，你不会去做空它。不过，你应当把它当作一个低3来看，并预期再有一段上涨。你还需要更多的价格行为，比如在均线处出现第二次入场，而它在第7根K线处形成了。第5根K线只是一根巨大的十字星，没有任何空头信念，所以它代表的低1强度不够（事实上，它构成了一个失败的低2，做多入场在下一根K线上）。


> Bar 6 strictly speaking is a Low 2, but since there was no meaningful bull trendline break at the Low 1, you would not be shorting it. However, you should be thinking of it as a Low 3 and expecting one more leg up. You would need more price action, like a second entry at the EMA, which developed at Bar 7. Bar 5 was just a huge doji and had no bearish conviction, so it does not represent an adequately strong Low 1 (in fact, it set up a failed Low 2 with the long entry on the next bar).


第8根K线是一个高1，但它同样是在单独一根小K线之后出现的，所以没有多少预测力，并且它构成一笔微型趋势线做空。


> Bar 8 is a High 1, but again it occurred after a single small bar, so it does not have much predictive power and was a Micro Trendline short.


第10根K线是一根均线缺口2K线，也就是在一个走平或向上的市场里，从均线下方反弹的第二次尝试。这些K线的高点与均线之间的空间就是所谓的缺口。第一次尝试是第9根K线那根多头趋势K线。前面的第4根K线也是均线缺口2K线买入。


> Bar 10 is a EMA Gap 2 Bar, which is the second attempt to rally from below the EMA in a flat or up market. The space between the high of these bars and the EMA is the gap in question. The first attempt was the bull trend Bar 9. Bar 4 earlier was also a EMA Gap 2 Bar buy.


第10根K线在一个走平的市场里也是一个清晰的高2，而走平市场里的高2通常是一笔好买入。


> Bar 10 is also a clear High 2 in a flat market, which is usually a good buy.


第11根K线是一个高1变体（一根没有向上延伸到前一根K线之上的多头趋势K线）。在这些不清晰的情况下，你需要看到更多的价格行为，才能知道这根K线会不会像一个高1那样奏效。它的更高的低点具有建设性，因为它是对下跌走势的一次轻微打断，因此是向上力量的迹象，尽管幅度极小。下跌到第10根K线的那段行情没有突破任何重要的空头趋势线（从第7根K线向下到第10根K线），所以它的动能很强。可以合理地假设会有第二段下跌，并且出现一个更低的低点，或者至少测试一下第10根K线的低点。


> Bar 11 was a High 1 variant (a bull trend bar that did not extend above the prior bar). In these unclear cases, you need to see further price action before you know whether the bar will work as a High 1. Its Higher Low is constructive because it is a minor disruption of the downswing and therefore a sign of upward strength, although minimal. The leg down to Bar 10 did not break any significant bear trendlines (from Bar 7 down to Bar 10), so it had a lot of momentum. It is reasonable to assume that there will be a second leg down and a Lower Low or at least a test of the Bar 10 low.


第12根K线在平静的一天里是一根多头反转K线，而且它是当天的新低，使它成为一笔高概率的交易，至少可以做一次剥头皮。到这个时候，在一段可交易的上涨行情出现之前，你不会再预期更多的下跌，所以你现在会把第11根K线称为一个高1。但何必费这个劲呢？因为它为第12根K线是高2提供依据，而高2是二次入场，因此更可能带来一笔有利可图的做多。如果当时没有传统的高1，也没有高1变体（在这里是第11根K线那根多头趋势K线），那么第12根K线处的做多就没那么确定，你很可能对大部分或全部合约做剥头皮，然后等待更多的价格行为。不过，在所展开的这幅情景里，第12根K线很可能至少有两段上涨，所以交易者会想把一半左右的合约做波段。而且，第12根K线是一段更大的两段式回调里一个等距运动（大致上）的终点，第一段结束于第10根K线；它也是一段从当天高点起算的更大等距运动的终点，第一段结束于第4根K线。最后，第12根K线是从一次空头趋势通道过靶中反转过来的（那条线没有画出，但它是根据从第7根K线高点画到第10根K线之后那个摆动高点的平行线，然后拖到第10根K线低点画出来的）。


> Bar 12 was a bull reversal bar in a quiet day, and it was the new low of the day, making it a high probability trade for at least a scalp. At this point, you would not be expecting more down movement until after a tradable rally, so you would now call Bar 1 1 a High 1. But why bother? Because it makes a case for Bar 12 being a High 2, which is a second entry and therefore more likely to lead to a profitable long. If there was no traditional High 1 or a High 1 variant (here, a bull trend bar at Bar 1 1), the long at Bar 12 would be less certain, and you would likely scalp most or all of your contracts and then wait for more price action. However, under the scenario that unfolded, Bar 12 was likely to have at least two legs up so a trader would want to swing about half of her contracts. Also, Bar 12 was the end of a Measured Move (approximately) in a larger two-legged pullback, with the first leg ending at Bar 10, and the end of an even larger Measured Move from the high of the day with a first leg ending at Bar 4. Finally, Bar 12 was a reversal from a bear trend channel overshoot (not shown, but based a parallel drawn from the Bar 7 high to the swing high that followed Bar 10, and then dragged to the Bar 10 low).


第14根K线是一个低2，结束了第二段上涨。它也是一个双顶熊旗。开盘时有一段强劲的下跌，随后在均线处有一段修正性上涨、结束于第7根K线前的那根K线。第14根K线是对那次的测试，形成了第二次冲向当天高点的失败尝试和一个双顶。在一个无趋势的交易日里、又在一个双顶熊旗之后，你应当寻找两段下跌。第一段以第15根K线处的高1结束，随后跟着两小段上涨，最后以第16根K线处的空头M2S结束。它是铁丝网形态，但位于交易区间高点处的那根小K线是一笔很好的做空。


> Bar 14 was a Low 2, ending the second leg up. It was also a Double Top Bear Flag. There was a strong move down on the open with a corrective move up ending on the bar before Bar 7. Bar 14 is a test of that, creating a second failed attempt to run to the high of the day and a Double Top. On a trendless day and after a Double Top Bear Flag, you should look for two legs down. The first leg ended with the Bar 15 High 1, which was followed by two small legs up, ending with the bear M2S at Bar 16. It is Barb Wire, but the small bar at the high of the trading range is a good short.


第二段下跌以第17根K线的高2结束，但第17根K线是一根空头趋势K线，而且它前面也是一根空头趋势K线，再前面则是下跌到第15根K线、非常强劲的第一段行情。这依然是一笔有效的买入，但长长的影线所显示出的不确定性，导致了第18根K线高2处的二次入场。这第二次入场之所以形成，是因为足够多的交易者对第一次入场感到足够不安，以至于他们愿意等第二个建仓形态。它也是一个只看实体的ii形态变体。


> The second leg ended with the High 2 at Bar 17, but Bar 17 was a bear trend bar following a bear trend bar, following a first leg down to Bar 15 that was very strong. It is still a valid buy, but the uncertainty as seen by the large tails resulted in a second chance entry at the Bar 18 High 2. This second entry developed because enough traders were sufficiently uncomfortable with the first entry to make them wait for a second setup. It is also an ii variant based on bodies only.


第19根K线处的低2是在强劲上涨动能之后出现的，但它依然是一笔有效的做空。不过，它在第20根K线处导致了一次五个最小报价单位的失败（第19根K线往下的那段行情只走了五个最小报价单位之后，第20根K线就向上延伸到了前一根K线的高点之上，因此让许多空头仍然被套、没拿到剥头皮交易者的利润）。


> The Low 2 at Bar 19 was after strong upward momentum, but it is still a valid short. However, it resulted in a Five Tick Failure at Bar 20 (Bar 20 extended above the high of the prior bar after the move down from Bar 19 only reached five ticks and therefore left many shorts still trapped without a scalper's profit).


第20根K线形成了一个失败的低2，它困住了大量空头，是一个很好的入场点，尤其是在向上的动能一直不错的时候。当它出现时，通常会导致两段上涨，并且常常以低4结束。正因如此，在第21根K线买入那个高1是一笔极好的交易。每个人都知道动能很强，而且会有第二段上涨。这段下跌行情有可能发展出第二段下跌、低点低于第21根K线的低点（从而形成一个高2买入建仓形态），但概率对它不利。力量实在太强了。


> Bar 20 formed a failed Low 2, which traps lots of shorts and is a great entry, especially when the up momentum has been good. When it occurs, it usually results in two legs up and often ends in a Low 4. Because of this, buying the High 1 at Bar 21 was a great trade. Everyone knew that the momentum was strong and there was going to be a second leg up. It is possible for this leg down to develop a second leg down with a low below the low of Bar 21 (forming a High 2 buy setup), but the odds were against it. There was simply too much strength.


如果每段行情至少有几根K线那么长，并且清晰地突破趋势线，K线计数就可靠得多。举例来说，如果一个空头低4出现在一段向上倾斜的窄幅交易区间构成的上涨行情里，它就不是一笔好的做空，因为没有清晰的趋势线突破。


> The bar counts are much more reliable if the legs are at least several bars long and break clear trendlines. For example, a bear Low 4 is not a good short if it occurs in a rally that is an up-sloping Tight Trading Range because there have been no clear trendline breaks.


图 4.18中，5分钟 Emini 走了两段强劲的下跌，结束于第1根K线处一个幅度为一个最小报价单位的假突破。市场在一条窄幅通道里横盘上移，最终突破了从开盘起的那条趋势线。在两段下跌和一次趋势线突破之后，很可能走出两段上涨。


> The 5-minute Emini had two strong legs down in Figure 4.18 that ended in a one-tick false breakout at Bar 1. The market drifted sideways and upward in a tight channel and finally broke the trendline from the open. After two legs down and a broken trendline, two legs up are likely.


第5根K线是在均线处的一个低4做空，但这不是一笔强势的做空，因为市场大部分时间都在横盘、有很多小十字星，而且很可能先出现一个更高的低点，所以空头没有多少获利空间。不过，如果交易者依靠信号K线上方的保护性止损，结果会是一笔有利可图的剥头皮。由于更高的低点、随后第二段上涨很可能出现，交易者会去寻找做多的理由。


> Bar 5 is a Low 4 short at the EMA, but this is not a strong short since the market has been largely sideways with lots of small dojis and there will probably be a Higher Low and there is not much room for the short to be profitable. However, if a trader relied on a protective stop above the signal bar, it would have resulted in a profitable scalp. Since a Higher Low and then a second leg up is likely, traders would be looking for a reason to buy.


从第6根K线起市场处于一条向下的窄幅通道里，但在均线下方被测试之后给出了一个高4买入（高1、高2和高3分别是第6、第7和第8根K线）。市场随后一路涨到收盘，形成第二段上涨。


> The market was in a tight channel down from Bar 6 but then gave a High 4 buy after a test below the EMA (the High 1, 2, and 3 were Bars 6, 7, and 8). The market then rallied into the close to form the second leg up.


出现窄幅交易区间时的交易并不特别好做。回调K线接连不断，重叠也太多。这些形态像一块巨大的磁力位，让市场很难在朝任何一个方向，直到出现过一次突破失败为止（第9根K线构成了一个下跌方向的突破失败）。


> Trading when there is a Tight Trading Range is not particularly good. There are constant pullback bars and too much overlap. The patterns act as a huge magnet, making it difficult for the market to go very far in either direction until there has been a failed breakout (Bar 9 set up a failed downside breakout).


![图 4.18](figures/fig-04-18.png)


**图 4.18　延伸行情之后往往是两段式修正**


任何时候只要出现趋势线突破，随后出现第二段行情的概率就很高，因为现在所有人都意识到有可能出现更高的低点／更低的高点的趋势反转。一般来说，在第二次尝试失败之前，要避免顺势入场。例如，在空头趋势线被强劲突破之后，与其寻找做空建仓形态，不如专注于买入一个更高的低点——直到那个更高的低点开始构筑失败为止。不过，如果到旧低点还有很多空间，你可以考虑做空那段强劲的第一段上涨，尤其是当它以空头里第一根位于均线上方的缺口K线收尾的时候。


> Any time there is a trendline breakout, the chances are high that there will be a second leg, because everyone now is aware of the possibility of a Higher Low/Lower High trend reversal. In general, avoid a With Trend entry until after the second attempt fails. For example, after a strong break of a bear trendline, it is better to focus on buying a Higher Low than to look for short setups until after the Higher Low is setting up a failure. However, if there is a lot of room to the old low, you can look to short that strong first up move, especially if it ends with the first gap bar above the EMA in the bear.


每当形成高2或低2、并且其中一根或多根K线触及均线时，尤其是在强趋势里，它就被称为 M2B（均线、二次入场、买入建仓形态或入场）或 M2S（均线、二次入场、卖出建仓形态或入场）。它值得与其他高2／低2建仓形态区分开来，因为它格外可靠（趋势中一次回踩均线的两段式回调是极好的建仓形态）。


> Whenever a High or Low 2 develops and one or more of the bars touches the EMA, especially in a strong trend, it is called an M2B (moving average, second entry, buy setup or entry) or an M2S (moving average, second entry, sell setup or entry). It is worth distinguishing from other High/Low 2 setups because it is particularly reliable (a two-legged pullback to the EMA in a trend is a great setup).


在图 4.19中，第5、6、8根K线都是 M2S 入场。第3根K线是低2，但这个建仓形态里没有任何一根K线触及均线。第2根和第4根K线是 M2B 建仓形态。


> Bars 5, 6, and 8 were M2S entries in Figure 4.19. Bar 3 is a Low 2, but none of the bars of the setup touched the EMA. Bars 2 and 4 were M2B setups.


空头第8根K线的 M2S 之后，紧接着就是第9根K线的多头高2（但它不是好的多头 M2B，因为它大部分都位于均线下方）。


> The bear Bar 8 M2S was immediately followed by the Bar 9 bull High 2 (but not a good bull M2B since it was largely below the EMA).


尽管高2和低2是常见的反转建仓形态，但除非此前的高1或低1突破了一条趋势线，否则绝不应该交易它们。


> Although a High 2 and a Low 2 are common reversal setups, they should never be traded unless the prior High 1 or Low 1 broke a trendline .


![图 4.19](figures/fig-04-19.png)


**图 4.19　M2B 与 M2S 建仓形态**


这次突破可能来自一段逆势行情，也可能来自一段横盘行情；这个行情段里K线越多、动能越强，逆势力量就越强，高2或低2这笔逆势交易获利的可能性也就越大。


> The break can occur from a Countertrend move or a sideways move, and the more bars and more momentum in the leg, the more the Countertrend strength, and the more likely that the High 2 or Low 2 Countertrend trade will be profitable.


图 4.20左边是5分钟图上的 Emini，右边是5分钟图上的 SDS，它是一只与 SPY（标普500的 ETF，可与 Emini 相比）反向的 ETF（交易所交易基金），但杠杆翻倍。在 Emini 图上，第1根K线处出现多头趋势线突破之后，第5根K线形成了一个高2，随后第3根K线的更高的高点测试了旧的趋势高点。这可能是一次趋势反转。下跌动能很强，而第4根K线的高1很弱。它刺穿从第3根K线高点画出的多头微型趋势线，随即反转下跌，说明多头很弱。这作为低1做空要好得多。买入第5根K线那个高2并不明智，除非它表现出格外的强势，比如出现一根强劲的多头反转信号K线。而且，这根信号K线太大了，逼着你在一段弱势市场里买在高位；这根信号K线是一根十字星K线，几乎完全落在前两根K线之内（那两根都是空头趋势K线）。当有三根或更多K线大量重叠、其中一根或多根是十字星（铁丝网）时，最好等到更多价格行为出现再开仓交易。多头和空头势均力敌，任何突破都很可能失败（比如第5根K线那个高2买入信号），而你当然不应该在它高点上方买突破，尤其是在一段空头行情段里，特别是因为大多数交易区间都是顺势的，而前一段是向下的。


> On the left in Figure 4.20 is the 5-min Emini, and on the right is the 5-min SDS, an ETF that is the inverse of the SPY (an ETF that is comparable to the Emini) but twice the leverage. On the Emini chart, there is a High 2 at Bar 5 following a bull trendline break at Bar 1, and then the Higher High at Bar 3 tested the old trend high. This could be a trend reversal. The down momentum is strong, and the High 1 at Bar 4 was weak. It poked above the bull Micro Trendline from the Bar 3 high and immediately reversed down indicating that the bulls were weak. This was a much better Low 1 short. It would be unwise to buy the High 2 at Bar 5 unless it showed exceptional strength, for instance, if there were a strong bull reversal signal bar. Also, the signal bar was too large, forcing you to buy high in a weak market, and the signal bar was a doji bar that waS almost entirely within the prior two bars (both were bear trend bars). When there are three or more bars with a lot of overlap and one or more is a doji (Barb Wire), it is best to wait for more price action before initiating a trade. The bulls and bears are in balance, and any breakout will likely fail (like the High 2 buy signal at Bar 5), and you certainly shouldn't be buying a breakout above its high, in particular in a bear leg, especially since most trading ranges are With Trend and the prior leg was down.


每当你拿不准一个信号是否足够强时，从不同角度研究图表会很有帮助：比如改用K线图或者改用反向走势图。一般来说，光是“你觉得自己还需要进一步研究”这一点，就应该告诉你这不是一个清晰而强势的信号，因此你不应该做这笔交易。


> Whenever you are wondering if a signal is strong enough, it is helpful to study the chart from different perspectives: for instance, using a bar chart or an inverse chart. In general, just the fact that you feel that you need further study should tell you that it is not a clear and strong signal and therefore you should not take the trade.


![图 4.20](figures/fig-04-20.png)


**图 4.20　反向走势图往往能让建仓形态更清楚**


即便你一时想在 Emini 图上买入那个高2，也几乎没有人会想在右边 SDS 图上卖出第5根K线的低2，因为上涨动能太强了。既然这两张图本质上只是彼此的倒影，如果你不会在 SDS 上买入，你就不应该在 Emini 上卖出。


> Even if you were tempted to buy the High 2 on the Emini chart, virtually no one would be looking to sell the Bar 5 Low 2 on the SDS chart on the right because the up momentum is so strong. Since these charts ar.e essentially just the inverse of one another, if you would not buy on the SDS, you should not sell on the Emini.


注意 Emini 上的第7根K线是一个高4，而高4通常是可靠的买入信号。不过，如果高1、高2或高3里没有表现出任何多头强势，这笔交易你就做不了。光有数K线的结果还不够。你还需要此前的强势，也就是一段相对强劲、至少突破了一条小型趋势线的行情。


> Note that Bar 7 on the Emini was a High 4, which is usually a reliable buy signal. However, in the absence of any bullish strength in the High 1, 2, or 3, you cannot take the trade. A bar count alone is not sufficient. You need prior strength in the form of relatively strong move that broke at least a minor trendline.


注意，早些时候出现了一段强劲的多头行情，在市场突破那条多头趋势线之前，低2做空都是糟糕的交易。当时并没有一波强劲的下跌冲击，但市场横盘了大约10根K线，说明空头强到足以在相当长的一段时间里把多头挡在外面。交易者要有信心去做空那次冲向第3根K线当日新高的最终旗形失败突破，空头这种力量的展示是必不可少的。


> Notice that earlier there was a strong bull and that Low 2 shorts were bad trades until after the market broke the bull trendline. There was not a strong down surge, but the market went sideways for about 10 bars, indicating that the bears were strong enough to hold the bulls at bay for a protracted period. This show of strength by the bears was necessary for a trader to feel confident to short the Failed Final Flag breakout to the Bar 3 new high of the day.


失败的低2往往最后变成低4做空。第2根K线是一个失败的低2，所以可以预期再有两段上涨。在图 4.21中，一个低4结束了空头的上涨行情，另一个低4结束了跌到当日低点的抛售。第A根K线的高1出现在前一段的低4之前，这并不重要。


> A failed Low 2 often ends up as a Low 4 short. Bar 2 was a failed Low 2 so two more legs up were to be expected. In Figure 4.21, a Low 4 ended the bear rally and another one ended the selloff to the low of the day. It does not matter that the Bar A High 1 occurred before the Low 4 of the prior leg.

**图 4.21　修正有时有四段而不是两段**


第1根K线是一次微型趋势线做空，适合做一笔剥头皮。它在下一根K线反转成突破回调做多（微型趋势线上方的突破失败了，但这次失败只持续了两根K线，那两根K线只是突破趋势线之后的一次回调）。理解高2／低2建仓形态这个概念的关键，是记住它的本意。这个想法是：市场对任何事情往往都会尝试两次，而在试图修正时，它常常会两次尝试反转趋势。如果两次都失败，它就很可能会反过来做（趋势将恢复）。在多头中买入高2回调的好处是几乎不用动脑筋，而且容易执行。难就难在当一次修正有两次尝试、却没有形成清晰的高2或低2时。所以有必要看看各种变体……即使没有完美的高2或低2建仓形态，你也能通过交易两段式回调赚钱。


> Bar 1 was a Micro Trendline short that was good for a scalp. It reversed to a Breakout Pullback long on the next bar (the breakout above the Micro Trendline failed but the failure only lasted a couple bars and those bars became just a pullback from the break above the trendline). The key to understanding the concept of High/Low 2 setups is to remember its intent. The idea is that the market will tend to make two attempts at anything, and in its attempt to correct, it frequently will try twice to reverse the trend. If it fails twice, it will likely do the opposite (the trend will resume). The advantage of buying a High 2 pullback in a bull is that there is very little thought involved, and it is easy to do. The difficulty comes when a correction has two attempts but does not form a clear High or Low 2. That is why it is necessary to look at variations . . . you can make money by trading two-legged pullbacks even when they don't offer a perfect High or Low 2 setup.


最显而易见的两段式行情有两段清晰的波段，中间夹着一段反向波段，并且这段反向波段突破了某条小型趋势线。这次回调通常在多头中形成高2回调、在空头中形成低2（即 ABC 修正）。不过，还有一些不那么清晰的变体，它们提供的交易同样可靠，所以识别这些变体也很重要。任何时候，只要你看到一次修正、能从中推断出两段行情，那你就找到了一个可接受的形态。不过，它离理想形态越远，表现就越不可能像理想形态。这种不确定性会让交易者犹豫，因此这个形态失败的可能性也更大。图 4.22中第2根K线的十字星在顶部有一根长影线，说明市场在这根K线内既上又下。那段上涨就是第一段下跌的终点，因此第3根K线应该起高2的作用——它也确实如此。既然出现了当日新低，而且当天是第三次向下推进（这里是一个收缩楼梯形态，说明空头力量在衰减；它同时是一次最终旗形失败反转），尽管有三根空头趋势K线，你还是在找机会买入。第3根K线处隐含的高2，就是最后一块拼图，让你有信心不必等更多价格行为就入场（比如不必等二次入场）。任何时候只要你能推断出两段行情，市场就很可能会表现得像真有两段行情一样。


> The most obvious two-legged move has two clear swings with an opposite swing in between that breaks a minor trendline. The pullback usually forms a High 2 pullback in a Bull or a Low 2 in a Bear (an ABC correction). However, there are less clear variations that provide just as reliable trades, so it is important to recognize these as well. Anytime that you see a correction where you can infer two legs, then you have found an acceptable pattern. However, the further from the ideal that it is, the less likely it will behave like the ideal. This uncertainty will make traders hesitant and therefore the pattern will be more likely to fail. The Bar 2 doji in Figure 4.22 had a large tail on the top, which indicates that the market moved up and down within that bar. That up move was the end of the first leg down, and therefore Bar 3 should act like a High 2, which it did. Since there is a new low of the day and a third push down on the day (here, a Shrinking Stairs pattern, which indicates waning bear strength; it was also a Failed Final Flag reversal), you were looking to buy, despite the three bear trend bars. The implied High 2 at Bar 3 is the final component that gives you confidence to enter without further price action (such as waiting for a second entry). Anytime that you can infer two legs, the market will likely behave as if there were two legs.


图 4.23中第3根和第4根K线构成了一段多头波段中的两段式修正，尽管第3根K线之后的那根K线才是上涨段的终点。因为这是一次两段式修正，第4根K线就是一个高2做多入场。这个由两根空头K线夹着一根多头K线的横盘形态，制造出了这两段行情。


> Bars 3 and 4 in Figure 4.23 create a two-legged correction in a bull swing, even though the bar after Bar 3 was the end of the up leg. Because it was a two-legged correction, Bar 4 is a High 2 long entry. The sideways pattern with two bear bars separated by a bull bar created the two legs.


第8根K线是高1做多，因为它前面是一根空头反转K线，那根K线试图结束从当日低点起的两段上涨。在第6根K线卖出那个低2的空头被套住了。


> Bar 8 is a High l long because it followed a bear reversal bar that tried to end two legs up from the low of the day. There were trapped shorts who sold the Low 2 at Bar 6.


![图 4.22](figures/fig-04-22.png)


**图 4.22　数K线变体：长影线也可以是一段行情**

> Bar 10 is a High 2 long (Bar 8 was the High 1) because it followed two attempts to sell off at the high of the day (Bars 7 and 10). Two attempts down is the same as a two-legged correction, so it is a High 2 long setup. You could also look at it as High 1 but since the prior six bars were largely sideways, it is reasonable to look at it as part of one pattern with Bar 7 being the first leg down.

图 4.24这张 SPY 的走势图展示了低2建仓形态的许多变体，但如果你逐一去想，每一个都是两段式空头修正合乎逻辑的终点。既然图表明显偏空（大多数K线都在下行的均线下方），交易者就在寻找做空入场的机会，所以任何看起来像低2的东西都够用了。

Since the chart is clearly bearish (most of the bars are below the falling EMA), traders are looking for opportunities to enter shorts, so anything that resembles a Low 2 is good enough.


第3根K线是低1，它的高点被第4根K线越过，使第4根K线成为第二次向上尝试，并构成那个在下一根K线触发的低2做空的建仓形态。


> Bar 3 is a Low 1, and its high is taken out by Bar 4, making Bar 4 a second attempt up and a setup for the Low 2 short that triggered on the next bar.


第6根K线是低1建仓形态，两根K线之后出现了一根多头趋势K线，说明有一段上涨。第7根K线是下一根K线做空的信号K线，尽管它比那个低1更低。它仍然是一次两段式修正。

第8根K线是向上修正中的一根小型空头趋势K线内包K线，因此它构成了一次很小的修正，结束了第一段上涨。第9根K线前面又是一根多头趋势K线（其实是两根），所以它是第二次向下尝试，实际上就是在均线附近的低2做空。


> Bar 8 was a small bear trend bar inside bar in an upward correction, and it therefore constitutes a tiny correction, ending the first leg up. Bar 9 followed another bull trend bar (actually two), so it is the second attempt down and effectively a Low 2 short near the EMA.


第11根K线比第10根K线低，所以它是涨到第12根K线那波行情的起点。为什么第12根K线顶部之后的那根K线是低2？第12根K线那根多头外包K线的低点，在它刚开盘之后就跌破了前一根K线，尽管这一点从这张图上看不出来，但看一张1分钟图（未给出）就能确定。这使第12根K线成为低1。外包K线会同时突破前一根K线的两侧，而你不知道它先突破的是哪一侧，不过它实体的方向通常是可靠的（例如，多头实体通常说明向上的突破发生在后，因为它的方向是向上直到收盘）。第12根K线之后的那根K线跌破第12根K线，所以这是从第11根K线起这段上涨中，第二次有K线跌破前一根K线的低点，因此是均线处的一次低2做空（一次 M2S）。


> Bar 1 1 is lower than Bar 10, so it is the start of the move up to Bar 12. Why is the bar after the Bar 12 top a Low 2? The low of the Bar 12 bull outside bar dipped below the prior bar just after Bar 12 opened, although you cannot tell from this chart, but you can tell for certain by looking at a 1-minute chart (not shown). This makes Bar 12 a Low 1. An outside bar breaks out of both sides of its prior bar, and you do not know which side it broke through first, although the direction of its body is usually reliable (for example, a bull body usually indicates that the upside breakout occurred second, since its direction is up into its close). The bar after Bar 12 broke below Bar 12, so it was the second time in this leg up from Bar 1 1 that a bar broke below the low of the prior bar and is therefore a Low 2 short at the EMA (an M2S).
