# 第 7 章　磁力位

*Chapter 7. Magnets*


本章与交易的关系很小，放在这里只是为了完整，因为它说明了一些价格行为的倾向；但这些倾向不够可靠，不足以成为交易的依据。如果你想学会怎么赚钱，就不要在这里花太多时间，而要把精力放在第15章的最佳交易上。


> This chapter has very little to do with trading and is included for completeness because it illustrates some price action tendencies, but these tendencies are not reliable enough to be the basis for trading. If you want to learn how to make money, do not spend much time here and instead focus on the best trades in Chapter 15.


有些价位会像磁铁一样，把市场吸向它们。当你意识到某个磁力位时，就把市场当作正在朝这个磁力位走趋势那样去交易，并且在磁力位被测试之前不要做逆势交易，除非先有一次清晰的趋势线突破、随后又有对趋势极值点的测试。通常市场会过靶这个磁力位然后反转，但在磁力位被测试之后，市场可以继续走趋势、可以形成交易区间、也可以反转，你必须等到更多价格行为出现，才能下下一笔单。当市场走出一段急速行情、随后出现回调时，它很可能会有第二段行情，而第二段行情常常与第一段大小大致相同。这有时候被称作 ABC 走势，或者 AB = CD（它是 ABC 的一种，只是 B、C、D 对应 ABC 里的 A、B、C）。这一点不太重要，因为你不该依据斐波那契扩展位、等距运动或任何其他磁力位挂限价单去反向操作这波行情。它们只是给你一个指引，让你在接近它们之前一直顺势交易；到了那一步，你也可以开始考虑逆势建仓形态。


> Some prices act as magnets, drawing the market toward them. When you become aware of a magnet, trade the market as if it is trending toward the magnet, and do not trade Countertrend until after the magnet is tested, unless there is a clear trendline break and then a test of the extreme. Usually the market will overshoot the magnet and reverse, but after the test of the magnet, the market can continue to trend, form a trading range, or reverse, and you must wait for more price action before placing your next trade. When a market makes a sharp move and then has a pullback, it will likely have a second leg, and the second leg is frequently approximately the same size as the first. This is sometimes called an ABC move or an AB = CD (a type of ABC but the B, C, and D correspond to the A, B, and C of the ABC). This is of minor importance because you should not be fading the move with a limit order based on Fibonacci extensions or Measured Moves or any other magnet. They just provide a guide to keep you trading With Trend until they are approached, and at that point you can consider Countertrend setups as well.


除了那些能构成等距运动的清晰回调入场之外，有时候还有一种更微妙、但同样有效的情形。当市场先走出一段强趋势行情、接着出现一段相当强的回调，然后开始形成交易区间时，交易者可以用这个区间大致的中部，来推算回调的第二段可能走到哪里。随着交易区间展开，不断调整你估算中点的位置；而等这波行情终于走完第二段之后，那个位置通常就在回调的中点附近。它只是提醒你：该在哪里预期趋势恢复的建仓形态。


> In addition to clear pullback entries that set up Measured Moves, sometimes there is a more subtle situation that is equally valid. When a market has a strong trend move and then a fairly strong pullback, which then begins to form a trading range, traders can use the approximate middle of the range to project where the second leg of the pullback might reach. As the trading range unfolds, keep adjusting the line where you estimate the midpoint to be, and that will usually be around the midpoint of the pullback once the move has finally completed its second leg. This just serves as a reminder of where you should be anticipating setups for a resumption of the trend.


在图 7.1中，XOM 从K线 A 到K线 B 是一段强势行情。在K线 C 形成更高的低点之后，交易者就应该只做多，以骑上第二段行情。K线 D 略微未及靶位（虚线的顶点）。一旦进入目标区域，交易者就可以考虑逆势交易。如果你要用 ABC 标注，那么K线 B 就是 A 点，K线 C 是 B 点，K线 D 是 C 点。


> XOM had a strong move from Bars A to B in Figure 7.1. After the Bar C Higher Low, a trader should be only on the long side to ride the second leg. Bar D slightly undershot the target (the top ofthe dashed line). Once in the area of the target, traders can consider Countertrend trades. If you were to use ABC labeling, Bar B is point A, Bar C is point B, and Bar D is point C.


等到K线 E 处出现更高的低点、上涨行情又突破了K线 D 之后，交易者就可以把 AD 看成包含两个更小行情段（AB 和 CD）的第一段行情，然后一路持多，直到出现一次向上的等距运动（AD = EF，目标位是实线的顶点）。


> Once there was a Higher Low at Bar E and the rally broke above bar D, a trader could look at AD as a first leg that contains two smaller legs (AB and CD), and then stay long until there was a Measured Move up (AD = EF, and the target is the top of the solid line).


斐波那契交易者也会把其他扩展位（62%、150%、162%，等等）当作寻找反转的有效区域，但这太复杂、也太粗略。倒不如凭最好的猜测来做，然后开始既考虑顺势建仓形态，也考虑逆势建仓形态。


> Fibonacci traders also look to other extensions (62 percent, 150 percent, 162 percent, and so on) as valid areas to look for reversals, but this is too complicated and approximate. It is just as easy to make a best guess and then begin to consider Countertrend setups in addition to With Trend.


![图 7.1](figures/fig-07-01.png)


**图 7.1　在接近等距运动区域之前保持顺势交易**


![图 7.2](figures/fig-07-02.png)


**图 7.2　从交易区间中部量出的等距运动**


在图 7.2中，RIMM 在一次开盘反转反转了昨天的低点之后（一次趋势通道线过靶并反转），急速拉起走到第2根K线，随后出现了一段回调。既然第二段上涨很可能出现，那么交易者若想知道它可能在哪里结束，就可以不断调整 B 线，让它落在正在成形的区间中部；等市场突破之后，再作一条平行线，从 A 线向上等距拖动，得到一次等距运动。这只是一个观察，与交易无关。它只是提醒你：市场很可能还要往上走第二段，因此在它进入等距运动区域之前，你对做多入场应该有轻微的偏向。不过，你本来就带着这个偏向，因为你预期这波行情，而且大多数K线都是多头趋势K线。


> RIMM had a sharp move up to Bar 2 in Figure 7.2 after an Opening Reversal reversed yesterday's low (a trend channel line overshoot and reversal), and then there was a pullback. Since a second leg up was likely, if a trader was interested in knowing where it might end, he could keep adjusting Line B to be in the middle of the developing range and then after the market breaks out, make a parallel and drag it equidistant up from Line A for a Measured Move. This is just an observation and has nothing to do with trading. It is simply a reminder that the market is likely to go up for a second leg, and you should have a slight bias toward long entries until it is in the area of the Measured Move. However, you already have that bias since you are expecting the move and most of the bars are bull trend bars.


回落到第3根K线的那次回调太深，所以很可能要走成交易区间；在市场突破三角形（第6根K线之上）之前，交易者可以双向交易，就像对待任何交易区间一样。这是一点小事，却是个有意思的观察，能帮你在市场的正确一侧交易。不过，如果你在交易时为了琢磨它花了一秒以上，你很可能正在错过好的建仓形态。这一节放在这里，只是因为这个价格行为现象很常见，它并不是交易的依据。


> The pullback to Bar 3 was so deep that a trading range was likely, and until the market broke out of the triangle (above Bar 6) traders could trade in both directions, as with any trading range. This is a minor point but an interesting observation that can help you to be trading on the correct side of the market. However, if you are spending more than a second thinking about it while trading, you are likely missing good setups. This section is simply here because it is a common price action phenomenon and it is not a basis for trading.


突破之后形成的区域往往有两种：要么是薄区（thin area）——因为动能强劲，市场很快冲到突破位之外很远，K线之间没有重叠或只有极少重叠；要么是厚区（fat area）——一个小型交易区间。两者的中点常常会成为整段行情的中点。厚区是一个交易区间，也就是多空双方对价格达成共识的区域，它的中部就是多空双方认为公道的价位的中部。薄区同样是一个共识区：它是多空双方一致认为不该发生交易的区域，它的中部就是那个区域的中点。无论哪一种，从简单的层面看，如果这些价位是多空共识的中点，它们就大致能指认所包含的那段行情的中点。它们一旦形成，就把顺势入场的一部分或全部拿成波段持仓。等目标位临近时，如果有好的建仓形态，就考虑逆势入场。大多数交易者用先前那个交易区间的高度来测量，这没问题，因为不管你怎么算，精确距离都只是近似的（除非你是斐波那契或艾略特波浪交易者，并且有一种不可思议的本事，能说服自己相信市场几乎总是造出完美的形态——哪怕反面的证据铺天盖地）。关键在于只做顺势；但一旦市场进入等距运动区域，你就可以开始找逆势入场。不过，最好的那些逆势入场总是出现在趋势线突破之后。


> A breakout often forms either a thin area, where there are no overlapping bars or minimal overlap as the strong momentum carries the market quickly well beyond the breakout, or a fat area, where there is a small trading range. The midpoint of both often becomes the midpoint of the move. The fat area is a trading range, which is an area of agreement on price, and its middle is the middle of what bulls and bears think is fair. A thin area is an area of agreement as well. It is an area where the bulls and bears agree that no trading should take place, and its middle is the midpoint of that area. In both cases, on a simplistic level, if those prices are a midpoint of agreement between bulls and bears, they are a rough guide to the midpoint of the leg that contains them. Once they form, swing part or all of the With Trend entries. Once the target is approached, consider Countertrend entries if there is a good setup. Most traders use the height of the prior trading range for measuring, which is fine because the exact distance is only approximate no matter how you do it (unless you are a Fibonacci or Elliott Wave trader and have the uncanny ability to convince yourself that the market almost always creates perfect patterns, despite the overwhelming evidence to the contrary). The key is to trade only With Trend, but once the market is in the area of the Measured Move, you can begin to look for Countertrend entries. However, the best ones always follow a trendline break.


如果等距运动走完之后市场再次停顿，就把这两段强趋势行情看成一次更高时间级别修正可能的终点，而不是一段5分钟K线图趋势的终点，然后计划把任何逆势入场的一部分拿成波段。两段行情往往就能走完一波走势，并且通常至少会带来一次拖得很久的、至少两个更小行情段的逆势行情，有时候还会带来一段新的、方向相反的趋势。这段逆势行情很可能会测试位于等距运动中部那个交易区间。


> If the market pauses again after the Measured Move has occurred, look at these two strong trend legs as a possible end of a higher timeframe correction instead of the end of a 5-minute bar chart trend, and then plan to swing part of any Countertrend entry. Two legs often complete a move and usually result in at least a protracted Countertrend move of at least two smaller legs, and sometimes a new, opposite trend. The Countertrend move will likely test the trading range that was at the middle of the Measured Move.


有时候这些推算精确到 tick，但多数时候市场会未及靶位或过靶目标位。这套办法只是一个指引，让你在市场的正确一侧交易。


> Sometimes the projections are exact to the tick, but most of the time the market undershoots or overshoots the target. This approach is only a guideline to keep you trading on the correct side of the market.


图 7.3里有等距运动的这两天，都在图上形成了薄区。薄区是突破区域，其中K线之间基本没有重叠。


> Two days with Measured Moves in Figure 7.3 form thin areas on the chart. A thin area is a breakout area where there is essentially no overlap of the bars.


FOMC 报告公布时，市场从第3根K线起急速上冲（太平洋时间（PST）上午11:15），并突破了当天第2根K线的高点。第4根K线处的旗形用一次两段式横盘修正测试了这个突破，但在这个旗形上做出高2做多之后，市场在第2根K线顶点与第4根K线底部之间留下了一个薄区。第4根K线这个交易区间也是一个小厚区，可以用来做等距运动。你可以用第1根K线或第3根K线的低点来计算这次等距运动。市场触及了由 A 线（第1根K线）到 B 线的等距运动所定的 C 线目标，时点恰好落在当天最后一根K线上；第二天开盘时，又用第3根K线到 B 线的投影向上刺穿了 D 线目标。尽管第1根K线高于第3根K线，仍可以把它看作这次等距运动的底部——只要把跌到第3根K线的抛售想成是对这一段行情中第1根K线实际低点的过靶。


> The market had a sharp move up from Bar 3 on the FOMC report at 1 1:15 A.M. PST and broke above the Bar 2 high of the day. The flag at Bar 4 tested the breakout with a two-legged sideways correction, but after the High 2 long from this flag the market was left with a thin area between the top of Bar 2 and the bottom of Bar 4. The Bar 4 trading range is also a small fat area that could be used for the Measured Move. You could use either the low of Bar 1 or Bar 3 to calculate the Measured Move. The market reached the Line C target from the Line A (Bar 1) to the Line B Measured Move exactly on the last bar of the day and poked above the Line D target using the Bar 3 to Line B projection on the open of the next day. Even though Bar 1 is higher than Bar 3, it can still be considered the bottom of the Measured Move by thinking of the selloff to Bar 3 as just an overshoot of the Bar 1 actual low of the leg.


![图 7.3](figures/fig-07-03.png)


**图 7.3　依据薄区算出的等距运动**


第二天，在第7根K线之下、第8根K线之上出现了一个薄区，而 F 线目标位在临近收盘时被超过。


> On the second day, there was a thin area below Bar 7 and above Bar 8, and the Line F target was exceeded just before the close.


顺便一提，那里还有一个双顶熊旗（第8根和第9根K线）。图 7.4中跌向第3根K线附近那个突破回调旗形的行情很陡，向下等距运动的一个合理目标位，是从这段行情的顶部（第2根K线）量到旗形的大致中部（C 线）。它指向 D 线，而 D 线被过靶，并导致了一次对均线的测试。你也可以用第1根K线的高点来测量，但你一般应该先看当前这一段行情的起点，作为你的第一个目标位。D 线目标位到达之后没多久，以第1根K线为起点的 E 线目标位也被打到了。注意，从第2根K线跌到第4根K线是一段强空头行情，中间没有明显的趋势线突破，所以最好坚持顺势建仓形态。


> Incidentally, there was also a Double Top Bear Flag (Bars 8 and 9). The move down to the Breakout Pullback flag around Bar 3 in Figure 7.4 was steep, and a reasonable target for a Measured Move down is from the top of the leg (Bar 2) to the approximate middle of the flag (Line C). This projected to Line D, which was overshot and led to an EMA test. You could also have used the Bar 1 high for a measurement, but you should generally look at the start of the current leg for your first target. After the Line D target was reached, the Line E target based on the Bar 1 starting point was hit soon afterwards. Note that the move down to Bar 4 from Bar 2 was a strong bear with no significant trendline break, so it was best to stick to With Trend setups.


从第4根K线起的这三根K线上涨突破了一条小趋势线，构成一次小级别的、可能的最终旗形失败；但由于至今还没有出现急速上涨（比如均线之上的一根缺口K线），逆势交易如果你要做，也只能当剥头皮做。只有当你足够优秀、能在一出现顺势交易机会时立刻切换过去，你才该做这些逆势交易。如果你做不到，你就不该做逆势交易，而应该下功夫去做顺势入场。仅仅处在等距运动区域，并不足以构成逆势入场的理由。你需要此前出现过一些逆势的强势表现。


> The three-bar rally from Bar 4 broke a minor trendline and setup a minor possible Final Failed Flag, but since there has yet to be a sharp rally (like a gap bar above the EMA), Countertrend trades have to be scalps if you take them at all. You should only take them if you are a good enough trader to then switch to With Trend trades as soon as one develops. If you cannot, you should not be trading Countertrend, and instead you should be working hard to take With Trend entries. Just being in the area of a Measured Move is not enough reason for a Countertrend entry. You need some earlier Countertrend strength.


![图 7.4](figures/fig-07-04.png)


**图 7.4　依据突破回调旗形算出的等距运动**


第二天，突破之后在第10根K线附近出现了一个旗形，它向上推算到 H 线（用第9根K线作起点）。如果你改用当天第7根K线的低点，那么目标位本可以在次日跳空高开之后不久就到达。


> On the second day, there was a flag around Bar 10 after the breakout, and this projected up to Line H (using Bar 9 as the starting point). If instead you used the Bar 7 low of the day, the target would have been reached shortly after the gap up on the following day . .


一旦出现突破旗形，明智的做法就是把顺势持仓的一部分拿成波段，一直持到等距运动到达。到那一步，如果有好的建仓形态，就考虑做一次逆势交易。


> Once there is a breakout flag, it is wise to swing part of your With Trend trade until the Measured Move is reached. At that point, consider a Countertrend trade if there is a good setup.


图 7.5中的 B 线，是突破位（第2根K线的高点）与首次回调的低点（第5根K线的低点）之间那个薄区的中点；这次等距运动在第8根K线处精确到 tick 被打到。


> Line B in Figure 7.5 is the midpoint of the thin area in between the breakout (the high of Bar 2) and the low of the First Pullback (the low of Bar 5) and the Measured Move was hit to the exact tick at Bar 8.


E 线是某个薄区的中点，而市场大幅过靶了它推算出的 F 线。从第12根K线熊旗出发的突破，向下一直延伸到第13根K线，形成一个大薄区，但当时已临近收盘，从这个薄区中点算出的等距运动不太可能出现。不过到那个时候，当天显然是一个空头趋势日，交易者只应该做空，除非出现一次清晰有力的做多剥头皮（最后一小时里有那么两次）。


> Line E was the midpoint of a thin area, and the market greatly overshot its line F projection. The breakout from the Bar 12 bear flag had a huge thin area down to Bar 13, but it was so late in the day that a Measured Move from its midpoint was unlikely. However, at that point the day was clearly a bear trend day, and traders should only be shorting unless there is a clear and strong long scalp (there were a couple in the final hour).


走到第7根K线的那波行情突破了一条趋势线，说明空头正在变强；走到第9根K线的那波行情突破了主要趋势线，构成第10根K线那个更低的高点对趋势极值点（第8根K线）的测试，以及随后展开的空头行情。


> The move to Bar 7 broke a trendline, indicating that the bears were getting stronger, and the move to Bar 9 broke a major trendline, setting up the Bar 10 Lower High test ofthe trend extreme (Bar 8), and the subsequent bear that followed.


![图 7.5](figures/fig-07-05.png)


**图 7.5　依据突破区域中部算出的等距运动**


先前失败的反转，往往会给最终成功的反转提供目标位。举例来说，如果市场处在空头里，期间有过几次做多入场、都随着市场继续抛售而失败，那么一旦向上反转最终成功，这些入场价（每根信号K线的高点）就都会成为目标位。市场常常会一路涨到最高的那根信号K线的高点，才会出现一次像样的回调。


> Prior failed reversals often provide targets for the successful reversal when it finally comes. For example, if there is a bear and there have been several bull entries that failed as the market continued to sell off, each of these entry prices (the high of each signal bar) will be targets once the reversal up finally succeeds. The market will often rally all the way to the highest signal bar's high before having a significant pullback.


弄明白这背后的原因并不重要。关键是要意识到：市场测试完那些更早的信号K线之后，往往会回调。很可能的情况是，一些照着那些信号入场的交易者在市场反向运动时开始分批建仓，然后把自己第一笔入场当作最后的止盈目标——在最差的那笔入场价上保本离场，而在其余所有入场价上止盈。


> It is not important to understand why this happens. The key is to realize that the market will tend to pullback after it tests those earlier signal bars. It is likely that some traders who entered on those signals scaled in as the market went against them and they then used their initial entry as their final profit target, exiting breakeven on their worst entry and taking profits on all of the other entries.


对很多交易者来说，这是一个有点像“谢天谢地，我再也不干这种事了！”的价位。你没有止损离场，亏损越滚越大，你一直盼着市场回到你的入场价。等它终于回来了，你出场，并发誓再也不犯这个错误。也许只是聪明的交易者相信事情就是这样，会在那些目标位抛掉自己的多头；也许它本来就是优秀交易者都懂的那些秘密握手之一——他们在那儿出场，只是因为他们知道，回调结束在更早的入场点附近，是个可靠且反复出现的形态。另外，既然市场早些时候在这些价位上失败过，交易者就会据此布局，认为市场可能再次失败，从而让这次修正结束在这些价位上。


> For many traders, it is something of a "Thank you, God, I will never do this again!" price. You did not exit a loser and your loss keeps growing and you keep hoping for the market to come back to your entry. When it finally does, you exit and swear that you will never make that mistake again. It might just be that smart traders believe this to be the case and will dump their longs at those targets, or it might simply be one of the many secret handshakes that great traders all know, and they exit there simply because they know that it is a reliable recurring pattern for pullbacks to end near earlier entry points. Also, since the market failed at these points earlier, traders will position themselves believing that the market might again fail, causing the correction to end at these prices.


![图 7.6](figures/fig-07-06.png)


**图 7.6　先前失败的反转，往往是反转最终成立之后的目标位**


图 7.6中 SPY（标普500的 ETF）的月线图有一段强多头行情在2000年结束，但它在上涨途中多次尝试反转。每一个空头信号K线的低点，都会成为下跌途中任何修正的目标位。


> The monthly chart of the SPY in Figure 7.6 had a strong bull that ended in 2000, but it had several attempts to reverse on the way up. Each of the bear signal bar lows becomes a target for any correction on the way down.


同样，在2003年结束的那段空头里，有多次失败的多头反转尝试，而每根信号K线的高点都会成为之后任何上涨行情的目标位。


> Likewise, the bear that ended in 2003 had several failed bull reversal attempts, and the high of each signal bar becomes a target for any subsequent rally.


最后，2003年以来的上涨行情里有多次失败的空头尝试，在当前这波下跌中，每一个都是目标位。


> Finally, the rally since 2003 had several failed bear attempts, and each one is a target in the current downswing.


这些目标位没有一个非得到达，但每一个都是强磁力位，常常把市场吸回它的位置。还有许多其他的价格磁力位，会倾向于把市场吸过去测试。下面列出其中一些，其中许多在本书前面已经讨论过。当市场正朝某个磁力位走趋势时，明智的做法是顺势交易，直到这个磁力位被测试、最好是过靶为止。不要在磁力位上做逆势交易，除非此前已经出现过一些逆势的强势表现，比如一次趋势线突破。


> N one of the targets ever has to be reached, but each is a strong magnet that frequently draws the market back to its level. There are many other price magnets that will tend to draw the market toward them for a test. Here is a list of some of them, and many of these have been discussed earlier in the book. When a market is trending toward a magnet, it is prudent to trade With Trend until the magnet is tested and preferably overshot. Do not trade Countertrend at the magnet unless there has been some prior Countertrend strength, like a trendline break.


- 趋势线。


> - Trendlines.


- 趋势通道线。


> - Trend Channel Lines.


- 斐波那契回撤位与扩展位。


> - Fibonacci retracements and extensions.


- 急速与通道：通道的起点通常会在两三天内被测试。这之后往往是通道区域里的一段盘整（随着交易区间展开，它的顶部和底部与通道的顶部和底部大致相同）。


> - Spike and Channel: the start of the channel is usually tested within a couple days. This is often followed by a period of consolidation within the area of the channel (as the trading range unfolds, its top and bottom are about the same as the top and bottom of the channel).


- 最终旗形失败：从旗形突破之后，市场会回到旗形，并且通常会从另一侧突破出去。


> - Failed Final Flags: after the breakout from the flag, the market comes back to the flag and usually breaks out of the other side.


- 昨天的最高价与最低价。


> - High and Low of yesterday.


- 最近几天的摆动高点与摆动低点。


> - Swing highs and lows of the past few days.


- 突破点。


> - Breakout points.


- 每一种回调之后的趋势极值点（见关于首次回调序列的那一章）。


> - The extreme of a trend after every type of pullback (see the chapter on the First Pullback Sequence).


- 交易区间，包括窄幅交易区间与铁丝网：它的两端和中部常常会被测试。


> - Trading ranges, including Tight Trading Ranges and Barb Wire: the extremes and the middle often get tested.


- 入场K线与信号K线的保护性止损。


> - Entry bar and signal bar protective stops.


- 入场价（突破回测）。


> - Entry price (Breakout Test).


- 巨大趋势K线的相反一端极值（一根巨大多头趋势K线的低点，以及一根巨大空头趋势K线的高点）。


> - Huge trend bar opposite extreme (the low of a huge bull trend bar and the high of a huge bear trend bar).


- 剥头皮与波段持仓的常见目标位：在 AAPL 上，是50美分和一美元；在 Emini 小型合约上，是做4个 tick 的剥头皮时赚5-6个 tick，以及两段式逆势行情赚3或4点。


> - Common targets for scalp and swing positions: in AAPL, 50 cents and a dollar; in the Emini, 5-6 ticks for a 4-tick scalp, and 3 or 4 points for a 2-legged Countertrend move.


- 所需止损的两倍（如果一笔 Emini 交易需要你用12个 tick 的止损才能避免被打掉，那就预期这波行情会从你的入场价延伸大约12个 tick。）


> - Double the required stop (if an Emini trade required you to use a 12-tick stop to avoid getting stopped out, expect the move to extend about 12 ticks from your entry.


12个 tick 的止损来避免被打掉，那就预期这波行情会从你的入场点延伸约12个 tick。


> 12-tick stop to avoid getting stopped out, expect the move to extend about 12 ticks from your entry.


- 日线、周线和月线的摆动高点与低点、K线高点与低点、均线、缺口、斐波那契回撤位与扩展位，以及趋势线。


> - Daily, Weekly, and Monthly swing highs and lows, bar highs and lows, moving averages, gaps, Fibonacci retracements and extensions, and trendlines.


- 情绪数字，比如股票里的整数百位（如 AAPL 的100）和道指的整数千位（道指12,000）。如果一只股票很快从


> - Emotional numbers like hundreds in stocks (such as AAPL at 100) and thousands in the Dow (Dow 12,000). If a stock quickly moves from


50涨到88，它很可能会试着去测试100。当出现一根影线很短的巨大趋势K线时，在当根K线或紧接着入场的交易者往往会把保护性止损放到这根K线之外。市场慢慢磨向那些止损、然后朝趋势K线的方向折返回来，这是相当常见的。


> 50 to 88, it will likely try to test 100. When there is a huge trend bar with small tails, traders who enter on the bar or soon afterwards will often put their protective stops beyond the bar. It is fairly common for the market to work its way to those stops and then reverse back in the direction of the trend bar.

Here, however, Bar 3 tried to form a trading range in the area of the Bar 2 low, but it failed, and this resulted in close to a measured move down.


# 第 8 章　趋势反转

*Chapter 8. Trend Reversals*


本书最要紧的一条规则是：在一条重要的趋势线被突破之前，你连想都不该去想逆着趋势做交易。而且即便趋势线已经突破，你仍然应该继续寻找顺势交易，因为在这第一波逆势冲击之后，市场几乎总会回到趋势的方向上去测试旧的趋势极值。只有在极少数情况下，趋势线突破的动能强到连一次剥头皮都做不了。如果市场在旧极值的价位上再次失败，那它就等于两次尝试突破该价位都没成功，而每当市场两次尝试做某件事却失败时，它通常会转而尝试相反的方向。正是在这次对旧极值的测试之后，你才应该去找逆势交易，而且前提是价格离开旧极值反转时出现了好的建仓形态。


> The single most important rule in this book is that you should never even be thinking about trading against a trend until after there has been a break of a significant trendline. And even then, you should still be looking for With Trend trades because after this first countertrend surge, the market almost always goes back in the direction of the trend to test the old .trend extreme. Only rarely is the trendline break on such strong momentum that the test won't be tradable for at least a scalp. If the market fails again at the price of the old extreme, then it has made two attempts to push through that level and failed, and whenever the market tries twice to do something and fails, it usually tries the opposite. It is after this test of the old extreme that you should look for countertrend trades and only if there is a good setup on the reversal away from the old extreme.


趋势反转，或者简称反转，未必是真正的反转。它可以是多头趋势转为空头趋势，或反过来；也可以是多头或空头趋势转为交易区间，或者交易区间转为多头或空头趋势。它可以简单到只是一次趋势线突破。新趋势可能持续很久，也可能只限一根K线。市场也可能在一两根K线之后只是横盘飘移，之后无论向上还是向下又走出趋势。许多技术分析师除非在事后、在一系列带趋势的高点与低点形成之后，否则不会使用“反转”这个词。然而这对交易没有用，因为等它出现会让风险回报比变得更差，趋势持续得越久，出现一次显著回调的可能性就越大。一旦交易者开始顺着与趋势相反的方向建仓，这位交易者就已经认为趋势反转了，哪怕严格的标准还没有满足。例如，如果他在空头中买进，他就相信市场很可能连一个 tick 都不会再往下走，否则他会等到更低再买。既然他买进时相信市场会走得更高，他就认为现在的趋势是向上的，因此反转已经发生。


> A Trend Reversal, or simply a reversal, is not necessarily an actual reversal. It can be a change from a bull trend to a bear trend or vice versa, or from a bull or bear trend to a trading range, or from a trading range to either a bull or bear trend. It can be as simple as a trendline break. The new trend may be protracted or limited to a single bar. The market may also simply drift sideways after a bar or two, and then trend again later either up or down. Many technicians will not use the term "reversal" except in hindsight, after a series of trending highs and lows has formed. However, this is not useful in trading because waiting for that to occur will result in a worse risk-reward ratio, since a significant pullback becomes more likely the longer a trend has been in effect. Once a trader is initiating trades in the opposite direction to the trend, that trader believes that the trend has reversed even thought the strict criteria have not yet been met. For example, if he is buying in a bear, he believes that the market will likely not even trade a single tick lower, otherwise he would wait to buy. Since he is buying with the belief that the market will go higher, he believes the trend is now up and therefore a reversal has taken place.


许多技术分析师不会接受这个定义，因为它不要求趋势的一些基本组成部分存在。大多数人会同意趋势反转有两个要求。第一个是绝对要求：这波行情必须突破先前趋势的趋势线。第二个要求大多数时候会出现，但不是必须的：趋势线突破之后，市场回来并成功测试旧趋势的极值。在极少数情况下，会出现一波高潮反转，它最初的一段行情持续很久，而且从未接近测试旧极值。


> Many technicians will not accept this definition, because it does not require some basic components of a trend to exist. Most would agree on two requirements for a trend reversal. The first is an absolute requirement: the move has to break a trendline from the prior trend. The second requirement happens most of the time but is not required: after the trendline break, the market comes back and successfully tests the extreme of the old trend. Rarely, there can be a climactic reversal that has a protracted initial move and never comes close to testing the old extreme.


大家一致认为，一旦多头中出现一系列高点与低点不断抬升、空头中出现低点与高点不断下移的走势，新趋势就已经成立。通常，最初的那段行情会突破趋势线，然后形成一次回调来测试旧趋势的终点，交易者会在这次测试之后寻找逆势（实际上是顺势，即顺着新趋势方向）的仓位。这次测试可能未及前一个极值，也可能过靶，但不会超出太多。例如，如果先有一段空头趋势，随后一波急速上涨远远越过空头趋势线，交易者会想在第一次回调时买进，期待这是众多更高的低点中的第一个。不过，有时回调会跌破空头趋势的低点，把新多头的止损打掉。如果这个更低的低点在几根K线之内反转回升，它可以带来一波强劲的波段上涨。但是，如果这个更低的低点跌到先前低点下方太远，最好等待下一次趋势线突破、向上的动能喷发，然后再等一个更高的低点或更低的低点回调，才重新做多。


> Everyone agrees that a new trend is present once there is then a series of trending Higher Highs and Lows in a bull and Lower Lows and Highs in a bear. Typically, the initial move will break the trendline and then form a pullback that tests the end of the old trend, and traders will look to initiate Countertrend (actually With Trend, in the direction of the new trend) positions after this test. The test may fall short of the prior extreme, or it may exceed it, but not by too much. For example, if there is a bear trend and then a sharp move upward that extends well beyond the bear trendline, traders will look to buy on the First Pullback, hoping for the first of many Higher Lows. However, sometimes the pullback extends below the low of the bear trend, running stops on the new longs. If this Lower Low reverses back up within a few bars, it can lead to a strong swing up. If, however, the Lower Low extends too far below the prior low, it is best to wait for another trendline break, upward momentum surge, and then a Higher or Lower Low pullback before going long again.


尽管交易者喜欢在新多头中买进第一个更高的低点，或在新空头中卖出第一个更低的高点（此前必须先有一条重要空头趋势线被突破），但如果趋势良好，就会出现一系列带趋势性波段的回调（多头中是不断抬升的高点与低点，空头中是不断下移的高点与低点），而每一次回调都可能提供绝佳的入场。第一次回调，例如新多头中的第一个更高的低点，可能是对空头低点的测试，也可能是对某个突破的测试（突破的关键点位如趋势线、先前的摆动点、交易区间或均线），而且它可能不会非常接近空头低点。


> Although traders love to buy the first Higher Low in a new bull or sell the first Lower High in a new bear (there first must have been a break of a significant bear trendline), if the trend is good, there will be a series of pullbacks with trending swings (Higher Highs and Lows in a bull and Lower Highs and Lows in a bear), and each pullback can provide an excellent entry. The first pullback, for example, the first Higher Low in a new bull, can be a test of the bear low or a test of a breakout (of a key point like a trendline, prior swing point, trading range, or the moving average) and may not get very close to the bear low.


大多数趋势都以趋势通道被突破而结束。例如，多头通常以两种方式之一结束。要么多头的趋势通道线被过靶、突破失败，随后向下反转，再跌破多头趋势线；要么市场在没有先过靶趋势通道线的情况下，直接跌破多头趋势线。如果多头以趋势通道线突破失败收场，通常会有两段下跌，而第一次回调几乎总会形成一个更低的高点（只有在极少数情况下才是更高的高点）作为对多头高点的测试。另一方面，如果多头以趋势线突破结束，对多头高点的测试既可以是更高的高点，也可以是更低的高点，两种情况出现的频率大体相当，都很常见。既然至少应有两段下跌，更高的高点之后应该跟着两段下跌，而更低的高点之后可能只有一段下跌，因为在更低的高点形成之前，第一段下跌已经发生过了。如果市场在对旧极值的测试中形成更高的高点，最佳交易之一就是卖出第一个更低的高点，那是对更高高点的测试。在空头中，在一次更低的低点反转之后（显然是在一波向上动能喷发突破一条主要趋势线之后），买进第一个更高的低点是必须的，因为这强化了大底已成立的前提。


> Most trends end with a breakout of a trend channel. For example, a bull typically ends in one of two ways. Either there is an overshoot of the bull trend channel line that fails and is followed by a reversal down and then a break below the bull trendline, or the market can fall through the bull trendline without first overshooting the trend channel line. If the bull ends with a failed breakout of the trend channel line, there will typically be two legs down, and the first pullback will almost always form a Lower High (and only rarely a Higher High) as its test of the bull high. On the other hand, if the bull ends with a trendline break, the test of the bull high can either be a Higher High or a Lower High and each occurs about equally frequently. Since at least two legs down are to be expected, a Higher High should be followed by two legs down, and a Lower High may be followed by a single leg, since the first leg down already occurred just before the Lower High formed. If the market forms a Higher High in its test of the old extreme, one of the best trades is to sell the first Lower High, which is a test of the Higher High. In a bear after a Lower Low reversal (obviously after an upward momentum surge that broke a major trendline), it is imperative to buy the first Higher Low because this reinforces the premise that a major bottom is in.


一个重要之处在于，趋势持续的时间比大多数交易者能想象的都要长得多。正因为如此，大多数反转形态都失败（其中一些会变成延续形态），而大多数延续形态都成功。交易者基于反转形态做逆势交易时必须非常小心，不过确实有一些价格行为建仓形态能大幅提高获利交易的概率。


> An important point is that trends last much longer than most traders would ever imagine. Because of that, most reversal patterns fail (and some become continuation setups), and most continuation patterns succeed. Traders have to be very careful when trading Countertrend based on a reversal pattern, but there are Price Action setups that greatly increase the chances of a profitable trade.


如果你发现自己画了很多条趋势通道线，那你就是太急于找到反转，很可能正在错过很多绝佳的顺势交易。另外，由于在强趋势中大多数趋势通道线过靶与反转都是小级别的、最终都失败，你会做进很多亏损单，并且纳闷这些形态明明应该那么好，为什么还会失败。等趋势线破位之后再去找逆势交易，同时把所有那些小级别的趋势通道线过靶都看成顺势建仓形态，在亏损者按保护性止损出场的价位入场。你会开心得多、放松得多、也富有得多，而且你会觉得有趣：这些做法直觉上不该奏效，实际却效果那么好。


> If you find yourself drawing many trend channel lines, then you are too eager to find a reversal and are likely missing lots of great With Trend trades. Also, since most trend channel line overshoots and reversals are minor in a strong trend and fail, you will be trading lots of losers and wondering why these patterns are failing when they are supposed to be so good. Wait for a trendline break before looking for a countertrend trade and look at all those minor trend channel line overshoots as With Trend setups, and enter where the losers are exiting on their protective stops. You will be much happier, relaxed, and richer, and you will be entertained by how well they work when intuitively they should not.


在多头趋势中，买方会一直买进，直到他们认为风险回报比不再像他们希望的那样有利，这时他们就开始分批止盈。随着市场继续上涨，他们会继续多止盈一些，并且在出现回调之前不会再急着买进。同时，随着市场持续走高，空头被挤出市场，被迫买回自己的空头仓位。到了某个时点，他们想平回的头寸都平完了，他们的买盘也就停止了。还有一些动量交易者，只要动能良好就会继续买进，但一旦动能放缓，这些交易者会迅速止盈。


> In a bull trend, buyers continue to buy until they decide that the risk-reward ratio is no longer as favorable as they would like it to be, and at that point they will begin to take partial profits. As the market continues to rise, they will continue to take more profits and will not be eager to buy again until there is a pullback. Also, shorts are being squeezed out of the market as the market continues upward, and they are being forced to buy back their short positions. At some point, they will have covered all that they wish to cover, and their buying will stop. There will also be momentum traders who will continue to buy as long as there is good momentum, but these traders will be quick to take profits once the momentum slows.


那么，在多头中买进最后一个 tick、或在空头中卖出最低点的是谁？是不是无数小交易者被卷进恐慌、被挤出市场，或者一时冲动买进快速上涨的多头的累积效应？要是我们的影响力能那么大就好了！很久以前或许是那样，但在今天的市场里不是。如果当天的高点和低点上有那么大的成交量，而机构占了其中大部分，那么他们既然那么聪明，为什么还要买进当天的最高一个 tick？当天成交量中很大一部分、甚至可能大部分，是由数学模型驱动的，其中一些模型会一直买进，直到趋势明确改变，只有到那时才会反手做空。它们会一直买到多头的最后一个 tick，也会一路做空到空头的最低点，因为这些系统的设计者已经认定这种做法能让利润最大化。由于它们交易的是如此巨大的成交量，高点上有充足的买盘来承接顶部涌入的大量空头成交（底部反之亦然）。它们很聪明、成交量很大，并不意味着它们一天能赚5%。事实上，其中最好的那些每天净赚百分之零点几，而有些已经认定，继续买进——甚至包括买进当天的最高一个 tick——才能让它们的利润最大化。许多机构还有涉及期权及其他产品的复杂策略，在当天极值处究竟有哪些因素在起作用，是无法弄清的。例如，它们可能预期向下反转，因而建立一笔 Delta 中性价差，买进一份 Emini 同时买进两份 Emini 平值看跌期权。它们只有在市场连续几天在一个极窄的区间里横盘时才会亏钱。如果市场上涨，看跌期权亏钱的速度慢于 Emini 增值的速度。如果市场下跌，看跌期权增值的速度快于多头 Emini 的贬值速度，它们的这个中性价差就越来越像一笔看空的交易。这样它们就能获利，哪怕它们是在当天最高处买进的 Emini。你只需要知道，极值处有巨大的成交量，而且这些成交量来自机构，其中一些在买进高点，另一些则在卖出高点。


> So who is buying that last tick in a bull or selling the low of a bear? Is it the cumulative effect of countless small traders who are getting caught up in the panic and are being squeezed out or instead are impulsively buying a rapidly rising bull? If only we could be so influential! That might have been the case long ago, but not in today's market. If there is so much volume at the high and low of the day and the institutions make up most of that volume, why would they buy the high tick of the day if they are so smart? A large percentage and possibly the majority of the day's volume is driven by mathematical models, and some of those models will continue to buy until there is a clear trend change, and only then will they reverse to the short side. They will buy right up to the last tick of a bull and short to the very low of a bear because the designers of the systems have determined that this approach maximizes their profit. Because they trade such huge volume, there is an ample supply of buying at the high to take the other side of the huge volume of shorts that is coming in at the top (and vice versa at the bottom). Just because they are very smart and trade huge volume does not mean that they are making a 5 percent profit a day. In fact, the best of them are netting a fraction of a percent each day, and some of them have determined that that their profit is maximized by continuing to buy, even including the high tick of the day. Many also have complex strategies involving options and other products, and it is impossible to know what all the factors are at play at the extremes of the day. For example, they might be expecting a reversal down and be entering a delta neutral spread where they would buy one Emini and buy two Emini at-the-money puts. They only lose if the market goes sideways in a very tight range for several days. If the market goes up, the puts will lose money at a slower rate than the rate at which the Emini gains in value. If the market falls, the puts will increase in value faster than the long Emini will fall in value, and their neutral spread becomes increasingly more of a bear play. This will allow them to profit, even though they bought the Emini at the high of the day. All that you need to know is that there is huge volume at the extremes, and it is coming from institutions, some of which are buying the high while others are selling it.


顺带一提，还有一个常见的迹象能说明数学化、计算机生成的交易有多活跃。只要看看相关联的市场，比如 Emini 和 SPY 这类所有相关 ETF，你就会发现它们基本上是逐 tick 同步波动的。其他相关联的市场也是如此。如果这些是人工做出来的，不可能全天都如此完美地同步。同样，除非有很大一部分交易是计算机生成的，图表形态也不会在所有时间级别上都那么完美，甚至一路完美到tick 级别的图表上。人在那么多市场里同时分析并下出那么快的单子，根本做不到，所以这种完美必然是计算机生成交易的结果，而且它们必然占了交易的很大一部分，甚至可能是大部分。


> Incidentally, there is one other common sign of just how active mathematical, computer-generated trading is. Just look at correlated markets, like the Emini and all of the related ETFs like the SPY, and you will see that they basically move tick for tick. This is also true for other related markets. This could not be taking place so perfectly all day long if it was being done manually. Also, chart patterns would not be as perfect as they are on all time frames, even down to tick charts, unless a huge volume of the trading was computer generated. People simply cannot analyze and place orders that quickly in so many markets simultaneously, so the perfection has to be the result of computer-generated trades, and they must make up a large part, if not a majority, of the trading.


当出现没有显著回调的强趋势时，人们常常会开始寻找一个小的反转，因为常识告诉我们，随着交易者开始分批止盈、足够的逆势交易者建立新仓位，市场迟早必须回调。交易者得决定：是去找一次逆势剥头皮更好，还是等回调结束、然后顺着趋势方向入场更好。如果趋势很强，通常最好是只在出现明确的趋势反转迹象时才做逆势，比如此前已有趋势线突破，随后一次测试以强势反转K线收场。然而，想做点什么的诱惑很大，许多交易者会开始看更小时间级别的图表，比如1分钟图、3分钟图或100 tick 图。随着趋势推进，小时间级别的图表会不断形成反转，而这些反转绝大多数都失败。交易者可以用这样的想法为自己的逆势交易找理由：1分钟图的K线很小，所以风险只有大约4个 tick，而如果这恰好就是市场的最高点，潜在收益就巨大。因此，吃几次小亏是值得的。结果每次都是，这几次小亏变成六次七次，合在一起造成的亏损是当天稍后无法补回的。而每次他们运气好、正好挑中趋势的终点时，他们又会赚几个 tick 就剥头皮出场，而不是按原计划把交易拿很远。死于数学。


> When there is a strong trend with no significant pullbacks, it is common to start looking for a small reversal because common sense dictates that the market will eventually have to pullback as traders begin to take partial profits and enough Countertrend traders take new positions. A trader will have to decide if it is better to look for a Countertrend scalp or wait for the pullback to end and then enter in the direction of the trend. If the trend is strong, it is usually best to only trade Countertrend if there are clear signs of a trend reversal, such as a prior trendline breakout and then a test that ends with a strong reversal bar. However, the temptation is great to do something and many traders will begin to look at smaller time frame charts, like 1- and 3-minute, or 100 tick charts. Smaller time frame charts continue to form reversals as the trend progresses, and the vast majority of the reversals fail. A trader can rationalize taking the Countertrend trade by thinking that a 1-minute chart has small bars so the risk is only about 4 ticks, and if this turns out to be the very top of the market, the potential gain is huge. Therefore, taking a few small losses is worth it. Invariably, the few small losses tum into six or seven and their combined effect is a loss that cannot be recovered later in the day. Invariably, when they get lucky and pick the exact end of a trend, they will scalp out with a few ticks profit instead of riding the trade for a long way, as they originally had planned. Death by mathematics.


如果一位交易者因为在一段延长的趋势里没有仓位而变得焦躁不安，觉得自己必须交易，并且开始去看1分钟图，那么1分钟图上的反转很可能提供了一条非常赚钱的路子。不过，办法是反着显而易见的那一面去做。等一次1分钟反转触发一个逆势入场，这个入场你不做，然后想清楚如果你做了这笔交易、会把保护性止损放在哪里。接着，在那个价位挂一张顺势的入场止损单。当逆势交易者被止损打出去的时候，你正好被止损进一个顺势仓位。那个时候没有人会想逆势入场，大概一直到趋势走得更远、另一个逆势建仓形态开始形成之前都不会。这是一次概率非常高的顺势剥头皮。


> If a trader is becoming agitated because he is not in the market during an extended trend and he feels like he needs to trade and he begins to look at 1-minute charts, 1-minute reversals offer a very profitable way to make money. However, it is by doing the opposite of the obvious. Wait for a 1-minute reversal to trigger a Countertrend entry, which you do not take, and then determine where you would place a protective stop if you had taken the trade. Then, place a With Trend entry stop at that price. You will be stopped into a With Trend position just as the Countertrend traders are getting stopped out. No one will be looking to enter Countertrend at that point and likely not until the trend has moved further along and another Countertrend setup begins to form. This is a very high probability With Trend scalp.


最可靠的一种逆势交易是逆着趋势、反向做一次回调，也就是顺着主要趋势相反方向的一个小趋势。一旦做回调的交易者耗尽了力量，而趋势交易者通过突破约束这次回调的那条趋势线再次表明了自己的决心，那么任何回测这次突破的小回调都是极好的突破回调入场。这笔入场与回调的方向相反，但与主要趋势方向一致，并且通常会至少带来一次对主要趋势极值的测试。趋势线突破中蕴含的动能越多，这笔交易获利的可能性就越大。


> The single most reliable Countertrend trade is entering Countertrend t{) a pullback, which is a small trend in the opposite direction of the major trend. ,Once the pullback traders have exhausted themselves and the trend traders have again demonstrated their resolve by breaking the trendline that contained the pullback, any small pullback to test this breakout is a great Breakout Pullback entry. This entry is counter to the trend of the pullback, but in the direction of the major trend, and will usually lead to at least a test of the major trend's extreme. The more momentum that is present in the trendline break, the more likely it is that trade will be profitable.


反转中的动能可以表现为几根大趋势K线，也可以表现为一连串带趋势、外观平平的K线。强势的迹象越多，反转就越可靠。理想情况下，反转的第一段会延续很多根K线，明显突破 EMA，其中大多数K线是顺着新趋势方向的趋势K线，并且延伸到先前趋势的摆动点之外（如果先前趋势是多头，那么新空头的第一段跌到先前多头的一个或多个更高的低点之下，就是强势的迹象）。


> Momentum in a reversal can be in the form of a few large trend bars or a trending series of average-looking bars. The more signs of strength, the more reliable is the reversal. Ideally, the first leg of the reversal will extend for many bars, break well beyond the EMA, have the majority of the bars be trend bars in the direction of the new trend, and extend beyond swing points in the prior trend (if the prior trend was a bull, then it is a sign of strength if the first leg of the new bear drops below one or more of the Higher Lows of that prior bull).


尽管最好的反转动能强劲、走得也远，它们常常起动得非常缓慢，在急速行情开始之前可能先有几根小K线。市场是想把你挤出这笔交易，好让你不得不在后面追赶，为行情添柴加火。趋势刚开始时，在1分钟图和3分钟图上出现把交易者挤出场的回调是很常见的。偶尔5分钟图上也会出现一次，而它常常演变成外包K线，把你挤出场，逼你以差得多的价位重新进入新趋势。一些最强的趋势正来自这些陷阱，因为它们告诉交易者：最后一批趋势交易者刚刚被烫到，旧趋势里已经没有人剩下了。同时，它们也告诉我们：弱手刚刚离场，现在会来追赶新趋势，顺着我们的方向加单。这给交易者信心。当这种躁动的反转发生在趋势线突破之后、并出现在对趋势极值的测试上时，新趋势通常会持续至少一两个小时，并走出很多点。


> Although the best reversals have strong momentum and go a long way, they often are very slow to start and can have several small bars before the sharp moves begin. The market is trying to trap you out of the trade so that you will have to chase the move and add fuel to it. It is common at the very start of a trend to find pullbacks on 1- and 3-minute charts, which trap traders out. Occasionally there will be one on the 5-minute chart and it will often turn into an outside bar, trapping you out and forcing you to re-enter the new trend at a much worse price. Some of the strongest trends come from these traps because they tell traders that the last trend trader just got burned and there is no one left from the old trend. Also, they tell us that weak traders just got out and now will be chasing the new trend, adding orders in our direction. This gives traders confidence. When this kind of agitated reversal happens after a trendline break and on the test of the trend's extreme, the new trend will usually last for at least an hour or two and will run for many points.


如果一位交易者入场很早，而行情在几根K线上犹豫不决（K线间重叠），这不该引起担忧，尤其当那些K线大多是方向正确的趋势K线时。这是强势的迹象，所有人都在观望，等动能出现再入场。一个好的价格行为交易者常常能在动能出现之前就进场，然后在动能启动后不久把止损移到保本，从而以最小的风险赚很多钱。如果你对自己的判读有信心，就做你的交易，不要担心还没有别人看到你所看到的。他们最终会看到。务必把仓位的一部分、甚至全部做波段持有，尽管趋势开始走远之前你有时会在保本止损上被打掉一两次。


> If a trader enters early but the move is hesitant (overlapping bars) for a few bars, this should not be a concern, especially if those bars are mostly trend bars in the right direction. This is a sign of strength, and everyone is watching and waiting for the momentum to begin before entering. A good price action trader can often get in before that happens and then is able to move her stop to breakeven soon after the momentum starts, allowing her to make a lot of money with minimal risk. If you are confident in your read, take your trade, and don't worry that no one else sees what you see yet. They eventually will. Make sure to swing part or even all of your position even though you sometimes will get stopped out on your breakeven stop once or twice before the trend begins its run.


当反转是渐进的，传统上称之为多头末端的派发区，或空头末端的吸筹区。用价格行为的说法，派发顶部可以是双顶牛旗、急速行情与交易区间，也可以是需要一段时间才形成通道的急速与通道。吸筹底部则有与之对应的价格行为形态。


> When a reversal is gradual, it is traditionally called an area of distribution at the end of a bull or an area of accumulation at the end of a bear. In Price Action terms, a distribution top can be a Double Top Bull Flag, a Spike and Trading Range, or a Spike and Channel where the channel takes a while to form. An accumulation bottom has corresponding Price Action patterns.


通常，趋势回调中的入场看起来糟糕，却是有利可图的；反转中的入场看起来不错，却是亏损的。如果你想在空头中买进反转，或在多头顶部卖出，务必确保形态完美。趋势不断形成那些看起来总有点不对劲的反转。也许是跟前几根K线重叠太多，也许是十字星太多，也许反转K线太小，或者在收盘前几个 tick 回撤了一下，又或者此前没有重要趋势线被突破，也没有趋势通道线突破失败。这些几乎完美的反转会诱你上钩、把你套住，所以除非反转清晰而强势，否则绝不要做反转交易。


> Typically, entries in trend pullbacks look bad but are profitable, and entries in reversals look good but are losers. If you are looking to buy a reversal in a bear or sell a top of a bull, make sure that it is perfect. Trends constantly form reversals that somehow don't look quite right. Maybe there is too much overlap with the prior bars or too many dojis or the reversal bar is too small or pulls back several ticks just before it closes, or there is no prior break of a significant trendline or failed breakout of a trend channel line. These almost perfect reversals sucker you in and trap you, so you should never take a reversal trade unless it is clear and strong.


市场在形成交替趋势时有自己的节奏。一种趋势常常以趋势通道线过靶并反转收场，随后是一段两段式行情突破趋势线。这两段之后就为新趋势画出了通道。有些趋势只是以趋势线突破、然后一次测试、接着走第二段来收场。同样，这两段形成一个新的趋势通道，而它可能是、也可能不是新趋势的开端。如果新趋势很弱，通常的结果只是回调一次，然后旧趋势恢复。交易者应该始终在画、或者至少在头脑中勾画趋势线与趋势通道线，并观察市场测试这些线时如何反应。


> There is a rhythm to the market as it forms alternating trends. One trend will often end with a Trend Channel Line overshoot and reversal followed by a two-legged move that breaks the trendline. The two legs then allow for the drawing of a channel for the new trend. Some trends end with simply a trendline break and then a test, followed by a second leg. Again, these two legs form a new trend channel that may or may not be the start of a new trend. If the new trend is weak, it will usually just result in a pullback and then a resumption of the old trend. Traders should always be drawing or at least visualizing trendlines and trend channel lines and watching how the market reacts when it tests these lines.


熊市中的主要反转往往波动剧烈，K线大，上下多次推进。人们以为最糟糕的已经过去，随后意识到“糟糕，我来早了”，于是很快卖出离场。在最终底部形成之前，这种情况可能发生好几次，这也解释了为什么那么多主要反转都以大区间K线、并以失败旗形或三次推进形态收场。


> Major reversals from bear markets often are volatile with large bars and several pushes up and down. People think that the worst is over and then realize "Oops, I'm too early," and they are quick to sell out. This can happen several times before the final bottom is in and accounts for why so many major reversal end with large range bars and either a Failed Flag or a Three Push pattern.


图 8.1中的第2根K线是一次最终旗形失败反转，带来一波强劲上涨直到第3根K线，超过了空头的最后一个更低的高点。


> Bar 2 in Figure 8.1 was a Failed Final Flag reversal leading to a strong move up to Bar 3, which exceeded the last Lower High of the bear.


第4根K线形成一个更高的低点，从而可以画出一条趋势线。


> Bar 4 formed a Higher Low, which allowed for the drawing of a trendline.


![图 8.1](figures/fig-08-01.png)


**图 8.1　日线 Emini 出现过许多趋势变化，每一次都遵循标准的价格行为原则，一如预期**


第5根K线跌破趋势线后立即反转上涨。不过，这样一来就生成了一条更平缓的趋势线。第6根K线是一个小楔形，回调到第7根K线时形成了一条新趋势线。第8根K线是楔形顶部之后的反转，这通常会带来两段下跌。它同时也是第三次向上推进。第9根K线这一段跌破了多头最后一个更高的低点（第7根K线），显示空头强势。第9根K线突破了多头趋势线，所以预期有两段下跌。第9根K线结束了第一段，随后应该出现一个更低的高点或更高的高点。这里出现的是更低的高点，第二段下跌在第11根K线结束。第10根K线是一波强势上涨，这种强势只能被一段跌破第9根K线（第一段下跌）的强势行情所否定。第11根K线在略微跌破第9根K线之后反转回升，所以这很可能是先前多头中两段式修正的结束。然而，这次修正突破了从第2根K线低点以来的主要趋势线，所以市场可能在测试第8根K线高点之后向下反转。第12根K线形成一个两段式的更高高点，新的空头至少应该有两段下跌。它同时还是一个小扩张三角形（第6、7、8根K线）。跌向第13根K线的第一段非常强势，远远跌破第8根到第11根K线构成的多头旗形。第14根K线的更低的高点形成之后，就可以用它画出一条趋势线，再画出趋势通道线。第15根K线从趋势通道线的突破处反转上涨，所以随后应该有两段上涨并突破空头趋势线，事实也正是如此。第16根K线跌破第一条多头趋势线后反转上涨。第17根K线是从多头趋势通道线上方突破之后的突破回调。这波上涨在第18根K线处以一个小楔形结束，它形成了一个名义上的更高高点，也构成了一个扩张三角形（第8、11、12、15和18根K线）。楔形是趋势通道线过靶的一种形式，很可能有两段下跌。第18根K线与第12根K线构成双顶。第19根K线跌破多头趋势线。第20根K线形成一个更低的高点，可以据此画出趋势线和趋势通道线。第21根K线跌破那条第18–20根K线趋势通道线（未画出），并形成一个始于第19根K线的楔形。上涨到第22根K线时突破了空头的最后一个小高点，也突破了空头趋势线，但在自第18根K线高点以来的下跌段中形成了第二个更低的高点。对第22根K线高点的测试在第23根K线失败（它没有涨过第22根K线），所以还会形成另一段下跌。


> Bar 5 pulled back below the trendline and immediately reversed up. However, this now generated a flatter trendline. Bar 6 was a small Wedge and the pullback to Bar 7 created a new trendline. Bar 8 was a reversal after a Wedge top, and that usually leads to two legs down. It was also a Third Push up. The Bar 9 leg fell below the last Higher Low (Bar 7) of the bull, indicating bear strength. Bar 9 broke the bull trendline so two legs down are expected. Bar 9 ended the first leg, and it should be followed by a Lower High or a Higher High. Here, there was a Lower High, and the second leg down ended at Bar 11. Bar 10 was a strong rally, and this strength could only be negated by a strong move below Bar 9, the first leg down. Bar 1 1 reversed back up after falling just a little below Bar 9, so this was likely the end of a two-legged correction in the prior bull. However, this correction broke a major trendline from the Bar 2 low, so the market could reverse down after a test of the Bar 8 high. Bar 12 formed a two-legged Higher High, and the new bear should have at least two legs down. It was also a small Expanding Triangle (Bar 6, 7, 8, The first leg down to Bar 13 was very strong, dropping well below the Bars 8 to 1 1 bull flag. Once the Bar 14 Lower High formed, it could be used to create a trendline and then a trend channel line. Bar 15 reversed up from its breakout of the trend channel line, so it should be followed by two legs up and a break above the bear trendline, which it was. Bar 16 broke below the first bull trendline and reversed up. Bar 17 was a Breakout Pullback from the breakout above the bull trend channel line. This rally ended in a small Wedge at Bar 18, which formed a nominal Higher High and an Expanding Triangle (Bars 8, 1 1, 12, 15, and 18). A Wedge is a form of a trend channel line overshoot, and two legs down are likely. Bar 18 was a Double Top with Bar 12. Bar 19 fell below the bull trendline. Bar 20 formed a Lower High, and it allowed for the creation of a trendline and trend channel line. Bar 21 fell below that Bar 18-20 trend channel line (not shown) and formed a Wedge that began at Bar 19. The rally up to Bar 22 broke above the last small high of the bear, and it broke above the bear trendline, but formed the second Lower High in the leg down from the Bar 18 high. The test of the Bar 22 high failed at Bar 23 (it did not go above Bar 22), so another down leg will form.


第24根K线在跌破一条趋势通道线后反转上涨。涨到第25根K线的行情突破了空头趋势线。第26根K线未能涨过第25根K线第一段上涨的高点，这个更低的高点本应带来一段下跌，并形成新低（事实如此）或一个两段式回调牛旗。它是双顶熊旗。第27根K线是第25根K线突破空头趋势线之后的一个两段式更低的低点。随后应该至少有两段上涨。第28根K线是那两段上涨之后的回调，但它形成了第二个更高的低点，所以应该还会形成至少两段以上的上涨。第30根K线是在第29根K线小楔形之后创出的新高，所以随后应该至少有两段下跌。第31根K线形成了一个双顶熊旗（一个更低的高点），它出现在多头趋势线被突破之后。它是第一段下跌之后回调的终点，随后应该至少还有一段下跌。第32根K线测试了楔形的空头趋势通道线。市场要么反转上涨，要么崩跌。交易者会在楔形低点下方一个 tick 处挂止损卖出。第33根K线是从空头趋势通道线过靶处反转上涨，它带来了一波涨到趋势线上方的小幅上涨。图 8.2中的第1根K线大约比昨日低点高10%，为 GS 一波巨大的两日多头行情画上句号。第3根K线在回调中突破了空头趋势线，随后在那段两段式更低的低点下跌中打掉了保护性卖出止损，一直跌到第4根K线的反转K线。这是一次绝佳的买进建仓形态。你不必去核查，但强趋势中的第一次大回调通常会测试15分钟 EMA（这一次几乎是精确测试，不过下单时并不需要这个信息）。尽管这是如此出色的一次价格行为买进建仓形态，请注意入场K线只是一根小型多头趋势K线。市场当时还没有意识到这有多好。当你在一只重要股票上做了一笔你自认为很棒的交易，而还没有别人觉得它棒时，感到紧张是很自然的。有时就会这样，在多头反转被确认成立之前，市场可以先走出几根小K线（通常是顺势的）。这种确认出现在那根大多头趋势K线，也就是第6根K线期间。它动能极强，上下都是平顶平底，说明多头极其激进，价格应该会继续走高。到第6根K线收盘时，你的止损已经是保本，而你持仓等待测试第1根K线的高点。大约在赚到第一个一美元的利润之后，把一部分股票剥头皮卖出会是明智的。


> Bar 24 reversed up after falling below a trend channel line. The rally to Bar 25 broke the bear trendline. Bar 26 failed to go above the Bar 25 first leg up, and this Lower High should have led to a leg down and formed either a new low (which it did) or a two-legged pullback bull flag. It was a Double Top Bear Flag. Bar 27 was a two-legged Lower Low after the Bar 25 breaking of the bear trendline. At least two legs up should follow. Bar 28 was a pullback from the two legs up, but it formed a second Higher Low, so at least two more legs up should form. Bar 30 was a new high after the small Bar 29 Wedge, so at least two legs down should follow. Bar 31 formed a Double Top Bear Flag (a Lower High) that followed the break of the bull trendline. It is the end of the pullback from the first leg down and should be followed by at least one more leg down. Bar 32 tested the Wedge bear trend channel line. The market should either reverse up or collapse. Traders would sell on a stop at one tick below the low of the Wedge. Bar 33 was a reversal up from a bear trend channel line overshoot, and it led to a small rally above the trendline. Bar 1 in Figure 8.2 was about 10 percent above yesterday's low, capping off a huge two-day bull in GS. Bar 3 broke the bear trendline in the pullback and then ran protective sell stops on the two-legged Lower Low move down to the Bar 4 reversal bar. This was a great buy setup. You don't have to check, but the first big pullback in a strong trend usually tests the 15-minute EMA (and this one was an almost exact test, but that information was not needed to place the trade). As great a price action buy setup as this was, notice how the entry bar was a small bull trend bar. The market had not yet realized how good this was. It is natural to become nervous when you take what you thought was a great trade in a major stock, but no one else saw it as great yet. Sometimes this happens, and the market can have several small bars (usually With Trend) before the bull reversal is perceived as having taken place. That realization occurred during the big bull trend bar, Bar 6. It had great momentum and a shaved top and bottom, meaning that the bulls were extremely aggressive, and higher prices should follow. By the close of Bar 6, your stop is breakeven, and you are holding for a test of the Bar 1 high. It would be wise to scalp some of your shares out after about the first one dollar of profit.


![图 8.2](figures/fig-08-02.png)


**图 8.2　出现强趋势时，在回调中寻找顺势的价格行为入场**


一旦出现了一段强势的逆势行情，随后就会有一次回调，它同时是多空双方的考验。例如，如果在多头市场中出现一波强势下跌，这波行情突破了一条维持了20到40根K线的趋势线，而且下跌持续了20根K线，远远跌破20根K线 EMA，甚至跌破多头最后一个更高的低点，那么空头已经展现出相当强的实力。等这第一段下跌自行耗尽，空头会开始分批止盈，多头会开始重建自己的多头仓位。两者都会推动市场走高，而多空双方都会非常仔细地观察这波走势。由于这段下跌太强，多空双方都相信，在市场向上突破创出新高之前，它的低点很可能会被测试。因此，当市场上涨时，如果没有强势动能，新的多头会开始止盈，空头则会变得激进并加仓做空。这波上涨很可能带有许多空头K线和影线，两者都说明多头很弱。从这波上涨往下的抛售，形成了潜在新熊市中的第一个更低的高点。无论如何，出现第二段下跌的概率很高，因为多空双方都预期如此，并会照此交易。本书最重要的一个概念是：你只应该沿着趋势线的方向交易，而做逆势仓位之前，你必须等待一条重要趋势线被突破。


> Once there has been a strong Countertrend move, there will be a pullback that will be a test for both the bulls and the bears. For example, if there was a strong downward move in a bull market and the move broke through a trendline that has held for 20 to 40 bars, and the down move continued for 20 bars and carried well below the 20-bar EMA and even below the low of the last Higher Low of the bull, then the bears have demonstrated considerable strength. Once this first leg down exhausts itself, bears will begin to take partial profits, and bulls will begin to reinstate their longs. Both will cause the market to move higher, and both bulls and bears will watch this move very carefully. Because the down leg was so strong, both the bulls and bears believe that its low will likely be tested before the market breaks out into a new high. Therefore, as the market rallies, if there is not strong momentum, the new bulls will start to take profits, and the bears will become aggressive and add to their shorts. The rally will likely have many bear bars and tails, both of which indicate that the bulls are weak. The selloff down from this rally creates the first Lower High in a potential new bear. In any case, the odds are high that there will be a second leg down, since both the bulls and bears expect it and will be trading accordingly. The single most important concept in this book is that you should only be trading in the direction of trendlines and you must wait for the break of a significant trendline before taking a Countertrend position.


几乎所有反转都以趋势线突破或趋势通道线过靶并反转开始，而当反转出现时，这些最终都会突破趋势线。趋势线突破是交易者在建立逆势仓位之前需要看到的东西。在它出现之前，大多数人做任何逆势交易都会剥头皮出场。没有趋势线突破时，强势趋势依然有效，交易者应该确保自己把握每一次顺势入场，不要为错过偶尔一次逆势剥头皮而挂心。最好的赔率和最多的钱都在顺势交易里。在没有趋势通道线过靶与反转的情况下，真正的 V 形底和 V 形顶极为罕见，不值得考虑。交易者应该专注于常见的形态，而如果偶尔错过一次罕见事件，总会有一次回调让他们可以跟上新趋势开始交易。


> Virtually all reversals begin with either a trendline break or trend channel line overshoot and reversal, and all of those eventually break the trendline when there is a reversal. The trendline break is what traders need to see before they feel confident about Countertrend positions. Until there is one, most will scalp out of any Countertrend trade. In the absence of a trendline break, there is still a strong trend in effect, and traders should make sure that they take every With Trend entry and don't worry about missing an occasional Countertrend scalp. The best odds and the most money are in the With Trend trades. True V bottoms and tops in the absence of trend channel line overshoots and reversals are so rare that they are not worth considering. Traders should focus on common patterns, and if they miss an occasional rare event, there will always be a pullback where they can start trading with the new trend.


强烈的趋势通道线反转来自过度延伸的趋势，它们在突破趋势线之后往往还能走很远。反转之后的第一次回调常常很浅，因为市场情绪化，所有人都很快认同趋势已经反转。由于这份信心，交易者会激进得多，在最微小的停顿里就加仓，也不止盈，这就让回调保持得很小。


> Strong trend channel line reversals are from greatly overextended trends and often run far after they break the trendline. The First Pullback after the reversal is often shallow because the market is emotional and everyone quickly agrees that the trend has reversed. Because of the confidence, traders will be much more aggressive and will add on during the smallest pause and not take profits, keeping the pullbacks small.


当趋势线被强势突破时，回调之后通常还会有第二段。回调往往会回撤并测试旧趋势线，但为了抓到回调（或新趋势）的第二段而在那里入场，几乎总有一些更可靠的价格行为理由。穿过趋势线的那一段越强，回调之后出现第二段的可能就越大。测试趋势极值的这次回调可能过靶（多头向下反转中的更高的高点，或空头末端的更低的低点），也可能未及靶位（新空头中的更低的高点，或新多头中的更高的低点）。如果出现过靶，但远远超出旧极值，那么反转就被否定了，旧趋势已经恢复。交易者需要再等一次趋势线突破或趋势通道线过靶，才能做逆势交易。


> When there is a strong break of a trendline, there will usually be a second leg after a pullback. The pullback often retraces and tests the old trendline, but there are almost always more reliable Price Action reasons for entering there in the attempt to catch the second leg of the pullback (or new trend). The stronger the move through the trendline, the more likely it is that there will be a second leg after a pullback. The pullback that tests the trend's extreme can overshoot (a Higher High in a reversal down from a bull or a Lower Low at the end of a bear) or undershoot (a Lower High in a new bear or a Higher Low in a new bull). If there is an overshoot but it extends well beyond the old extreme, the reversal is nullified, and the old trend has resumed. Traders need to look for another trendline break or trend channel line overshoot before taking a Countertrend trade.


趋势线突破（可能反转的第一段）的强势迹象包括：


> Signs of strength of a trendline break (the first leg of a possible reversal) include:


- 行情覆盖了很多点。


> - The move covers many points.


- 它远远越过 EMA。


> - It goes well past the EMA.


- 在空头反转中，它跌破多头最后一个更高的低点；在多头反转中，它涨过空头最后一个更低的高点。


> - In a bear reversal, it extends below the final Higher Low of the bull, and in a bull reversal, it extends above the final Lower High of the bear.


- 它持续很多根K线（大约10到20根）。


> - It lasts many bars (10 to 20 or so).


- 此前还有过其他强势的趋势线突破（这不是逆势强势的第一个迹象）。


> - There were other strong prior trendline breaks (this isn't the first sign of Countertrend strength).


- 回到旧趋势极值的测试缺乏动能，证据是它有许多重叠的K线，其中很多还是顺着新趋势方向的趋势K线。


> - The reversal back to test the old trend's extreme lacks momentum, as evidenced by its having many overlapping bars with many being trend bars in the direction of the new trend.


- 回到旧趋势极值的测试在 EMA 或旧趋势线处失败，没有接近该极值。图 8.3中跌向第4根K线的那段弱势空头行情勉强突破了趋势线，它没有接近跌破多头最后一个更高的低点（第2根K线），也没能突破 EMA。不过，第6根K线仍是对第3根K线多头极值可以接受的更高高点测试，尤其因为它是从前一日高点被突破后的开盘反转。


> - The reversal back to test the old trend's extreme fails at the EMA or the old trendline and does not get close to the extreme. The weak bear leg to Bar 4 in Figure 8.3 barely broke the trendline, and it did not come close to falling below the last Higher Low in the bull (Bar 2), and it could not break through the EMA. However, Bar 6 is still an acceptable Higher High test of the Bar 3 bull extreme, especially since it is a reversal on the open from a breakout of the prior day's high.


跌向第9根K线的那段空头行情跌破了一条更长的趋势线、EMA 以及多头最后一个更高的低点（第5根K线），而且它之前还出现过一次急速的趋势反转尝试（跌到第4根K线的抛售）。同样，随后那波小幅上涨没有接近测试趋势线的下沿，也没有接近测试第一段下跌中第8根K线的第一次回调。所有这些都是趋势线突破的强势迹象，增大了至少出现第二段下跌或一次真正趋势反转的可能。这个形态同时也是头肩顶，但不值得带着这种眼光去看价格行为；更好的做法是把多得多的注意力放在靠近你打算入场处的那些K线上。此外，大多数头肩形态都失败，远不如逐棒的价格行为可靠。


> The bear leg to Bar 9 broke below a longer trendline, the EMA, and the last Higher Low of the bull (Bar 5), and it followed a previous sharp attempt at a trend reversal (the selloff to Bar 4). Also, the small rally that followed it did not come close to testing the underside of the trendline or the Bar "8 first pullback in the first leg down. All of these are signs of strength of the trendline break and increase the chances for at least a second leg down or an actual trend reversal. The pattern was also a Head and Shoulders Top, but it is not worth looking at price action with that in mind; it is better to pay much more attention to the bars closer to where you are thinking of entering. Also, most Head and Shoulder patterns fail and are not nearly as reliable as the bar-by-bar price action.


第10根K线是在一次低动能的、对趋势极值（第6根K线）的更低的高点测试中做空的低4。


> Bar 10 is a Low 4 short in a low momentum Lower High test of the trend extreme (Bar 6).


![图 8.3](figures/fig-08-03.png)


**图 8.3　在趋势线被突破之前，不要做逆势交易**


突破多头趋势线之后，交易者会开始画空头趋势线（未画出），而随着市场转变为一连串更低的高点与低点构成的空头趋势，这些线变得越来越重要。所有这些行情有一个共同点：它们的斜率。斜率不是线性的（一条直线），而是弯曲且不断增大的。到某个时点，市场迅速反向，而通常至少会出现一段长期的横盘，也可能是一次趋势反转。所有这类形态都不过是趋势通道线过靶并反转，因此就应该按这样的方式去交易；给它们取专门的名字，对你的交易成功毫无帮助。反转发生的那一刻，趋势通道线可能并不明显，但一旦抛物线行情展开，价格行为交易者就会不断画出并重画趋势通道线，然后等待过靶与反转。最好的反转具有大反转K线，最好还有二次入场。反转的第一段几乎总会突破趋势线，如果没有突破，那么这个反转就可疑，更可能出现交易区间或延续形态。如果第二次反转入场失败，趋势很可能恢复，并至少再走出两段。


> After the break of a bull trendline, traders would start to draw bear trendlines (not shown) and these become increasingly important as the market transforms into a bear trend with a series of Lower Highs and Lows. All of these moves have one thing in common: their slope. Instead of being linear (a straight line), it is curved and increasing. At some point, the market quickly reverses direction and usually at the very least there will be a protracted sideways move and possibly a trend reversal. All of these patterns are simply trend channel line overshoots and reversals, and therefore they should be traded as such; giving them special names adds nothing to your trading success. The trend channel line might not be obvious at the moment of the reversal, but once a parabolic move is underway, price action traders are constantly drawing and redrawing trend channel lines and then watching for an overshoot and reversal. The best reversals have large reversal bars and preferably a second entry. The first leg of the reversal will almost always break the trendline, and if it does not, then the reversal is suspect, and a trading range or continuation pattern becomes much more likely. If a second reversal entry fails, the trend will likely resume and run for at least two more legs.


逆势交易者始终在画趋势通道线，期待出现过靶与反转，好让他们至少能做一次剥头皮，最好是拿到一段两段式的逆势行情。


> Countertrend traders are always drawing trend channel lines, hoping for an overshoot and a reversal that will allow for at least a scalp and preferably a two-legged Countertrend move.


图 8.4中的第2根K线突破了一条小趋势通道线，但之前没有逆势强势，而且建仓形态K线只有一个小多头实体。聪明的交易者会等待二次入场，如果没有出现，他们就会把它看作顺势建仓形态——结果证明它确实如此（它是一段陡峭的急速与通道空头趋势中的通道）。注意第2根K线下方的突破是一根强势空头趋势K线。这是因为许多多头被这个楔形引诱而提早入场，而大多数人要等到价格跌破楔形的第2根K线低点才承认反转失败了。那是他们放保护性止损的地方。同样，许多空头也会在那里挂入场止损，因为一次失败的楔形通常至少会走出楔形的高度，形成极佳的做空入场。


> Bar 2 in Figure 8.4 broke a small trend channel line, but there was.no earlier Countertrend strength, and the setup bar had only a small bull body. Smart traders would wait for a second entry, and if one did not develop, they would view this as a With Trend setup, which it turned out to be (it is a channel in a steep Spike and Channel bear trend). Notice how the breakout below Bar 2 was in the form of a strong bear trend bar. This is because many longs were tempted to enter early on this Wedge, and most would not concede that the reversal failed until there was a move below the Bar 2 low of the Wedge. That is where their protective stops were. Also, many bears will have entry stops there as well because a failed Wedge usually runs about the height of the Wedge as a minimum, creating a great short entry.


第3根K线过靶了另一条趋势通道线，但没有入场信号，所以被套的多头极少。而且之前也没有多头强势的迹象表现为空头趋势线的突破，所以聪明的交易者只会考虑做空。


> Bar 3 overshot another trend channel line, but there was no entry signal so there were very few trapped bulls. Also, there was no prior bull strength in the form of a break of a bear trendline, so smart traders would only be looking to short.


![图 8.4](figures/fig-08-04.png)


**图 8.4　趋势通道线的突破失败可以成为可靠的逆势建仓形态**


第5根K线大幅跳空开在空头趋势线上方，但它实质上是一根均线缺口K线（差不多就是这样……它的实体很大且完全位于 EMA 上方，尽管它的低点在 EMA 下方），形成了一波开盘即趋势的下跌行情。


> Bar 5 opened well above the bear trendline, but it was essentially a first EMA Gap Bar (close enough . . . its body was large and entirely above the EMA, even though its low was below the EMA), creating a Trend from Open move down.


第6根K线没有触及趋势通道线，所以尽管它试图反转昨日低点，这波行情仍然可疑。当一波行情接近趋势通道线这样的磁力位时，大多数交易者会等待过靶出现，而在没有过靶时，他们会希望至少有个二次入场。另外，信号K线是一根实体很小的十字星，这意味着多头并不强。


> Bar 6 did not reach the trend channel line, so although it tried to reverse yesterday's low, the move was suspect. When a move approaches a magnet like a trend channel line, most traders would wait for the overshoot, and in its absence, would want at least a second entry. Also, the signal bar was a doji with only a tiny body, which means that the bulls were not strong.


第8根K线过靶了空头趋势通道线，而信号K线是一根带有像样多头实体的内包K线。这个建仓形态同时也是第二次尝试反转昨日低点（第7根K线旗形被突破之后的一个最终旗形失败买进建仓形态），构成了一次可靠的开盘反转建仓形态。


> Bar 8 overshot the bear trend channel line, and the signal bar was an inside bar with a good-size bull body. This setup was also a second attempt to reverse yesterday's low (a Failed Final Flag buy setup after the breakout of the Bar 7 flag), creating a dependable Opening Reversal setup.


### 反转第一段的强势迹象


> SIGNS OF STRENGTH IN THE FIRST LEG OF A REVERSAL


有些反转最终成为趋势反转，另一些只是带来小幅的逆势波段。仔细分析反转前后的价格行为，能帮助交易者判断自己的仓位该留多少做波段（如果有的话），以及该预期多大的行情。当出现强趋势时，交易者不该做逆势交易，直到趋势线被突破，或者至少出现一次来自趋势通道线过靶的高潮反转。然而，在市场处于交易区间时，交易者可以在两个方向上交易反转。强反转有许多特征，具备的特征越多，逆势交易获利的可能性就越大，交易者在决定仓位留多少做波段时也就应该越激进。趋势反转中先前的趋势线突破越强，反转就越可能走出更多点、持续更久、并具有两段或更多段。最强的趋势线突破动能强劲，远远冲过 EMA，并且通常越过先前趋势中的摆动点。以下是强反转的许多特征：


> Some reversals result in trend reversals, and others simply in small Countertrend swings. Carefully analyzing the price action before and after the reversal helps a trader gauge how much if any of his position he should swing and how big a move to anticipate. When there is a strong trend, traders should not be taking Countertrend trades until there has been a trendline break or at least a climactic reversal from a trend channel line overshoot. In a trading range market, however, traders can trade reversals in both directions. There are many characteristics of strong reversals, and the more that are present, the more likely it is that a Countertrend trade will be profitable and the more aggressive the trader should be in her decision over how much of her position she should swing. The stronger the prior trendline break in a trend reversal, the more likely the reversal will gain more points and last longer and have two or more legs. The strongest trendline breaks have strong momentum and surge well past the EMA and usually beyond swing points in the prior trend. Here are many characteristics of strong reversals:


- 强势反转K线。


> - Strong reversal bar.


- 二次入场信号。


> - Second entry signal.


- 陷阱K线（把交易者挤出场），在新多头中形成一个小小的更高的低点，或在新的空头中形成一个小小的更低的高点。


> - Trap Bar (trapping traders out) forming a small Higher Low in a new Bull or Lower High in a new Bear.


- 开始时是旧趋势趋势通道线过靶之后的反转。


> - Began as a reversal from an overshoot of a trend channel line from the old trend.


- 反转一个重要的摆动高点或低点（例如跌破一个强势的先前摆动低点后反转上涨）。


> - Reverse a significant swing high or low (such as breaking below a strong prior swing low and reversing up).


- 远远突破旧趋势的趋势线。


> - Break well beyond the trendline of the old trend.


- 以许多个 tick 突破 EMA，并在许多根K线上收在它之外。


> - Break the EMA by many ticks and close beyond it for many bars.


- 突破先前空头的最后一个更低的高点，或先前多头的最后一个更高的低点。


> - Break above the last Lower High of the prior bear or Higher Low of the prior bull.


- 第一次逆势行情段之后的回调形成 M2B 或 M2S。


> - The pullback from the first Countertrend leg forms an M2B or an M2S.


- 第一段持续很多根K线，并反转了先前趋势的许多根K线。


> - The first leg lasts many bars and reverses many bars of the prior trend.


- 任何东西呈现趋势：收盘价、高点、低点或实体。


> - Trending anything: closes, highs, lows, or bodies.


- 小幅回调，尤其只是横盘式的回调。


> - Small pullbacks, especially if only sideways.


- 两个方向上的影线都极小、或者根本没有影线。如果你确实被止损出局，要意识到一种可能：你被关在一笔好交易之外，所以要赶紧找机会重新入场。下面举几个例子，都是把交易者关在新趋势之外的陷阱K线。图 8.5中的第1根K线是一根强空头趋势K线，也是在一段冲到前一天收盘价的强空头行情之后出现的低1。开盘时大幅跳空低开，随后跟着三根多头趋势K线。开盘已经走过了头，又出现这么强的多头力量，聪明的交易者不会在远离 EMA 的地方去做空一个低1。这个失败的低1是一次极好的做多入场（一个小型更高的低点），因为它把多头关在场外、把空头关在场内，而这两拨人都会追着市场往上买。


> - Bars with tiny or no tails in either direction. If you do get stopped out, be aware of the possibility that you were trapped out of a great trade and look to re-enter quickly. Here are several examples of Trap Bars that trapped traders out of new trends. Bar 1 in Figure 8.5 is a strong bear trend bar and a Low 1 after a strong bear into the prior day's close. There was a big gap down on the open followed by three bull trend bars. With this much bull strength on an overdone open, smart traders would not be shorting a Low 1 far from the EMA. The failed Low 1 was a great long entry (a small Higher Low) because it trapped bulls out and bears in, and both will chase the market up.


![图 8.5](figures/fig-08-05.png)


**图 8.5　不要被关在新趋势之外**


第3根K线是一根外包下跌K线。聪明的交易者不会在这里买进，因为市场正试图从一个最终多头旗形反转，而他们预期会有两段下跌行情。另外，高潮之后的小K线：（从那个旗形向上突破的那根大多头趋势K线）几乎总是引出一段拖长的行情。市场并不着急，K线实体很小就说明了这一点。


> Bar 3 was an outside bar down. Smart traders would not be buying in here since the market was attempting to reverse from a Final Bull Flag and they are expecting two legs down. Also, small bars after a climax: (a large bull trend bar breakout from that flag) almost always lead to a protracted move. The market is not in a hurry, as indicated by the small size of the bars.


第4根K线试图在一根大空头趋势K线之后形成一根大多头趋势K线，可能是在构筑一个开盘即趋势的多头日。它的收盘价低于自己的中点，并且变成了一根内包K线。这根K线把多头套住，并构筑出一段空头行情段。


> Bar 4 tried to form a large bull trend bar after a big bear trend bar, possibly setting up a Trend from the Open Bull day. It had a close below its midpoint, and it became an inside bar. This bar trapped longs and set up a bear leg.


第5根K线是一个失败的低1，它变成一个小型更高的低点，同时也是均线走平时出现的第二个均线缺口K线，而这对做多一方来说永远是一个至少做一笔剥头皮的好建仓形态。趋势的收场方式是先出现一次反转（一次打破趋势线的逆势行情），然后是对趋势最终极值的一次测试。这次测试可能越过先前的极值——比如新多头里出现一个更低的低点，或者新空头里出现一个更高的高点；也可能未及靶位——比如新多头里出现一个更高的低点，或者新空头里出现一个更低的高点。极少数情况下，这次测试会形成双顶或双底，而且要精确到最小报价单位。严格来说，过靶属于旧趋势的最后一段行情，因为过靶形成了该趋势里最极端的价格。未及靶位则是新趋势第一段行情之后的回调。测试本身常常由两段行情组成。


> Bar .5 was a failed Low 1, and it became a small Higher Low that was also a second EMA Gap Bar with a flat EMA, which is always a good setup for at least a scalp on the long side. Trends end with a reversal (a Countertrend move that breaks a trendline) and then a test of the final trend extreme. The test may overshoot the old extreme, as in the case of a Lower Low in a new bull or a Higher High in a new bear, or it may undershoot it with a Higher Low in a new bull or a Lower High in a new bear. Rarely, the test will form a Double Top or Double Bottom to the exact tick. Overshoots are strictly speaking the final leg of the old trend because they form the most extreme price in the trend. An undershoot is the pullback from the first leg in the new trend. Tests themselves are frequently made of two legs.


例如，在市场顶部，趋势线被突破之后，市场几乎总是会再上涨一次，做第二次尝试把价格推向更高。如果卖方反而在跟先前相同的价位区域再次压倒买方，那么多头就是做了两次把市场推高的尝试，而两次都失败了。当市场两次尝试做某件事、两次都失败时，它接下来通常会转去做相反的方向。


> For example, at a market top, after the trendline break the market will almost always rally one more time in a second attempt to drive the market to higher prices. If instead the sellers again overwhelm the buyers around the price level that they did earlier, the bulls will have made two attempts to drive the market higher and both failed. When the market tries to do something twice and it fails both times, it usually then tries to do the opposite.


由于趋势线突破之后的逆势行情通常至少有两段行情，如果多头反转在测试空头低点时形成的是更高的低点，那么它同时也是第二段行情的起点。另一方面，如果测试形成的是更低的低点，那个低点就是第一段行情的起点，而走完第一段之后，很可能会有一次回调，然后是第二段。空头反转同理：更低的高点是第二段行情的起点，而更高的高点这种测试则是第一段行情的起点。


> Since a Countertrend move after a trendline break usually has at least two legs, if a bull reversal has a Higher Low for the test of the bear low, it will also be the start of the second leg. On the other hand, if it forms a Lower Low for the test, that low will be the start of the first leg, and after that first leg it is likely that there will be a pullback and then a second leg. Likewise in a bear reversal, a Lower High is the start of the second leg, but a Higher High test is the start of the first leg.


有一种非常常见的形态：出现一段没有任何回调的强劲逆势行情（一段急速行情），这段急速行情可能是一次趋势反转，但随后原趋势又恢复了。如果这次恢复走势的K线足够多、也回撤掉急速行情的足够大部分，交易者就会怀疑它到底是反转失败，还是成功反转之后的回调。不过，那些回撤又深又久的大幅动量急速行情，其极值大多数最终仍会被测试到，而且大多数会被越过。例如，一段大幅急速下跌之后跟着一波缓慢上涨、把这段急速行情的大部分回撤掉，通常接下来还会有第二次抛售，去测试最初那段急速行情的低点。到那个时候，原趋势可以继续（双底牛旗），反转也可以继续向下，或者市场可以进入交易区间。如果这段急速行情出现在交易区间里、或者方向与趋势一致（比如多头趋势里的一段急速上涨），被测试的可能性就大得多；而如果它是一个强趋势里的第一段逆势行情，就不太可能被测试。例如，强多头趋势里一段陡峭的空头急速行情，通常只会把空头套住，而不会被测试。


> A very common pattern is where there is a strong Countertrend move (a spike) without any pullbacks, and this spike could be a trend reversal, but there is then a resumption of the trend. If this resumption has enough bars and retraces enough of the spike it will make traders wonder if it represents a failed reversal rather than a pullback after a successful reversal. However, the extremes of most of those sharp momentum spikes that have deep, lengthy retracements still end up being tested, and most are exceeded. For example, a large spike down that is followed by a slow rally that retraces most of the spike will usually be followed by a second selloff that tests the low of the initial spike. At that point, the original trend can continue (Double Bottom Bull Flag), the reversal can continue down, or the market can enter a trading range. The test is much more likely if the spike is in a trading range or in the direction of the trend (like a spike up in a bull), and it is not likely if it is the first Countertrend move in a strong trend. For example, a sharp bear spike in a strong bull will usually just trap bears and not get tested.


高潮反转（通常是对趋势通道线的一次过靶并反转，或者一次高潮式的最终旗形失败）不一定会有回调去测试极值。高潮在更小的时间级别图上要常见得多。例如，1分钟图上往往每天有好几次，而5分钟图可能每个月只有两三次。完美的V形顶和V形底形态很少见，交易者若把这些形态想成别的东西，什么好处也得不到——它们就是趋势通道线过靶失败之后的一次反转，也应该按这种方式去交易。


> A climax reversal (usually an overshoot and reversal of a trend channel line, or a climactic Failed Final Flag) does not have to have a pullback that tests the extreme. Climaxes are much more common on smaller time frame charts. For example, a 1-minute chart often has several each day, whereas a 5-minute chart might only have a couple each month. Perfect V top and bottom patterns are rare, and there is nothing to be gained by a trader thinking of these patterns as anything other than a reversal after a failed trend channel line overshoot, and it should be traded as such.


![图 8.6](figures/fig-08-06.png)


**图 8.6　强趋势中的回调之后通常是对趋势极值的一次测试**


任何一串强趋势K线（实体大、影线小、相互重叠极少），如果后面跟着一次回调，它的极值几乎总是会被测试。图 8.6中的第3根K线测试并越过了第1根K线急速行情的低点，但并没有发生反转，空头又继续走了好几根K线，形成一个楔形底。


> Any series of strong trend bars (big bodies, small tails, and very little overlap) that is followed by a pullback almost always has a test of its extreme. Bar 3 in Figure 8.6 tested and exceeded the Bar 1 spike low, but there was no reversal, and the bear continued for several more bars, forming a Wedge bottom.


今天开盘在测试昨天低点处那个楔形时形成了一个更高的低点。它同时也是一个双底牛旗（与昨天的最后一个摆动低点构成），以及昨天最后两个小时那个大型两段式熊旗的突破失败。


> Today's open formed a Higher Low in its test of the Wedge at yesterday's low. It was also a Double Bottom Bull Flag (with the last swing low of yesterday) and a failed breakout of the large two-legged bear flag of the final two hours of yesterday.


第5根K线是从第4根K线空头急速行情起的那波拖长的大幅上涨行情的最高点，但第4根K线急速行情的低点在当天收盘时被测试到了。


> Bar 5 was the top of a protracted, big rally off the Bar 4 bear spike, but the Bar 4 spike low was tested at the close of the day.


图 8.7中第1根K线的空头急速行情，在当天晚些时候被一段大得多的空头急速行情测试并越过（第3根K线的低点）。这第二段空头急速行情，由第5根K线的更高的低点完成了测试。


> The Bar 1 bear spike in Figure 8. 7 was tested and exceeded later in the day by a much larger bear spike (the Bar 3 low). This second bear spike was tested with the Bar 5 Higher Low.


图 8.8中第1、3、6根K线的空头急速行情，以及第4、8根K线的多头急速行情，在这张 AAPL 60分钟图上全都被测试到了。


> The Bar 1, 3, and 6 bear spikes and the Bar 4 and 8 bull spikes in Figure 8.8 all were tested on this 60-minute AAPL chart.


第4根K线是空头趋势中的一段多头急速行情，不一定非被测试不可，但大约10根K线之后它还是被测试了。


> Bar 4 is a bull spike in a bear and does not have to be tested, but it was about 10 bars later.


第8根K线是交易区间里的一段多头急速行情，也是对一条主要趋势线的突破，所以它很可能被测试。

第7根K线是一个新的摆动低点（一个更低的低点，也可能是趋势线突破之后空头的底部），但它不是急速行情，所以不一定被完整测试。第9根K线形成一个更高的低点，测试了第7根K线，是一次多头反转。


> Bar 7 was a new swing low (a Lower Low and possible bear bottom after a trendline break) but not a spike, so it does not have to be fully tested. Bar 9 formed a Higher Low test of Bar 7 and was a bull reversal.

Bar 2 was a bear spike that followed a Wedge top, making it likely to be tested since at least two legs down should be expected. Bar 3 was a bear spike in a bear and was tested with a Higher Low that led to resumption of the higher time frame bull.

第9根K线是在昨天那条主要空头趋势线被突破之后的更高的低点（这条趋势线被涨到第1根K线的那波上涨行情打破），而作为更高的低点，它是第二段行情的起点，走完的第二段也可能是这波上涨的终点。第3根K线是空头趋势线突破之后的一个更低的低点，所以它可能是一次主要趋势反转。这时候你需要去找机会买进第一个更高的低点，它出现在第7根K线。市场在启动之前常常会先把保本止损扫掉一两次，所以你需要一次又一次地找机会买入；同时把部分持仓做成波段，而第9根K线提供了一个极好的机会。

Bar 3 was a Lower Low after a bear trendline break so it was a possible major trend reversal. You now need to be looking to buy the first Higher Low, which occurred at Bar 7. It is common for the market to run the breakeven stops once or twice before it takes off so you need to look to buy again and again swing part of your position and Bar 9 offered a great opportunity.


图 8.12中，SKF UltraShort Financials ETF（交易所交易基金）上第2根K线那次高潮式开盘反转（倒V形顶），不过是向上突破空头趋势通道线顶部之后对昨天高点的一次反转。它同时也是突破昨天高点之后的二次入场。


> This Bar 2 climactic Opening Reversal (inverted V top) in the SKF UltraShort Financials ETF in Figure 8. 12 was simply a reversal of yesterday's high after breaking out of the top of a bear trend channel line. It was also a second entry after breaking above yesterday's high.


顺便说一句，它也是从昨天交易区间向上的一波等距运动，但在考虑一笔交易时，这只是次要的考量。当强趋势到达等距运动的区域时，交易者这时才可以开始考虑逆势交易，而且只有在有好的建仓形态时才可以。等距运动不太重要，也不是特别可靠，一般来说应该忽略。


> Incidentally, it was a Measured Move up from yesterday's trading range, but this is only a minor consideration when contemplating a trade. When a strong trend reaches an area of a Measured Move, traders can then begin to consider Countertrend trades but only if there is a good setup. Measured Moves are of minor importance and not terribly reliable and in general should be ignored.


图 8.13中这张5分钟 OIR 图上，在昨天低点下方出现了一次高潮式开盘反转，它同时也是对三次趋势通道线过靶的反转。交易者应该在那根大幅反转K线、也就是第1根K线上方买入，然后在第2根K线的高2首次回调处再买一次，预期至少有两段上涨行情。当可能出现两段行情时，永远要把部分持仓做成波段，因为有时候出现的会是一段拖长的新趋势，而不只是一次两段式回调。

A trader should buy above the large reversal Bar 1, and again at the High 2 First Pullback at Bar 2, expecting at least two legs up. Always swing part of your position when two legs are likely because sometimes there will be a protracted new trend rather than just a two-legged pullback.
