What made it especially good was that it trapped new longs out and immediately reversed up on them, so psychologically it would be difficult for them to buy. They will then chase the market up, entering late, adding fuel to the upswing. This is also a Double Bottom Bull Flag (Bars 1 and 2).


![图 9.11](figures/fig-09-11.png)


**图 9.11　二次入场**


趋势线和趋势通道线应该守住，并带来逆着这条线的反转，这说明它们在约束趋势上很成功。有时候其中一条会守不住价格行为，市场在测试这条线时不会停下来反转。趋势线被突破和趋势通道线被突破，含义正好相反。趋势线被突破意味着一次可能的趋势反转正在进行，但趋势通道线被突破意味着趋势变强了、现在更陡了。


> Trendlines and trend channel lines should hold and lead to reversals away from the lines, indicating that they were successful in containing the trend. Sometimes one will fail to hold the price action, and the market will not stop and reverse on the test of the line. The breaking of a trendline has the opposite implication from the breaking of a trend channel line. The break of a trendline means that a possible trend reversal is underway, but breaking a trend channel line means that the trend has increased in strength and is now steeper.


趋势线突破是趋势反转的第一步，如果这次突破是有力的，成功测试趋势极值点的概率就上升。比如，在一次空头趋势线突破之后，对低点的测试很可能形成一个更高的低点、然后至少再来一段上涨；或者形成一个更低的低点、然后至少走出一波两段的上涨。


> A trendline break is the first step in a trend reversal, and if the break is on strength, the odds of a successful test of the trend's extreme increase. For example, after a bear trendline break, the test of the low would likely form a Higher Low and then at least a second leg up, or a Lower Low and then at least a two-legged up move.


带一个或两个K线突破失败的陡峭趋势线是可靠的顺势形态，因此吸引了很多交易者。不过，每当一个可靠的形态失败，被套住的交易者就会异常地多。反向的那一波很可能是一笔能赚钱的交易，而且可能又急又猛，导致一次趋势反转。这在1分钟图上更常见，但在1分钟图上做逆势交易要差得多，因为大多数反转都会失败。你几乎总是应该顺着5分钟图的方向交易。


> Steep trendlines with one-or two-bar false breakouts are reliable With Trend patterns and therefore attract a lot of traders. However, whenever a reliable pattern fails, then there will be an unusually large number of trapped traders. The reverse move will likely be a profitable trade, and it can be sharp and result in a trend reversal. This is more common on 1-minute charts, but it is far better to not trade Countertrend off 1-minute charts since most reversals fail. You should almost always trade in the direction of the 5-minute chart.


每当趋势通道线失败（市场穿过去，而不是从它上面弹开），你就应该假定趋势比你想的强得多，并去找顺势入场。


> Whenever a trend channel line fails (the market breaks through it instead of bouncing off it), you should assume that the trend is much stronger than you thought, and you should look for With Trend entries.


图 9.12中第4根K线是第3根K线更低的低点（扩张三角形底部）之后对空头趋势线的一次强突破，所以交易者会等一次回调，然后找第二段上涨。一次更高的低点之后可能只有一段上涨，因为从这波行情起点那个低点算，这一段已经是第二段了。


> Bar 4 in Figure 9.12 was a strong breakout of the bear trendline after the Bar 3 Lower Low (Expanding Triangle bottom), so traders will look for a pullback and then a second leg up. A Higher Low can be followed by only a single up leg since that leg is already the second leg up from the low at the start of the move.


第8根K线是另一条空头趋势线的突破，所以对第7根K线低点的测试应该带来一笔做多。一个更低的低点后面通常都会跟着两段上涨。


> Bar 8 was the break of another bear trendline, so a test of the Bar 7 low should result in a long. A Lower Low usually is followed by two up legs.


与第3根K线那个低点相比，第9根K线在更高时间级别上也是一个更高的低点。


> Bar 9 is also a higher timeframe Higher Low compared to the Bar 3 low.


比如，图 9.13中第1根K线突破了一条陡峭的三根K线微型趋势线，随后在它低点下方一个最小报价单位处出现了一个好的做空入场。


> For example, Bar 1 in Figure 9.13 broke above a steep, three-bar Micro Trendline and then had a good short entry at one tick below its low.


第3根K线是一根强多头反转K线、突破了陡峭的微型趋势线，因此是一个做空建仓形态（任何对趋势线之上的突破，哪怕是强多头反转K线造成的，都是做空的建仓形态），随后的内包K线下方触发了做空。第3根K线跟在一次跌破 ii形态（可能是一次最终旗形失败）之后，但那个 ii形态并没有突破趋势线，也没有别的多头强势迹象，所以做多的交易者会想要一次二次入场，他们在第4根K线上等到了。虽然灵活的剥头皮交易者也许能从跌到第4根K线低点那波29美分的突破里赚到一点钱，但会很难，所以这实际上是一次失败后的失败跌破 ii形态（可能是一次最终旗形失败）之后，但那个 ii形态并没有突破趋势线，也没有别的多头强势迹象，所以做多的交易者会想要一次二次入场，他们在第4根K线上等到了。虽然灵活的剥头皮交易者也许能从跌到第4根K线低点那波29美分的突破里赚到一点钱，但会很难，所以这实际上是一次失败后的失败（市场没能突破空头趋势线之后，也没能走出一次轻松的空头剥头皮利润）。失败后的失败通常够走两段行情，而当它伴随微型趋势线出现时，它运作起来就像一个突破回调做多建仓形态，尽管它其实是一个更低的低点。第4根外包K线入场之后，出现了一波小幅两段式上涨。前一根K线是那次失败微型趋势线突破做空的入场K线，而做空入场K线上方总是有止损，这让第4根K线的做多更加确定。


> Bar 3 was a strong bull reversal bar break above a steep Micro Trendline and therefore was a bear setup (any break above the trendline, even if it is by a strong bull reversal bar, is a setup for a short), and a short was triggered below the inside bar that followed. Bar 3 followed a break below an ii (a possible Failed Final Flag), but the ii did not break the trendline, and there was no other sign of bullish strength, so longs would want a second entry, which they got on Bar 4. Although a nimble scalper might have been able to make some profit on the 29 cent breakout to the Bar 4 low, it would have been difficult, so this is effectively a failed failure break below an ii (a possible Failed Final Flag), but the ii did not break the trendline, and there was no other sign of bullish strength, so longs would want a second entry, which they got on Bar 4. Although a nimble scalper might have been able to make some profit on the 29 cent breakout to the Bar 4 low, it would have been difficult, so this is effectively a failed failure (the market failed to make an easy short scalper's profit after it failed to break above the bear trendline). Failed failures are usually good for a two-legged move, and when it occurs with a Micro Trendline, it operates like a breakout pullback long setup, even though it is a Lower Low. There was a small two-legged rally after the entry on the Bar 4 outside bar. That prior bar was the entry bar for the short from the failed Micro Trendline break, and there are always stops above short entry bars, making the Bar 4 long even more certain.


![图 9.12](figures/fig-09-12.png)


**图 9.12　突破回调**


![图 9.13](figures/fig-09-13.png)


**图 9.13　对趋势线的一根或两根K线突破失败，通常是极好的顺势建仓形态**


第6根K线突破了陡峭的微型趋势线，为做空做好了铺垫，但它在第7根K线上失败了。第7根K线在交易区间或弱多头里也是一个高2，可以说还是一个双底牛旗（与第5根K线一起）。


> Bar 6 broke above a steep Micro Trendline, setting up a short, which failed on Bar 7. Bar 7 was also a High 2 in a trading range or weak bull and arguably a Bull Flag Double Bottom (with Bar 5).


图 9.14中第1根K线突破了陡峭的微型趋势线，但没有回调K线来形成做空建仓形态。交易外包K线的通行做法是在它高点上方一个最小报价单位处、低点下方一个最小报价单位处各挂一张入场止损单，哪张成交就按哪一边入场。不过一般来说，你应该等更多价格行为出现，而从横盘走势看，大多数交易者显然就是这么做的。


> Bar 1 in Figure 9. 14 broke above a steep Micro Trendline but there was no pullback bar to setup a short . The general convention for trading outside bars is to place entry stop orders at one tick above its high and one tick below its low and enter on whichever is filled. However, in general, you should wait for more price action, which is obviously what most traders did, as seen by the sideways action.


第2根K线是第二次尝试涨到那条趋势线上方，因此是一次合理的做多入场，与那根无关紧要的小幅横盘外包K线（第1根K线）无关。它实际上是在第1根K线突破微型趋势线之后的突破回调做多入场。随后三根K线都想回调、但都失败了（三根低点相同，没有一根能走到前一根K线之下），这是多头在站稳脚跟的迹象。


> Bar 2 was a second attempt to rally above that trendline and so was a reasonable long entry, independent of the meaningless small sideways outside Bar 1. It was effectively a Breakout Pullback long entry following the Bar 1 breakout above the Micro Trendline. The next three bars tried to pull back but failed (all had the same low and none was able to trade below the prior bar), which is a sign that the bulls were taking a stand.


![图 9.14](figures/fig-09-14.png)


**图 9.14　趋势线突破失败之后的失败**


![图 9.15](figures/fig-09-15.png)


**图 9.15　失败的楔形通常至少会走出一次等距运动**


图 9.15中第4根K线完成了从第2根和第3根K线开始的向下三次推进，也从第1根和第3根K线形成的空头趋势通道线处弹开。然而，市场走出的是横盘而不是上涨。多头不强，所以表面上看起来的过度看空其实一点也不过度。当一个高潮形态没能形成任何逆势动能时，就假定自己读错了市场，正在往错误的方向找交易。


> Bar 4 in Figure 9.15 completed a Three Push down move from Bars 2 and 3, and also bounced off a bear trend channel line from Bars 1 and 3. However, the market went sideways rather than up. The bulls were not strong, so what appeared to be excess bearishness was not an excess at all. When a climax pattern fails to form any Countertrend momentum, then assume that you read the market wrong and are looking to trade in the wrong direction.


第8根K线一直是一根多头反转K线，直到最后几秒它快速下跌，变成一根空头趋势K线。过度急切的多头以为它是楔形底部、两条空头趋势通道线处的多头反转K线，结果它变成了对空头趋势通道线的一次空头突破，这意味着现在所有人都同意后面还有更多行情。紧随这次楔形反转失败之后的那一系列空头趋势K线证实了这一点。如果你留意市场走势，你会看到那根多头反转K线垮塌成一根空头趋势K线，然后你就会做空它，因为你清楚有被套住的早入场多头，他们买的是自己以为会从空头趋势通道线起来的一根强多头反转K线（不要抢在K线收盘前动手；总是等它们收盘、等下一根K线确认反转）。即使不知道这些，在那次空头趋势通道线突破的低点下方一个最小报价单位处做空，仍然是一笔聪明的交易。


> Bar 8 was a bull reversal bar until the final seconds when it quickly sold off into a bear trend bar. What overly eager bulls thought was going to be a bull reversal bar at the bottom of a Wedge and two bear trend channel lines turned into a bear breakout of the bear trend channel lines, which means that everyone now agrees that there is much more to go. This is confirmed by the series of bear trend bars that followed the Wedge reversal failure. If you watched the market action, you would have seen the bull reversal bar collapse into a bear trend bar, and you then would have shorted it, knowing that there were trapped early entry longs who bought what they thought was going to be a strong bull reversal bar off a bear trend channel line (don't front run the bars; always wait for them to close and the next bar to confirm the reversal). Even without knowing this, shorting one tick below the low of that bear trend channel line breakout is still a smart trade.


第11根K线是又一个三次推进向下形态，但带着那么多十字星和重叠K线，任何做多都需要第二个信号，而交易者应该在铁丝网高点附近找一根小K线来做空（比如第12根K线，它显然把前一根K线那个多头反转K线入场处突破做多的交易者套住了）。第12根K线是一根糟糕的多头反转K线，因为它与前几根K线重叠太多，逼着你在一个空头交易区间的高点附近买入（记住，买低，卖高！）。这是一个非常强的空头趋势日，最佳交易者不会去找楔形。相反，他们会在均线附近找做空。既然机会那么少，空头就非常强，聪明的空头会卖出每一个失败的做多信号，也会卖出低1和低2入场。


> Bar 11 was another Three Push down pattern, but with all of those dojis and overlapping bars, a second signal was needed for any long, and traders should be looking for a small bar near the high of the Barb Wire to short (like Bar 12, which clearly trapped longs on the breakout from the bull reversal bar entry one bar earlier). Bar 12 was a bad bull reversal bar because it had too much overlap with the prior bars, forcing you to be buying near the high of a bear trading range (remember, buy low, sell high!). This has been a very strong bear trend day, and the best traders would not be looking for Wedges. Instead, they would be looking to short near the EMA. Since there were so few opportunities, the bears were very strong and smart shorts would be selling every failed buy signal as well as Low 1 and Low 2 entries .


![图 9.16](figures/fig-09-16.png)


**图 9.16　趋势线突破失败之后的失败**


图 9.16中，第3根K线向上突破了一条陡峭的微型趋势线，构成了一个做空的建仓形态。可是，这次趋势线突破的失败形态，两根K线之后在第4根K线又失败了（严格说，它并不算失败，因为它已经拿到了一次剥头皮的利润），而失败后的失败总是一个好的建仓形态（这里是一次突破回调做多）。


> Bar 3 in Figure 9.16 broke above a steep Micro Trendline, setting up a short. However, the failed trendline breakout failed two bars later at Bar 4 (technically, it did not fail because it reached a scalper's profit), and a failed failure is always a good setup (here, a Breakout Pullback long).


图 9.17中趋势很强，而你把所有顺势做空的机会都错过了，因为你看到的全是趋势通道线和潜在的反转——你以为这是交易区间日里一次过头的抛售（急速与通道形态里的通道，看上去总是那副样子）。要有耐心，在出现一次清晰、强劲到不用画线就能看出过头的反转之前，只做顺势交易，比如那根反转了昨天低点的巨大第6根K线，那是一个三次推进向下形态（第4、5、6根K线）。不要交易你以为应该发生的事。只交易正在发生的事，哪怕它看起来不可思议。


> The trend is strong in Figure 9.17, and you are missing all of the With Trend shorts because all you are seeing are trend channel lines and potential reversals in what you believe is an overdone selloff in a trading range day (channels in Spike and Channel patterns always look that way). Be patient, and only trade With Trend until there is a reversal that is so clear and strong that you don't need to draw the line to see the excess, like the large Bar 6 that reversed yesterday's low and was a Three Push Down pattern (Bars 4, 5, and 6). Don't trade what you believe should be happening. Only trade what is happening, even if it seems impossible.


![图 9.17](figures/fig-09-17.png)


**图 9.17　每当你发现自己在画多条趋势通道线时，你必然会被自己对“不敢相信正在发生的事”的焦虑蒙住眼睛，看不见眼前的东西**


所有形态都会失败，不管它们看上去多好。当它们失败时，总会有被套的交易者不得不带着亏损出场，通常是在入场K线或信号K线之外一个最小报价单位处，而这对聪明的交易者来说是一次机会，可以做一笔低风险的剥头皮。把你的入场止损单挂在这些被套交易者挂保护性止损的完全相同的位置上，你就能在他们出场的地方入场。他们不会急着再朝原来的方向入场，这会让市场朝你的方向一边倒，应该至少带来一次剥头皮，通常还会走出一段两段式行情。


> All patterns fail, no matter how good they look. When they do, there will be trapped traders who will have to exit with a loss, usually at one tick beyond the entry or signal bars, and this is an opportunity for smart traders to enter for a low-risk scalp. Place your entry stop order at exactly the same place that these trapped traders are placing their protective stops, and you will get in where they will get out. They won't be eager to enter again in their original direction, and this makes the market one-sided in your direction and should lead to at least a scalp and usually a two-legged move.


这类形态大多可以交易，但始终要把一部分仓位剥头皮止盈，并把止损移到保本，以防这个形态失败。


> Most are tradable, but always scalp out part of your position and move your stop to breakeven in case the pattern fails.


图 9.18中，第2根K线和第4根K线形成了一个双顶熊旗，但失败了；随后市场又形成了第3根K线和第5根K线的双底牛旗。


> Bars 2 and 4 in Figure 9.18 formed a Double Top Bear Flag that failed, and the market then formed a Bars 3 and 5 Double Bottom Bull Flag.


接下来，在第4根K线和第6根K线的双顶熊旗处，你不得不再次反向；不过你这笔多头本可以净赚70美分。到这时你就知道，市场正在形成一个交易区间，很可能是一个三角形。


> You then had to reverse again at the Bar 4 and 6 Double Top Bear Flag, but you would have netted 70 cents from your long. At this point, you knew that the market was forming a trading range, likely a triangle.


第7根K线是又一次失败形态，但也是一次不错的多头机会，因为强行情（这里的强行情是涨到第1根K线的那段上涨行情）之后的交易区间通常是延续形态，而且第3、5、7根K线都在 EMA 处找到了支撑。当价格保持在上升的 EMA 上方时，只要前一根K线触及 EMA，就始终要在它的高点之上寻找买入机会，尤其是当这根K线的收盘价朝着你的方向时。


> Bar 7 was another failure but a good long since trading ranges following a strong move (the rally to Bar 1) are usually continuation patterns and Bars 3, 5, and 7 all found support at the EMA. When the prices are holding above a rising EMA, always look to buy above the high of the prior bar if that bar touches the EMA, especially if its close is in your direction.


![图 9.18](figures/fig-09-18.png)


**图 9.18　股票常常在头一个小时形成双顶或双底旗形**


跌向第9根K线的那段抛售持续了七根K线，其中没有任何多头力量，所以更好的做法是等二次入场，尽管与第7根K线相比，第9根K线是一个更高的低点。


> The sell off to Bar 9 was seven bars long with no bullish strength so it would be better to wait for a second entry, despite Bar 9 being a Higher Low (compared to Bar 7).


第10根K线处的突破回调，是一次完美的二次入场做多——此前微型趋势线向上突破已经失败（它只给了空头一次剥头皮的利润），而那次失败又在第10根K线失败。


> The Breakout Pullback at Bar 10 was a perfect second entry long after the Micro Trendline breakout to the upside failed (it only gave the shorts a scalper's profit) and the failure failed at Bar 10.


图 9.19中，第4根K线是一个双底牛旗入场的建仓形态，但它随着第5根K线处的 M2S 突破回调而失败，随后走出了两段下跌。你既可以做空 M2S，也可以在第4根K线低点下方一个或两个最小报价单位处挂止损卖出。当市场两次尝试做某件事（比如从第2根K线低点附近的价格向上反弹）、而两次都失败时，接下来它通常就会做相反的事。


> Bar 4 in Figure 9.19 was a setup for a Double Bottom Bull Flag entry, but it failed with the Bar 5 M2S Breakout Pullback, which led to two legs down. You could either short the M2S, or you could sell on a stop at one or two ticks below the Bar 4 low. When the market makes two attempts to do something (like rally off the price around the low of Bar 2) and fails, it usually will then do the opposite .


![图 9.19](figures/fig-09-19.png)


**图 9.19　双底牛旗失败**


![图 9.20](figures/fig-09-20.png)


**图 9.20　大多数头肩形态会失败，并变成顺势建仓形态**


图 9.20中，第5根K线和第11根K线都是头肩底的右肩，这类形态大多数会失败，这里也一样。光凭形状，不足以成为做逆势交易的理由。在反转形态出现之前，你始终希望先看到一些逆势力量。即便如此，也保证不了这笔交易一定会成功。第2根K线突破了一条趋势线，随后涨到第4根K线的上涨行情很强，只是它没能超过第2根K线的高点，这是一个弱势信号。虽然大多数聪明的交易者不会在第5根K线双底牛旗做多入场之后、于第6根K线的失败形态处反手做空，但他们会把止损移到保本，心想：如果止损被打掉、而这笔交易本身依然不错，那么这次扫止损就会构成一个突破回调做多建仓形态。这里，止损确实被打掉了，但市场继续抛售。刚跌破第5根K线之后的那次单根K线突破回调，是一笔很棒的空头。


> Bars 5 and 1 1 in Figure 9.20 were right shoulders of Head and Shoulder Bottoms, most of which fail, as they did here. The shape alone is not enough reason to place a Countertrend trade. You always want to see some prior Countertrend strength prior to the reversal pattern. Even then, there are no guarantees that the trade will be successful. Bar 2 broke a trendline, and the rally to Bar 4 was strong, although its failure to exceed the Bar 2 high was a sign of weakness. Although most smart traders would not have reversed to short at the Bar 6 failure after the Bar 5 Double Bottom Bull Flag long entry, they would have moved their stops to breakeven, thinking that if the stop was hit but the trade was still good, the stop run would set up a Breakout Pullback long setup. Here, the stop was hit, but the market kept selling off. The one-bar Breakout Pullback just after the breakout below Bar 5 was a great short.


第11根K线那个右肩是一次买入机会，但保本止损同样会被打掉。


> The Bar 1 1 right shoulder was a buy, but again the breakeven stop would have been hit.


图 9.21中，跌向第2根K线和跌向第6根K线的两段抛售都突破了主要趋势线，所以对前高的一次两段式测试应该会构成一笔不错的空头。第3根K线处的低2做空成功了，做法既可以是在第3根K线下方做空，也可以两根K线之后做二次入场。


> The selloffs to Bar 2 and to Bar 6 in Figure 9.21 broke major trendlines, so a two-legged test of the prior high should setup a good short. The Bar 3 Low 2 short was successful, either by shorting below Bar 3 or taking the second entry two bars later.


![图 9.21](figures/fig-09-21.png)


**图 9.21　反转失败就是顺势建仓形态**


第8根K线处的做空没那么确定，因为这次测试是一根大型多头趋势外包K线（差不多算外包，因为它的低点与前一根K线相同）。外包K线之后传统的入场方式，是在它两端之外一个最小报价单位处挂止损单，哪个方向被突破就朝哪个方向成交。可是，外包K线本质上就是一根K线构成的交易区间，而交易区间的突破入场大多数都会失败。你只应该很少在外包K线的突破处入场，因为风险太大（止损要放到这根K线的另一侧，而它很大）。


> The Bar 8 short is less certain because the test was a large bull trend outside bar (almost outside, since it had the same low as the prior bar). The traditional way to enter after an outside bar is on a stop at one tick beyond both extremes, getting filled in the direction of the breakout. However, outside bars are basically one-bar trading ranges, and most trading range breakout entries fail. You should only rarely enter on a breakout of an outside bar because the risk is too great (to the opposite side ofthe bar, which is large).


如果你在第8根K线突破内包K线时做空，那么到这根K线收盘时你就会紧张起来（它是一根十字星K线，说明没人有把握）。不过，多数交易者不会做那笔空，因为三根或更多根横盘K线、其中至少一根是十字星，通常会制造太多不确定性（铁丝网）。外包K线之前的两根小K线，小得足以起到十字星的作用，所以最好等更多价格行为。可是，如果你没有在第8根K线做空，你就得相信很多人做了空，而他们入场K线的十字星收盘让这些交易者对自己的持仓感到不安。他们会急着出场，因此被套住了。他们很可能会在第8根K线入场K线上方一个最小报价单位处买回空头，并且在看到更好的价格行为之前不愿再卖。空头离场、又在买回自己的持仓，那么在他们出场的位置做多（第9根K线，即做空入场K线上方一个最小报价单位处），应该能剥到一次头皮，而且很可能走出两段上涨。要么在第9根K线处、即在十字星内包K线上方一个最小报价单位买入，要么在第9根K线上方买入，理由是第9根K线是一根多头趋势K线，因而是个不错的做多信号K线。


> If you shorted at the Bar 8 breakout of the inside bar, you would be nervous by the bar's close (a doji bar, indicating no conviction). However, most traders would not have taken that short because three or more sideways bars where at least one is a doji usually create too much uncertainty (Barb Wire). The two small bars before the outside bar were small enough to act like dojis, so it is best to wait for more price action. However, if you did not short on Bar 8, you would have to believe that many did and the doji close of their entry bar has these traders feeling uncomfortable with their positions. They will be quick to exit and are therefore trapped. They will likely buy back their shorts at one tick above the Bar 8 entry bar and be reluctant to sell again until they see better price action. With the shorts out of the market and with them buying back their positions, going long exactly where they are exiting (Bar 9, one tick above the short entry bar) should be good for a scalp and likely two legs up. Either buy Bar 9 at one tick above the doji inside bar or above the Bar 9, relying on Bar 9 being a bull trend bar and therefore a good long signal bar.


一段拖得很长的趋势，常常会形成一个水平旗形：它横向延伸好几根K线，突破一条趋势线，然后突破到一个新的极值，但紧接着在随后几根K线里迅速反转。这种最终旗形失败的突破，常常标志着趋势的结束，有时还会带来一次反转。多数情况下，会出现一段可以交易、幅度很大的逆势行情，而且至少有两段。关键的一点是，这个旗形通常主要是水平的，而且往往可以简单到只是一个 ii形态（内包内包）。


> A protracted trend often forms a horizontal flag that extends sideways for several bars, breaks a trendline, and then breaks out to a new extreme but quickly reverses in the next few bars. This Failed Final Flag breakout often marks the end of the trend and sometimes leads to a reversal. In most cases, there will be a tradable, extended Countertrend move that will have at least two legs. A key point is that the flag is usually mostly horizontal and often can be as simple as an ii pattern.


水平区域是双向成交的区域，买家和卖家势均力敌，因此这个区域就像一块磁力位，把每一小段上冲或下探都拉回到它的中部或另一侧。举例来说，在一段延伸的多头行情之后，如果多头夺过控制权、把市场往上推，他们很可能会迅速止盈，而空头则确信先前的交易区间（旗形）是一个平衡区域、因此很可能被测试。通常情况下，多头在至少出现一段延伸至旗形下方很远的两段式修正之前，都不愿再积极进攻（因为旗形突破失败了）。


> A horizontal area is an area of two-sided trading where the buyers and sellers are evenly balanced, and therefore this area acts as a magnet that pulls each little move up or down back to the center or opposite side. For example, after an extended bull move, if the bulls seize control and push the market up, they will likely be quick to take profits and the bears will be confident that the prior trading range (flag) was an area of balance and therefore likely to be tested. Usually, the bulls will be reluctant to be aggressive again until after at least a two-legged correction that extends well below the flag (the flag breakout failed).


微型趋势线突破回调，在某种程度上就是一种最终旗形失败。举例来说，当市场向上突破一条空头微型趋势线、随后又反转向下，但这段抛售在一两根K线之内就失败了，那么这次对趋势线的向上突破，实际上就是一次最终空头旗形的失败。


> A Micro Trendline Breakout Pullback is something of a Failed Final Flag. For example, when there is a break above a bear Micro Trendline and the market reverses down, but the sell off fails within a bar or two, the break above the trendline is effectively a Failed Final Bear Flag.


有时候，最终旗形失败带来的反转，只是发展出一个更大的、呈楔形的旗形。举例来说，多头行情中出现最终旗形失败时，这个旗形的第一段就是楔形最低的那根K线。第二段是把市场反转向下、跌破旗形的那根K线。而楔形余下的部分，就是向下的两段或多段抛售。此时它就是一个更大的牛旗，通常会带来一次多头突破。这个旗形可能变成一个更大的最终旗形失败，也可能只是更大级别多头行情里的一个延续形态。


> Sometimes a Failed Final Flag reversal just leads to the development of a larger flag with a Wedge shape. For example, in a Failed Final Flag in a bull, the first leg of that flag is the lowest bar of the Wedge. The second leg is the bar that reversed the market down below the flag. And the rest of the Wedge is the two or more legged selloff down. This is now a larger bull flag that usually leads to a bull breakout. The flag may become a larger Failed Final Flag or just a continuation pattern in a larger bull.


图 9.22中，第1根K线结束了开盘以来的两段下跌，因此它可能是当日低点。它是在一段拖得很长的行情之后，向上突破了一个横盘空头旗形，所以这可能是一次最终旗形失败、一次反转向上的机会。第1根K线是一根不错的反转K线，触发了这次最终旗形失败的做多，让交易者预期至少会有两段上涨。


> Bar 1 in Figure 9.22 ended two legs down from the open and was therefore a possible low of the day. It broke out of a sideways bear flag after a protracted move, so this could be a Failed Final Flag and a reversal up. Bar 1 was a good reversal bar, triggering the Failed Final Flag long, causing traders to expect at least two legs up.


第4根K线向上突破开盘价时势头很强，促成了图 9.23里一个窄幅交易区间的形成。这个区间常常会成为这波上涨的中部。这里，旗形的强势突破在第7根K线结束，那是一段两段式上涨（第5根K线是第一段）。旗形之后的两段式行情，常常会构成一次主要趋势反转，而这类反转通常至少有两段。与其把第6根K线看成突破回调做多，你也可以把它读作仍在水平形态之内、是第一段的结束即从第5根K线高点下来的那段下跌。第6根K线之后的那根空头K线，成为第二段下跌；在它的高点之上买入是合理的，因为此时你是在多头行情里两次向下尝试都失败之后才买入的。始终要想着正在发生什么。


> The Bar 4 breakout above the open was on strength, and led to the formation of a Tight Trading Range in Figure 9.23. This often becomes the middle of the up move. Here, the strong breakout of the flag ended at Bar 7, which was a two-legged move up (Bar 5 was the first leg). Two-legged moves out of flags often set up a major reversal that typically has at least two legs. Instead of seeing Bar 6 as a Breakout Pullback long, you could read it as still part of the horizontal pattern and the end of the first leg down from the Bar 5 high. The bear bar after Bar 6 becomes the second leg down and buying above its high is reasonable since you are buying after two attempts down in a bull failed. Always be thinking about what is taking place.


![图 9.22](figures/fig-09-22.png)


**图 9.22　最终旗形失败**


![图 9.23](figures/fig-09-23.png)


**图 9.23　最终旗形失败**


跌向第10根K线的这波行情是两段的，但它只有一根逆势K线（第9根K线），这意味着它很可能只是两个更大行情段中的第一段。


> The move down to Bar 10 was in two legs, but it only had a single Countertrend bar (Bar 9), which means that it was likely going to be just the first leg of two larger legs.


第9根K线这个插曲的强度，还不足以被看作第一段的结束。不管怎样，做空的交易者如果不确定，可以把止损移到保本。另外，趋势开始时出现的外包K线，应该被视为趋势真正的起点，而且外包K线之后通常至少会有两段下跌，所以第10根K线之后的高2其实只是高1。再者，那是一次微型趋势线做空，因此应该被看作低1。


> The Bar 9 interruption was not strong enough to be considered the end of the first leg. In any case, if a short trader is unsure, he could move his stop to breakeven. Also, an outside bar at the start of trend should be considered as the true beginning of the trend and there will usually be at least two legs down following the outside bar, so the High 2 after Bar 10 is actually just a High 1. Also, it was a Micro Trendline short and therefore should be viewed as Low 1.


第11根K线没能扫掉止损，而 EMA 处的高2（M2B）失败了——这在意料之中，因为它实际上只是一个高1——结果走出了一段强劲的空头。很容易预见到这个高2会失败，因为聪明的交易者会把它当作高1，而第7根K线创出的更高的高点跟在一次趋势线突破之后，所以此时趋势应该被认为是向下的。聪明的交易者不会去找高2买入，尤其是在一根外包下跌K线之后，更尤其是因为很可能会有两段清晰的下跌。事后看，第4根K线处的交易区间，在从第1根K线起来的那段多头行情中变成了一个最终旗形失败；但聪明的交易者本来就会预见到这种可能，并留出一部分空头仓位做波段。有时候，一个最终旗形可以只有一两根K线长。当市场正在快速运行、出现异常大的趋势K线时，这很常见。从这个小型旗形出去的突破，常常会在一两根K线后反转，而这通常会导致一次持续一个小时或更久的两段式回调。这是一个可以交易的逆势建仓形态，但它并不能可靠地引向一次趋势反转。那些大趋势K线所展示的强劲动能，通常之后会跟着一次对趋势极值点的测试。


> Bar 11 failed to run the stop, and the High 2 at the EMA (M2B) failed, as expected since it functionally was just a High 1, resulting in a strong bear. It was easy to anticipate that this High 2 would fail because smart traders would be regarding it as a High 1 and the Higher High at Bar 7 followed a trendline break so the trend should be considered down at this point. Smart traders would not be looking to buy a High 2, especially after an outside down bar, and especially since two clear down legs are likely. In hindsight, the Bar 4 trading range turned into a Failed Final Flag in the bull move up from Bar 1, but smart traders would have anticipated this possibility and swung part of their short. Sometimes a Final Flag can be only one or two bars long. This is common when the market is moving fast with unusually large trend bars. The breakout from that small flag often reverses after a bar or two, and this usually results in a two-legged pullback that lasts for an hour or more. This is a tradable Countertrend setup, but it does not reliably lead to a trend reversal. The strong momentum demonstrated by those large trend bars usually is followed by a test of the trend extreme.


图 9.24中，第3根K线是一根巨大的空头趋势K线，在市场向上跳空越过空头趋势线之后，它前面已经接连出现了四根强劲的空头趋势K线。空头趋势线被突破，提醒交易者去寻找一次对这段空头行情第1根K线低点的测试，看看卖家会不会在同一个价位附近再次失败。


> Bar 3 in Figure 9.24 was a huge bear trend bar that followed four other strong bear trend bars after the market gapped above the bear trendline. The break of the bear trendline alerts traders to look for a test of the Bar 1 low of the bear to see if the sellers fail again around the same price level.


第4根K线是从一个小型熊旗和微型趋势线低1走出来的做空建仓形态。考虑到市场到目前为止的高潮式行为以及昨天的趋势线突破，交易者会期待这里成为一个最终旗形——在对第1根K线那个空头低点做一次测试之后，引出一段向上的反转。


> Bar 4 was the setup for a short off a small bear flag and the Micro Trendline Low 1. Given the climactic behavior of the market to this point and yesterday's trendline break, traders will be looking for this to be a Final Flag that will lead to a reversal up after a test of the Bar 1 Bear low.


![图 9.24](figures/fig-09-24.png)


**图 9.24　最终旗形失败**


第5根K线又是一根巨大的空头趋势K线，第6根K线则是一个 ii形态做多入场，预期会有一段至少持续一个小时、至少两段的上涨。两根 ii 形态K线都是多头收盘，这让做多交易成功的机会更大。第二段出现在第二天的第9根K线。那些大型空头趋势K线所展示的向下动能很强，通常会让交易者把市场压下去，在一两天之内测试那个低点。虽然没有画出，但第9根K线的高点引发了当天晚些时候的一次抛售，跌到了远低于第5根K线低点的位置。


> Bar 5 was another huge bear trend bar, and Bar 6 was an ii long entry, with the expectation of a rally that will last at least an hour and have at least two legs up. Both ii bars had bull closes, which makes the chances for a successful long trade greater. The second leg occurred at Bar 9 on the following day. The strength of the downward momentum demonstrated by the large bear trend bars usually makes traders push the market down for a test of the low within a day or two. Although it is not shown, the Bar 9 high lead to a selloff later that day that went far below the Bar 5 low.


图 9.25中，第3根K线是一根巨大、可能带有高潮性质的多头趋势K线之后的两根K线回调，因此它是一个可能的最终旗形。第4根K线也是从昨天低点起来的第二段上涨（第1根K线是那第一段的结束）。


> Bar 3 in Figure 9.25 was a two-bar pullback after a huge and possibly climactic bull trend bar, and therefore it is a possible Final Flag. Bar 4 was also a second leg up from yesterday's low (Bar 1 was the end of the first leg).


第4根K线是一个 ii形态建仓形态，用来做空最终旗形失败；这种建仓形态应该被预期会引出一段两段式、持续时间很长的修正，事实也确实如此。第3根K线处的牛旗原来就是那个最终旗形，它的突破失败了，并在第4根K线之后反转下跌。注意，ii 形态的第二根K线是空头收盘，当交易者想寻找做空机会时，这始终是理想的。第一根K线也是空头收盘，但第二根K线始终更重要，因为它是更近的历史。


> Bar 4 was an ii setup for a Failed Final Flag short that should be expected to lead to a two-legged, protracted correction, which it did. The Bar 3 bull flag turned out to be the Final Flag, and its breakout failed and reversed down after Bar 4. Note that the second bar of the ii pattern had a bear close, which is always desirable when a trader is looking to short. The first bar also had a bear dose but the second bar is always more important because it is the more recent history.


涨到第4根K线高点的那股强劲动能，让交易者在当天晚些时候把市场推上去测试趋势极值点。


> The strong momentum up to the Bar 4 high made traders drive the market up to test the trend extreme later in the day.


![图 9.25](figures/fig-09-25.png)


**图 9.25　最终旗形失败**


第3–5根K线演变成了一个更大的、呈楔形形状的牛旗。第3根K线是第一次向下推进，第5根K线是第三次。再往前三根K线，是第二次向下推进。随后市场对这个向下倾斜、呈楔形的牛旗走了一次很弱的多头突破，但在第6根K线处形成一个更低的高点、以失败告终。楔形旗形也可能引出一段延伸的多头行情，或者变成一个更大的最终旗形失败。楔形常常在以下情形失败：交易者急于做逆势，不等一次清晰的趋势线突破和逆势力量出现，就去反向操作第一个出现的小型三次推进形态。单靠三次推进——尤其是当它很小时——在既没有先前的趋势线突破、也没有一次主要趋势通道线过靶并反转的情况下，很少能让趋势反转。这些楔形应该被看作顺势建仓形态，聪明的交易者会在逆势交易者认赔出场的位置入场。


> Bars 3-5 evolved into a larger Wedge-shaped bull flag. Bar 3 is the first push down and Bar 5 is the third. Three bars earlier was the second push down. The market then had a weak bull breakout of this downward sloping, Wedge-shaped bull flag, but failed in a Lower High at Bar 6. A Wedge flag can also lead to an extended bull move or become a larger Failed Final Flag. Wedges most often fail when traders are overly eager to enter Countertrend, do not wait for a clear trendline break and countertrend strength, and fade the first small Three Push pattern that appears. Three Pushes alone, especially when small, will rarely reverse a trend in the absence of a prior trendline break or a major trend channel line overshoot and reversal. These Wedges should be viewed as With Trend setups, and smart traders will enter where the Countertrend traders will be taking their losses.


有时候，楔形反转之后，那次反转失败了，然后趋势恢复，紧接着却是一次冲向新极值的突破失败。这就是失败后的失败；它是一个二次信号，因此很可能至少带来一段两段式修正。举例来说，如果多头行情里有一个楔形顶，市场先小幅下跌、随后强势反转创出新高，而这个新高又失败了，那么这可能引出一段强劲的空头行情，因为这是多头第二次没能把价格推过这个区域。这场从最初那个楔形开始的下跌，通常会突破趋势线；而冲向新高的那一波，是对多头顶部的一次更高的高点测试，因此是一个做空建仓形态。


> Sometimes after a Wedge reverses, the reversal fails, and the trend resumes only to be followed by a failed breakout to a new extreme. This is a failed failure, which is a second signal and therefore likely to result in at least a two-legged correction. For example, ifthere is a Wedge top in a bull and the market drops a little but then reverses strongly to a new high, and that new high fails, this can lead to a strong bear move since it is a second failure by the bulls to push beyond this price area. The move down from the original Wedge typically breaks the trendline, and the move to the new high is a Higher High test of the bull top and therefore a short setup.


![图 9.26](figures/fig-09-26.png)


**图 9.26　楔形反转失败就是顺势建仓形态**


图 9.26中，市场试图形成一个楔形反转，但第3根K线是在一片十字星区域（铁丝网）里连续第三根相互重叠的K线。这是对更低价格的接受，而不是拒绝，所以它让向上反转变得不太可能。第3根K线作为入场K线，是一根外包上涨K线，它套住了那些只看到三次推进、却忽略了一个事实的多头：市场并没有对空头趋势通道线做出明显的过靶。楔形是一种高潮反转，所以它要奏效，就需要出现高潮式行为。必须有一段急速下跌，而不是一连串相互重叠的K线（交易区间或熊旗）。


> The market tried to form a Wedge reversal in Figure 9.26 but Bar 3 was the third overlapping bar in a row in an area of dojis (Barb Wire). This is acceptance of the lower price and not rejection, so it made a reversal up unlikely. The Bar 3 entry bar was an outside up bar that trapped bulls who overlooked the absence of a significant overshoot of the bear trend channel line and only saw the Three Pushes. A Wedge is a type of climax reversal, so climactic behavior is needed for it to be effective. There needs to be a spike down and not a series of overlapping bars (a trading range or bear flag).


当楔形失败时，这波行情通常会是近似的一次等距运动，幅度等于楔形的高度（这里，跌破第3根K线的这波下跌，点数大约等于从第1根K线刚过之后的楔形顶部、到第3根K线低点底部的那一段）。


> When a Wedge fails, the move will usually be an approximate Measured Move equal to the height of the Wedge (here, the move down below Bar 3 was about the same number of points as there were from the top of the Wedge just after Bar 1, to the bottom at the low of Bar 3).


图 9.27中，在一个跳空低开的日子里，市场走的是第一根K线即趋势的空头行情。过于急切的多头会为自己买入第2根K线处那个楔形反转找理由，说服自己这是两段式下跌的终点，而且第1根K线处有一次趋势线突破。可是，第1根K线是一次失败的趋势线突破，并不代表多头带着任何动能接管了市场。第2根K线处在内包K线上方做多、做楔形反转的入场，是一次成功的剥头皮，但不是那种很可能演变成更大行情的建仓形态。从开盘到第2根K线的空头微型趋势线，是空头强势的标志。跌向第2根K线的这段行情，中间没有一次有意义的趋势线突破，中间也没有向上的动能，因此看上去更像是由两个更小行情段构成的一段下跌。在空头趋势线被突破之后，应该还会有一段下跌，然后才可能有像样的上涨。


> The market was in a bear Trend from the First Bar on a gap down day in Figure 9.27. Overly eager bulls will rationalize buying the Bar 2 Wedge reversal by convincing themselves that it was the end of a two-legged move down and there was a trendline break at Bar 1. However, Bar 1 was a failed trendline break and did not represent the bulls' taking control of the market with any momentum. The Bar 2 Wedge long entry above the inside bar was a successful scalp but not a setup that would likely tum into anything more. The bear Micro Trendline from the open to Bar 2 is a sign of bearish strength. The move down to Bar 2 did not have a meaningful trendline break or upward momentum in the middle and therefore looked more like a single leg down made up of two smaller legs. There should be a second leg down after a break of the bear trendline before any meaningful rally could be likely.


![图 9.27](figures/fig-09-27.png)


**图 9.27　如果此前没有趋势线突破，就预期楔形反转会失败，所以不要反向操作趋势**


随后在第3根K线出现了一次低2做空。这波小上涨确实突破了一条趋势线，所以买家可以在新低失败处寻找一次剥头皮机会，这个机会出现在第4根K线。可是，由于没有一根强劲的多头反转K线，这笔做多很可能会失败——它果然在第5根K线的 M2S 做空处失败了——随后市场向下突破，进入第二段空头行情，并在第5根K线处那个最终旗形失败的一个最小报价单位假突破上结束。


> There was then a Low 2 short at Bar 3. This little rally did break a trendline so buyers could look for a scalp on a failed new low, which occurred at Bar 4. However, in the absence of a strong bull reversal bar, this long was likely to fail, which it did at the Bar 5 M2S short, and the market then broke down into the second bear leg that ended at the Bar 5 Failed Final Flag one-tick false breakout.


这是一段开盘即趋势的空头行情，属于最强的空头类型之一；聪明的交易者会强迫自己接过每一次做空机会，而不会去做多。


> This was a Trend from the Open bear, which is one of the strongest types of bears and smart traders would be forcing themselves to take every short and would not be taking longs.


图 9.28中，第9根K线是一次空头趋势通道线过靶反转，也是一次第三次向下推进（楔形）。不过，它不是一根强劲的多头信号K线，因为它与前一根K线重叠太多，收盘又弱（多头实体很小）。这里没有对过度抛售的清晰拒绝。充其量，你应该等到二次入场再买。此外，从第5根K线下来的这波下跌中没有先前的多头力量，所以你不应该去找做多机会。


> Bar 9 in Figure 9.28 was a bear trend channel line overshoot reversal and a Third Push Down (Wedge). However, it was not a strong bull signal bar because it overlapped the prior bar too much and had a weak close (small bull body). There is no clear rejection of excessive selling. At best, you should wait for a second entry before buying. Also, there was no prior bullish strength in the move down from Bar 5 so you should not be looking for longs.


第10根K线对任何买入这个楔形的交易者来说，都是一次一个最小报价单位的失败。它是第三根横盘K线，所以现在聪明的交易者看到的是空头行情中的一个交易区间，而交易区间通常是延续形态。K线相互重叠，意味着市场正在接受这些更低的价位，而不是在拒绝它们。


> Bar 10 was a One-Tick Failure for any traders who bought the Wedge. It was the third sideways bar, so now smart traders are seeing a trading range in a bear, which is usually a continuation pattern. Overlapping bars mean that the market is accepting these lower prices, not rejecting them.


![图 9.28](figures/fig-09-28.png)


**图 9.28　没有更早趋势线突破的楔形，不是反转建仓形态**


在空头行情里买入之前，你需要看到一个拒绝的信号。把交易建立在一个信念上——认为市场早该修正了——是一种亏钱的交易方式。趋势能走出的幅度，可以远超大多数交易者的想象。


> You need a sign of rejection before you buy in a bear. Basing a trade on a belief that the market is overdue for a correction is a losing approach to trading. Trends can go much further than most traders could ever imagine.


交易者可以在第11根K线做空低1，但这是一个交易区间，而聪明的交易者不会在没有更强多头陷阱的情况下，在它的低点做空。这是第二次一个最小报价单位的失败突破。另外，楔形通常会有两次向上反弹的尝试（两段上涨），所以你只应该在楔形失败时（也就是跌破第9根K线的低点）做空，或者在第二次向上反弹的尝试失败时做空——就像第12根K线处的低2做空那样。


> A trader could short the Low 1 at Bar 1 1, but this is a trading range, and smart traders will not short at its low without a stronger bull trap. It was a second One-Tick Failed Breakout. Also, a Wedge usually makes two attempts to rally (two legs up) so you should only short if the Wedge failed (that is, fell below the Bar 9 low), or if the second attempt to rally fails as it did at the Bar 12 Low 2 Short.


第12根K线是连续第三次一个最小报价单位的失败突破，但这一次它出现在两段上涨之后（第9根K线和第11根K线），而且是一次低2做空。这是聪明的交易者会做的第一笔交易，因为它是熊旗里的一个低2。它之所以特别好，是因为让楔形向上反转的两次尝试都失败了（第10根K线和第12根K线），两次都没成。这两次尝试代表了从楔形起来的两段上涨，而且它们明显很弱。此外，连续三次一个最小报价单位的失败非常罕见，所以接下来的这波行情很可能会一路走开，尤其是在一个趋势日里、这还是一笔顺势交易。


> Bar 12 was a third One-Tick Failed Breakout in a row, but this time, it followed two legs up (Bars 9 and 1 1) and was Low 2 short. This is the first trade that smart traders would take, because it is a Low 2 in a bear flag. What made it especially good was that there were two failed attempts to make the Wedge reverse upward (Bars 10 and 12), and both failed. These represent the two legs up from the Wedge, and, they are clearly weak. Also, three One-Tick Failures in a row is very rare, so it is likely that the next move would run, especially since it was With Trend in a trend day.


交易者也可以等到跌破第9根K线低点再去做空，因为只有到那时，楔形才算确定失败。这次突破的成交量很大（1分钟图上14,000张合约），证明许多聪明的交易者一直等到那一刻才做空。


> A trader could also have waited to short below the low of Bar 9 because it was only then that the Wedge definitively failed. The heavy volume on the breakout (14,000 contracts on the 1-minute chart) confirmed that many smart traders waited until that point to short.


在双顶突破之后不久，交易者就会认出这一天是一个趋势性交易区间日。在这类空头趋势日里，通常两个方向都可以安全交易，但做多是逆势的，所以建仓形态必须很强，比如第3根K线处、以及第4根K线之后两根K线处的那些（二次入场做多）。


> Traders would have recognized this day as a Trending Trading Range day shortly after the breakout from the Double Top. It is usually safe to trade in both directions on this type of bear trend day, but the longs are Countertrend so the setups must be strong, like those at Bar 3 and two bars after Bar 4 (second entry long).


要做多，你首先需要有一次趋势线突破，最好还有一根反转K线。既然第9根K线是一根弱势的反转K线，而你又倾向于在趋势通道线过靶并反转之后买入，那么你可以等一次做多的二次入场。第12根K线是一次二次入场，但那是在一个四根K线交易区间顶部的买入，而在熊旗的顶部，你绝不可以买入。那次弱势的二次入场一失败，空头就接管了市场；而这才你需要做的那笔交易，而不是花太多精力说服自己做多的建仓形态已经够好了。


> To buy, you first need a trendline break, and it is better to have a reversal bar. Since Bar 9 was a weak reversal bar and you are inclined to buy after a trend channel line overshoot and reversal, you could wait for a second long entry. Bar 12 was a second entry, but it was a purchase at the top of a four-bar trading range, and you can never buy at the top of a bear flag. Once that weak second entry failed, the bears took control, and that was the trade that you needed to take instead of spending too much energy convincing yourself that the long setups were adequate .


![图 9.29](figures/fig-09-29.png)


**图 9.29　失败后的失败楔形（一次再度失败的失败形态）**


图 9.29中，第1、2、3根K线形成了一个楔形反转。第4根K线向上突破了趋势线，但出现了一次更低的低点，测试了第3根K线的低点。楔形有时会失败，而这次失败又失败了，结果形成一个更低的低点。这个更低的低点是一次反转，因为它跟在第4根K线处的趋势线突破之后。第5根K线也完成了一个更大的楔形底。在 Emini 上，一种非常流行的交易是为四个最小报价单位剥头皮。在趋势中，可能会有一连串成功的剥头皮，但当某一笔打到限价单却没有成交时，这种五个最小报价单位的失败就是动能流失的信号。


> Bars 1, 2, and 3 in Figure 9.29 formed a Wedge reversal. Bar 4 broke above the trendline, but there was a Lower Low test of the Bar 3 low. Sometimes Wedges fail, and the failure fails, resulting in a Lower Low. This Lower low is a reversal because it followed a trendline break at Bar 4. Bar 5 also completed a larger Wedge bottom. In the Emini, a very popular trade is a scalp for four ticks. In a trend, there may be a series of successful scalps, but when one hits the limit order and does not get filled, this Five-Tick Failure is a sign of a loss of momentum.


这些在1分钟图和3分钟图上也很常见。由于要做成一次四个最小报价单位的剥头皮，需要六个最小报价单位的突破（一个最小报价单位用于止损入场，四个最小报价单位的利润，通常还要再多一个最小报价单位来确保止盈目标的限价单成交），所以一波只走了五个最小报价单位就反转的行情，常常说明趋势交易者已经失去了控制，回调或反转即将来临。在另一些有很多剥头皮交易者的市场里，也有类似的失败，比如 SPY 和 QQQQ。对这两个品种来说，常见的止盈目标是10个最小报价单位，这通常需要走出信号K线之外12个最小报价单位的行情。如果这波行情只走到10个或11个最小报价单位（甚至只有8个或9个）就反转了，那它通常至少会带来反方向上的一次能赚钱的剥头皮，因为剥头皮交易者被套住了；他们会在信号K线或入场K线反转时出场，给你的交易添上一把火。


> These are also common on 1- and 3-minute charts. Since a six-tick breakout is needed to make a four-tick scalp (one-tick for the stop entry, four-ticks profit, and usually one more tick to be sure the profit target limit order is filled), a move that goes only five ticks and then reverses often indicates that the trend traders have lost control and a pullback or reversal is imminent. There are comparable failures in other markets that have many scalpers, like the SPY and the QQQQ. For both, a common profit target is 10 ticks, which usually requires a 12-tick move beyond the signal bar. If the move only reaches 10 or 11 ticks (or even 8 or 9) and then reverses, it usually leads to at least a profitable scalp in the opposite direction, since the scalpers are trapped and will get out on the reversal of the signal or entry bars and add fuel to your trade.


如果一只股票在剥头皮时能可靠地走到超过一美元，但随后两次冲击一美元目标都只差一点点没到，那么这就是反方向上的一次不错剥头皮机会。


> If a stock reliably reaches more than a dollar on a scalp but then falls just short on two attempts at the one dollar target, then this is a good scalp in the opposite direction.


为四个最小报价单位做空剥头皮，曾是一个成功的策略，持续了将近两个小时。可是，图 9.30中从第4根K线内包K线做的那笔空头，只下跌了五个最小报价单位就反转向上。这意味着许多空头没有在止盈目标的限价单上成交，也说明空头很快就保本出场了，而且在第5根K线上方更是如此。当时市场正在测试昨天的低点，而这是趋势通道线下方的第二次试探（趋势通道线以第1根K线到第3根K线的趋势线为基准）。多头正在找买入的理由，而这笔失败的做空剥头皮，正是他们最想找到的最后一样东西。


> Scalping short for four ticks was a successful strategy for almost two hours. However, the short from the Bar 4 inside bar in Figure 9.30 dropped only five ticks and reversed up. This means that many shorts did not get filled on their profit target limit order and that the shorts were quick to exit at breakeven and certainly above Bar 5. The market was testing yesterday's low, and it was the second probe below the trend channel line (based on the trendline from Bars 1 to 3). The bulls were looking for reasons to buy, and the failed short scalp was the final thing that they were hoping to find.


![图 9.30](figures/fig-09-30.png)


**图 9.30　Emini 里的五个最小报价单位的失败**


图 9.31中这些 QQQQ 的5分钟图交易，每一笔在失败之前都走到了8到11个最小报价单位。保护性止损会让剥头皮交易者在这些交易里都大约在保本位置出场，但这仍然是忙活半天、没什么可展示的。不过，显然还有很多其他能赚钱的剥头皮机会；但如果失败的交易太多，剥头皮会很累人，常常让交易者失去专注，随后错过能赚钱的交易。在一个清晰的、开盘即趋势的空头日里，最好的做法是只做顺势交易，寻找 M2S 建仓形态或简单的低2来卖出。你的胜率会很高，让你能保持健康的心态、继续入场。


> Each of these 5-minute QQQQ trades in Figure 9.31 reached between 8 and 1 1 ticks before failing. The protective stops would get scalpers out at around breakeven in all of them, but it still was a lot of work with little to show. Clearly, however, there were many other profitable scalps, but it is tiring to scalp if there are too many unsuccessful trades, often making a trader lose focus and then miss profitable trades. On a clear Bear Trend from the Open day, the best approach is to only trade With Trend and look to sell M2S setups or simple Low 2s. Your winning percentage will be high, allowing you to have a healthy attitude and continue to take entries.


![图 9.31](figures/fig-09-31.png)


**图 9.31　失败的剥头皮交易常常变成反方向的建仓形态**


![图 9.32](figures/fig-09-32.png)


**图 9.32　差一点没够到止盈目标的剥头皮交易，常常是反转建仓形态**


AAPL 通常会给出赚一美元的剥头皮机会（这些行情通常超过一美元，让剥头皮交易者可以先在一美元的限价单上止盈一部分）。图 9.32中，第2根K线只延伸到第1根K线上方那个入场价之上93美分，随后就构成了一个低2做空。这个低2意味着市场两次都没能到达目标。由于市场大体横盘、又刚好差一点没做到赚一美元的剥头皮，交易者很可能会把止盈目标降到50美分左右。他本可以在这波61美分的下跌中分批止盈。


> AAPL usually yields one-dollar scalps (the moves are usually more than one dollar, allowing a scalper to take partial profits on a one-dollar limit order). Bar 2 in Figure 9.32 extended only 93 cents above the entry above Bar 1, and then set up a Low 2 short. This Low 2 means that the market failed twice to reach the target. With the market largely sideways and just missing a one-dollar scalp, a trader would likely reduce his profit target to about 50 cents. He would have been able to take partial profits on this 61-cent drop.


# 第 10 章　日内交易

*Chapter 10. Day Trading*


日内交易要考虑的第一件事，是选择你要交易的市场和走势图类型。最好是交易那些机构青睐的股票，因为你想降低被专家经纪人（specialist）或做市商操纵的概率，也想把滑点降到最小。在任意一组5到10只股票的篮子里，每天都有那么多好交易，你根本不必退而求其次去碰成交量小、可能带来额外风险的股票。


> The first consideration in day trading is the selection of the market and type of chart that you want to use. It is best to trade stocks that are popular with institutions because you want to reduce the chance of manipulation by a specialist or market maker, and you want minimal slippage. There are so many great trades every day on any basket of 5 to 10 stocks that you won't have to resort to stocks with small volume that might carry additional risks.


你一天里的K线越多，你做的交易就越多，每笔交易的风险也越小。但你也许没法读图读得足够快、看到那些建仓形态；你也可能没有时间把单子挂出去而不犯下无法接受的错误。存在一个数学上的最佳点，你得根据自己的性格和交易能力去确定它。多数成功的交易者能交易5分钟图。读3分钟图非常相似，交易更多、止损更小，但总体而言胜率更低。如果你发现自己漏掉了太多交易，尤其是当天最赚钱的那些交易，就该考虑换到更慢的时间级别，比如15分钟图。


> The more bars in your day, the more trades you will make, and the risk per trade will be less. However, you might not be able to read the charts fast enough to see the setups, and you might not have time to place . your orders without an unacceptable level of mistakes. There is a mathematical sweet spot that you will have to determine based on your personality and trading abilities. Most successful traders can trade a 5-minute chart. Reading a 3-minute chart is very similar and offers more trades and smaller stops, but in general it has a lower winning percentage. If you find that you are missing too many trades, especially the most profitable trades of the day, you should consider moving to a slower timeframe, like a 15-minute chart.


你也可以用按成交量划分的图（比如每根K线代表1,000张合约），或者按 tick 划分的图（例如每根K线代表500次价格变动或 tick），或者简单的K线图。线图同样可以交易，但价格行为交易者如果看不到K线或蜡烛线，就等于放弃了太多信息。


> You can also use charts based on volume (like each bar representing 1,000 contracts) or ticks (for example, each bar representing 500 price changes or ticks) or simple bar charts. Line charts are also tradable, but a Price Action trader is giving up too much information when she cannot see bars or candles.


总体而言，既然做日内交易时每笔交易的风险最小，那么一旦你能持续盈利，就该交易你最大数量的合约；在那之前，你只该交易一张 Emini 小型合约，甚至只交易100股 SPY（标普500的 ETF）。有人引述沃伦·巴菲特的话说：“如果它值一便士，那它就值一角。”一旦你确定某笔入场是有效的，就要准备好交易合理数量的合约。


> In general, since your risk per trade is smallest when you day trade, you should be trading your maximum number of contracts once you are consistently profitable (until then, you should trade only a single Emini or even only 100 SPY shares). Warren Buffet was quoted as saying, "If it's worth a penny, then it's worth a dime." Once you have decided that you have a valid entry, you need to be prepared to trade a reasonable number of contracts.


交易者总是在琢磨怎样最好地提高自己的盈利能力，而其中最重要的两项考量是交易选择和仓位规模。交易者应该把重点放在每天只做最好的两到五笔入场，这些入场通常是非趋势日（也许占80% 的日子）里、新摆动高点和低点处反转形式的二次入场，以及趋势日里的回调。一旦交易者能持续盈利，下一个目标就该是加大仓位规模，而不是去增加那些概率更低的入场。如果一位交易者在 Emini 上每天稳定净赚只有1点、但交易25张合约，这算下来一天就超过1,000美元。如果这位交易者能把规模做到100张合约，他一年就能赚1,000,000美元。如果他一天净赚4点，那就是一年4,000,000美元。Emini，以及美国长期国债（Bond）与国债票据（Note）期货市场，都能轻松承接这样的交易规模。对于价格在100美元以上的高流动性股票，有经验的交易者大多数日子都能净赚50美分到一美元，而这些股票能承接1,000到3,000股的订单，滑点很小。像 QQQQ 这样的 ETF 能承接10,000股的订单，但日内波幅更小，对一位好交易者来说，更现实的日内净利大约是10到20美分，也就是一年几十万美元。


> Traders are always thinking about the best way to maximize their profitability and the two most important considerations are trade selection and position size. A trader should focus primarily on taking only the best two to five entries each day, which are usually second entries in the form of reversals at new swing highs and lows on non-trending days (maybe 80 percent of days), and pullbacks on trend days. Once a trader is consistently profitable, the next goal should be to increase the position size rather than adding lower probability entries. If a trader consistently nets only one point a day in the Eminis but trades 25 contracts, this comes out to over $1,000 per day. If the trader can get up to 100 contracts, he will make $1,000,000 per year. If he nets four points a day, that IS $4,000,000 per year. The Emini and Treasury Bond and Note markets can easily handle this size of trading. For very liquid stocks with prices over $100, an experienced trader can net 50 cents to a dollar on most days and these stocks can handle 1,000 to 3,000 share orders with minimal slippage. ETFs like the QQQQ can handle 10,000 share orders, but the daily range is smaller and a more realistic daily net would be about 10 to 20 cents for a good trader, or a couple hundred thousand dollars a year.


如果一位交易者在管理一笔50,000,000美元的基金，每笔交易做1,000张 Emini 合约（他也许得把订单拆成200到400张一份的零单），而每天只净赚1点，那么在扣除费用之前，这会为他的客户赚到10,000,000美元。把精力放在做最佳交易上，然后再去放大你的交易量。


> If a trader is managing a fund of $50,000,000 and he was trading 1,000 Emini contracts per trade (he might have to split his orders into 200 to 400 lot pieces), and he only netted a point per day, this would generate $10,000,000 for his clients before fees. Concentrate on taking the best trades and then increasing your volume.


### 选择市场


> SELE(;TING A MARKET


价格行为技巧在所有市场都管用，但多数日内交易者偏爱这样的市场：在5分钟图上有许多入场机会，而且能承接大仓位规模而不产生滑点。5分钟 S&P Emini 期货合约能承接个人交易者下得出的任何订单规模；你永远不会大到它容不下。不过，Russell（罗素）合约受到一些个人交易者的欢迎，因为他们觉得它日内趋势走得好，而且相对于平均波段幅度来说保证金比较小。多数成功的个人交易者最终都会想交易比 Russell 能承接还多的合约，而又不必担心滑点。


> Price action techniques work in all markets but most day traders prefer markets that have many entries a day on the 5-minute chart and can handle large position sizes without slippage. The 5-minute S&P Emini futures contract can handle any order size that an individual trader can place; you will never outgrow it. The Russell, however, is popular with some individual traders because they feel that it trends well intraday and the margin is relatively small for the size of the average swing. Most successful individual traders eventually want to trade more contracts than the Russell can handle without the worry of slippage.


刚起步时，你应该考虑交易 SPY 而不是 Emini。如果 Emini 在1,100附近成交，SPY 就会在110.00附近，而在 Emini 上做4个 tick、赚1点的剥头皮，在 SPY 上就是赚10美分的剥头皮（也就是说，一个 Emini 的 tick 比 SPY 的一个 tick 大两倍半）。一张 Emini 合约等同于500股 SPY；如果你交易300到500股 SPY，就可以对波段持仓分批止盈，而不会承担太大风险。SPY 的一个好处是：10美分的剥头皮金额感觉太小、来得又太快，所以你会更容易为波段交易下单、而不是为剥头皮下单，这在刚起步时是更好的做法。


> When starting out, you should consider trading the SPY instead of the Emini. If the Emini is trading around 1,100, the SPY will be around 110.00 and a four-tick scalp for one point in the Emini is a 10 cent scalp in the SPY (i.e., each Emini tick is two and a half times larger than an Spy tick). One Emini contract is identical to 500 SPY shares and if you trade 300 to 500 SPY, you can scale out of your swing position and not incur too much risk. One advantage of the SPY is that the 10 cent scalp value feels so small and comes so quickly that it will be easier to place orders for swing trades than for scalps, which is a better approach when just starting out.


一旦你把仓位规模加到1,000到1,500股 SPY，如果你打算继续加大规模，就换到 Emini，它能承接巨大的成交量，滑点不会成为大问题。刚起步时，你可以用100股 SPY 做剥头皮，而2点的 Emini 止损相当于20美分的 SPY 止损，所以你的风险只有20美元外加手续费。不过，除非你的手续费极低——比如100股只收1美元——否则你在 SPY 上做剥头皮是赚不到钱的。此外，你还需要一套能让你快速下单的订单录入系统。否则就只做波段交易，直到你持续成功，然后再考虑加入一些剥头皮。


> Once you have increased your position size to 1,000 to 1,500 SPY, if you plan to continue to increase your size, switch to the Emini, which can handle huge volume without slippage being a significant problem. When just starting out, you can scalp 100 SPY and a 2-point Emini stop is the equivalent of a 20 cent Spy stop, so your risk is just $20 plus commissions. However, you cannot scalp and make money in the SPY unless your commissions are minimal, like one dollar for 100 shares. Also, you need an order entry system that allows you to quickly place orders. Otherwise, just swing trade until you are consistently successful, and then look to add some scalping.


另外，在你开始盈利之前，只该盯一个市场，因为如果你连抛一个球都还不会，却想同时抛更多个球，既愚蠢又昂贵。几乎每一只主要股票都走势规矩、可以交易，选哪一只并不重要。真正重要的是：在你持续盈利之前，把自己限制在一只股票的一张5分钟图上。即便到那时，如果你只盯一个市场，很可能也会赚得更多。除了 Emini，我也交易股票，因为它让我觉得有趣，让我觉得自己更属于交易这个世界，这对我心理健康有好处，因为我这个人是个交易隐士。不过，如果我只交易 Emini，我会赚得更多。


> Also, until you are profitable, you should only watch a single market because if you are not yet able to juggle one ball, it is foolish and expensive to try to juggle many more. Almost every major stock is well-behaved and tradable and it does not matter which you choose. What does matter is that you limit yourself to a single 5-minute chart of a single stock until you are consistently profitable. Even then, you will likely make more money if you stick to a single market. I trade stocks in addition to Eminis because it entertains me and makes me feel more a part of the trading world, which is good for my mental health because I am such a trading recluse. However, I would make more money if I just traded the Emini.


货币期货与外汇市场，以及美国长期国债与国债票据期货，都能承接巨大成交量，但大多数日子给出的入场机会比 Emini 少。国债与国债票据日内可以走出漫长的趋势，所以一旦某笔交易成形，你往往可以进场，然后让它波段走上好几个小时。在 Emini 日盘时段，外汇市场通常不会提供多少好交易，既然你不想有任何分心的事，白天最好回避它。DIA 和道指期货的流动性有点稀薄，所以滑点对剥头皮交易者来说可能是个问题。正如 SPY 等同于 Emini，QQQQ 等同于纳斯达克期货。两者都能承接巨大成交量。QQQQ 在日内交易者中也非常受欢迎，能承接大额订单。


> Currency futures and the Forex, and Treasury Bond and Note Futures can handle huge volume but give fewer entries than the Eminis on most days. Bonds and Note1:i can have protracted trends intraday so when a trade sets up, you can often enter and let it swing for hours. The Forex market usually doesn't offer many great trades during the Emini day session and since you don't want any distractions it is best to avoid it during the day. The DIA and Dow futures are a little thin so slippage can be a problem for scalpers. Just as the SPY is identical to the Eminis, the QQQQ is identical to the NASDAQ futures. Both can handle huge volume. The QQQQ is also very popular with day traders and can accommodate large orders.


许多股票日内交易的表现非常好，最省事的做法是只交易那些平均日内波幅有好几美元、平均成交量在500万股以上的股票。你要能低滑点地剥头皮赚50美分到一美元，还要有可能让波段那部分跑出好几美元。目前，AAPL、RIMM、GOOG、AMZN、GS、OIR、DUG、UYG 和 SKS 都很好，但还有很多别的，你可以按需要往名单里加减。UYG 的价格只有10美元左右，但它能轻松承接3,000股的订单，所以一段30美分的波段大约是900美元。


> Many stocks trade very well intraday and it is easiest to only trade those with an average daily range of several dollars and an average volume of 5 million shares or more. You want to be able to scalp 50 cents to a dollar with minimal slippage, and you want the possibility that the swing portion can run several dollars. Currently, AAPL, RIMM, GOOG, AMZN, GS, OIR, DUG, UYG, and SKS are all good but there are many others and you can add or subtract from your list as needed. UYG's price is only around $10 but it can easily handle 3,000 share orders, so a 30-cent swing is about $900.


在本书后面的“日内交易详细示例”一章里，有多个市场的走势图，展示了可能的价格行为交易。对剥头皮交易者来说，Emini 最容易用的是5分钟蜡烛图。不过，对 Emini 或个股的日内波段交易来说，一张简单的5分钟K线图就很好用。因为在一台笔记本电脑或单个显示器上，你可以把六张K线图摆在屏幕上（图 10.1），每张是一只不同的股票，而且每张图都装得下一整天的K线。如果你用蜡烛线，它比K线宽，你的图就只放得下大约半天的价格行为。提到这一点有个重要原因：是要提醒交易者，这套方法用简单的K线图就很好使，尤其是当你只想对最好的入场做波段交易的时候。对剥头皮交易者来说，Emini 上蜡烛图的优势在于：一眼就能快速看出每根K线由谁掌控，尤其是建仓形态那根K线。另外，很多高2、低2的变体在K线图上不容易看出来。


> Later in the book in the Detailed Day Trading Examples chapter, there are charts of many markets that demonstrate possible price action trading. For a scalper, it is easiest to use a 5-minute candle chart for the Emini. However, for intraday swing trading of the Emini or stocks, a simple 5-minute bar chart works well. This is because on a laptop or a single monitor you can fit six bar charts on your screen (Figure 10. 1), each with a different stock, and each chart will contain a full day's worth of bars. U you use candles, which are wider than bars, your charts will only show about a half day of price action. An important reason for mentioning this is to remind traders that this approach works well with simple bar charts, especially when you are only trying to swing trade the best entries. The advantage of candle charts on the Ernini for scalpers is that is it easy to quickly see who owns the bars, especially the setup bar. Also, a lot of High and Low 2 variants are not easy to see on bar charts.


你觉得你能交易更小的时间级别，比如3分钟甚至1分钟吗？如果可以，先用100股 SPY 试上几个小时。然后看看图，诚实地问自己：在过去最近的那五个建仓形态里，你是不是至少有四个读对了价格行为，并且把入场、止损和止盈单都挂对了？如果你做到了，你也许能做得到，尤其是3分钟图；但我还没遇到过谁能在1分钟图上做得到，尤其是要应付那个时间级别上每天出现的40到50笔交易，还要年复一年地做下去。现实一点。如果这是一份工作，你就得能长期做下去，压力必须很小，你还得对自己确实做得很好这一点感到满意。5分钟图才是最佳点，它每天至少给出10笔交易，还给你时间思考建仓形态、把单子挂出去。它也能承接你将来会做的任何成交量。3分钟图也很好用，但很可能你会太频繁地挑挑拣拣，胜率会更低。


> Do you think that you can trade smaller time frames like the 3-minute or even 1-minute? U so, try it with 100 SPY shares for a couple of hours. Then look at the chart and honestly ask yourself if you read the price action correctly and correctly placed your entry, stop, and profit orders on at least four of the past five most recent setups. U you did, you might be able to do it, especially with the 3-minute, but I have yet to meet anyone who can do it on the 1-minute, especially for the 40 to 50 trades that occur every day on that time frame, and then do it year after year. Be realistic. U this is a job, you have to be able to do it for the long haul and it has to have minimal stress and you have to be satisfied that you are doing it really well. The 5-minute is the sweet spot and it offers at least 10 trades a day and gives you time to think about the setups and to place your orders. It can also handle whatever volume that you will ever trade. The 3-minute also works well but it is likely that you will end up cherry-picking too often and your winning percentage will be less.


当趋势存在时，要在回调中顺势入场，比如多头中的一个 M2B（均线、二次入场、买入建仓形态）或空头中的一个 M2S（均线、二次入场、卖出建仓形态）。另外，在一次强劲的趋势线突破之后，要在测试时逆势入场，比如在一个可能的新多头行情中出现更高的低点或更低的低点时，前提是那里有一根强劲的反转K线。


> When there is a trend, look to enter With Trend on a pullback, like an M2B in a bull or an M2S in a bear. Also, after a strong trendline break, look to enter Countertrend on a test, like a Higher Low or Lower Low in a possible new bull, if there is a strong reversal bar.


价格行为交易技巧在所有市场、所有时间级别上都管用，所以交易者必须做一个显而易见的基本决定：该交易哪些市场、哪些时间级别。多数交易者的目标是长期实现盈利最大化，而隐含其中的，是找到一种适合他个性的方法。


> Price action trading techniques work in all market and all time frames, so a trader has to make the obvious basic decision of which markets and time frames he should trade. The objective of most traders is to maximize profitability over the long run, and implicit in that is finding an approach that suits his personality. profitability over the long run, and implicit in that is finding an approach that suits his personality. profitability over the long run, and implicit in that is finding an approach that suits his personality.


![图 10.1](figures/fig-10-01.png)


**图 10.1　要拿价格行为做波段交易，一张简单的K线图就够了**


如果一张5分钟 Emini 图平均每天给出十几笔好入场，3分钟图给出20笔，1分钟图给出30笔，而风险（保护性止损的大小）在5分钟图上是8个 tick、在3分钟图上是6个 tick、在1分钟图上是4个 tick，那为什么不交易更短的时间级别？交易更多、风险更小、钱更多……对吧？对——只要你能在实时行情中足够快地正确读图，把入场、止损和止盈目标的单子分毫不差地挂在准确的价位上，并且每天7小时、年复一年地一直这么做。对很多交易者来说，时间级别越小，他们漏掉的好交易就越多，胜率也随之下滑。他们用这套方法在1分钟和3分钟图上剥头皮，就是快不到能在5分钟图上那么赚钱的程度，所以5分钟图才该是他们的重点，他们应该不断下功夫加大自己的仓位规模。最佳交易往往来得出人意料，那些建仓形态可能很难让人信任，而多数交易者根本来不及处理这些信息。他们总会挑挑拣拣，而且往往挑不中最好的那些建仓形态，而那些才是对最终盈亏最重要的。


> If a 5-minute Emini chart offers a dozen good entries on average every day, and the 3-minute offers 20, and the 1-minute offers 30, and the risk (size of the protective stop) is eight ticks on the 5-minute, and six ticks on the 3-minute, and four ticks on the 1-minute, why not trade the shorter time frames? More trades, smaller risk, more money . . . right? Right, if you can read the charts correctly fast enough in real time to be able to place your entry, stop, and profit target orders at the exact prices correctly, and do this constantly for 7 hours a day, year in, year out. For many traders, the smaller the time frame, the more good trades they miss and their winning percentage goes down. They simply cannot scalp with this method fast enough on the 1 and 3-minute charts to be as profitable as they are on the 5-minute chart, so that should be their focus and they should continually work on increasing their position size. The best trades often come as a surprise and the setups can be hard to trust and most traders simply cannot process the information fast enough. Invariably, they will cherry pick and tend not to pick the very best setups, which are the most important ones to their bottom lines.


更高时间级别图上，一段行情的平均幅度要大于更低时间级别图上的。不过，几乎每一个更高时间级别的波段，都是从1分钟和3分钟图上的反转开始的。只是很难知道哪些反转会成功，而且一天想做30笔以上、盼着一波大行情，会让人精疲力竭。1分钟和3分钟图上最好的那些交易，会引出5分钟和15分钟图上强劲的入场；对多数交易者来说，把重点放在最好的5分钟图上交易、并下功夫加大仓位规模，要赚钱得多。一旦他们能成功交易，就能赚到多得惊人的钱，还能拥有非常高的胜率，这带来的压力小得多，长期保持表现的能力也更好。


> The average size of a move on a higher timeframe chart is greater than that on a smaller timeframe chart. However, almost every higher timeframe swing starts with a reversal on the 1- and 3-minute charts. It is just hard to know which ones will work and it can be draining trying to take 30 or more trades a day, hoping for a big move. The very best trades on 1- and 3-minute charts lead to strong entries on 5- and 15-minute charts and for most traders, it is much more profitable to focus on the best 5-minute trades and work on increasing their position size. Once they can trade successfully, they can make an incredible amount of money and have a very high winning percentage, which results in much less stress and a better ability to maintain the performance over time.


另外，随着你的仓位规模变大，到了某个时点，在1分钟图上，你的交易量会在太多笔交易上影响到市场。举个极端的例子：假如你挂了一张限价止盈单，要在市价上方两个 tick 处卖出5,000张合约，任何看价格阶梯（price ladder）的人都会看到这个异常挂单，你一天10到15笔交易就很难成交。同样，用止损单进这么大的量，会带来一两个 tick 的滑点，这会毁掉剥头皮的风险回报比。交易者用价格行为可以一笔交易做5,000张合约，但不能用上大多数交易需要的那种入场、出场剥头皮技巧。愿你有一天也能遇上这个问题：因为你的交易量开始对成交不利，你不得不重新思考自己的做法！


> Also, as your position size increases, at some point the volume will affect the market on too many trades on a 1-minute chart. As an extreme example, if you had a limit profit target order to sell 5,000 contracts at two ticks above the market, anyone with a price ladder would see the aberration and you would have a difficult time getting filled on 10 to 15 trades a day. Also, entering that size on a stop would result in a tick or two of slippage, which ruins the risk-reward ratio of scalping. A trader can trade even 5,000 contracts per trade using price action, but not with the entry and exit scalping techniques needed for most of trades. May you someday have the problem of having to rethink your approach because your volume is adversely affecting your fills!


1分钟图在两种情况下会有帮助，但这只是理论、不是实践，我强烈建议不要照它交易。如果5分钟图正处在一段失控的趋势里，而你空着仓却想进场，你可以看1分钟图，找高2/低2回调来顺势入场。1分钟图有用的第二种情况，是顺着5分钟图对走趋势的股票做波段交易。股票在走趋势时，对 EMA（均线）非常尊重，可以在均线处用高1/低1或高2/低2的建仓形态做顺势交易，风险就是信号K线的高度。交易者可以稍微降低这个风险：在5分钟图上均线被触及或穿刺之后的第一次反转处，改用1分钟图入场。如果你把5分钟图的20根K线 EMA 画到1分钟图上，就能很快看到那些触及，然后下单。实际上，你需要在1分钟图上画一条90根K线的 EMA，作为5分钟图20根K线 EMA 的替代。为什么是90而不是100根？因为1分钟图上的 EMA 平均的是每一个1分钟的收盘价、而不是每第五个收盘价，而且近端K线的权重更大，往往会让100根K线的 EMA 有一点点太平。为了修正这一点，就用90根K线的 EMA，它与5分钟图的20根K线 EMA 非常接近。在实际操作中，因为你把注意力放在 Emini 上，你很少会有时间去看1分钟的个股图。不过，当某只股票趋势很强时，你也可能偶尔从1分钟图上抓几笔快速入场。让我再次强调：我强烈建议永远都别看1分钟图，因为它看起来太容易了，你会不停地试着把它做成，而你的账户会随着时间不断被磨损。别去做！


> The 1-minute chart can be helpful in two situations, but this is in theory and not in practice and I strongly recommend against trading off of it. If the 5-minute chart is in a runaway trend and you are flat but want to get in, you can look at a 1-minute chart for High/Low 2 pullbacks to enter With Trend. The second situation where 1-minute charts are helpful is in swing trading trending stocks off the 5-minute chart. When stocks are trending, they are very respectful of the EMA and With Trend trades can be made off High/Low 1 or 2 setups at the EMA, risking the height of the signal bar. Traders can reduce that risk somewhat by entering on the 1-minute chart on the first reversal after an EMA touch or penetration on the 5-minute chart. If you plot a 5-minute 20 bar EMA plotted on the 1-minute chart, you can quickly see the touches and then place the order. You actually need to plot a gO-bar EMA on the 1-minute as a surrogate for the 5-minute 20 bar EMA. Why gO and not 100 bars? Because the EMA on the 1-minute averages every 1-minute close and not every fifth close, and the weighting of the more recent bars tends to make a 100-bar EMA a tiny bit too flat. To correct for this, use a gO-bar EMA, which is very close to the 5-minute 20-bar EMA. In actual practice, you will rarely have time to look at a 1-minute stock chart because of your focus on the Emini. However, when a stock is strongly trending, you might occasionally take quick entries off the 1-minute. Let me again stress that I strongly recommend against ever looking at the 1-minute chart because it looks so easy that you will constantly keep trying to do it successfully and you will constantly wear down your account over time. Don't do it!


图 10.2中那张5分钟 Emini 的缩略图显示，它从开盘起走了11.75点，中间没有回调。如果交易者错过了“第一根K线即趋势”的那笔做多，他就会错过整段行情，因为当时没有任何回调。不过，如果他改看1分钟图，那里有三个高1建仓形态（K线 A、K线 B 和K线 C）可以让他入场。但是，千万别去看了1分钟图、然后突然意识到那些是可以做空的反转。你看1分钟图只有一个理由……就是去找高1和高2的做多入场，因为5分钟图上没有回调。在1分钟图上做逆势交易会让你亏钱。事实上，那三个做多建仓形态正好就在1分钟图上那些空头会回补的价位；而他们回补时，就会变成额外的买方，帮着把市场推上去。


> The thumbnail of the 5-minute Emini in Figure 10.2 shows that it went 11. 75 points up off the open without a pullback. If a trader missed the Trend from the First Bar long, he would have missed the entire swing because there were no pullbacks. However, if instead he looked at the 1-minute chart, there were three High 1 setups (Bars A, B, and C) where he could have entered. However, never look at the 1-minute and suddenly realize that those are reversals that can be shorted. You looked at the 1-minute for one reason only . . . to find High 1 and 2 long entries because there were no pullbacks on the 5-minute. Trading Countertrend on the 1-minute will cost you money. In fact, those three long setups are at exactly the price that the 1-minute shorts would cover, and as they cover, they will become additional buyers, helping to drive the market up .

图 10.3中这张 AAPL 的1分钟图，出自一个强空头趋势日，它在90根K线的 EMA（相当于5分钟图的20根K线 EMA）处给出了三次风险很低（风险只有一根K线的高度）的好做空。缩略图显示了那波强劲的5分钟空头趋势。


> This 1-minute chart in Figure 10.3 of AAPL during a strong bear trend day offered three good shorts at the gO-bar EMA (equivalent to the 5-minute 20 bar EMA) with low risk (the height of the bar). The thumbnail shows the strong 5-minute bear trend.


图 10.4中最上面那张是5分钟图，中间那张每根K线是1500个 tick（即每根K线1,500笔成交），最下面那张每根K线是20,000张合约（自K线开始起算，成交量首次达到20,000张或更多合约的那笔成交就收出这根K线）。它们的价格行为相似，都能交易，但由于最大成交量出现在开盘头一个小时左右，tick 图和成交量图是偏斜的：当天早些时候和最后那个小时里，每小时的K线要多得多。


> The top chart in Figure 10.4 is a 5-minute chart, the middle has 1500 ticks per bar (1,500 trades per bar), and the bottom had 20,000 contracts per bar (the bar closes on the first trade that makes the volume 20,000 or more contracts since the start of the bar). They have similar price action and all are tradable but since the highest volume takes place in the first hour or so, the tick and volume charts are skewed, with many more bars per hour earlier in the day and in the final hour.


![图 10.4](figures/fig-10-04.png)


**图 10.4　Emini 日盘的三张图**


报告可以引出情绪极重的行情，伴随大K线、外包K线和好几次反转。不过，尽管快速行情和大K线会在所有交易者心里激起情绪，价格行为的建仓形态依然非常可靠。总体而言，总是要把持仓的一部分拿成波段，并用保本止损，因为有时候一段波段会走得比你想象的远得多。


> Reports can lead to very emotional moves with big bars, outside bars, and several reversals. However, despite the emotion that the rapid moves and big bars generate in all traders, price action setups are still very reliable. In general, always swing part of the position with a breakeven stop because sometimes a swing will go much farther than you could ever imagine.


FOMC 报告在11:15 A.M. PST 公布，引发了情绪化的交易：图 10.5中的大K线、外包K线，以及接下来三十分钟里的好几次反转，都说明了这一点。不过，记得基本规则的价格行为交易者做得很好。第2根K线是一根巨大的多头反转K线，但只要有大量与前一根K线的重叠，就可能正在形成交易区间，而你绝不该想着在区间的顶部买入。相反，要去找被套的交易者、小K线，以及二次入场。第3根K线是一笔很好的做空剥头皮，因为那里有被套的、过于急切的多头，他们把那根大反转K线误当成了合理的做多形态。


> The FOMe report was released at 11:15 A.M. PST and caused emotional trading as evidenced by large bars in Figure 10.5, outside bars and several reversals within the next thirty minutes. However, price action traders who remember the basic rules did well. Bar 2 was a large bull reversal bar but whenever there is a lot of overlap with the prior bar, a trading range might be forming and you should never be looking to buy at the top of a range. Instead, look for trapped traders, small bars, and second entries. Bar 3 was a great short scalp because there were trapped overly eager bulls who mistook the large reversal bar as a sensible long setup.


![图 10.5](figures/fig-10-05.png)


**图 10.5　报告后出现巨幅K线的剧烈反应时，也要遵守价格行为规则**


第4根K线，是对跌破开盘时形成的当日低点那次突破的第二次反转尝试。二次入场总是值得做的，而在情绪化的一天里，一根多头趋势内包K线已经是你可能得到的最好的东西了。因为这至少应该带来两段向上的行情，你需要把持仓的一部分拿成波段。初始止损设在信号K线中部附近；等第4根入场K线收盘后，再把止损放到它下方一个 tick 处。然后让止损跟着前一根K线的低点往下移，最终移到保本。情绪化的一天往往会带来比你想象的远得多的趋势，抓住这样一波行情，比许许多多剥头皮加起来赚的钱还要多得多。这里的多头一路走了将近30点，也就是每张合约大约1,500美元。


> Bar 4 was the second attempt to reverse the breakout below the low of the day formed at the open. Second entries are always worth taking and a bull trend inside bar is as good as you are likely to get on an emotional day. Since this should result in at least two legs up, you need to swing part of your position. The initial stop is around the middle of the signal bar, and then one tick below the Bar 4 entry bar once that bar closed. Then trail the stop below the low of the prior bar and eventually move it to breakeven. Emotional days often lead to trends that carry much further than you would ever imagine and catching one like this is much more profitable than the combined profit from many, many scalps. Here, the bull continued for almost 30 points, or about $1,500 per contract.


图 10.6中的第1根K线，是在一个跳空高开日里的一次向上假突破。第2根K线在 EMA 处形成一个高2，同时构成一次趋势通道线反转。


> Bar 1 in Figure 10.6 was a false upside breakout on a gap up day. Bar 2 setup a High 2 at the EMA and a trend channel line reversal.


![图 10.6](figures/fig-10-06.png)


**图 10.6　对能读懂价格行为、又能极快下单的人来说，Emini 开盘头两个小时在1分钟图上提供了许多可获利的剥头皮机会。要在实际操作中做到非常难。**


第3根K线，是在一个跳空高开日里、对创新高突破的失败所做的做空，这可能带来一次对缺口的测试（市场通常会试着去测试缺口，所以交易者应该在这个方向上找交易机会）。


> Bar 3 was a short on a failed breakout to a new high on a gap up day that could lead to a test of the gap (the market usually tries to test gaps so traders should look for opportunities to trade in that direction).


第5根K线是 EMA 处的一个低2。第6根K线是一次失败的微型趋势线突破。第7根K线反转了两条空头趋势通道线，但做多并不赚钱，这会让你相信空头很强。


> Bar 5 was a Low 2 at the EMA Bar 6 was failed Micro Trendline breakout. Bar 7 reversed two bear trend channel lines but was not a profitable long, leading you to believe that the bears are strong.


第8根K线是一次失败的趋势线突破、一次双顶回调、一个空头 M2S，也是对第7根K线那笔做多的“五个 tick 的失败”。有这么多因素偏向空头，市场快速下跌就不足为奇了。


> Bar 8 was a failed trendline breakout, a Double Top Pullback, a bear M2S, and a Five Tick Failure long from Bar 7. With so many factors favoring the shorts, it is no surprise that the market fell quickly.


第9根K线是从空头趋势通道线过靶处向上反转的第二次尝试。预期至少有两段向上的行情。


> Bar 9 was a second attempt to reverse up from the bear trend channel line overshoot. Expect at least two legs up.


第10根K线是一笔值得怀疑的做空，因为你正预期一个更高的低点和第二段上涨。它在第11根K线处变成了“五个 tick 的失败”，那是一个反转形态。第11根K线同样是一次失败的趋势线突破和一个更高的低点，而且它出现在空头趋势线被突破之后。


> Bar 10 is a questionable short because you are expecting a Higher Low and a second leg up. It turned into a 5 Tick Failure at Bar 11, which is a reversal pattern. Bar 11 was also a failed trendline breakout and a Higher Low and it followed a break of the bear trendline.


第12根K线是一次失败的牛旗突破，但这笔做空的结果是亏了1个 tick。


> Bar 12 was a failed bull flag breakout but the short resulted in a one tick loss.


第13根K线是一次失败后的失败，因此是一笔多头突破的做多。它同时是一个高2。


> Bar 13 was a failed failure and therefore a bull breakout long. It was also a High 2.


第14根K线是摆动高点处的一个低2，同时是一次趋势通道线反转，以及（与第5根K线构成的）双顶熊旗。第15根K线是 EMA 处的一个低2（一个 M2S）、一次失败的趋势线突破（自第14根K线的高点起算），也是第11到13根K线那段趋势线突破之后的一个更低的高点。第16根K线是一笔 M2S 做空。图 10.7中的第1根K线是一笔楔形做多，也是一个双底，但对多数交易者来说，它会以亏1个 tick 收场。总体而言，楔形底部（或称三次推进向下，或这个形态许多别的叫法中的任何一个）都会带来两段向上的行情。第2根K线是一个更高的低点，也是一次微型趋势线反转。第3根K线是一个 M2B。第4根K线是一份报告，它带来一次向上的假突破（最终旗形失败），随后是一根外包下跌K线。交易者会在第3根K线下方做空，也就是那些多头止损所在的位置。第5根K线是一次突破回调。


> Bar 14 was a Low 2 at a swing high, and a trend channel line reversal and a Double Top Bear Flag (with Bar 5). Bar 15 was a Low 2 at the EMA (a M2S), a failed trendline breakout (from the Bar 14 high), and a Lower High after the Bars 1 1 to 13 trendline breakout. Bar 16 was a M2S short. Bar 1 in Figure 10.7 is a Wedge long and a Double Bottom but it would have resulted in a one tick loss for most traders. In general, a Wedge bottom (or Three Pushes Down, or any of many other names for this pattern) will lead to two legs up. Bar 2 is a Higher Low and a Micro Trendline reversal. Bar 3 was an M2B. Bar 4 was a report that resulted in a false breakout to the upside (Failed Final Flag) and then an outside down bar. Traders would short below Bar 3, where the longs would have their stops. Bar 5 was a Breakout Pullback.


![图 10.7](figures/fig-10-07.png)


**图 10.7　盘前是可以交易的，但在纽交所6:30 A.M. PST 开盘前的一两个小时里通常没有多少入场机会。5:30 A.M. 常常有报告，结果是快速的趋势和反转。**


第6根K线是从一个新摆动低点向上反转的第二次尝试（第5根K线是第一次），它给出了一次二次入场。


> Bar 6 was a second attempt to reverse up from a new swing low (Bar 5 was the first), and it gave a second entry.


### Globex 电子盘、盘前、盘后，以及隔夜市场


> GLOBEX, PRE-MARKET, POST-MARKET, AND OVERNIGHT MARKET


同样的价格行为技巧适用于所有市场，包括隔夜交易。盘前极值常常是日盘里会被测试的目标位，但做日盘交易时不必去看 Globex 电子盘的价格，因为这样几乎得不到什么，而且信号会基于日盘的价格行为。


> The same price action techniques apply in all markets, including overnight trading. The premarket extremes are often targets that get tested during the day session, but it is not necessary to look at Globex prices when trading the day session, since very little is gained and the signals will be based on the day session price action .

> Bar 3 was a High 1 breakout long after a major trendline break. Bar 4 was a short. It had a reversal bar and was a failed breakout of the Bar 3 bull flag (Failed Final Flag). Also, the Bar 3 flag broke a big bull trendline, indicating that the bears were gaining a little strength. Only fade a strong trend if there was first a trendline break. Also, a Countertrend trade in a strong trend needs a 5-minute (not a 3 or 1-minute) reversal bar. The market went sideways for the rest of the post market session.

> The Emini in Figure 10.9 reacted poorly to the 5:30 A.M. PST unemployment report. Note that the thirty bars between Bars 1 and 5 all occurred within one minute due to the fast action off the report. These bars were forming so rapidly that it would have been impossible to trade anything other than market orders. It was theoretically possible to make many profitable scalps based on the price action but traders should never attempt to trade this. The only purpose of showing it is to demonstrate that standard patterns are present throughout.

### 剥头皮、波段交易、交易，以及投资


> SCALPING, SWINGING, TRADING, AND INVESTING


投资者是依据基本面买入股票、并打算把股票持有六个月到许多年的人，好留出时间让有利的基本面反映到股价上。如果股票对他不利，他往往会加仓，因为他相信这只股票在当前价位是有价值的。交易者是依据日线图、以及财报和产品发布这类短期基本面事件来交易的人，目的是抓住一段持续一天到几天的快速行情。他会在第一次停顿处先止盈一部分，然后把剩余持仓的止损移到保本。他不愿意让一笔盈利变成亏损。交易者有时会被人叫作剥头皮交易者，但这个词更常用来指某一类日内交易者。


> An investor is someone who buys stocks based on fundamentals and plans to hold the stocks for six months to many years, allowing time for the beneficial fundamentals to be reflected in the price of the stock. He will often add to his position if the stock goes against him, since his belief is that the stock is a value at the current price. A trader is someone who trades off daily charts and short term fundamental events like earnings reports and product announcements with the intention of capturing a quick move, lasting from one to several days. He will take partial profits at the first pause and then move his stop to breakeven on the balance. He is not willing to have a profit tum into a loss. Traders are sometimes referred to scalpers, but that term more commonly is used to refer to a type of day trader.


在用日线到月线级别交易的交易者或投资者眼里，所有日内交易都是剥头皮。然而，在一位日内交易者眼里，剥头皮是把持仓拿住一到十五分钟左右，而且通常是在止盈目标处用限价单出场，目的是抓住他做交易所用时间级别上的一个小行情段。他不想要任何回调；如果价格在到达目标之前又回头，他会很快在保本处出场，因此他相当于日线图上的交易者。一位日内波段交易者会持仓穿越回调，力求抓住当天两到四段较大的波段，每笔持仓从十五分钟拿到一整天。他相当于日线图上的投资者，后者愿意持仓穿越回调。


> In the eyes of a trader or investor using daily to monthly time frames, all day trading is scalping. However, to a day trader, scalping is holding a position for one to fifteen minutes or so and usually exiting on a limit order at a profit target in an attempt to capture one small leg on whatever time frame he is using for his trades. He does not want any pullbacks and will quickly exit at breakeven if the trade comes back before his target is reached, and he is therefore comparable to a trader on the daily charts. An intraday swing trader will hold a trade through pullbacks and he tries to capture the two to four larger swings of the day, holding each position from fifteen minutes to an entire day. He is comparable to an investor on the daily charts, who is willing to hold a position through pullbacks.


要在5分钟 Emini 图上有效剥头皮，你通常得冒大约2点的风险，止盈目标则是1点或更多。这意味着，仅仅为了保本，你就得在超过67% 的交易中取胜。不过，如果你把图读对了，这是可以做到的。另外，如果你在部分止盈之后，用保本止损把交易的一部分拿成波段，这会降低所需的胜率。最后，如果你在入场K线收盘之后，把止损从信号K线的极值移到入场K线的极值（两边都越过一个 tick），再在走出五个 tick 之后移到保本，这又会进一步降低当天做到盈利所需的胜率。最后，有些剥头皮交易者用3到5点这种更宽的止损，并在市场朝自己不利的方向走时加仓，然后用一个更宽的止盈目标，这同样会进一步降低所需的胜率。


> To scalp the 5-minute Emini chart effectively, you usually have to risk about two points and your profit target is one point or more. This means that you have to win on over 67 percent of your trades just to breakeven. However, if you read the charts correctly, this is achievable. Also, if you swing part of your trade using a breakeven stop after taking partial profits, this reduces the required winning percentage. Finally, if you move your stop from the signal bar extreme to the entry bar extreme (one tick beyond both) after the entry bar closes, and then to breakeven after a five tick move, this further reduces the required winning percentage to be profitable on the day. Finally, some scalpers use a wider stop of three to five points and add on as the market moves against them, and then use a wider profit target, and this again further reduces the required winning percentage.


波段交易者用的建仓形态和止损跟剥头皮交易者一样，但会把重点放在每天那几笔很可能至少走出两段行情的交易上。他们通常能在每笔交易的持仓的一部分上净赚3点或更多，然后把剩余持仓的止损移到保本。许多人会任由交易先对自己不利，再在更好的价位加仓。不过，他们至少总有一个心里的止损；如果市场走到那个位置，他们就断定自己的想法已经不再成立，于是认亏出场。要始终留意剥头皮交易者的止损会设在哪儿，如果形态依然有效，就在那个位置给你的持仓加仓。如果你买入的是自己认定的一个反转，可以考虑让市场先走出一个更低的低点，然后在二次入场处加仓。比如，面对 AAPL 这种可靠的股票，如果你买在自以为接近这波行情低点的位置，而大盘又不是空头趋势日，可以考虑在这笔交易上冒2到3美元的风险，并在浮亏1到2美元时加仓。不过，只有那种对自己的读图能力、以及对自己读错时能接受一大笔亏损的能力都非常从容的老手，才该尝试这个。在多数日子里，市场应该立刻朝你的方向走，所以这不是问题。


> Swing traders use the same setups and stops as the scalpers, but focus on the few trades each day that are likely to have at least a two legged move. They can usually net three or more points on part of their position on each trade and then move their stop to breakeven on the balance. Many will let the trade go against them and add on at a better price. However, they always have at least a mental stop and if the market gets to that point, they conclude that their idea can no longer be valid and they will exit with a loss. Always look for where scalpers will have their stops and look to add on to your position at that location, if the pattern is still valid. If you bought what you perceived to be a reversal, consider allowing the market to put in a lower low and then add on at the second entry. For example, with a reliable stock like AAPL, if you are buying what you perceive to be near the low of the move and the overall market is not in a bear trend day, consider risking two to three dollars on the trade and add on at a one to two dollar open loss.
