However, only an experienced trader who is very comfortable in his ability to read and in his ability to accept a large loss if his read is wrong should attempt this. On most days, the market should go your way imme<;liately so this is not an issue.


多数波段交易者会在交易没有按希望展开时剥头皮出场，而多数剥头皮交易者在用最佳建仓形态入场时会把持仓的一部分拿成波段，所以两者做的事有很大重叠。根本的区别在于：剥头皮交易者会做多得多笔交易，而这些交易大多不大可能带来超过一笔剥头皮利润的收益；而波段交易者只做那些很可能至少有两段行情的交易。两种做法没有高下之分，交易者会选最适合自己性格的那一种，而两者带来的利润大致相同。


> Most swing traders will scalp out ifthe trade is not unfolding as desired and most scalpers will swing part of their position when they are entering on the best setups, so there is a lot of overlap in what both do. The fundamental difference is that the scalper will take far more trades and most of those trades are not likely to yield more than a scalper's profit, and a swing trader tries to only take the trades that are likely to have at least two legs. Neither way is superior and traders choose the method that best suits their personalities and both yield about the same profit.


交易 Emini 时以剥头皮为主、交易股票时以波段交易为主，是合理的做法。做 Emini 时，在赚到四个 tick 之后，用限价单把交易的其中一部分或全部出场；这通常要求行情越过信号K线延伸六个 tick（入场是在信号K线之外一个 tick 处的止损单，之后你还需要四个 tick 才够止盈，而你的限价出场单通常要等价格再越过目标位一个 tick 才会成交）。Emini 上的四个 tick 就是1点，相当于 SPY（ETF 合约）上十美分（十个 tick）的走势。


> It is reasonable to be primarily a scalper when trading Eminis and a swing trader when trading stocks. For the Eminis, exit part or all of your trade on a limit order after four ticks of profit, which usually requires the move to extend six ticks beyond the signal bar (the entry is on a stop at one tick beyond the signal bar, then you need four more ticks for your profit, and your limit exit order usually is not filled until the price moves one tick beyond your target). Four ticks in the Emini is one point, which is equivalent to a ten cent (ten tick) move in the SPY (ETF contract).


换成股票，止盈目标的幅度变化要大得多。一只500美元、日均波幅10美元的股票，为10美分去剥头皮很愚蠢，因为你很可能得冒大约2美元的风险，胜率还得超过95%。不过，在 QQQQ 上为10美分剥头皮可能值得做，尤其是当你交易10,000股的时候。


> When it comes to stocks, there is much more variability in the size of the profit targets. For a $500 dollar stock with an average daily range of $10, it would be foolish to scalp for 10 cents because you would likely have to risk about two dollars and your winning percentage would have to be over 95 percent. However, scalping for 10 cents might be worthwhile in QQQQ, especially if you are trading 10,000 shares.


在高成交量股票（每天至少300万股，不过最好是700万股以上）里找平均波幅有好几美元的波段，相对容易。你想要的是最小滑点、可靠的形态，以及每笔交易至少1美元的利润。试着先剥头皮赚1美元，然后对剩余持仓用保本止损，一直拿到收盘，或拿到出现一个清晰、强烈的反向建仓形态为止。你可能可以全天有规律地盯大约5只股票，有时在一天中的不同时段再看另外5只左右，但你很少会真的交易它们。


> It is relatively easy to look for swings in high-volume stocks (at least three million shares per day but prefer seven million or more) that have an average range of several dollars. You want minimal slippage, reliable patterns, and at least one dollar profit per trade. Try to scalp for one dollar and then use a breakeven stop on the balance and hold until the close or until a clear and strong opposite setup develops. You might be able to watch about five stocks regularly throughout the day and sometimes check on up to another five or so at different times during the day, but you will rarely ever trade them.


Emini 剥头皮交易者很可能一天只能做成几笔股票交易，因为 Emini 日内交易要占用太多注意力。另外，做股票只用K线图，这样你能在一个屏幕上放下六张图。只挑那只趋势最好的股票，然后在 EMA 附近找回调。如果你在先前的强劲趋势线突破之后，看到趋势通道线过靶并反转，也可以交易反转。如果 Emini 市场很活跃，可以考虑只交易15分钟股票图，它们需要的注意力更少。如果你漏掉了太多好的 Emini 交易，那也许是因为你被那些多出来的图分了心；这时候，不再看它们、只交易 Emini，要好得多。


> An Emini scalper will likely only be able to enter a couple stock trades a day since Emini day trading takes so much attention. Also, only use bar charts for stocks, which allows you to put six charts on one screen. Just pick the one stock that is trending the best and then look for a pullback near the EMA. You can also trade reversals if you see a trend channel overshoot and reversal after there was a prior strong trend line break. If the Emini market is active, consider only trading 15-minute stock charts, which require less attention. If you are missing too many good Emini trades, it might be that you are getting distracted by the additional charts and it is far better then to stop looking at them and only trade the Emini.


虽然所有股票的交易方式基本相同，但彼此之间有着微妙的性格差异。比如，AAPL 在测试突破位时非常守规矩，而 GS 则倾向于扫止损，需要更宽的止损。


> Although all stocks trade basically the same way, there are subtle personality differences between them. For example, AAPL is very respectful when it comes to testing breakouts, whereas GS tends to run stops, requiring a wider stop.


![图 10.11](figures/fig-10-11.png)


**图 10.11　空头趋势线被强劲突破之后，预期两段向上行情**


百度在昨天尾盘突破了图 10.11中的15分钟趋势线，因此很可能至少有两段向上行情。第二段向上行情有可能在第5根K线就结束了，但今天开盘太强，回调之后很可能会有一次尝试去超越它。跌到第7根K线的那一跌很急，但第7根K线是一根强劲的多头反转K线，它反转了均线缺口、跳空高开的走势，以及对第3根K线高点的测试（它扫掉了那个高点下方的止损，然后急剧掉头向上）。对一只300美元的股票，你需要更宽的止损，所以少交易一些股数、把风险保持在同一水平，但剥头皮那部分要用更大的止盈目标。2美元是一个合理的初始目标，然后移到保本止损，到收盘时出场。


> Baidu broke above the 15-minute trendline in Figure 10. 11 late yesterday and therefore was likely to have at least two legs up. It was possible that the second up leg ended at Bar 5, but today's open was so strong that there likely would be an attempt to exceed it after a pullback. The drop to Bar 7 was sharp but Bar 7 was a strong bull reversal bar that reversed the EMA Gap, the gap up open, and the test of the Bar 3 high (it ran the stops below that high and turned up sharply). For a $300 stock, you need a wider stop so trade fewer shares to keep the risk the same, but use a larger profit target on the scalp portion of the trade. Two dollars is a reasonable initial target and then move the stop to breakeven and exit by the close.


当你预期一波显著行情或一段新趋势时，或者当你在一段强趋势里的回调中入场时，先在剥头皮利润处出场25% 到75% 的合约，然后随着市场继续朝你的方向走，对剩余合约分批止盈。在你出掉剥头皮那部分交易之后，把保护性止损移到保本附近（如果你强烈觉得这笔交易会保持良好——而先出场再重新入场的做法会在更差的价位成交——有时候你会愿意在 Emini 上冒多达四个 tick 的风险）。一笔好交易不该回头，让迟到的人以和那些在完美时机进场的聪明交易者相同的价格进场。如果这笔交易非常好，所有错过首次入场的人现在都急着进场，他们会愿意在更差的价位入场，在比原始入场差一两个 tick 的地方挂限价入场单，从而让原本那些交易者的保本止损不会被打到。不过，有时候最佳交易会回撤到保本止损之外，把交易者关在一段后来会变得又大又快的趋势之外。当这看起来像是一种可能时，就多冒几个 tick 的风险。另外，如果它回撤扫掉了那些止损、然后立刻恢复新趋势，就在前一根K线之外一个 tick 处重新入场，或给波段持仓加仓（在一段新的多头行情里，这就是前一根K线高点上方一个 tick）。


> When you are anticipating a significant move or a new trend, or when you are entering on a pullback in a strong trend, exit 25 to 75 percent of your contracts at a scalper's profit and then scale out of the remaining contracts as the market continues to go your way. Move your protective stop to around breakeven (sometimes you will want to risk as many as four ticks in the Eminis if you feel strongly that the trade will remain good, and an exit and then a re-entry approach will be at a worse price) after you exit the scalp portion of your trade. A good trade should not come back to let late comers in at the same price as the smart traders who got in at the perfect time. If the trade is great, all of the traders who missed the initial entry are now so eager to get in that they will be willing to enter at a worse price and will place limit entry orders at a tick or two worse than the original entry, keeping the breakeven stop of the original traders from being hit. However, sometimes the best trades come back to beyond the breakeven stop to trap traders out of what will become a huge, fast trend. When that seems like a possibility, risk a few extra ticks. Also, if it comes back and runs those stops and then immediately resumes the new trend, re-enter or add to your swing position at one tick beyond the prior bar (in a new bull, this is one tick above the prior bar's high).


如果市场触及止盈限价单，但没有穿过去，而单子仍然成交了，那就意味着趋势压力可能比图上显现的更大，市场在接下来几根K线内越过止盈目标的可能性也随之增大。如果你是多头，而市场愿意在这段行情最高的那个 tick 上把你的持仓买回去（你是在用限价单卖出止盈），说明买方很激进，而且很可能在任何一次回调中重新出现。去找再次做多的机会。


> If the market touches the profit target limit order but does not go through it and the order is still filled, that means that there might be more trend pressure than is evident on the chart and the chances increase that the market will go beyond the profit target within the next several bars. If you were long and the market was willing to buy your position back from you (you were selling on a limit to take profits) at the very highest tick of the leg, the buyers are aggressive and will likely reemerge on any pullback. Look for opportunities to get long again.


同样，如果市场触及你的止盈目标（信号K线之外五个 tick），但你没能成交，这可能是一次失败形态。可以考虑在这根K线收盘后，在它相反一端之外一个 tick 处挂一张反手单。如果你是做多，而市场到了信号K线上方五个 tick 处、你却没有成交，可以考虑把止损移到保本。等这根K线收盘后，可以考虑在它下方一个 tick 处挂一张做空单，因为那里很可能就是剩下的大多数多头剥头皮交易者出场的位置，会制造卖压。另外，在更多价格行为展开之前，他们不会再想买入，这就把买方从市场里抽走，增大卖方把市场压得足够低、让你能从空头里剥头皮出场的概率。“五个 tick 的失败突破”在拖得很久的趋势末端很常见，而且往往是反转的第一个迹象。对剥头皮、并偶尔把一部分交易拿成波段来说，一个不错的替代做法是尽量在当天大部分时间里都留在场上，收盘时出场。交易者应该把入场重点放在主要摆动点和反转上，要么把整个持仓拿成波段，要么至少交易两张合约——一张剥头皮，然后把另一张的止损移到保本。对 Emini 来说，扫止损和深度回调很常见，所以最好是剥头皮一半、波段一半，并确保每一笔至少到过剥头皮利润的交易都能让你有所收获。


> Similarly, ifthe market touches your profit target (five ticks beyond the signal bar) but you do not get filled, this can be a failure. Consider placing an order to reverse at one tick beyond the opposite end of the current bar once it closes. If you were long and the market hit five ticks above the signal bar and you were not filled, consider moving your stop to breakeven. Once this bar closes, consider placing an order to go short at one tick below this bar because that is likely where most of the remaining long scalpers will get out, providing selling pressure. Also, they will not want to buy again until more price action unfolds, thus removing buyers from the market and increasing the odds that the sellers will push the market down enough for you to scalp out of your short. A Five-Tick Failed Breakout is common at the end of a protracted trend and is often the first sign of a reversal. A good alternative to scalping and occasionally swinging a portion of the trade is to try to stay in the market most of the day, exiting on the close. Traders should focus on major swing points and reversals for entries and either swing the entire position or trade at least two contracts, scalp one, and then move the stop to breakeven on the other. For Eminis, there are often stop runs and deep pullbacks so it is preferable to scalp half and swing half, making sure that you get something out of every trade that reached at least a scalper's profit.


换成股票，保本止损被打到的机会小得多，所以着眼于波段交易更赚钱。通常的做法是：在行情走出大约1美元之后，先剥头皮出掉三分之一到一半，然后再把剩余持仓拿成波段。如果市场看起来正在反转、但还没有反转，比如在测试当日高点的时候，就再出掉四分之一到三分之一，但要始终留至少四分之一让它跑，直到你的保本止损被打到，或者直到出现一个清晰、强烈的反向信号，或者直到收盘。趋势往往走得比你能够想象到的远得多。


> For stocks, breakeven stops have much less chance of being hit so it is more profitable to look to swing trade. Typically, look to scalp out a third to a half after about a one dollar move and then swing the balance. If the market appears to be reversing but has not yet reversed, like at a test of a . high of the day, take off another quarter to a third, but always let at least a quarter run until your breakeven stop is hit, or until there is a clear and strong opposite signal, or until the close. Trends often go' much further than you could ever imagine.


持仓穿越一次又一次的回调，除非保护性止损被打到，即使这些回调很猛烈。如果止损被打到，就待在场外，直到任一方向上又出现一个清晰、强烈的建仓形态。如果出现清晰、强烈的建仓形态，就重复这套流程。如果你的交易规模是两张合约，而在一个反转形态触发时你手里还持有多头一张，那就卖出三张。一张把你剩下的多头平掉，另外两张则在这个新的反方向启动这套流程。第一张剥头皮，第二张做波段。


> Hold the position through repeated pullbacks unless the protective stop is hit, even if the pullbacks are violent. If it is hit, stay out of the market until there is another clear and strong setup in either direction. If there is a clear and strong setup, repeat the process. If your trading size is two contracts and you are long one when a reversal pattern triggers, sell three. One gets you out of your remaining long position and the other two start the process in this new, opposite direction. Scalp the first and swing the second.


这套方法的关键在于：只有在出现清晰、强烈的建仓形态时才入场或反手。如果不是，就依靠你的保本止损，哪怕你可能把波段那部分的全部收益都还回去。如果你盯着一小篮子股票，几乎每天都会有至少一只形成可靠的入场建仓形态，让你能做上一笔波段交易。


> The key to this approach is to only enter or reverse when there is a clear and strong setup. If not, rely on your breakeven stop, even though you may give back all of the gains on your swing portion. If you watch a small basket of stocks, almost every day at least one will setup with a reliable entry that will allow you to put on a swing trade.


AAPL 在图 10.12中的第1根K线处有一次缺口测试，那是一根强劲的反转K线，它在创出当日新低之后、并且在〔译注：原书此处文字被走势图截图碎片覆盖，句子未完〕跌破一条空头趋势通道线之后，向上反转。这是一次很好的波段做多入场，到收盘时本可以净赚将近4美元。


> AAPL had a gap test at Bar 1 in Figure 10.12, which was a strong reversal Bar that reversed up after hitting a new low on the day and after breaking below a bear trend channeUine. This was a great entry for a swing long that would have netted almost $4 by the close.


![图 10.12](figures/fig-10-12.png)


**图 10.12　始终入场波段交易示例1**


第3根K线是从昨日高点向下的一次强劲空头反转，那也是一次多头趋势通道线的过靶。当时有一根大的空头趋势K线，这个建仓形态提供了一笔概率很高、至少会走出两段下跌的交易。


> Bar 3 was a strong bear reversal down from the prior day's high and a bull trend channel line overshoot. There was a large bear trend bar, and this setup offered a highly probable trade for at least a two-legged move down.


第8根K线是一次对第6根K线低点的更低的低点测试，而且它出现在一次趋势线突破之后。它还测试了一条空头趋势通道线，是一笔不错的反转交易。如果你只是平掉空头、而不是反手做多，这笔交易本可以净赚大约2.40美元。


> Bar 8 was a Lower Low test of the Bar 6 low and it followed a trendline break. It also tested a bear trend channel line, and was a good reversal trade. If you simply exited your short instead of reversing to long, the trade would have netted about $2.40.


![图 10.13](figures/fig-10-13.png)


**图 10.13　始终入场波段交易示例2**


图 10.13中的第一天是一个交易区间日，用始终入场（always in）的方式本可以净赚52个 tick，也就是每张合约大约600美元。第二天以开盘即趋势开场，随后进入交易区间。一位始终入场交易者本可以净赚79个 tick，约合每张合约950美元。如果交易者交易两张合约、一张剥头皮、一张做波段，他每天本可以有十次成功的剥头皮，每天每张合约再多赚450美元。这听起来、看起来都容易，但真做起来非常难。一些基本规则能让交易容易得多，因为一条规则一旦成立，你就能毫不犹豫地动手。最重要的规则之一是：要做一笔顺势交易，或在交易区间日里做任何一笔交易，你都需要两个理由，而任意两个理由都够用。一旦凑齐，就挂单入场；一旦进场，就只遵守基本的止盈目标和保护性止损规则，并相信你到当天结束时会是赚钱的。重要的一点是：如果趋势很陡，绝不要做逆势交易，即使出现高2、高4或低2、低4，除非之前先有一次显著的趋势线突破，或者一次趋势通道线过靶并反转。另外，如果那次趋势线突破带着强劲的动能、而不是仅仅横向漂移，那就好得多。


> The first day in Figure lO.13 is a trading range day and the Always In approach could have netted 52 ticks, or about $600 per contract. The second day began as a Trend from the Open and then entered a trading range. An Always In trader could have netted 79 ticks or about $950 per contract. If a trader traded two lots and scalped one and swung one, he could have had ten successful scalps each day, yielding an additional $450 per contract per day. It sounds and looks easy but is very difficult to do. Some basic rules make trading much easier because once a rule is satisfied, you can act without hesitation. One of the most important rules is that you need two reasons to take a With Trend trade or any trade in a trading range day, and any two reasons are good enough. Once you have them, place your order to enter, and once in, just follow basic profit target and protective stop loss rules, and trust that you will be profitable by the end of the day. One important note is that if there is a steep trend, never trade Countertrend, even if there is a High or Low 2 or 4, unless there was first a prior significant trendline break or trend channel overshoot and reversal. Also, it is far better if the trendline break had strong momentum instead of just a sideways drift.


要学会预判交易，好让自己随时准备好挂单。比如，如果在一次空头趋势线突破之后，出现一次跌破某个主要摆动低点的两段式行情，或者一次趋势通道线的过靶，就去找反转；或者如果出现一次 ii形态（内包内包）突破，就去找反转。一旦看到外包K线或铁丝网形态，就在极值处找一根小K线，做一次可能的反向操作。如果有一波强趋势，就要为第一次 EMA 回调、任何到达 EMA 的两段式回调，以及第一次均线缺口回调做好准备。


> Learn to anticipate trades so that you will be ready to place your orders. For example, if after a bear trendline break there is a two-legged break below a major swing low, or an overshoot of a trend channel line, look for a reversal, or if there is a ii break out, look for a reversal. Once you see an outside bar or a Barb Wire pattern, look for a small bar at the extreme for a possible fade trade. If there is a strong trend, be ready for the first EMA pullback and any two legged pullbacks to the EMA and for the first EMA Gap pullback.


只有少数几种情况，你只需要一个理由就能入场。第一，任何时候只要有一波强趋势，你就必须在每一个不跟在一次高潮或失败旗形突破之后的回调上入场，即使这个回调只是一个高1或低1。另外，如果出现了一次趋势通道线过靶加上一根不错的反转K线，你就可以反向操作这段走势。另一种只需一个理由就能入场的情形，无论是在交易区间里还是在趋势里，就是出现二次入场的时候。按定义，之前已经有过一次入场，所以二次入场本身就是第二个理由。


> There are only a few situations when you only need one reason to enter a trade. First, anytime there is a strong trend, you must enter on every pullback that does not follow a climax or failed flag breakout, even if the pullback is just a High or Low 1. Also, if there was a trend channel line overshoot and a good reversal bar, you can fade the move. The only other time that only one reason is needed to enter a trade, whether in a trading range or a trend, is when there is a second entry. By definition, there was a first entry, so the second entry is the second reason.


下面是一些可能的入场理由（记住，你需要两个或更多）：


> Here are some possible reasons for entering a trade (remember, you need two or more):


- 反转K线


> - Reversal bar


- 良好的信号K线形态


> - Good signal bar pattern


- 趋势中 EMA 处的回调，尤其是两段式的


> - EMA pullback in a trend, especially if two legged


- 突破回调


> - Breakout Pullback


- 突破回测


> - Breakout Test


- 高2、高4或低2、低4（如果是在反向操作一段强趋势，之前必须出现过一次趋势线突破）


> - High/Low 2 or 4 (there must have been a prior trendline break if fading a strong trend)


- 任何东西的失败形态：此前的高点或低点、旗形突破、趋势线或趋势通道线过靶之后的反转、五个 tick 的失败。图 10.14中的第2根K线是一段强多头行情里的一个 M2B（均线、二次入场、买入建仓形态），仅凭它就足以做多。它是一段大幅跳空高开、第一根K线即趋势的多头行情里，两个半小时还多以来的第一次 EMA 触及。它也是第一次不错的趋势线突破，所以预期会有一次对高点的测试。


> - Failure of anything: Prior High or Low, flag breakout, reversal from an overshoot of a trendline or a trend channel line, 5 tick failure Bar 2 in Figure 10.14 is an M2B in a strong bull and is reason enough to go long. It was the first EMA touch in more than two and a half hours in a Trend from the First Bar bull with a big gap up. It was also the first good trendline break, so a test of the high is expected.


![图 10.14](figures/fig-10-14.png)


**图 10.14　任意两个入场理由就够**


第3根K线是趋势线突破之后出现的一个更低的高点，它出现在第二次突破第1根K线失败之后。当时有一个 ii 形态的建仓形态，其中第二根K线收在空头一侧。


> Bar 3 was a Lower High after a trendline break and it followed the second failed attempt to break above Bar 1. There was an ii setup with the second bar having a bear close.


第5根K线是空头波段中的一个 M2S（第3根K线处是一个更低的高点，第4根K线处是一个更低的低点）。


> Bar 5 was an M2S in a bear swing (there was a Lower High at Bar 3 and a Lower Low at Bar 4).


第6根K线是空头趋势通道线过靶后的反转，但那里的建仓K线是一根空头趋势K线，所以还需要一个理由才能入场。这个理由出现在第7根K线的更高的低点处，它是跌破自第5根K线向下的微型趋势线之后的一次突破回调（图未显示）。


> Bar 6 was a bear trend channel line overshoot and reversal but there the setup bar was a bear trend bar, so one more reason was needed to enter. That came at the Bar 7 Higher Low, which was a Breakout Pullback after breaking the Micro Trendline down from Bar 5 (not shown).


昨天以一波冲向图 10.15中第4根K线的急拉收盘，走完了一个扩张三角形的四段。如果你注意到了这一点，就会在跌破第3根K线之后寻找做多入场。第5根K线跌破了第3根K线，走完扩张三角形的底部，这时你只需要等一个入场建仓形态。第6根K线处有一个高2，而且第6根K线走完了一个下—上孪生反转，在下一根K线即在第6根K线上方一个 tick 处用止损单入场。价格行为交易者总是在找一个入场的理由，走完这个建仓形态的那根K线就叫信号K线。你实际入场的那根K线叫入场K线。用价格行为交易最好的方式之一是在止损单处入场，因为你被市场的动能带进了交易，因此你交易的方向至少算得上一个小趋势（至少一个 tick 长）。例如，如果你要做空一个空头趋势，你可以在前一根K线低点下方一个 tick 处挂一张卖空单，等你的单子成交之后，那根K线就成了你的信号K线。保护性止损的合理位置是在信号K线高点上方一个 tick 处。入场K线收盘后，把止损收紧到入场K线上方一个 tick 处。


> Yesterday closed with a surge to Bar 4 in Figure 10.15, completing four legs of an Expanding Triangle. If you noticed that, you would look for a long entry after a break below Bar 3. Bar 5 dropped below Bar 3, completing the Expanding Triangle bottom, and now you just had to wait for an entry setup. There was a High 2 at Bar 6 and Bar 6 completed a Down Up Twin reversal, with an entry on the next bar at one tick above Bar 6 on a stop. A price action trader is looking for a reason to enter and the bar that completes the setup is called a signal bar. The bar when you actually enter is called the entry bar. One of the best ways to trade using price action is to enter on a stop because you are being carried into the trade by the market's momentum and therefore are trading in the direction of at least a tiny trend (at least one tick long). For example, if you are shorting a bear, you can place an order to sell short at one tick below the low of the prior bar, which becomes your signal bar after your order is filled. A reasonable location for a protective stop is at one tick above the high of the signal bar. After the entry bar closes, tighten the stop to one tick above the entry bar.


![图 10.15](figures/fig-10-15.png)


**图 10.15　如果有两个入场的理由，那就做这笔交易**


Emini 里的剥头皮交易者通常需要信号K线之外走出六个 tick 的行情，才能剥到四个 tick 的利润。这是因为入场的止损单挂在K线之外一个 tick 处，然后你还需要四个 tick 才能拿到你的利润，而你的止盈目标限价单通常要等市场走出你的挂单之外一个 tick 才会成交。有时候市场没有穿过你的挂单，你的单子也会成交，但那种情况下市场往往很强，很可能会在你成交后的几分钟内走到那个价位之外。同样，要在 QQQQ 上剥到10个 tick，你通常需要12个 tick 的行情。


> A scalper in the Eminis usually needs a six-tick move beyond the signal bar to scalp four ticks of profit. This is because the entry stop is one tick beyond the bar, and then you need four more ticks for your profit, and your profit target limit order usually won't get filled unless the market moves one tick beyond your order. Sometimes your order will get filled without the market moving through it, but when that happens, the market is usually strong and will likely move beyond that price within a few minutes of your fill. Similarly, to scalp 10 ticks in the QQQQ, you usually need a I2-tick move.


当一个建仓形态看起来弱时，最好别做，去等下一次机会。如果它弱，很可能失败，而你承担不起没必要的风险。弱的建仓形态往往会给出二次入场，那样它就变成了一个强的建仓形态。


> When a setup looks weak, it is best to not take it and wait for another opportunity. If it is weak, it will likely fail and you cannot take needless risk. Often a weak setup will have a second entry, in which case it becomes a strong setup.


尽管多数交易都应该在止损单处入场，但当趋势很强时，任何时候入场都安全，而在均线处用限价单入场、或者在1分钟图上用止损单入场，对股票来说尤其好，因为股票的走势往往很规矩。这允许用更小的风险换更大的回报，而胜率基本上没有变化。


> Although most trades should be entered on stops, when there is a strong trend, it is safe to enter anytime, and entering at the EMA on a limit order or on a 1-minute chart on a stop is particularly good in stocks, which tend to be well-behaved. This allows for a smaller risk and greater reward and essentially no change in the winning percentage.


![图 10.16](figures/fig-10-16.png)


**图 10.16　在 Emini 里，通常要走出信号K线之外六个 tick，才能净赚一笔四个 tick 的剥头皮**


入场止损单挂在图 10.16中第2根信号K线高点上方一个 tick 处的 A 线，你会在那里成交。你剥头皮赚四个 tick 的止盈限价单挂在那之上四个 tick 处的 B 线。你的限价单通常要等市场走出它之外一个 tick、到 C 线才会成交，而 C 线在信号K线高点上方六个 tick 处。


> The entry stop is one tick above the Bar 2 signal bar's high at line A in Figure 10. 16, where you will be filled. Your limit order to take four ticks profit on your scalp is four ticks above that, at line B. Your limit order usually won't get filled unless the market moves one tick beyond it to line C, which is six ticks above the high of the signal bar.


图 10.17中的第1根K线是测试昨天高点之后的第二次入场做空（一根外包下跌K线处的低2）。这波上涨很强，因此最好等二次入场。


> Bar 1 in Figure 10. 17 was a second entry short (a Low 2 on the outside down bar) following a test of yesterday's high. The run up was strong and therefore it was better to wait for the second entry.


第2根K线是在一根大内包十字星K线之后的高2，但下跌动能很强。最好是等趋势线突破之后再买入。同样，第3根K线是一个糟糕的第二次做多入场，因为它前面是一根强劲的空头趋势K线，而在寻找买入机会之前，你仍应等待空头趋势线的突破。当天的顶部是趋势线突破之后的一个更高的高点，而市场已经在均线下方待了很多根K线，所以你只应该去找做空机会，因为现在的多头行情段已经结束。交易眼下正在发生的东西，而不是当天早些时候已经发生过的东西。


> Bar 2 was a High 2 following a large inside doji bar but the down momentum was strong. It is better to wait for a trendline break before buying. Likewise, Bar 3 was a bad second long entry because it followed a strong bear trend bar and you should still be waiting for a bear trendline break before looking to buy. The top of the day was a Higher High after a trendline break and the market has been below the EMA for many bars so you should only be looking for shorts because the bull leg is now over. Trade what is there now, not what was there earlier in the day.


![图 10.17](figures/fig-10-17.png)


**图 10.17　在止损单处入场，但只在建仓形态好时这么做**


第4根K线是一个 M2S，但它前面的四根K线几乎完全重叠。在这样一个窄幅交易区间里，在两个方向上你都绝不该入场，要等到有一根大趋势K线突破形态至少3到4个 tick 之后，再去等那根K线失败；除非交易区间顶部或底部附近有一根小K线，让你可以反向操作（fade）。


> Bar 4 was an M2S but it followed four bars that almost entirely overlapped. In a Tight Trading Range like this, you should never enter in either direction until after there is a large trend bar that breaks out of the pattern by at least 3 or 4 ticks, and then wait for that bar to fail, or unless there is a small bar that you can fade near the top or bottom of the trading range.


像第2根和第3根K线处那样的许多一个 tick 的假突破，都发生在逆势的5分钟入场K线的第一两分钟里。在K线最后一分钟里发生的突破往往更可靠，因为那时你拥有的动能就紧挨着K线的末端。它延续到下一根K线的机会，比发生在四分钟以前、之后又已经回调的情形更大。


> Many of One-Tick False Breakouts like those at Bars 2 and 3 occur in the first minute or two of a Countertrend 5-minute entry bar. Breakouts that occur in the final minute of the bar tend to be more reliable because you then have momentum right at the end of the bar. The chance of it continuing into the next bar is greater than if it occurred four minutes earlier and has since pulled back.


交易低概率的交易，抹掉的会比你全部的盈利还多。


> Trading low probability trades will wipe out more than all of your gains.


当一只股票像图 10.18中那个开盘即趋势的空头一样处在强趋势里时，在头两次测试均线时用限价单入场是安全的，或者你也可以在1分钟图上用价格行为止损入场法在均线处入场。在 AAPL 的第1根和第2根K线处，在画到1分钟图上的5分钟均线处、依照1分钟图做的二次入场，风险约为25美分，而从5分钟图上做的价格行为入场（插页）的风险约为45美分。你也可以在第一次收在均线之外的那根5分钟K线收盘时以市价做空，用大约20美分的止损。这里，在第1根和第2根K线处，市场只向上超出了收盘价四美分就反转向下。总体而言，最好要么等1分钟图上的第二次入场，要么用传统的5分钟价格行为入场（在那根测试均线的K线下方一个 tick 处挂止损单），因为其他方法得到的东西微乎其微，只会带来更多思考，而思考会分散你做 Emini 交易的注意力。入场K线收盘之前，初始止损在信号K线之外一个 tick 处；收盘之后收紧到入场K线之外一到两个 tick 处。如果K线太大，更明智的做法是用金额止损，比如 Emini 5分钟图上八个 tick，或者60% 的回调。例如，从一根大信号K线做多时，你会把保护性止损挂在从信号K线底部到入场价这段距离的约40% 处。金额止损的大小与K线的大小成比例。例如，在2008年10月的空头行情中，有几天波动范围超过40点，需要8点的止损，但这允许你用4点的止盈目标。要让风险保持不变，你得把仓位规模减少75%，但如果你遵循价格行为的基本原则，你赚到的可以和平时一样多，甚至更多。市场到达第一个止盈目标、部分利润锁定之后，把保护性止损移到大约保本处（入场价，距信号K线极值一个 tick）。最佳交易不会碰到保本止损，而多数的交易在5分钟 Emini 上不会超出入场价四个 tick 以上（比如做多之后，低到信号K线高点下方三个 tick）。如果这笔交易好，市场就不会回来让胆小的交易者在更好的价位进场。如果它真的回来了，那就是一个信号：这笔交易可能不强。


> When a stock is in a strong trend like the Trend from the Open bear in Figure 10. 18, it is safe to enter on a limit order on the first couple tests of the EMA, or you can enter on the 1-minute chart with a price action stop entry at the EMA. At Bars 1 and 2 in AAPL, a second entry off the 1-minute chart at the 5-minute EMA plotted on the 1-minute chart had about a 25-cent risk, and the price action entry off the 5-minute chart (insert) had about a 45-cent risk. You could also short at the market on the first 5-minute close beyond the EMA and use about a 20-cent stop. Here, at Bars 1 and 2, the market went only four cents above the close before reversing down. In general, it is better to either wait for the second 1-minute entry or use the traditional 5-minute price action entry (on a stop below the bar that tests the EMA) because there is very little gained by the other methods and they just involve more thought, which can distract you from your Emini trading. The initial stop is one tick beyond the signal bar until the entry bar closes when it is tightened to one or two ticks beyond the entry bar. If the bars are too large, it is wiser to use a price stop, like eight ticks on the Emini 5-minute chart, or a 60 percent pullback. For example, in a long off a large signal bar, you would place the protective stop about 40 percent of the distance up from the bottom of the signal bar to the entry price. The size of the money stop is in proportion to the size of the bars. For example, in the October 2008 bear, several days had ranges of over 40 points and required an 8-point stop, but this allowed you to use a 4-point profit target. You need to reduce your position size by 75 percent to keep your risk the same, but if you follow basic price action principles, you could make the same or even more than on a typical day. After the market reaches the first profit target and partial profits are secured, move the protective stop to about breakeven (the entry price, which is one tick from the signal bar extreme). The best trades will not hit a breakeven stop, and the majority don't go more than four ticks beyond the entry price on the 5-minute Emini (for example, three ticks below the signal bar high after getting long). If the trade is good, the market won't come back to let timid traders come in at a better price. If it does come back, that is a sign that the trade might not be strong.


![图 10.18](figures/fig-10-18.png)


**图 10.18　趋势强的时候，可以考虑在均线处用限价单入场（但最好还是等止损入场）**


如果你不确定今天会不会是一个大波动范围的交易日、会不会需要大止损，那就头一两笔交易只做一张合约，看看需要多大的止损才能让你留在交易里。只依靠信号K线之外的那一个止损，等它收盘后，就依靠入场K线之外一点点的止损。你1点的止盈限价单成交之后，看看止损要放到多少个 tick 才不会被碰到，你可以把它当作当天的止损。如果市场会碰到14个 tick 的止损、但碰不到16个 tick 的止损，那么当天剩下的时间里你可以用4点的止损，但要把仓位规模减少50%，并把止盈目标提高到2点。如果一两个小时之后，2点的目标没能成交，你很可能就会发现2点或3点的止损正在起作用。如果是这样，就回到更小的止损和更小的目标，把仓位规模加回正常。


> If you are uncertain if today will be a huge range day and will require large stops, trade just one contract for the first one or two trades and see how large a stop would have been needed to keep you in the trade. Rely only on a stop beyond the signal bar and once it closes, rely on a stop just beyond the entry bar. Once your one point profit limit order is filled, see how many ticks the stop would have had to be for it not to have been hit and you can use this as your stop for the day. If the market would have hit a 14-tick stop but not a 16-tick stop, you could use a 4-point stop for the rest of the day, but reduce your position size by 50 percent and increase your profit target to 2 points. If after an hour or two, the 2-point targets are not getting filled, you will likely notice that a 2- or 3-point stop is now working. If so, just go back to using a smaller stop and a smaller target and increase your position size back to normal.


当保护性止损在拿到剥头皮利润之前就被碰到时，你被套了，所以在止损处反向操作偶尔是个好策略。这取决于背景。例如，空头回调中一个失败的低2做空，通常是一笔很好的反手做多。不过，窄幅交易区间里的一次止损狩猎不是反转。花点时间，确保你把图读对了，再考虑做反方向的交易。如果你没有时间马上重新进场，就等下一个建仓形态，它总是会在不久之后出现。


> When a protective stop is hit before making a scalper's profit, you were trapped, so reversing on the stop is occasionally a good strategy. This depends on the context. For example, a failed Low 2 short in a pullback in a , bear is usually a good reversal into a long trade. However, a stop run in a Tight Trading Range is not a reversal. Take time to make sure that you read the chart correctly before considering a trade in the opposite direction. If you don't have time to get right back in, wait for the next setup, which will always come before too long.


研究过一个市场之后，你就会看出什么样的止损是合理的。对 Emini 5分钟图来说，八个 tick 在大多数日子都很好用。不过，要格外注意头一个小时里所需的最大止损，因为它往往会成为当天余下时间里最好用的止损。如果这个止损超过八个 tick，你很可能会发现止盈目标也可以放大。不过，除非K线异乎寻常地大，这样做的优势顶多算一般。


> After studying a market, you will see what a reasonable stop is. For the Emini 5-minute chart, eight ticks works well on most days. However, pay close attention to the maximum size stop required in the first hour because this often becomes the best stop to use for the rest of the day. If the stop is more than eight ticks, you will likely be able to increase the size of your profit target as well. However, this provides a modest advantage at best unless the bars are exceptionally big.


例如，如果你确信某个低点会守住，但做多需要的金额止损远大于你平时用的，你可以用那个更大的止损，然后等待。如果你担心额外的风险以至于下不了这笔单，就把仓位规模减半再下单。如果市场没有多大回调就碰到你的止盈目标，就把利润拿走。不过，如果它只超出你的入场价一两个 tick 就回调到几乎碰到你的止损，然后又开始回到你的入场价上方，那就提高你的止盈目标。作为一般规则，市场会涨到与你为了留在交易里所必须承受的止损大小相当的位置。所以，如果市场在你入场价下方下探了十一个 tick 才反转向上，那么只有十二个 tick 的止损才行得通，因此市场很可能会走到你入场价上方大约十二个 tick 处。明智的做法是在那里下方一到两个 tick 处挂一张限价单出场，等它接近目标时，把你的止损移到保本，然后等着看你的止盈目标单会不会成交。


> For example, if you are confident that a low will hold but a long trade would require a much greater money stop than you typically use, you can use the larger stop and then wait. If you are concerned enough about the extra risk that you can't take the trade, cut your position size in half and place the order. If the market hits your profit target without much of a pullback, take your profit. However, if it only goes a tick or so beyond your entry and pulls back almost to your stop and then starts up again above your entry price, raise your profit target. AB a general rule, the market will rally enough to equal the size of the stop that it required you to have to stay in the trade. So if the market dipped eleven ticks below your entry before reversing back up, only a twelve tick stop would have work and therefore the market will likely go about twelve ticks above your entry price. It would be wise to place a limit order to exit at a tick or two below and when it approaches the target, move your stop to breakeven and wait to see if your profit target order gets filled.


有一种情况，你可以常常挂限价单而不是止损单入场。它出现在趋势线突破之后、你又看到一次二次入场加一根强劲反转K线的时候。例如，如果你刚做多，而市场在一两根K线里反复测试入场K线的同一个低点，那就考虑在入场K线低点上方一个 tick 处挂一张限价买入单、把仓位翻倍，只承担两个 tick 的风险（止损设在原始止损处，就在入场K线下方）。如果你挂限价单想买入场K线的低点，你很可能不会成交，因为通常市场得穿过你的限价，单子才会成交。每个人都知道，入场K线低点下方一个 tick 处有很多保护性止损……聪明的资金为什么不去猎杀它们？因为如果那些止损被碰到，市场的性质就变了。它不再是强劲的二次入场，这张图现在成了一个失败的二次入场，而那是顺势建仓形态，很可能还会带来两段下跌。如果聪明的资金已经在底部吸足了货，他们不想看到市场再跌两段，所以他们会完全像你一样做。他们会继续积累多头，守住底部。最终，卖方会放弃并开始回补，而随着他们回补，市场会涨到远超剥头皮目标的位置。在你长期稳定盈利之前，别做这种交易，因为在那之前，你应该保持交易风格简单，不该想得这么费劲。


> There is one situation where you can often enter on a limit and not a stop. This occurs when you see a second entry after a trendline break and a strong reversal bar. For example, if you just bought and the market tests the exact low of the entry bar several times over the one or two bars, consider placing a limit buy order to double your position at one tick above the low of the entry bar and risk just two ticks (to the original stop, just below the entry bar). You would likely not get filled if you tried to buy the low of the entry bar on a limit order since usually the market has to trade through the limit price for the order to get filled. Everyone knows that there are many protective stops just one tick below that entry bar low . . . why isn't the smart money gunning for it? Because if those stops are hit, the character of the market will have changed. Instead of being a strong second entry, the chart now has a failed second entry, and that is a With Trend setup and will likely result in two further legs down. If smart money had loaded up on the bottom, they do not want to see the market drop for another two legs, so they will do exactly as you did. They will continue to accumulate longs to defend the bottom. Eventually, sellers will give up and start to cover and as they do, the market will rise well beyond the scalper's target. Do not place this kind of trade until you have been consistently profitable for a long time because until then, you should keep your trading style simple and you should not be thinking this hard.


入场K线一收盘，就把止损移到入场K线之外一个 tick 处。如果风险太大，就用金额止损，或者承担信号K线高度约60% 的风险。


> Once the entry bar closes, move the stop to one tick beyond the entry bar. If risk is too great, use a money stop or risk about 60% of the height of the signal bar.


如果你在图 10.19中第1根K线处、在双底孪生（前两根K线低点相同）下方做空，初始止损就在信号K线上方。顺便说一句，这不是一笔好的做空，因为它是开盘时对均线的一次回调，反弹回去的机会很大。第1根入场K线在入场后立刻反转向上，但没有超过信号K线的高点，所以这最终会是一笔有利可图的做空剥头皮。入场K线收盘后，把止损移到它上方一个 tick 处。在这个例子里，信号K线和入场K线的高点相同，所以止损不需要收紧。


> If you shorted on Bar 1 in Figure 10.19 below the Double Bottom Twin (the two prior bars had the same low), the initial stop would be above the signal bar. Incidentally, this is not a good short since it is a pullback to the EMA on the open and has a high chance or rallying back up. The Bar 1 entry bar reversed up immediately after entry but did not exceed the top of the signal bar, so this would have eventually ended up as a profitable short scalp. Once the entry bar closed, move the stop up to one tick above its high. In this example, the signal and entry bars had the same high, so the stop would not have to be tightened.


![图 10.19](figures/fig-10-19.png)


**图 10.19　初始保护性止损在信号K线之外一个 tick 处**


第3根入场K线入场后立刻下跌，但没有跌破信号K线的低点，也没有跌破它高度的60%（如果你用的是金额止损，认为这根信号K线太大、不该用其低点下方的价格行为止损）。入场K线收盘后，把保护性止损移到它低点下方一个 tick 处。两根K线之后，出现了一根回调K线，但没有碰到止损。它精确到 tick 地测试了入场K线的低点，做出一个双底，设下一个极好的陷阱，把弱的多头关在了场外。


> The Bar 3 entry bar immediately sold off but did not fall below the low of the signal bar, or below 60 percent of its height (if you used a money stop, thinking that this signal bar was too big to use a price action stop below its low). Once the entry bar closed, move the protective stop up to one tick below its low. Two bars later, there was a Pullback Bar but it did not hit the stop. If tested the entry bar low to the tick, creating a Double Bottom and a great trap, trapping weak longs out.


第4根K线 M2S 处的那笔做空，尽管入场后两根K线处有一根回调K线，止损也没有被碰到。考虑到K线的尺寸很大，在空头趋势K线的低点下方做空，会比仅仅在一根多头趋势K线下方的低2处做空更好。止损在入场K线上方，在市场朝你的方向走出大约四个 tick 之前，不要把它收紧到最近一根K线高点上方。给交易时间，让它走。另外，当入场K线是一根十字星K线时，通常可以让它回调一个 tick。十字星K线是一根K线构成的交易区间，在一个交易区间上方买入是愚蠢的，所以别在那里把你的空头买回来。在市场至少朝你的方向走出几个 tick 之前，依靠你原来的止损。


> The stop for the short at the Bar 4 M2S was not hit, despite a Pullback Bar two bars after entry. Given the large size of the bars, it would have been better to short below the low of the bear trend bar rather than simply on the Low 2 below a bull trend bar. The stop is above the entry bar and does not get tightened to above the high of the most recent bar until after the market has moved about four ticks in your direction. Give the trade time to work. Also, when the entry bar is a doji, it is usually safe to allow a one tick pullback. A doji bar is a one bar trading range and it is foolish to buy above a trading range, so don't buy back your short there. Rely on your original stop until the market has moved at least several ticks in your direction.


第5根K线的高2做多入场后立刻下跌去测试信号K线的低点（这在1分钟图上很明显，图未显示），形成由两根K线构成的双底，随后是一笔成功的做多剥头皮。依靠你的止损，别去看1分钟图。做5分钟入场时，就依靠5分钟的止损，否则你会亏得太频繁，在你想把每笔交易的风险降下来的尝试里，被扫出局的好交易会多得离谱。


> The Bar 5 High 2 long immediately sold off to test the signal bar low (this is evident on the 1-minute chart, not shown) forming a two bar Double Bottom and then a successful long scalp. Rely on your stop and ignore the 1-minute chart. When taking a 5-minute entry, rely on a 5-minute stop, else you will lose too often and be stopped out of a great many trades in your attempt to risk less per trade.


第7根K线 M2B 做多的确测试了信号K线下方的那道止损，但差一个 tick 没碰到，随后又测试了入场K线下方收紧后的止损，两道止损都没有被碰到。入场前的那些十字星增加了这笔交易的风险（铁丝网），但在创出当日新低后急拉、又收在均线上方六次的情况下，你必须预期有一段向上的行情，而 M2B 是一个合理的入场。更好的一个入场在四根K线之后，就在那根小空头K线上方，因为这实际上是一个高4做多（从铁丝网里出发的第二次高2尝试）。


> The Bar 7 M2B long tested the stop below the signal bar but missed by one tick, and then tested the tightened stop below the entry bar, but neither stop was hit. The dojis prior to entry increase the risk of the trade (Barb Wire), but with six closes above the EMA after the surge from a new low of the day, you had to be expecting a second leg up and the M2B was a reasonable entry. An even better one was four bars later, above the small bear bar, because this was essentially a High 4 long (a second attempt at a High 2 out of the Barb Wire)


如果一个交易者在第8根K线的 ii形态上方买入，止损会在入场K线上被碰到，而这会是一笔很好的反转，就像大多数失败的 ii 形态一样。这笔买入很糟糕，因为一个双顶熊旗正在形成（与第4根K线），而且除非在多头趋势里，你不该在高点附近买入。另外，此前二十根K线中大多数都与它前面几根中的若干根重叠，使市场具有很强的交易区间性质（从第7根K线起的这波上涨，是急速行情与通道的多头里的一条小通道）。因此，当第二段上涨的顶部可能就是这轮上涨的终点时，你不会想在第二段上涨的顶部买入。


> If a trader bought above the Bar 8 ii, the stop was hit on the entry bar and this would have been a good reversal, as are most failed ii patterns. The buy was bad because a Double Top Bear Flag was setting up (with Bar 4) and you should not be buying near the high except in a bull trend. Also, most of the previous twenty bars overlapped several of the bars before them, giving the market a strong trading range quality (the move up from Bar 7 was a small channel in a Spike and Channel bull). Therefore, you would not want to be buying at the top of the second leg up when that might be the end of the rally.


如果你在第11根K线的摆动高点做空，你要么可以在第12根那根测试均线的反转K线处反手，要么可以在第11根K线做空之后的入场K线上方一个 tick 处的买入止损单处反手。


> If you shorted the Bar 1 1 swing high, you could either have reversed on the Bar 12 reversal bar that tested the EMA or you could have reversed on a buy stop at one tick above the entry bar that followed the Bar 11 short.


第13根K线摆动高点处的做空、一个低2，变成了一个五个 tick 的失败和一个失败的低2。你应该在第14根K线上、在入场K线（第13根信号K线之后的那根K线）上方一个 tick 处反手做多，因为那里有被套的空头，而你应该预期至少还有两段向上的行情。


> The short from the Bar 13 swing high, Low 2 became a 5 Tick Failure and a failed Low 2. You should reverse to long on Bar 14 at one tick above the entry bar (the bar after the Bar 13 signal bar), since there are trapped shorts and you should expect at least two more legs up.


图 10.20中跌到第1根K线的那波抛售是高潮式的，在跌破一根内包K线的最终旗形失败之后三根K线，于一个下—上孪生底部反弹向上。如果一个交易者在第1根K线上方买入（不明智，因为它是一根空头趋势K线），他会预期一段两段的上涨行情，并且预期第1根K线的低点会守住。在这么强的空头里，等第二个信号更合理，尤其是此前连一次小的趋势线突破都没有。


> The selloff to Bar 1 in Figure 10.20 was climactic and bounced up on a Down Up Twin bottom after breaking out of an inside bar Failed Final Flag three bars earlier. If a trader bought above Bar 1 (not wise since it was a bear trend bar), he would expect a two legged move up and that the low of Bar 1 would hold. In this strong a bear, it would make more sense to wait for a second signal, especially since there was not even a small prior trendline break.


第3根K线的回调下探到入场K线第2根K线低点下方一个 tick 处，但又在下—上孪生底部的第二次反转中反弹向上，这次反转差一个 tick 没碰到信号K线第1根K线的低点。如果交易者随后在第3根K线上方买入，他就会知道第1根K线是一个可以接受但有风险的多头入场，而在第3根K线处的下探是17个 tick，所以要一直做多就需要18个 tick 的止损。因此，这位交易者可以把目标从四个 tick 提高到约16个 tick。这段第二段上涨恰好在入场价上方18个 tick 处结束。当风险约为正常水平的两倍时，交易者应该只做一半数量的合约，让美元风险保持不变。一个明智的做多入场是等第4根K线收盘，一旦你看到它是一根强劲的多头趋势K线，并且知道它是四根K线里的第二根强劲多头趋势K线，而到均线还有空间（一个明显的磁力位），就在它高点上方一个 tick 处以买入止损单入场。是的，这是在熊旗的顶部买入，但这里有很好的多头力量和奔向均线的空间。


> The Bar 3 pullback dipped one tick below the entry Bar 2 low but bounced back up in a second Down Up Twin reversal that missed the signal Bar 1 low by one tick. If a trader then bought above Bar 3, he would know that Bar 1 was an acceptable but risky long and that the dip at Bar 3 was 17 ticks, so an 18 tick stop would have been needed to stay long. Therefore, the trader could raise his target from four ticks to about 16 ticks. The second leg up ended at exactly 18 ticks above the entry price. When the risk is about twice normal, a trader should trade half as many contracts to keep the dollar risk the same. A sensible long entry would be to wait for Bar 4 to close and once you see that it was a strong bull trend bar, and you know that it was the second strong bull trend bar in four bars, and there is room to the EMA (an obvious magnet), enter on a buy stop at one tick above its high. Yes, this is buying the top of a bear flag, but here was good bullish strength and room to run to the EMA.


![图 10.20](figures/fig-10-20.png)


**图 10.20　保护性止损的放置**


第6根K线低点处有类似的情形。这里市场在试图与第3根K线的低点形成双底牛旗，但第6根K线的收盘弱。保守的交易者不会在高点上方一个 tick 处买入，而会等第二个信号。第7根K线收盘后，一个可以接受的第二个信号是在第7根K线上方一个 tick 处买入，那会是第二次上涨尝试，但它的收盘也弱，所以这不是理想的做法。这个第8根入场K线同样会要求把止损设在低于第6根K线双底牛旗低点的位置，而那也正是最初的信号K线，它只在入场K线下方几个 tick 处，所以考虑到两段上涨的可能性，增加的风险是值得的。一旦在第8根K线处做多，止损就是十二个 tick，所以这波行情很可能会向上延伸大约十二个 tick。10个 tick 的目标值得一试（后来证明是成功的）。市场在接下来两根K线里各自测试了第8根K线的低点，所以机构在守住这道止损，这让上涨更可能发生。第9根K线到达十二个 tick，市场又在两根K线之后高了一个 tick。更安全的入场是在第8根多头趋势K线之后那根空头内包K线上方买入，因为第8根K线的强度表明多头愿意守住底部。


> A similar situation was present on the Bar 6 low. Here the market was trying to form a Double Bottom Bull Flag with the Bar 3 low but Bar 6 has a weak close. Conservative traders would not have bought at one tick above the high and instead would have waited for a second signal. After Bar 7 closed, an acceptable second signal would be to buy at one tick above Bar 7, which would be a second attempt to rally, but it also had a weak close so this is not ideal. This Bar 8 entry bar again would require a stop below the Bar 6 Double Bottom Bull Flag low, which was also the initial signal bar, and it was only a couple ticks below the entry bar so the added risk was worth it, given the likelihood of two legs up. Once long in Bar 8, the stop would be twelve ticks, so it was likely that the move would extend about twelve ticks up. A target of ten ticks was worth trying (and proved to be successful). The market tested the Bar 8 low in each of the next two bars, so the institutions were defending the stop, making a rally more likely. Bar 9 reached twelve ticks, and the market went one tick higher two bars later. A safer entry would be to buy above the bear inside bar that followed the Bar 8 bull trend bar because the strength of Bar 8 showed that the bulls are willing to defend the bottom.


![图 10.21](figures/fig-10-21.png)


**图 10.21　头一个小时里所需的最大止损，通常也是当天余下时间的好止损**


图 10.21中，从第1根信号K线做空——它上穿了昨天的高点——本来需要九个 tick，因为入场K线收盘后，止损会放在它高点上方一个 tick 处。第2根K线测试了入场K线的高点，它会碰到八 tick 的止损，但碰不到九 tick 的止损。当天剩下的时间里，记住这一点。


> A short off the Bar 1 signal bar that poked above yesterday's high in Figure 10.21 would have required nine ticks, since after the entry bar closed, the stop would be one tick above its high. Bar 2 tested the entry bar high, and it would have hit an eight tick stop but not a nine tick stop. Remember that for the rest of the day.


如果你在第3根K线处买入那个失败的低2，并把初始止损放在信号K线低点下方一个 tick 处，你要承担八个 tick 的风险。当有十字星时，一个 tick 的止损狩猎很常见，而你知道当天早些时候需要九个 tick 的止损，所以多冒一个 tick 的风险是明智的。这不是一笔很好的买入，因为它前面是一次很小的突破，而且最后七根K线基本横盘，带着好几根十字星（铁丝网）。二次入场会更好。


> If you bought the failed Low ' 2 at Bar 3 and placed the initial stop at one tick below the signal bar's low, you would risk eight ticks. One tick stop runs are common when there are dojis and you know that a nine tick stop was needed earlier in the day, so it would have been wise to risk the extra tick. This was not a great buy because it followed a tiny breakout and the last seven bars were largely sideways with several dojis (Barb Wire). A second entry would be better.


今天在图 10.22中向下跳空很大，所以这一天很可能会走出上涨或下跌的趋势。第3根K线之后，市场强势抛售进入一个更低的区间，到第6根K线形成时，这一天已经是一个趋势性交易区间日或开盘即趋势的空头。在趋势性交易区间里，通常可以在每个区间的底部附近买入、在顶部附近做空。


> Today had a big gap in Figure 10.22 down so the day was likely to trend up or down. Following Bar 3, the market sold off strong into a lower range, and by the time Bar 6 formed, the day was a Trending Trading Range Day or a Trend from the Open bear. It is usually safe to buy near the bottom of every range in Trending Trading Ranges and short near the top.


第5根K线突破了微型趋势线。第4根和第6根K线都是强劲的多头反转K线，第6根K线形成了突破回调做多。入场K线变成了一根空头趋势K线，这是一个弱势的信号。如果市场在它低点下方一个 tick 处成交，这就会是一次失败，市场很可能会在两段行情中快速跌下去。由于聪明的资金认为这是一个趋势性交易区间日，并且买入了二次入场（第5根K线是第一次），他们就会一直买到入场K线的低点，以此来守住它。他们不想让市场低一个 tick，因为那样他们就有了亏损的交易。市场在接下来的十五分钟里，一次又一次地差一个 tick 没碰到那些保护性止损，有耐心的多头得到了回报。


> Bar 5 broke above a Micro Trendline. Bars 4 and 6 were strong bull reversal bars, with Bar 6 setting up Breakout Pullback long. The entry bar became a bear trend bar, which is a sign of weakness. If the market traded one tick below its low, this would have been a failure and the market would likely have dropped quickly down in two more legs. Since smart money believed that this was a Trending Trading Range Day and they bought the second entry (Bar 5 being the first), they will defend it by continuing to buy down to the low of the entry bar. They do not want the market to go one tick lower because they will then have a losing trade. The market missed those protective stops by one tick many times over the next fifteen minutes and patient longs were rewarded.


![图 10.22](figures/fig-10-22.png)


**图 10.22　机构在守住它们的止损**


# 第 11 章　头一个小时

*Chapter 11. The First Hour*


最初的最佳交易通常都与昨天的形态有关；你首先要找的是突破失败、突破回调、开盘即趋势及其第一次回调，然后才是常见的价格行为形态。虽然人们倾向于认为头一个小时里的形态有所不同，但从价格行为的角度看，事实并非如此。这些建仓形态与一天中其他任何时段、任何时间级别上的完全一样。不同之处在于波动性往往更大，因此形态会走得更远，而反转往往来得意外地突然。反转看起来虚弱、在趋势突破之前先走出两三根十字星K线，这很常见。要明白这很常见；如果你已经入场、又看到这种弱势，不要草草平仓了事。相信自己的判读，因为你很可能没错，而且你很有可能赚到一大笔波段利润。


> The best trades initially are usually related to patterns from yesterday and you first need to look for failed breakouts, breakout pullbacks, Trends from the Open and their first pullbacks, and then common price action patterns. Although there is a tendency to think that the patterns are different in the first hour, the reality is that from a Price Action perspective, they are not. The setups are the same as during any other time of the day and on any time frame. What is different is that the volatility is often greater, and therefore the patterns run further, and the reversals are often unexpectedly abrupt. It is common for reversals to look weak and have two or three doji bars before the trend breaks out. Realize that this is common, and if you entered and see this weakness, don't scratch out. Rely on your read because you will likely be right, and you stand to make a large swing profit.


如果K线更大，为了让风险保持不变，交易者就得交易更少的合约。市场动得很快，一边读图、一边下单，还要花时间做精确计算是很难的。干脆快速把仓位规模砍掉一半或三分之二。怎么做都无所谓；要紧的是做得快、不再去想它，把注意力集中到重要得多的事情上：正确读图，把单子挂出去。


> If the bars are larger, to keep his risk the same, a trader needs to trade fewer contracts. The market is moving quickly, and it is difficult to spend time doing exact math while trying to read the charts and place orders. Just quickly cut the position size in half or two-thirds. It doesn't matter what you do; what matters is that you do it quickly, stop thinking about it, and concentrate on what is much more important: reading correctly and placing your orders.


开盘还有另一个不同之处：许多交易是依据昨天的价格行为形成的。昨天最后几个小时里常常会走出一面大旗形，然后在今天开盘时发生突破；或者市场跳空，远远越过这面旗形。无论哪种情况，都要留意反转与延续。


> One other difference about the open is that many trades set up based on yesterday's price action. There will often be a large flag that develops in the final couple of hours of yesterday and then a breakout occurs on today's open, or the market gaps well beyond the flag. In either case, watch for reversals and continuations.


最后一个重要不同之处是：在多数日子里，当天的高点或低点都出现在头一个小时，所以任何可能形成重大高点或重大低点的交易，都务必把一部分仓位拿成波段，并用保本止损，让自己能收下开盘后常常出现的那笔意外之财。


> A final important difference is that the high or low of the day occurs in the first hour on most days, so it is critical to swing part of any trade that could be a major high or low, and use a breakeven stop to allow yourself to collect the windfall profits that often happen off the open.


一天里头一两个小时往往充满了可靠的交易。多数日子里都会有一到几个可交易的反转，通常在获利剥头皮离场之后，还有好几次重新入场的机会。偶尔趋势会从第一根或第二根K线展开、一个多小时不回调地一路走下去（开盘即趋势，或第一根K线即趋势）；但交易者应该始终在头一个小时左右寻找反转，因为反转是常态、不是例外，而且它们通常会引出一段漫长的趋势。


> The first hour or two of the day is often rich in reliable trades. On most days, there are one or more tradable reversals, usually with several opportunities to re-enter after scalping out with a profit. Occasionally a trend will develop from the first bar or two and run for an hour or more without a pullback (a Trend from the Open or Trend from the First Bar), but traders should always be looking for a reversal in the first hour or so because they are the rule and not the exception, and they commonly lead to a protracted trend.


在多数日子里，一天最初几个小时里都会有一到几个可交易的反转。市场开盘后为什么会在接下来的几根K线里大走一波、然后反转？它为什么不干脆就开在当天的最低点或最高点？当天的开盘价不是由哪家机构或哪群机构设定的，它只代表开盘那一刻买卖双方之间短暂的均衡。如果这些机构当天计划大量买入，市场究竟为什么会先开在昨天收盘价上方、然后抛售一阵，之后才上涨创新高？假如你是一名机构交易者，今天有大量买单要成交，你会巴不得市场开在你想要买入的价位上方，然后急剧下跌、进入你的买入区；在那里，你可以和所有其他机构一起大力买入——他们的客户多半也有大量类似的买单——然后盼着看到一次小小的卖出高潮，由此会形成当天的低点，让人信服。


> On most days, there are one or more tradable reversals in the first couple hours of the day. Why does the market open and then make a big move over the next several bars and then reverse? Why doesn't it simply open at the low or high of the day? The location of the open of the day is not set by any firm or group of firms and instead represents a brief equilibrium between buyers and sellers at the instant of the open. If the institutions have a large amount of buying planned for the day, why would the market ever open above yesterday's close and then selloff before rallying to a new high? If you were an institutional trader and had a lot of buy orders to fill today, you would love the market to open above where you wanted to buy and then have a sharp move down into your buy zone where you could aggressively buy along with all the other institutions who likely also have lots of similar buy orders from their clients, and then hope to see a small sell climax that will form a convincing low of the day.


如果向上反转足够强，就几乎没有交易者还会想做空，因为大家普遍会觉得上升动能足够强：在低点受到测试（如果真的受到测试）之前，至少还应该有第二段上涨。假如你是机构交易者，你能做点什么来促成这件事吗？能！你可以在盘前临近收盘时买入，把价格推上去，顺便填掉一部分订单。在6:30 A.M. PST 开盘之前，期货或股票要推动价格所需的成交量并不大。然后，等市场一开盘，你可以平掉一部分或全部多头，甚至做一点空。既然你想在更低的价位买入，那么在市场跌到你认为有价值的位置之前，你不会开始买。价格行为非常重要。你会想看看市场跌到某个关键价位——比如 EMA（均线）、前一个摆动高点或低点、或者昨天的低点——之后如何反应。如果下跌动能开始减弱，市场又开始从关键价位向上反转，你就会平掉所有空单、大力买入以填满订单。既然多数机构的单子都差不多，市场就会开始上涨。如果你相信当天的低点可能已经出现，你就会在市场上行途中继续买入，而且任何回调你都会大力买入。由于你的订单规模巨大，你不想一次性全部买进，以免冒险造成一波急速上冲、随后出现买入高潮。相反，你宁可一整天都有条不紊地不停买入，直到所有订单都成交。


> If the reversal back up is strong enough, very few traders will be looking to short because there will be a general feeling that the upward momentum is sufficiently strong to warrant at least a second leg up before the low is tested, if it gets tested. Would there be anything that you, if you were an institutional trader, could do to make this happen? Yes! You could buy into the close of the premarket to push the price up and fill some of your orders. Not as much volume is needed in futures or stocks to move the price before the 6:30 A.M. PST open. Then, once the market opens, you could liquidate some or all of your longs and even do some shorting. Since you want to buy lower, you will not start buying until the market falls to an area that you consider to represent value. Price action is very important. You would like to see how the market responds once it gets down to some key price, like the EMA or a prior swing high or low or the low of yesterday. If the downward momentum begins to wane and if the market starts to reverse up from the key price, you will liquidate any shorts and aggressively buy to fill your orders. Since most firms will have similar orders, the market will start to rally. If you believe that the low of the day might be in, you will continue to buy as the market rallies, and you will aggressively buy any pullback. Since your order size is huge, you don't want to buy all at once and risk causing a spike up and then a buy climax. Instead, you would rather just keep buying in an orderly fashion all day long until all of your orders get filled.


这真的就是实情吗？机构里的交易者知道这是不是他们的做法，但从来没有人能确切知道市场在某一天究竟为什么反转。而且原因无关紧要。唯一要紧的是价格行为。反转常常在报告发布几秒钟后就出现，但单凭看 CNBC，个体交易者不太可能弄懂市场会如何回应一份报告。无论报告是利多还是利空，市场都可能上涨或抛售，而在没有价格行为的情况下，交易者根本没有能力可靠地解读一份报告。要知道市场会怎么反应，最好的办法就是看着它怎么反应，并在价格行为展开的过程中下单。很多时候，报告前的那根K线就是一个极好的建仓形态，报告一出就被触发。把单子挂上、把止损设好，然后相信你的判读。


> Is this what actually happens? Traders at institutions know if this is what they do, but no one ever knows for certain why the market reverses on any given day. Also, reasons are irrelevant. All that matters is price action. Reversals often happen seconds after a report is released, but an individual trader is unlikely to understand how the market will respond to a report by simply watching CNBC. The market can rally or selloff in response to either a bullish or bearish report, and a trader is simply not qualified to reliably interpret a report in the absence of price action. The best way to know how the market will respond is simply to watch it respond and place your trades as the price action unfolds. Very often, the bar before the report is a great setup that gets triggered on the report. Place your order and then your stop, and trust your read.


开盘反转（Opening Reversal）往往发生得很快，而反转的剧烈程度让人难以理解基本面。如果几分钟前市场还那么看空，现在怎么会变得这么看多？别去想它。只去找标准的价格行为建仓形态，照着机械地做，完全不去考虑反转为什么发生。你只需要知道反转事实上正在发生，而你必须入场。


> Opening Reversals often happen quickly, and the sharpness of the reversal makes it difficult to understand the fundamentals. If the market was so bearish a couple of minutes ago, how can it be so bullish now? Don't give it any thought. Instead, just look for standard price action setups, and trade them mindlessly without giving any consideration to the reasons why the reversal is taking place. All that you need to know is that it is in fact taking place and you must enter.


虽然5分钟图最容易读、也最可靠，但3分钟图也很好使，尤其是在头一个小时。不过它更容易带来亏损；如果你想要最高的胜率、又不想承受亏损带来的负面情绪，你就应该坚持交易5分钟图，并下功夫加大你的仓位规模。


> Although the 5-minute chart is the easiest to read and the most reliable, the 3-minute chart trades well, particularly in the first hour. However, it is prone to more losers, and if you like the highest winning percentage and don't want the negative emotion that comes from losing, you should stick to trading the 5-minute chart and work on increasing your position size.


作为交易者，最好把分析保持得简单，尤其是在市场走得很快的头一个小时。绝大多数开盘情形都与前一天最后一小时左右的价格行为有关，并表现为突破、突破失败、突破回调或开盘即趋势，而其中任何一种都可能走得非常快。看 Globex 电子盘的 tick 图或成交量图时，开盘并不容易找，因为它只是24小时交易日中的一部分，在图上与其他时段看不出区别。Globex 电子盘的高点和低点有一种倾向：常常会在日盘受到测试；Globex 里的一些形态，也会在日盘最初许多根K线中完成。头一个小时左右通常走得很快，单是日盘就提供了极好的价格行为。既然多数交易者没有能力同时把两张图交易好——尤其是在开盘后这种快市里——那就只看日盘的5分钟图。多数在 Globex 图上成立的交易，仅凭日盘的价格行为也会有同样的做单理由。你应该宁可偶尔错过一笔交易，也不要一边急忙挂入场单、止损单和止盈单，一边手忙脚乱地分析两张图，在混乱中亏钱。


> As a trader, it is best to keep your analysis simple, especially in the first hour when the market is moving quickly. The vast majority of opens are related to the price action of the final hour or so of the prior day and take the form of a breakout, a failed breakout, a breakout pullback, or a trend from the open, and any of these can move very fast. When looking at tick or volume charts of the Globex, the open is not easy to spot because it is just part of the 24-hour trading day and appears indistinguishable from the rest to the chart. There is a tendency for Globex highs and lows often to get tested in the day session, and there are patterns in the Globex that get completed during the first many bars of the day session. The first hour or so usually moves quickly, and the day session alone provides great price action. Since most traders are not capable of trading two charts well, especially in a fast market such as after the open, just watch the 5-minute day session. Most trades that setup on the Globex chart will have price action reasons for the same trade based on the day session alone. You should be willing to miss an occasional trade rather than risk losing money while being confused as you quickly try to analyze two charts while you place entry, stop, and profit target orders.


![图 11.1](figures/fig-11-01.png)


**图 11.1　同时看日盘和 Globex 电子盘毫无收获**


图 11.1中，左侧 Globex 电子盘图和右侧日盘图上的第1根K线，都是6:40 A.M. PST 那根K线。Globex 电子盘上出现了一个失败旗形反转的买入信号，日盘上则是一根强劲的多头反转K线：它是昨天收盘前那波两段式上涨之上的突破回调，也可能是一段多头开盘即趋势的起点。记住，如果当天第一根K线是一根趋势K线，它通常是一个剥头皮建仓形态。如果它失败了——尤其当跟着一根反向趋势K线时——它就是反方向的建仓形态。


> Bar 1 in Figure ILI on both the Globex chart on the left and on the day session chart on the right is the 6:40 A.M. PST bar. The Globex had a Failed Flag reversal buy signal, and the day session had a strong bull reversal bar that was a Breakout Pullback above the two-legged up move into yesterday's close and a possible bull Trend from the Open. Remember that if the first bar of the day is a trend bar, it is usually a setup for a scalp. If it fails, especially with an opposite trend bar, it is a setup in the opposite direction.


同时看两张图得不到任何好处；试图这么做，只会增加这些可能：你不够快，抓不住所有可做的交易，而且在挂单时出错。昨天摆动高点与低点、大旗形、趋势线或交易区间处的突破、突破失败和突破回调，是头一个小时里最可靠的形态。这些建仓形态通常会把价格推向当天的某一个极端，因此对至少一部分持仓来说，它们是很重要的波段建仓形态。要在开盘前就依据昨天的价格行为，努力预判建仓形态。从图上那巨大的成交量你能看出，世界上最优秀的交易者正在做这些交易，你也应该这样做。


> Nothing was gained by watching both charts, and trying to do so increases the chances that you will not be quick enough to take all of the available trades and make mistakes in your order placement. Breakouts, Failed Breakouts, and Breakout Pullbacks from yesterday's swing highs and lows, large flags, trendlines, or trading ranges are the most reliable patterns in the first hour. These setups usually lead to one extreme of the day and therefore are important swing setups for at least part of the position. Try to anticipate setups before the market opens, based on yesterday's price action. As you can see from the huge volume, the best traders in the world are taking them, and so should you.


头一个小时里的许多交易都与前一天的形态有关，很多大交易者的入场就是根据日线图、以及前一天的高点、低点和收盘价来做的。开盘之前，先看看昨天最后那一两个小时：那里是强趋势还是交易区间（因而有没有趋势线），是不是出现了趋势线突破、现在很可能要去测试极端位，又或者有没有可能正在形成三次推进形态、或正在酝酿一次趋势通道线测试。市场常常在头一个小时里测试昨天的高点或低点，从而带来一次可交易的突破回调或反转。


> Many trades in the first hour are related to patterns from the prior day, and lots of large traders base their entries off daily charts and the high, low, and close of the prior day. Before the open, look at the final hour or two of yesterday, and see if there was a strong trend or a trading range and therefore a trendline, or if there was a trendline break and a test of the extreme is now likely, or if there is a possible Three Push pattern or a trend channel line test setting up. The market often tests yesterday's high or low in the first hour, resulting in a tradable breakout pullback or a reversal.


图 11.2中这张昨天的5分钟 OIR 图，在早盘抛售之后走出了一波长达三小时的两段式上涨，突破了主要空头趋势线（未画出）；这波上涨两次对一条空头趋势通道线过靶，并两次掉头向下（第4根和第5根K线），说明多头正在失去控制。这波上涨的长度本身就是多头强势的证据。在最后那一两个小时里出现一段突破主要趋势线的两段式逆势行情，是常见的形态。它提醒你：在开盘时留意以更高的低点或更低的低点形式出现的趋势反转。


> The 5-minute OIR chart yesterday in Figure 1 1.2 had a three-hour, two-legged rally that broke the major bear trendline (not shown) after morning selling, and the rally overshot a bear trend channel line twice, reversing down both times (Bars 4 and 5), showing that the bulls were losing control. The length of the rally is evidence of bullish strength. A two-legged Countertrend move in the final hour or two that breaks a major trendline is a common pattern. It alerts you to look for a trend reversal on the open in the form of a Higher Low or a Lower Low.


![图 11.2](figures/fig-11-02.png)


**图 11.2　突破失败**


今天，市场跳空低开后迅速跌到昨天低点下方，在那里形成了一根强劲的多头反转K线。这次大熊旗的突破失败先后跨越两天，并在第7根信号K线高点上方一个 tick 处给出了极佳的做多入场。反转前一天高点或低点的开盘反转，往往就会形成当天的高点或低点，所以交易者应该把一部分、甚至大部分合约拿成波段。


> Today the market gapped down and quickly traded below yesterday's low where it formed a strong bull reversal bar. This large bear flag failed breakout occurred over two days and provided an excellent long entry at one tick above the high of the Bar 7 signal bar. Opening Reversals that reverse the high or low of the prior day often form the high or low of the day so traders should swing some or most of their contracts.


当天的一个极端价位通常出现在头一个小时左右，所以把一部分或全部股票拿成波段很重要。在这里，如果用了保本止损，交易者就能一路拿到第5根K线上方的新摆动高点，赚到多达5美元。


> Since one extreme of the day usually occurs in the first hour or so, it is important to swing some or all of your shares. Here, a breakeven stop would have allowed a trader to make as much as five dollars on a swing to a new swing high above Bar 5.


当开盘突破的是昨天收盘时的某个形态时，交易者应该按突破失败形态入场（比如第7根K线）；如果这个突破失败再失败、变成突破回调，就反方向入场。这里没有好的做空突破回调，因为从第7根K线低点起的上涨很强（二次入场做空值得一做，但这里只有低1、没有低2，而那个低1又引出了第8根K线的高1做多）；不过在更小的级别上，第8根K线正是当天创出新高后回调形成的突破回调做多。


> When the open forms a breakout of a pattern from the prior day's close, traders should enter on a failed breakout setup (like Bar 7) and then enter in the opposite direction if the failed breakout fails and becomes a Breakout Pullback. Here, there was no good Breakout Pullback short because the move up from the Bar 7 low was strong (a second entry short would be worth taking, but there was only a Low 1 and not a Low 2, and the Low 1 led to the Bar 8 High 1 long), but on a smaller scale, Bar 8 was a Breakout Pullback long on the pullback from a new high on the day.


显然，当市场开盘远离均线、随后又强劲反转时，头一个小时里的 EMA 可能会误导人。比如，EMA 正在下跌，市场却在强势上涨。虽然 EMA 在头一个小时里常常有用，但价格行为更重要，所以照市场告诉你的做，而不是照指标说的做。


> Obviously, the EMA in the first hour can be misleading when the market opens far from it but then reverses strongly. For example, the EMA is falling yet the market is rising strongly. Although the EMA is often helpful in the first hour, the price action is more important so do what the market is telling you and not what the indicator is saying.


图 11.3中，市场跳空高开，到第5根K线时收出一根多头趋势K线，让一段多头开盘即趋势成为可能。市场没有突破第5根K线上方，反而跌破了它的低点，形成一个双顶孪生和一根空头趋势K线。当一天中的第一根或第二根K线是一根强趋势K线时，它通常至少会带来一次可交易的剥头皮，而且往往还是一笔好波段。在第5根K线买入的早期多头，在其低点下方被止损出局；当第二根K线收成一根强空头趋势K线时，多头多半会先观望一阵、再考虑重新买入，因此做空获利的概率很高。开盘时连续两根反向趋势K线都赚不到一次剥头皮，这会极其罕见。


> The market gapped up into a bull trend bar at Bar 5 in Figure 11.3, creating the possibility of a bull Trend from the Open. Instead of breaking above Bar 5, the market broke below its low, creating a Double Top Twin and a bear trend bar. When either of the first bar or two of the day is a strong trend bar, it usually leads to at least a tradable scalp and often a good swing. The early longs who bought Bar 5 were stopped out below its low, and when the second bar closed as a strong bear trend bar, the longs would likely wait before looking to buy again, and the odds of a profitable short were therefore high. It would be very unusual for back-to-back opposite trend bars on the open to both fail to yield at least a scalp.


昨天在一波急速上涨之后以三次推进向上收尾（实际上就是一个楔形），而这通常会引出一段深度回调：先测试低点，然后上涨、创出高于这个楔形的新高。跌到第4根K线的那波抛售动能足够强，所以很可能出现一次对第3根K线前高的失败测试（通常就是一个更低的高点）；这本来会是一笔很好的做空，目标第二段下跌——楔形顶之后这很常见。市场在开盘时以第5根K线给出了一次更高的高点测试。虽然这个楔形没有抛售太多（只跌到第4根K线），但第5根K线可以看作第二次尝试跌回昨天上涨行情的起点。记住，一切都是灰色的；虽然楔形通常不会失败（那次向上突破到第5根K线之所以算失败，是因为它延伸到了楔形顶部上方），但在这里，这次失败又失败了，而失败后的失败通常是很好的入场。永远想一想眼下正在发生什么。楔形通常不会在至少走出一段两段式修正之前就失败，所以当市场跳空高开、收出一根多头趋势K线时，多头很兴奋。然而，就在紧接着的那根K线上，他们就被止损出局；聪明的交易者把这看成一次失败后的失败，于是做空。


> Yesterday closed with Three Pushes Up after a sharp rally (effectively a Wedge), and this commonly leads to a deep pullback that tests the lows and then rallies to a new high above the Wedge. The sell off down to Bar 4 had enough momentum so that a failed test of the prior Bar 3 high was likely (normally, a Lower High), and it would have been a good short for a second leg down, which is common after a Wedge top. The market gave a Higher High test on the open at Bar 5. Although the Wedge did not sell off much Oust down to Bar 4), Bar 5 can be looked at as a second attempt to get down to the beginning of yesterday's rally. Remember, everything is gray, and although a Wedge does not typically fail (the upside breakout to Bar 5 was the failure because it extended above the top of the Wedge), here the failure failed, and failed failures are usually good entries. Always think about what is going on. Wedges usually don't fail before having at least a two-legged correction, so when the market gapped up and formed a bull trend bar, the bulls were excited. However, on the very next bru:, they were stopped out, and smart traders saw this as a failed failure and shorted.


![图 11.3](figures/fig-11-03.png)


**图 11.3　对昨天高点的失败测试，随后是对昨天低点的成功测试和一个更高的低点**


第6根K线是陡峭空头里的一次微型趋势线突破失败，所以是一笔做空。第7根K线构成了一个空头 M2S 做空（均线、二次入场、卖出建仓形态）。第8根K线正是价格行为交易者从第3根K线这个楔形以来一直在等的深度修正。它也是当天向下的两段行情，并且测试了昨天的低点。第8根K线是一笔极好的二次入场做多。第9根K线是又一次买入机会，因为它是一个失败的低2，而低2失败之后，通常至少还会有两段向上行情（从而形成一个可能的低4）。这是一笔极好的交易，因为它把多头关在了一段强势上涨之外，他们随后不得不追着市场往上买。这样的陷阱在强趋势刚起步时很常见，也是趋势很可能走得很远的信号。第10根K线是一段强劲的向上行情，它突破了趋势线、站到了 EMA 上方，而且带有很多多头趋势K线，所以后面很可能跟着一个更高的低点。第10根K线还是一根均线缺口K线（与 EMA 之间留有缺口），带着一根空头信号K线；有理由认为它至少够做一次做空剥头皮。不过，此时你会去找回调来买入，因为在被证明是别的样子之前，趋势都是向上的。


> Bar 6 was a failed Micro Trendline break in a steep bear, so was a short. Bar 7 set up a bear M2S short. Bar 8 was the deep correction that price action traders were looking for since the Bar 3 Wedge. It was also two legs down on the day and a test of yesterday's low. Bar 8 was a great second entry long. Bar 9 was another chance to buy since it was a failed Low 2, which usually results in at least two more legs up (to form a possible Low 4). This was a great trade because it trapped bulls out of a strong up move and they would then have to chase the market up. A trap like this is common at the start of a strong trend and is a sign that the trend will likely go far. Bar 10 was a strong up leg that broke the trendline and broke above the EMA and had many bull trend bars, so a Higher Low was likely to follow. Bar 10 was also an EMA Gap Bar (gap above the EMA) with a bear signal bar and it is reasonable to assume that it would be good for at least a short scalp. However, at this point you would be looking to buy a pullback, since the trend is up until proven otherwise.


第11根K线是一次窄幅交易区间突破的失败，它还突破了一条趋势线。第12根K线是一次失败后的失败……在窄幅交易区间顶部的突破失败之后，市场这次看起来又在跌破底部的突破上要失败了。


> Bar 1 1 was a failed breakout from a Tight Trading Range, and it broke a trendline. Bar 12 was a failed failure . . . after the failed breakout of the top of the Tight Trading Range, the market now appeared to be failing on its breakout of the bottom.


市场在走向第13根K线的途中收出两根小空头趋势K线，这实际上是从第12根K线向上反转以来的两段式修正。你可以在第13根K线、也就是第二根空头趋势K线上方买入，也可以在充当突破回调的那根内包K线之后的第14根K线上买入。


> The market formed two small bear trend bars en route to Bar 13, and this is effectively a two-legged correction from the Bar 12 reversal up. You could buy on Bar 13, above the second bear trend bar, or you could buy on Bar 14 after the inside bar that acted as a Breakout Pullback.


市场突破第10根K线时没有回调，说明多头很强。你可以在1分钟图上找高2做多，或者等5分钟图上出现停顿或回调。


> There was no pullback when the market broke above Bar 10, indicating that the bulls were strong. You could look for a High 2 on the 1-minute chart to go long or wait for a 5-minute pause or pullback.


第15根K线不是好的做多，因为它是空头趋势通道线小幅突破并反转之后出现的。而且，这根建仓形态K线太大，高点也太高（低买高卖！）。第16根K线是在突破一根小内包K线之后做的高2，这允许把止损设得很紧。


> Bar 15 is not a good long because it was after a small bear trend channel line breakout and reversal. Also, the setup bar was too big, and its high was too high (buy low, sell high!). Bar 16 was a High 2 long on the breakout above the small inside bar, which allowed for a tight stop.


图 11.4中，AAPL 昨天以一段窄幅交易区间收盘，这可能构成一个最终旗形失败的建仓形态。在第3根K线上，AAPL 迅速向下测试了昨天收盘时的牛旗，然后突破其顶部。可是，它下一根K线又反转下跌。虽然这是一个还算不错的最终旗形失败做空入场，但动能很强，而且此前向下那次突破失败说明：也许最好再多等一些价格行为再入场。此时，一次失败旗形突破加上昨天高点的反转，让看空的情形更有可能出现。


> AAPL closed yesterday with a Tight Trading Range in Figure 11.4, which could be a setup for a Failed Final Flag. On Bar 3, AAPL quickly tested below the bull flag from yesterday's close and then broke out of the top. However, it reversed back down on the next bar. Although this is a decent Failed Final Flag short entry, the momentum was strong, and the original failed breakout through the downside means that it might be better to wait for more price action before entering. At this point, a Failed Flag breakout and a reversal of yesterday's high make a bear case more likely .


![图 11.4](figures/fig-11-04.png)


**图 11.4　最终旗形失败，随后是一次测试（形成三次推进向上和一个双顶）**


第5根K线出现在一段铁丝网形态的末端，这段形态把多头套住、诱他们买入高2；它是一笔极好的做空入场，位置在高2信号K线（前一根K线）低点下方一个 tick 处。单是这一根K线就会把多头套住、逼他们出局。铁丝网常常还有第二次反转，所以你必须准备好反手。第6根K线是一个反手做多的信号，因为它是一次突破失败，也是多头行情中向 EMA 的第二段下跌（多数K线都在一条上升的 EMA 上方）。


> Bar 5 came at the end of a Barb Wire pattern that trapped bulls into buying a High 2, and was a great short entry at one tick below the low of the High 2 signal bar (the prior bar). This one bar would trap the bulls long and force them out. Barb Wire often has a second reversal so you have to be prepared to reverse. Bar 6 was a signal to reverse to long, because it was a failed breakout and a second leg down to the EMA in a bull (most bars are above a rising EMA).


注意，跌到第6根K线的那波抛售突破了一条趋势线，说明空头愿意变得激进；所以你得准备好面对一次对第4根K线多头顶部的失败测试。


> Note that the selloff to Bar 6 broke a trendline, indicating that the bears are willing to become aggressive, so you need to be prepared for a failed test of the Bar 4 top of the bull.


第7根K线是一根反转K线，它在向新高突破时失败；这也是突破昨天高点的第二次失败尝试（第4根K线是第一次）。由于到目前为止当天的区间只有近期典型一天的一半左右，所以无论向哪一边突破，多半都会把区间翻倍、并且很可能走出至少两段（趋势交易者多半有足够信心，在任何回调之后再走第二趟）。第7根K线这个双顶（也是多头中的第三次推进向上）就是当天的高点。


> Bar 7 was a reversal bar that failed in its breakout to a new high, and it was the second failed attempt to breakout above yesterday's high (Bar 4 was the first). Since the range of the day so far had been only about half of that of a typical recent day, there was a good chance that a breakout in either direction would double the range and likely have at least two legs (the trend traders would likely be confident enough to make at least a second run after any pullback). The Bar 7 Double Top (and third push up in the bull) was the top of the day.


第9根K线跌破了第6根K线的摆动低点，但没有跌破当天低点，所以极有可能至少还会再有一次向下的推进，去测试那个低点——它是个磁力位，而且离得很近。第10根K线完成了一段铁丝网形态；但既然所有人都确信会有第二段下跌、并去测试当天新低，它就在那根小内包K线下方提供了一笔极好的 M2S 做空。它同时也是跌破第6根K线那次突破之后的突破回调。


> Bar 9 broke below the Bar 6 swing low but not the low of the day, so the odds were very high that there would be at least one more push down to test that low, which was a magnet and very close. Bar 10 completed a Barb Wire pattern, but since everyone was confident of a second leg down and a test to a new low of the day, it offered a great M2S short below the small inside bar. It was also a Breakout Pullback from the breakout below Bar 6.


回调到第10根K线的这段铁丝网走势突破了一条小级别趋势线（未画出），所以它可能是终结第一段下跌的修正；但下跌动能一直太强，多头还不会有足够信心大力买入。他们还需要看到更多价格行为。


> The Barb Wire pullback to Bar 10 broke a minor trendline (not shown), so it might be the correction that ended the first leg down, but the momentum down has been so strong that the bulls would not be confident enough to buy aggressively yet. They would need more price action.


跌破到第11根K线、创出当天新低的那一下基本上是直着下去的，因此很可能不是这波行情的终点（交易者会去找第二段下跌，至少测试第11根K线的低点）。由于这是空头趋势通道线的一次突破失败，所以很可能先走出两段向上行情。


> The break to the Bar 1 1 new low of the day was essentially straight down and therefore likely not the end of the move (traders will look for a second leg down to at least test the Bar 1 1 low). Since it was a failed breakout of a bear trend channel line, two legs up were likely first.


第12根K线是一次双底回调做多，也是一个失败的低2；但在此前没有良好趋势线突破、也没有强反转K线的情况下，它只会是一笔剥头皮。而且，既然很可能有第二段下跌，那么明智得多的做法，是专注再次做空、或者给空单加仓，而不是在七根带长影线的横盘K线之后，被一笔小的多头剥头皮牵着走。


> Bar 12 was a Double Bottom Pullback long and a failed Low 2, but in the absence of a prior good trendline break or a strong reversal bar, it would only be a scalp. Also, since a second leg down is likely, it would be much wiser to focus on getting short again or adding to shorts than allowing yourself to be distracted by a small bull scalp after seven sideways bars with big tails.


第13根K线是空头的又一次 M2S 机会，但涨到 EMA 的那波上涨突破了一条像样的空头趋势线。这对多头和空头都是一个信号：接下来从新摆动低点起的向上反转，只要足够强，就很有可能走出两段向上行情。


> Bar 13 was another M2S opportunity for the bears, but the rally to the EMA broke a good bear trendline. This is a signal to both the bulls and bears that the next reversal up from a new swing low has a good chance of having two legs up, if the .reversal is strong enough.


第14根K线是又一次 M2S 做空。第15根K线跌破创出新低，从新低处收出一根强劲的多头反转K线，并且对两条空头趋势通道线过靶。由于这是一段向下的急速与通道，所以很可能要去测试第14根K线、也就是这个通道的起点。它也是从回调到第13根K线的第一次趋势线突破以来的第二段下跌。最后，它还是从当天高点起的第二段下跌。这些都是强势信号，增加了这波上涨会走出两段的概率。第二段结束于第16根K线：它突破了第一段的高点后反转，但没能突破第14根K线的高点，与第14根K线一起形成一个双顶熊旗。


> Bar 14 was another M2S short. Bar 15 was a break to a new low, and it had a strong bull reversal bar off the new low, and it overshot two bear trend channel lines. Since it was a Spike and Channel down, a test of the Bar 14 start of the channel was likely. It was also the second leg down from the first trendline breaking pullback to Bar 13. Finally, it was the second leg down from the high of the day. All of these are signs of strength and increase the odds that the rally will have two legs. The second leg ended at Bar 16, which broke above the high of the first leg and reversed, and it failed to break above the Bar 14 high, forming a Double Top Bear F1ag with Bar 14.


顺便说一句，当一段强劲行情以三次推进收尾、随后又以更小的动能抛售（斜率更浅、趋势K线更小、影线更多）时，三次推进的高点很快就会被超越的概率很高，因为这很可能是更高时间级别上的一个更高的低点。市场在第二天开盘时就实现了第7根K线的目标。


> Incidentally, when there is a strong move that ends in Three Pushes and then sells off with less momentum (shallower slope, smaller trend bars, more tails), the odds are high that the high of the Three Pushes will be exceeded shortly because this is likely a higher time frame Higher Low. The market fulfilled its Bar 7 objective on the open of the next day.


图 11.5中，昨天是一个多头趋势性交易区间日、或者说一个趋势楼梯形态日，但它走出了三次推进向上，并沿着一条趋势线拾级而上，这通常意味着趋势线突破近在眼前。市场借着跳空开盘突破了这条趋势线；第1根K线是一笔做空的突破回调，它可能是空头开盘即趋势的起点。


> Yesterday in Figure 1 1.5 was a bull Trending Trading Range day or a Trending Stairs day but had Three Pushes up and walked up a trendline, which usually means that a trendline break is imminent. The market broke the trendline with the gap opening, and Bar 1 was a Breakout Pullback short, and it might be the start of a bear Trend from the Open.


第3根K线试着形成一个突破失败，但下跌途中有太多重叠K线，也没有高潮底部。向下有三次推进到第3根K线，但这些推进都很小，而且此前没有空头趋势线突破。


> Bar 3 tried to form a failed breakout, but there were too many overlapping bars on the way down and no climax bottom. There were Three Pushes down to Bar 3, but the pushes were small, and there was no prior bear trendline break.


![图 11.5](figures/fig-11-05.png)


**图 11.5　小幅突破回调与可能的空头开盘即趋势**


第5根K线试图与昨天的低点构成双底（分毫不差），结果却引出一波小楔形上涨，并在第6根K线形成一个双顶熊旗。双顶熊旗是开盘后第一段下跌之后常见的建仓形态，在个股上尤其如此；它后面往往跟着一段漫长的空头趋势，而那常常是趋势性交易区间的空头走势。第6根K线的信号K线是一根均线缺口K线。

The Bar 6 signal bar was an EMA Gap Bar.


第7根K线是一笔做空的突破回调，尽管那次突破还没有真正展开。差不多就够了。它还是一次失败的双底回调、一个成功的双顶回调建仓形态，以及一次微型趋势线做空。

> Yesterday. in Figure 1 1.6 was a strong bear, but Bar 4 broke above a major trendline, indicating that the market might try to reverse after a test of the Bar 3 low (usually a two-legged drop). Instead, the market sold off in two legs into the close.


第8根K线突破了由第4根K线那波上涨画出的那条新的、更平缓的主要趋势线，随后到第9根K线时向 EMA 走出一次小的两段式突破回调（两根空头趋势K线之间夹着一根多头趋势K线）。这次突破回调引出了一段多头开盘即趋势。它也是一个更高的低点，并且是从第7根K线趋势通道线过靶起第二段上涨的起点。

第10根K线是第三次推进向上（三个趋势性交易区间），所以预期会出现一段两段式回调。


> Bar 10 was the third push up (three Trending Trading Ranges), so a two-legged pullback was expected.

第4根K线是一个做空的突破回调建仓形态。开盘在第3根K线的更低的高点之后走出了一个更低的低点，第4根K线则构成了一个低2做空。

The Breakout Pullback entry above Bar 5 was effectively a High 2 since Bar 5 was the second leg down (yesterday's close was the first leg).

Whenever there are three or more overlapping bars, it is better to wait for a second entry, like a High 2. Bar 4 is a Wedge short and a failed breakout of yesterday's high.

FCX，开盘即趋势。市场大幅跳空高开，随后横盘了好几根K线，在第7根K线的 ii形态（内包内包）上方，构成一个高2做多入场。第8根K线是一次楔形做空。
