第2根K线是楔形做空，也是牛旗的一次突破失败。第3根K线是突破回调做空。第4根K线是突破回测做空，尽管它是一个更高的高点（高于第3根K线的摆动高点），而更高的高点本是强势的标志。第5根K线是一个更低的高点，也是在均线下方的一笔 M2S。第6根K线是楔形做多，也是一个扩张三角形的底部。第7根K线是趋势线突破失败后的一笔做空。第8根K线是第7根K线突破趋势线之后的两段式更低的低点，也是交易区间日里的一个更低的低点。第10根K线是楔形，也是交易区间日里的一个更低的低点。第11根K线是趋势线突破之后的第一次回调，也是一笔 M2B 做多。第12根K线是又一个多头 M2B。第13根K线是楔形做空，也是一个可能的双顶熊旗（与第4根K线）。第14根K线是一次失败的趋势线突破和交易区间突破失败，是一个双底牛旗，也可能是一段两段式上涨的第二段的起点。第15根K线是一个高2，它的前面两根K线处刚出现过一次突破回测。第16根K线是多头趋势里的一个高2。第17根K线是楔形，也是对当日高点的一次失败测试，因此可能是一个更低的高点。第19根K线是空头的低2（M2S），对在第18根K线买入的交易者来说，还是一次“五个 tick 的失败”。第20根K线是在一个交易区间日里两次推进创下的当日新低（第18根K线是第一次推进）（尽管从第17根K线的高点起有一段强劲的空头行情段……但此时它还算不上一个空头日）。它也是价格只以一个 tick 创出当日新低之后的反转向上（一次仅超出一个 tick 的突破失败）。它同时也是楔形。第21根K线是小小的第二段上涨，也是一个可能的双顶熊旗（与第19根K线）。第22根K线是趋势线突破（第17到第19根K线）之后回落到更高的低点的两段式回调，也是一笔双底（第10根与第20根K线）回调做多。第23根K线是一次失败的趋势线突破，也是一个双底牛旗（第23根K线比第22根K线高一个 tick）。


> Bar 2 was a Wedge short and a failed breakout of a bull flag. Bar 3 was a Breakout Pullback short. Bar 4 was a Breakout Test short even though it was a Higher High (above the Bar 3 swing high), which is a sign of strength. Bar 5 was a Lower High and an M2S below the EMA. Bar 6 was a Wedge long and an Expanding Triangle bottom. Bar 7 was a failed trendline breakout short. Bar 8 was a two-legged Lower Low after the Bar 7 break of a trendline, and a Lower Low on a trading range day. Bar 10 was a Wedge and a Lower Low on a trading range day. Bar 11 was the First Pullback after a trendline break, and it was an M2B long. Bar 12 was another bull M2B. Bar 13 was a Wedge short and a possible Double Top bear Flag (with Bar 4). Bar 14 was a failed trendline and trading range breakout failure, a Double Bottom Bull Flag, and a possible start of a second leg up. Bar 15 was a High 2 that followed a Breakout Test two bars earlier. Bar 16 was a High 2 in a bull. Bar 17 was a Wedge and a failed test of the high of the day, and therefore a possible Lower High. Bar 19 was a bear Low 2 (M2S) and a Five-Tick Failure for traders who bought Bar 18. Bar 20 was two pushes to a new low of the day (Bar 18 was the first) in a trading range day (even though there was a strong bear leg from the Bar 17 high . . . it is not a bear day at this point). It was also a reversal up after a one-tick new low of the day (a one-tick failed breakout). It was also a Wedge. Bar 21 was a small second leg up and a possible Double Top Bear Flag (with Bar 19). Bar 22 was a two-legged pullback to a Higher Low after a trendline break (Bars 17 to 19), and a Double Bottom (Bars 10 and 20) Pullback long. Bar 23 was a failed trendline break and a Double Bottom (Bar 23 was one tick higher than Bar 22) Bull Flag.


# 第 13 章　日线图、周线图与月线图

*Chapter 13. Daily, Weekly, and Monthly Charts*


尽管日线图、周线图和月线图也能产生日内信号，但它们出现的频率太低，对日内交易者来说只会成为干扰，因此应当忽略。最常见的信号是那些基于昨日最高价和最低价的信号，它们在5分钟图上就能看到。不过，这些更长的时间级别上经常会出现价格行为入场点，只是因为信号K线太大，如果风险要和日内交易一样，可以交易的合约数就少得多。另外，隔夜风险可能意味着你应当把合约数再减一些，或者考虑风险有明确上限的期权策略，比如直接买入期权或价差组合。只有当这些图不占据他交易日里的思绪时，日内交易者才应当交易它们，因为一边照料着基于日线图建立的、合约数或股数少得多的持仓，一边很容易错过几笔用大成交量做的日内交易，而这些错过的交易可能远不止抵掉日线信号带来的收益。


> Although daily, weekly, and monthly charts can generate intraday signals, they occur so infrequently that they become a distraction for a day trader and should be ignored. The most common signals are those based on yesterday's high and low, and you can see them on a 5- minute chart. However, there are frequently price action entries on these longer time frames, but because the signal bars are so large, far fewer contracts can be traded if the risk is to be the same as for a day trade. Also, overnight risk may mean that you should reduce your contracts even further or consider trading option strategies that have a defined risk, like outright purchases or spreads. A day trader should only trade these charts if they do not occupy his thoughts during the trading day because it is easy to miss a few day trades using large volume while nursing a trade of far fewer contracts or shares based on the daily chart, and these misses can more than offset any gain from the daily signal.


世界上那些规模最大的公司的股票，其价格行为通常比小公司股票更容易预测。出现巨大的隔夜不利波动的风险要小得多，尤其是在一轮持久的多头行情中向上急拉的风险。这意味着，在 WMT 上做逆势交易，失败的概率比在 CHK 上要小。不过，盈利潜力也同样更小。


> The price action of the stock of the largest companies in the world usually behaves in a more predictable way than that for the stock of small companies. The risk of a huge, overnight adverse move, especially on the upside in a protracted bull, is much less. This means that a Countertrend trade in WMT has a smaller chance of failing than in CHK. However, the profit potential is also less.


逆着强趋势交易时，目标应当是一笔1% 或2% 的剥头皮，因为大多数逆势交易的结果只是形成回调，而回调最终会变成顺势入场点。缺口会让入场变得复杂；一般来说，如果市场在昨日区间之内开盘、随后又越过位于该区间外一个 tick 处的入场止损单，风险会更小。如果你没法在盘中盯这只股票，又出现了跳空开盘，那大概最好还是放弃这笔交易。如果你能盯盘，而出现了跳空开盘，就留意缺口回抽，然后在市场恢复离开昨日区间的走势、那次向缺口内的回抽失败时入场。换句话说，如果你本来打算买入，但今天跳空高开，就留意今日开盘后的抛售，然后在向上反转的突破回调处买入，把止损放在今日低点下方。如果入场失败、止损被打掉，就去别处找机会；只有在出现第二次做多建仓形态时，才再给它一次机会。别在一只没有按你的预期走的股票上花太多时间，因为那样你会亏钱。亏损之后，人自然会有一种想在同一只股票上把钱赚回来的倾向，但这是你情绪软弱的表现。如果你觉得需要证明自己是对的、证明自己确实是个了不起的读图高手，那这件事上你可能是对的，但你并不是一个了不起的交易者。了不起的交易者接受自己的亏损，然后继续往前走。


> When trading counter to a strong trend, the goal should be a scalp of 1 or 2 percent, since most Countertrend trades just result in pullbacks that become With Trend entries. Gaps complicate the entries, and in general, the risk is less if the market opens within yesterday's range and then trades through the entry stop at one tick beyond the range. If you cannot watch the stock intraday and there is a gap open, it is probably best to pass on the trade. If you can watch the stock and there is a gap opening, watch for a gap pullback, and then enter on the failed pullback into the gap, as the market resumes its move away from yesterday's range. In other words, if you were looking to buy, but today gapped up, look for a selloff on the open today, and then buy a Breakout Pullback reversal back up, placing your stop below the low of today. If the entry fails and your stop is hit, look elsewhere or give it only one more try if there is a second buy setup. Don't spend too much time on a stock that is not doing what you wanted it to do because you will lose money. There is a natural tendency to want to make back your money on the same stock after a loss, but this is a sign of your emotional weakness. If you feel a need to prove that you were right and are in fact a great chart reader, you might be right about that, but you are not a great trader. Great traders accept their losses and move on.


日线图上的回调很少出现经典的反转K线，这就让交易者比交易5分钟图时面临更多的不确定性。不确定性就意味着风险，而风险更大时，仓位规模就需要更小，交易者还得考虑先建立一部分仓位，再随着价格行为逐步展开加仓。在多头回调中，如果市场再多跌一点、但空头尚未证明自己已经掌控局面，就可以在更低的价位加仓。也可以在更高的价位加仓：等趋势恢复、一次小回调形成高于你最初入场点的更高的低点之后再加。


> Pullbacks on daily charts rarely have classic reversal bars, leaving traders with more uncertainty than when trading 5-minute charts. Uncertainty means risk, and when there is more risk, position sizes need to be smaller, and a trader will have to consider taking a partial position and adding to the position as the price action unfolds. In a bull pullback, additions can be made at a lower price if the market sells off a little more but the bears have not yet demonstrated that they are in control. Additions can also be made at a higher price, after the trend has resumed and a small pullback forms a Higher Low, above your original entry.


收盘后翻看日线图时，你经常会看到一些可以留到第二天考虑的建仓形态。建仓形态一旦触发，往往会出现一段日内趋势，为你提供许多不错的5分钟顺势入场点。如果这只股票不是你平时做日内交易的对象，但它的成交量约有500万股或更多，那就不妨考虑把它加入你的日内交易股票池，做一两天。不过，有时候即使是 OIH 这种流动性非常好的股票，你的经纪商也可能没有可卖空的库存，结果你可能只能交易做多类的建仓形态。


> When you scan your daily charts at the end of the day, you will frequently see setups to consider for the next day. Once the setup triggers, there will often be an intraday trend that will provide you with many good 5-minute With Trend entries. If the stock is not one that you normally trade intraday but its volume is about 5 million shares or more, it is worth considering adding it to your basket of day trading stocks for a day or two. Sometimes, however, even with very liquid stocks such as the OIH, your broker might not have an inventory available for selling short, and you might be only able to trade buy setups.


价格行为是大量交易者出于无数种理由、各自独立地尽可能多赚钱所累积出来的结果。正因如此，它的指纹一直没有改变，并且永远会为那些读得懂它的人提供一件可靠的赚钱工具。图 13.1是1933年和1934年道琼斯工业指数的日线图，它看上去和今天任何时间级别上交易的任何一只股票没什么两样。


> Price action is the cumulative result of a large number of traders acting independently for countless reasons to make as much money as they can. Because of that, its fingerprint has remained unchanged and will always provide a reliable tool for making money for those who can read it. Figure 13.1 is a daily chart of the Dow Industrials in 1933 and 1934, and it looks like any stock trading today on any time frame.


第2根K线是一个低2，它突破了一条趋势线。第3根K线是一次小小的最终旗形失败反转，也是在趋势线突破之后对第1根K线低点的更低的低点测试（趋势线突破之后跟随一次对趋势极值的测试，可能构成主要趋势反转）。


> Bar 2 is a Low 2 that broke a trendline. Bar 3 is a small Failed Final Flag reversal and a Lower Low test of the Bar 1 low after a trendline break (a trendline break followed by a test of the trend's extreme can be a major trend reversal).


![图 13.1](figures/fig-13-01.png)


**图 13.1　价格行为在历史长河中大体保持不变**


第4根K线是一次突破回调，也是一个小小的更高的低点。第5根K线是强多头行情中的第一次回调，也是一个高2。第6根K线是一个楔形，它引出了两段大幅下跌行情，结束于第8根K线。一波强劲急速行情末端的楔形，通常会导致很深的回调，然后创出新高。第7根K线是一次趋势线突破，也是一次两段式回调。第8根K线是趋势线突破之后的更低的低点，也是对第2根K线的一次突破回测。第10根K线是一个更高的低点。第11根K线是一个高2突破回调，出现在向上突破由第7与第9根K线构成的失败双顶熊旗之后。第12与第13根K线是小级别趋势线被突破之后的向上反转。第14根K线是一个楔形。第15根K线是一次趋势线突破，也是一段动能强劲的逆势行情，在上涨行情测试第14根K线高点之后，它很可能会被测试。第16根K线是一个楔形，第17根K线是这个楔形的突破失败。第18根K线是对第14根K线多头趋势极值的更低的高点测试，它也是针对这个楔形“失败后的失败”的一笔低2做空入场。楔形下方出现过一次突破失败，现在这个楔形又在自己的向上突破中失败。一个失败后的失败楔形往往会带来强劲的反转。第18根K线也是对第14根信号K线低点的一次突破回测。第19根K线是对第15根K线低点的测试，也是一个双底牛旗。第20根K线是反转向上行情中一次更高的低点回调，也是一个双底回调。


> Bar 4 is a Breakout Pullback and a small Higher Low. Bar 5 is the First Pullback in a strong bull and a High 2. Bar 6 is a Wedge that led to two large legs down, ending at Bar 8. A Wedge at the end of a strong surge usually results in a very deep pullback and then a new high. Bar 7 was a trendline break and a two-legged pullback. Bar 8 was a Lower Low after a trendline break and a Breakout Test of Bar 2. Bar 10 is a Higher Low. Bar 1 1 is a High 2 Breakout Pullback after the breakout above the failed Bars 7 and 9 Double Top Bear Flag. Bars 12 and 13 are reversals up after a minor trendline breaks. Bar 14 is a Wedge. Bar 15 is a trendline break and a strong momentum Countertrend move that will likely be tested after a rally tests the Bar 14 high. Bar 16 is a Wedge, and Bar 17 is a failed breakout of the Wedge. Bar 18 is the Lower High test of the Bar 14 bull trend extreme, and it is a Low 2 entry for a short on the Wedge failed failure. There was a failed breakout below the Wedge, and now the Wedge is failing on its upside breakout. A failed failed Wedge often leads to a strong reversal. Bar 18 is also a Breakout Test of the Bar 14 signal bar low. Bar 19 is the test of the Bar 15 low and is a Double Bottom Bull Flag. Bar 20 is a Higher Low pullback in the reversal up and a Double Bottom Pullback.


![图 13.2](figures/fig-13-02.png)


**图 13.2　AAPL，5分钟图**


AAPL 在日线图（缩略图）上处于强多头行情中，并在图 13.2的第1根K线处出现了第一次均线回调，那是一次空头趋势通道过靶（两张图上的编号相同）。日线图上的第2根K线出现了强劲的日内向上反转，收盘接近其高点。想在第2天高点上方一个 tick 处买入是合理的。不过，次日跳空高开于第2天高点之上。与其去冒可能出现一个下跌反转日的风险，更谨慎的做法是等回抽测试缺口之后出现向上反转。


> AAPL was in a strong bull on the daily chart (thumbnail) and had a first EMA pullback at Bar 1 in Figure 13.2, which was a bear trend channel overshoot (the numbering is the same on both charts). Bar 2 on the daily had a strong intraday reversal up and closed near its high. It was reasonable to want to buy at one tick above the high of Day 2. However, the next day gapped above the Day 2 high. Rather than risk a possible reversal down day, it would be prudent to watch for a reversal up after a pullback test of the gap.


5分钟图上的第6根K线回补了缺口，它是一根均线缺口K线，也是一次空头趋势通道过靶并向上反转。这是一笔绝佳的做多入场，保护性止损放在第6根K线下方。这62美分的风险带来了好几美元的收益。


> Bar 6 on the 5-minute chart closed the gap and was an EMA Gap Bar . and a bear trend channel overshoot and reversal up. This was a great long entry with a protective stop below Bar 6. This 62 cent risk led to a several dollar gain.


在一轮持久的上涨之后，市场在图 13.3第2根K线处的高2回调之后突破了牛旗。


> After an extended bull run, the market broke out of a bull flag after the High 2 pullback at Bar 2 in Figure 13.3.


第7根K线是对连接第3与第5根K线高点画出的趋势通道线的测试，它同时也是一个扩张三角形的信号K线，这个形态构成了一笔绝佳的做空，目标至少是一段两段式回调。任何时候，只要一笔交易有可能成为主要趋势反转，就必须在剥头皮减掉一部分仓位之后，用保本止损持有剩下的波段部分。


> Bar 7 was a test of the trend channel line drawn across the highs of Bars 3 and 5, and it was also the signal bar of an Expanding Triangle, which setup a great short for at least a two leg pullback. Whenever a trade could be a major reversal, it is imperative to swing part with a breakeven stop after scalping out of some of the position.


第11根K线向上突破了空头趋势线，但在这么强的一段下跌之后，多头会不愿意买入，因为他们预期任何上涨行情都会走出第二段下跌。市场略微上破了连接第10与第12根K线高点画出的趋势通道，并在第13根K线处形成两根十字星，这意味着多头已经不再掌控从第11根K线开始的这波上涨行情。这是一根可能的建仓K线，对应一笔向下的均线缺口2K线（第二次尝试回补到均线的缺口），所以你必须挂一张订单，在第13根K线低点下方一美分处做空。股票里跳空开盘的情况太多，会造成糟糕的成交，所以更好的做法是只在开盘之后挂单，而且只在没有缺口时挂。如果出现向下跳空，就像这里这样，你就该用5分钟图，在上涨行情回补缺口之后，寻找一个做空的价格行为理由。


> Bar 1 1 broke above the bear trend line, but after this strong a down move the bulls would be reluctant to buy, expecting a second leg down from any rally. The market poked above the trend channel drawn from the highs of Bars 10 and 12 and formed two dojis at Bar 13, meaning the bulls were no longer in control of the rally from Bar 1 1. This is a possible setup bar for an EMA Gap 2 Bar down (second attempt to close the gap to the EMA), so you must place an order to go short at one cent below the low of Bar 13. Since there are so many gap opens in stocks, resulting in terrible fills, it is better to place the order only after the open and only if there is no gap. If there is a gap down, as there was here, you would use the 5-minute chart to look for a price action justification for a short after the rally closed the gap.


![图 13.3](figures/fig-13-03.png)


**图 13.3　杜邦，1987年崩盘**


第14根K线向上突破了一条微型趋势线。你会在第14根K线低点下方一美分处挂一张做空单。这是突破回调的一个变体，尽管价格还没有跌破第11根K线的低点。下跌去测试第11根K线低点的那四根K线非常陡直，你会预期它的表现和确实出现过一次小突破时一样。因此，第14根K线下方的做空属于一种突破回调入场，这类交易往往会带来持久的行情。那根入场K线是平顶，这说明空头从第一分钟起就掌控着局面。


> Bar 14 broke above a Micro Trendline. You would place an order to short at one cent below the low of Bar 14. This is a variant of a Breakout Pullback, even though the breakout below the low of Bar 11 has not yet occurred. The four bars down to test the low of Bar 11 were very vertical, and you would expect it to behave the same as if in fact there was a small breakout. Therefore, the short below Bar 14 is a type of Breakout Pullback entry, and these trades often lead to protracted moves. The entry bar had a shaved top, which means that the bears were in control from the first minute.


第11根K线结束了第一段下跌，第16根K线完成了这两段下跌行情中的第二段。由于跌到第16根K线这一段非常陡峭，最好等一次对低点的测试之后再去做多，或者等别的迹象表明卖方打算在看到更多价格行为之前不再做空。不过，第二段的陡峭程度以及那些空头趋势K线的大小都意味着，这很可能是卖出高潮，而卖出高潮之后通常至少会跟着一段两段式逆势上涨，持续的时间比大多数人预期的要长得多。


> Bar 11 ended the first leg down, and Bar 16 completed the second leg of the two legs down. Since the move down to Bar 16 was so steep, it is better to wait for a test of the low before going long, or some other indication that the sellers were going to wait for more price action before they short again. However, the steepness of the second leg and the size of the bear trend bars imply that there is a high probability of this being a sell climax, which usually is followed by at least a two-legged Countertrend rally that lasts for far more bars than most would expect.


从低点起来的、由两根K线构成的上涨行情突破了一条趋势线，尽管那是条陡峭的线，所以买入第17根K线处的高2（更高的低点）是明智的。随后你可以在第18根K线处、靠近均线的位置做空那个低2，或者等待更多价格行为，因为这波回调没有触及均线，而且那根K线是一根多头趋势K线，所以还可能继续上涨。


> The two-bar rally off the low broke a trendline, albeit a steep one, so it is sensible to buy the Bar 17 High 2 (Higher Low). You could then short the Low 2 near the EMA at Bar 18, or wait for more price action, since the pullback did not reach the EMA, and it is a bull trend bar, so more rally is possible.


第19根K线是空头行情中一个低2的信号K线，也是一个失败的高2，位置靠近均线，所以这是一笔很强的做空。它还是一个由三根K线构成的双顶熊旗。


> Bar 19 was a signal bar for a Low 2 in a bear and a failed High 2, near the EMA, so it is a strong short. It was also a three-bar long Double Top Bear Flag.


第20根K线略微下破第17根K线的低点，但立刻遇到了买盘，空头也回补了。市场试图形成一个双底牛旗。在第20根信号K线处做多的多头只把价格推到均线，他们会在那里止盈一部分、并把止损移到保本。他们本来会被止损打掉，但会在第22根信号K线处的高2再次买入——那根信号K线测试了第16根K线的空头低点，而且它紧随第21根K线对空头趋势线的突破。那里并没有一根强劲的反转K线；尽管这可能是新一轮持久多头行情的开端、必须买入，你也得预期，在任一方向走出强趋势之前，还会出现更多双向来回的交易。


> Bar 20 poked below the Bar 17 low but immediately found buyers and the shorts covered. The market tried to form a Double Bottom Bull Flag. The longs from the Bar 20 signal bar only made it to the EMA, where they would take partial profits and move their stops to breakeven. They would have been stopped out, but they would buy again at the High 2 off the Bar 22 signal bar that tested the Bar 16 bear low, and it followed the Bar 21 break of the bear trendline. There was not a strong reversal bar, and although this could be the start of an extended bull and it must be bought, you would have to expect more two-sided trading to unfold before a strong trend in either direction begins.


GE 在1987年初急速上涨，但在第6根信号K线处有一笔小做空——那是一次反转，来自对图 13.4中连接第2与第3根K线画出的多头趋势通道线的第二次过靶。成交是在下方一个 tick（一美分）处的止损单上完成的。由于此前还没有出现过向下的急拉，这笔做空很可能会在两段式下跌走到均线附近时失败，随后再创新高。


> GE rallied sharply in early 1987, but there was a small short based on the Bar 6 signal bar that was a reversal from a second overshoot of a bull trend channel line drawn from Bars 2 and 3 in Figure 13.4. The fill was one tick (one cent) below on a stop. Since there was not yet an earlier downward surge, this is likely going to fail on a two-legged down move to around the EMA, and be followed by a new high.


![图 13.4](figures/fig-13-04.png)


**图 13.4　GE 的周线图，1987年崩盘**


第9根K线处的 M2B（靠近均线的高2）是一笔不错的做多入场，目标是测试高点。


> The M2B (High 2 near the EMA) at Bar 9 was a good long entry for a test of the highs.


第11根K线向上穿过了挂在第5根K线高点上的趋势通道线，那条通道线是连接第1与第8根K线所画趋势线的平行线。你如果穿过第2与第5根K线的高点画一条趋势通道线，也会得到类似的信号。


> Bar 11 broke through the trend channel line attached to the high of Bar 5, which is a parallel of the trendline drawn from Bars 1 and 8. You would get a similar signal by drawing the trend channel line across the highs of Bars 2 and 5.


第11根K线是一个可能的信号K线，但下一根K线没能打掉它的低点。相反，下一根K线是一根内包K线，并以强劲的空头收盘得到强化。如果你在它的低点下方一个 tick 处挂做空单，订单会在下一根K线成交（那根空头内包K线由此变成了这笔做空的信号K线）。在这样一次穿过趋势通道线的高潮式上涨之后，再加上此前跌到第8根K线的那次趋势线突破，空头应当预期至少会有两段下跌，去测试第1到第6根K线急速行情之后通道上涨的起点——第8根K线。


> Bar 1 1 was a potential signal bar, but the next bar failed to take out its low. Instead, the next bar was an inside bar reinforced by a strong bear close. If you placed an order to short at one tick below its low, the order would be filled on the next bar (turning that bear inside bar into a signal bar for this short). After such a climactic move up through the trend channel line and following the earlier trendline break down to Bar 8, the shorts should expect at least two legs down to test the Bar 8 start of the channel up after the Bars 1 to 6 spike.


第13根K线是从这个潜在的新空头开始的回调中的第二小段上涨。之所以算两段上涨，是因为均线处先出现了一根多头趋势K线，接着是一根空头趋势K线（在更小的时间级别上就是一段下跌），最后是第二段上涨，由连续的多头趋势K线构成。既然空头预期在可能出现新高之前还会有第二段下跌，就在第13根K线下方一美分处挂一张做空的止损单（订单成交后，这根K线就成了信号K线）。初始止损放在信号K线的高点之上。入场K线一收盘，就把止损下移到其高点上方一美分处。


> Bar 13 was the second small leg up in the pullback from the potential new bear. It is two legs up because there was a bull trend bar off the EMA, and then a bear trend bar (a down leg on a smaller time frame), and finally a second leg up, made of consecutive bull trend bars. Since the shorts are expecting a second leg down before any possible new high, place a stop order to go short at one cent below Bar 13 (which becomes the signal bar once the order is filled). The initial stop goes above the high of the signal bar. Once the entry bar closes, lower the stop to one cent above its high.


市场在向下跌到第14根K线的第二段大跌中崩盘。因为这是两段下跌，而且它没有打掉先前多头行情的低点，所以在更长的时间级别上，它可能形成一个更高的低点。另外，由于那些空头趋势K线实体巨大，很可能接下来至少会有两段上涨（很可能四段），而且这段横盘到上涨的行情应当会持续很长时间（至少20到30根K线，这是根据目测图表得出的近似值）。空头很可能会在相当长一段时间里放弃掌控，等待更多价格行为出现，才愿意积极做空。不过，他们会做空每一次上涨行情，并在下跌的每一次停顿处止盈。同样，多头也知道市场很可能会长期横盘到上涨，他们会开始逢跌买入，但在上涨行情停滞时迅速离场，直到出现价格行为表明向上或向下的趋势已经启动。


> The market crashed in a large second leg down to Bar 14. Because this is two legs down and it did not take out the low of the prior bull, it could form a Higher Low in a longer time frame bull. Also, since the bear trend bars were so large, it is likely that there will be at least two legs up (and likely four legs), and the sideways to up action should last for a long time (at least 20 or 30 bars, as an approximation based on eyeballing the chart). The bears will likely relinquish control for an extended period and wait for more price action before being willing to short aggressively. They will, however, short every rally and take profits at every pause in the down move. Likewise, the bulls know that the market will probably go sideways to up for a long time, and they will start buying the dips but exiting quickly on stalled rallies, until there is price action that indicates that a trend up or down has begun.


第16根K线是一个低2的潜在信号K线，所以空头会在它的低点下方一美分处挂做空单。


> Bar 16 is a potential signal bar for a Low 2, so the bears will place an order to short at one cent below its low.


第17根K线测试了空头低点，是一个潜在的高2信号，所以多头会在它的高点上方一个 tick 处挂买单（而空头会把剩余仓位平掉）。它是一次最终旗形失败。


> Bar 17 tested the bear low and is a potential High 2 signal, so the bulls will place buy orders at one tick above its high (and the shorts will exit the remainder of their positions). It is a Failed Final Flag.


第18根K线与第15根K线构成一个双顶熊旗。第20根K线是一根基于低2的做空入场K线，尤其是在市场从第18根K线起六根K线下跌期间没能守住微型趋势线（未画出）之后。不过，这里是铁丝网，通常更好的做法、也永远是压力更小的做法，是等一次突破失败，然后在失败处入场。


> Bar 18 is a Double Top Bear Flag with Bar 15. Bar 20 is a short entry bar based on a Low 2, especially after the market failed to hold above the Micro Trendline (not shown) over the six bars down from Bar 18. However, this is Barb Wire, and it is usually better and always less stressful to wait for a breakout to fail and then enter on the failure.


第21根K线是又一次对空头低点的测试，与第14根K线构成双底（或者把第14根和第17根K线都视为第一个底）。涨到第18根K线的这波上涨行情还突破了一条陡峭的空头趋势线，那条线从第13根K线连到第15、第16根K线附近的任意一根K线。趋势线被突破、随后又可能出现双底，这可能是新一轮多头趋势的开端。第21根K线还反转了价格对一条七根K线空头趋势通道线的下破，那条线是用紧邻前面那七根蜡烛线实体底部的最佳拟合画出来的。


> Bar 21 was another test of the bear low, forming a Double Bottom with Bar 14 (or, with Bars 14 and 17 both being considered as the first bottom). The rally to Bar 18 also broke a steep bear trendline from Bar 13 to any of the bars around Bars 15 and 16. A broken trendline and then a possible Double Bottom could be the start of a new bull trend. Bar 21 also reversed a break below a seven-bar bear trend channel line, drawn using a best fit of the bottom of the bodies of those immediately prior seven candles.


涨到第22根K线的上涨行情又突破了一条空头趋势线。连续突破多条空头趋势线，强烈表明多头正在确立自己的地位，一段持久的向上波段正变得更加可能。不过，这也是均线上方的第一次测试，所以第22根K线之后的那个低2是一笔不错的做空，预期会走出两小段下跌。


> The rally to Bar 22 broke another bear trendline. Breaks of multiple bear trendlines is a strong indication that the bulls are asserting themselves and that a protracted swing up is becoming more likely. However, this was also the first test above the EMA so the Low 2 after Bar 22 is a good short, expecting two small legs down.


第23根K线构造了一笔高2做多入场，它同时是一个更高的低点（高于第21根K线）和一个双底回调，并且它出现在一段涨到第22根K线的上涨行情之后，那段上涨包含七根连续的多头蜡烛线，虽然都很小。涨到第24根K线的九根K线上涨中只含一根空头蜡烛线，之后又跟着五根连续收在均线上方的多头K线，两者都表明多头正掌控着市场。


> Bar 23 setup a High 2 long entry that was also a Higher Low (above Bar 21) and a Double Bottom Pullback and it followed a rally up to Bar 22 that contained seven consecutive, albeit small, bull candles. The nine-bar rally up to Bar 24 contained only one bear candle, and was followed by five consecutive bull bars that closed above the EMA, both indicating that the bulls are owing the market.


第26根K线在上破一条多头趋势通道线（从第23与第25根K线低点引出的平行线）以及第15根K线自高潮低点起的最初那段上涨之后反转。这是一个潜在的双顶熊旗。由于涨到第26根K线的那波上涨行情力度太强，很可能第26根K线的高点会先被测试，然后第23根K线的低点才会被打掉——如果低点先被打掉，预期的（最少）两段下跌就被否定了。


> Bar 26 reversed after poking above a bull trend channel line (a parallel from the Bar 23 and 25 lows ) and the Bar 15 initial up move off the climactic low. This is a potential Double Top Bear Flag. Since there was so much strength on the rally to Bar 26, it is likely that its high will be tested before the Bar 23 low is taken out, which would negate the expected two legs (minimum) down.


第28根K线构造了一个 M2B（均线处的高2）。另外，它还是两根把价格推回均线下方的空头趋势K线中的第二根（第一根出现在三根K线之前），此前价格连续24次收在均线上方。当对某件事的两次尝试都失败时，就要预期反方向会出现大行情。它同时也是第26根K线那波上破交易区间（该区间自第15根K线以来一直有效）的上涨行情之后的突破回调，也是从第14（或第17）根K线与第23（或第21）根K线构成的双底而来的一个大型双底回调，这种形态有时被称为杯柄做多建仓形态（cup and handle）。


> Bar 28 setup an M2B (a High 2 at the EMA). Also, it was second of two bear trend bars that tried to push back below the EMA (the first occurred three bars earlier) after 24 consecutive closes above the EMA. When two attempts at something fail, expect a big move in the opposite direction. It is also a Breakout Pullback from the Bar 26 rally above the trading range that has been in effect since Bar 15, and a large Double Bottom Pullback from the Bars 14 (or 17) and 23 (or 21) Double Bottom, and is sometimes called a cup and handle long setup.


第29根K线测试了第27根K线的高点，形成一次突破回测，随后以一根巨大的外包上涨K线猛烈飙升，把弱势多头挤出场、迫使他们追着市场向上买。


> Bar 29 tested the Bar 27 high, creating a Breakout Test, and then violently surged up in a large outside bar up trapping weak longs out of their positions and forcing them to chase the market up.


第31根K线测试了第30根K线之后出现的缺口，它同时构造了一笔高2的多头回调做多。


> Bar 31 tested the gap that followed Bar 30, and it also setup a High 2 bull pullback long.


从2000年高点起有一段两段式下跌，第一段结束于图 13.5中的第B根K线。涨到第C根K线的那波上涨行情突破了趋势线，所以交易者想在一段测试第B根K线低点的行情里做多，无论它形成的是更高的低点还是更低的低点。


> There was a two-legged move down from the 2000 high with the first leg ending at Bar B in Figure 13.5. The rally to Bar C broke the trendline, so traders were looking to buy a Higher Low or Lower Low test of the low of Bar B.


![图 13.5](figures/fig-13-05.png)


**图 13.5　这是 SPY（标普500的 ETF）的月线图，显示2003年那个双底回调底部**


第1根K线跌破了第B根K线太多，在没有更多价格行为出现的情况下，交易者不会在那里积极买入。


> Bar 1 dropped too far below Bar B for traders to aggressively buy there in the absence of more price action.


第5根K线处在铁丝网里（三根或更多相互重叠的K线，其中至少有一根是十字星），所以你只该考虑在高点附近的小K线上做空，或在低点附近的小K线上买入。虽然第1根和第5根K线的低点并不完全相同，但已经足够接近，可以构成一个可能的双底；在交易里，接近通常就意味着足够接近。从第5根K线起的那波上涨行情突破了一条空头趋势线，所以交易者会等着在测试第5根K线低点时买入。


> Bar 5 was in Barb Wire (three or more overlapping bars with one or more being a doji), so you should only look to short a small bar near the high or buy a small bar near the low. Although Bars 1 and 5 did not have identical lows, they were close enough to be a possible Double Bottom, and in trading close is usually close enough. The rally from Bar 5 broke a bear trendline, so traders will look to buy a test of the Bar 5 low.


第11根K线在对双底低点的一次深度测试之后向上反转。这个双底回调完成了从第A根K线开始的两段下跌，随后走出了一轮持久的上涨。像通常那样，这轮多头行情打掉了从第A根K线跌到第5根K线那段空头行情中形成的那些多头信号K线的高点。


> Bar 1 1 reversed up from a deep test of the Double Bottom low. This Double Bottom Pullback completed the two legs down from Bar A and an extended bull ensued. As is typical, the bull took out the highs of the bull signal bars that formed in the bear down from Bar A to Bar 5.


第1、第5和第11根K线与下面日线图中的那几根K线一一对应。涨到第15根K线的那波上涨行情非常强。有意思的是，任何回调都应当被预期去测试从第11根K线低点起来的上涨行情中的那些空头信号K线（见下一张图）。事实上，这波抛售跌穿了此前所有的空头信号，演变成了一轮主要空头行情。不过，没有什么事会令人意外，交易者只该交易自己所用图表上出现的形态，而不一定去做月线图上的形态。


> Bars 1, 5, and 1 1 correspond to those in the daily chart below. The rally up to Bar 1,5 was very strong. It is interesting to note that any pullback would be expected to test the bear signal bars in the rally up from the Bar 1 1 low (see next chart). The selloff in fact fell through all of the earlier bear signals and became a major bear. However, nothing is ever surprising, and traders should just trade whatever patterns appear on the chart that they use for trading and not necessarily trade monthly patterns.


第15根K线处的顶部是对第A根K线的一次三次推进向上的更高的高点测试（从第A根K线开始的下跌里显然有过一次趋势线突破）。此外，向上到第15根K线的第三次推进之前，刚出现过一次小的趋势线突破。


> The Bar 15 top was a Three Push up Higher High test of Bar A (there obviously was a trendline break in the bear down from Bar A). Also, the third push up to Bar 15 followed a small trendline break.


第16根K线是主要多头趋势线被突破之后的一笔 M2S。第17根K线是一次低1突破回调。尽管第18根K线是一根巨大的K线，可能是对第5根K线低点的一次高潮式测试，但此时完全没有价格行为上的证据表明底部已经出现，不管电视上的专家在说什么。这次高潮可能带来反转，也可能带来一个交易区间，但空头趋势线还没有被突破，也还没有出现明显的向上动能。趋势仍然是向下的；虽然很难想象市场还能跌得更低，但它确实还能跌。此时市场的交易与估值无关；当它像这样情绪化时，它会一直跌到最后一个卖家卖完为止。等最后一个卖家卖完，就会出现一波上涨行情，突破一条重要的空头趋势线，然后去测试低点；但在那之前，趋势仍然是向下的。


> Bar 16 was a M2S after the break of the major bull trendline. Bar 17 was a Low 1 Breakout Pullback Although Bar 18 is a huge bar that might turn out to be a climactic test of the Bar 5 low, there is absolutely no price action evidence of a bottom at this point, despite what the pundits are saying on television. The climax might lead to a reversal or a trading range, but there has yet to be a break of the bear trendline and there has been no significant upward momentum. The trend is still down and although it is hard to imagine that the market could get much lower, it can. The market is not trading based on valuation at this point and when it is emotional like this, it will keep dropping until the last seller has sold. When he does, there will be a rally that will break a significant bear trendline and then a test of the low, but until then, the trend is still down.


顺便说一句，虽然专家们一直把这次2008年的崩盘归咎于房地产泡沫和相关的银行业危机，但房地产市场几乎在三年前就开始崩盘了，信贷危机也至少已经酝酿了几年。真正发生的是，全世界意识到奥巴马要当总统了，而他会增加对企业的监管、抬高劳动力成本，这两者都会压低企业的盈利能力。企业赚得更少，股票就更不值钱。全球市场只是在迅速调整股票的估值，以反映聪明钱预期奥巴马治下将会出现的盈利下降。市场很可能把这一点折扣打得过头了，未来很多个月里，市场会在等待、观望奥巴马到底做什么的过程中涨回来。这类似于1994年共和党接管国会时开启的那轮股市大涨，而那次上涨从来没有被归功于他们（顺便说一句，我是一个非常自由的独立派人士，不是共和党人）。当时全世界大幅上调了盈利预期，显著抬高了股票的价值。这些对日内交易者都没什么用，但它是一个例子，说明要愿意和专家想得不一样，也要能安然持有一个少数派的看法。永远不要害怕与所有人看法不同，尤其是与电视上的专家不同。


> Incidentally, although pundits have been attributing this 2008 crash to the housing bubble and the related banking crisis, the housing market began its crash almost three years earlier arid the credit crisis has been simmering for at least a couple of years. What did happen was the world realized that Obama was going to become president and that he would increase business regulations and increase the cost of labor, both of which would reduce corporate profitability. When companies earn less, their stock is worth less. The worldwide market was just rapidly adjusting the value of stocks to reflect the reduced earnings that smart money anticipates under Obama. It is likely that the market has discounted this too much and that the market will rally back over the next many months as it waits to see what Obama does. This is similar to the huge stock market rally that began when the Republicans took over Congress in 1994 and it was never attributed to them (by the way, I am a very liberal Independent and not a Republican). The world adjusted its earnings expectations dramatically upward, significantly increasing the value of stocks. None of this is useful to a day trader, but it is an example of being willing to think differently from the experts and being comfortable holding a minority opinion. Never be afraid to see things differently from everyone else, especially the experts on television.


图 13.6中涨到第3根K线的强劲上涨行情远远突破了均线，也突破了趋势线。这波上涨行情末端看上去像个楔形；每当一波强劲急速行情末端出现楔形，就常常会出现一次对这段行情起点的测试（第1根K线的低点）。


> The strong rally up to Bar 3 in Figure 13.6 broke well above the EMA and broke the trendline. The end of the rally had a Wedge look to it and whenever there is a Wedge at the end of a strong surge, there is often a test of the start of the move (the Bar 1 low).


第5根K线是对第1根K线的更低的低点测试，形成了一个双底。记住，交易者生活在一个不完美的世界里；如果某个东西看起来和某个可靠形态相当相似，它往往会表现得一样。低点处出现了空头趋势通道的突破与反转，那个低点位于从第3根K线开始的大幅下跌的末端，而测试第3根K线是有可能的。


> Bar 5 was a Lower Low test of Bar 1, forming a Double Bottom. Remember, traders live in a world of imperfection and if something looks reasonably similar to a reliable pattern, it will tend to act the same way. There was a bear trend channel break and reversal at the low, which was at the end of the big move down from Bar 3, and a test of Bar 3 is possible.

第7根K线是对第3根K线的更低的高点测试，形成一个双顶熊旗；它同时结束于一个小楔形，因此很可能会有一波深度回撤。


> Bar 7 was a Lower High test of Bar 3, forming a Double Top Bear Flag, and it also ended in a small Wedge and therefore likely would have a deep retracement.


第11根K线是对第5根K线低点的深度测试，随后向上反转，形成了一次双底（第1与第5根K线）回调，接着走出一轮持久的上涨。第11根K线也是一次对空头趋势通道线的下破失败，为测试这段下跌的起点——第7根K线——做好了铺垫。不过，日线图、周线图和月线图上同时出现的这个双底回调，使对第7根K线的测试变成了突破，而不是一次失败测试之后再走出新一轮抛售。


> Bar 11 was a deep test of the Bar 5 low, and it reversed up, forming a Double Bottom (Bars 1 and 5) Pullback and then an extended rally. Bar 11 also was a failed break below a bear trend channel line, setting up for a test of the Bar 7 start of the leg down. However, the Double Bottom Pullback on the daily, weekly, and monthly charts made the test of Bar 7 tum into a breakout instead of a failed test followed by another selloff.


许多技术分析者会把这里称为头肩底，但那说明不了任何有关价格行为的东西。大多数双底回调都是头肩底，但既然大多数头肩形态都会失败（它们通常只是变成持续形态，而不是反转形态），而大多数双底回调都会成功，你就该把两者区分开，永远不必费心去用“头肩形态”这个词。


> Many technicians would refer to this as a Head and Shoulders Bottom, but that does not tell anything about the price action. Most Double Bottom Pullbacks are Head and Shoulders Bottoms, but since most Head and Shoulder patterns fail (they usually just become continuation patterns instead of reversal patterns) and most Double Bottom Pullbacks succeed, you should distinguish them and never bother with the term "Head and Shoulders. "

> Bar 1 in Figure 13.7 was a spike, and it led to a channel that ended at Bar 6.

> The Bars 2 to 3 rally was another spike, and it also led to a channel that also ended at Bar 6, The market has been so strong that it never attempted to retrace to the beginning of either channel (Bars 2 and 4).

突破时，第1与第4根K线之间有一块成交稀疏区（thin area），随后是一个大约在第4根K线附近结束的交易区间。接着出现了一次接近等距运动的上涨，直到第6根K线的顶部（从第2根K线量到第4根K线交易区间的中点）。


> There was a thin area between Bars 1 and 4 on the breakout and then a trading range that ended around Bar 4. This was followed by close to a Measured Move up to the top of Bar 6 (from Bar 2 to the middle of the Bar 4 trading range).


第5与第7根K线之间又有一次突破留下的成交稀疏区，随后是一段从第4、第5根K线附近走到大约第9根K线附近的走势。


> There was another breakout thin area between Bars 5 and 7 followed by an approximate move from Bars 4 and 5 to around Bar 9.


第7根K线所在交易区间的中点，就是急速行情之后的停顿，它给出了一个从整张图最低点到最高的等距运动。从这个旗形突破后不久，出现了一笔突破回调做多。不过要记住，等距运动只是观察，交易时你不该考虑它们。


> The middle of the Bar 7 trading range was the pause after the spike, and it gave a Measured Move from the low of the chart to the top of the chart. There was a Breakout Pullback long shortly after the breakout from this flag. Remember, however, that Measured Moves are just observations and you should not consider them while trading.


这个通道在第10根K线的抛售中试图失败，但反而在均线下方形成了一个由缺口K线构成的双底。一直到第16根K线高点为止，还有好几次其他失败的趋势线突破，它们也都是不错的做多建仓形态。第9与第12根K线之间的那块成交稀疏区，投射到了第13根K线高点附近（从第7根K线的低点量起）。


> The channel attempted to fail on the Bar 10 selloff but instead formed a Double Bottom of gap bars below the EMA. There were several other failed trendline breaks all of the way to the Bar 16 high that were also good long setups. The thin area between Bars 9 and 12 projected to around the Bar 13 high (from the Bar 7 low).


第15根K线跌破均线和主要趋势线的那一跌，在价格测试高点之后几乎肯定会被测试。


> The Bar 15 plunge below the EMA and the major trendline was almost certainly going to be tested after a test of the high.


这次高点测试是一次过靶（更高的高点），它既是一个楔形形态（先向上急速，随后三次小幅推进到第16根K线），也是一个扩张三角形的末端（第11、12、13、15和16根K线）。


> The high test was an overshoot (Higher High) that was a Wedge pattern (a spike up and then three small pushes up to Bar 16), and the end of an Expanding Triangle (Bars 11, 12, 13, 15, and 16).


第18根K线是一次突破回调（一个变体，因为跌破第15根K线的突破还没有发生，但跌到第17根K线的动能已经足以让图表表现得像发生过突破一样），也是一次双顶回调。


> Bar 18 was a Breakout Pullback (a variant, since the breakout below Bar 15 did not yet happen, but the momentum down to Bar 17 was enough to make the chart act like a breakout) and a Double Top Pullback.


第20根K线是又一次突破回调，也是从下方对第7与第10根K线趋势线的测试。


> Bar 20 was another Breakout Pullback and a test of the Bars 7 and 10 trendline from below.


市场抛售测试第19根K线低点之后，会试图形成一个双底回调；但考虑到跌到第19根K线这波抛售的力度，市场更可能走出第二段下跌、结束在第19根K线下方，而且它最终可能去测试第7根K线处的通道低点，甚至继续跌得更低。每当市场强到这种程度——就像这里一样，对一路回溯到第1根K线急速行情的那几个急速与通道底部，它都根本不回来测试预期的价位——那么当修正终于到来时，它通常会持续得更久、比任何人预期的都深得多。


> Af3 the market sells off to test the Bar 19 low, it will attempt to form a Double Bottom Pullback, but with the strength of the selling down to Bar 19, the market more likely will form a second leg down that ends below Bar 19, and it might ultimately test the Bar 7 channel low or even continue much lower. Whenever the market has so much strength that it does not come back to test the expected prices for several patterns as it did here with the Spike and Channel bottoms that go all the way back to the Bar 1 spike, when the correction finally comes, it will usually last longer and be much deeper than anyone anticipates.


通道之后的修正通常会导致交易区间；既然这是周线图，我们可能还要大体横盘好几年。最终市场会朝某个方向突破；由于我们身处一个增长中的经济体，而 Emini 就是这一经济体价值的平均值，市场最终应当向上突破，但那可能需要很长很长的时间。


> Corrections after channels usually lead to trading ranges, and since this is a weekly chart, we may go largely sideways for several more years. Ultimately the market will break out in one direction or another, and since we are in a growing economy and the Emini is an average of the value of that economy, the market ultimately should break out of the upside but that could take a long, long time.


CNBC 上的所有专家一直在说底部已经到了、我们正走在通往新高的路上，但价格行为看起来说的正好相反。不过，任何时候只要市场涨几个百分点，他们就会找来一批多头，宣称下一轮大牛市已经有了证据；而每次市场跌几个百分点，他们又总能找到一批空头，声称我们正在走向大萧条。你应当带着好笑的心情看着他们，因为你不做他们那个时间级别，这些预测和你的收入毫无关系（也丝毫不能告诉你价格行为正在说什么）。这些观察说明，对日内交易管用的那些想法，在更长的时间级别上同样管用。当一只股票在日线图上处于陡峭的空头行情中，然后出现一天成交量是正常水平5到10倍的行情时，多头可能已经投降，一个可交易的底部可能已经出现。这种巨量日很常见是跳空低开的一天；如果它以强劲的多头收盘，做多盈利的几率就会上升。交易者不一定是在找多头反转，但在一次高潮式抛售之后，出现至少两段式上涨、至少涨到均线的几率很大，这让他们能够做一笔从几天持续到几周的盈利交易。


> All of the pundits on CNBC have been saying that the bottom is in and that we are on the way to new highs, but the price action appears to be saying otherwise. However, any time the market is up a couple of percent, they round up bulls proclaiming evidence of the next great bull and every time it drops a couple of percent, they find the bears who claim that we are heading to a depression. You should look at them with amusement because you don't trade in their time frame, and the predictions have nothing to do with your income (and nothing to do with what the price action is telling you). These observations demonstrate that the same ideas that work for day trading also work for longer time frames. When a stock is in a steep bear on the daily chart and then has a day with volume that is 5 to 10 times normal, the bulls may have capitulated and a tradable bottom may be present. The huge volume day is very often a gap down day, and if it has a strong bull close, the odds of a profitable long increase. Traders are not necessarily looking for a bull reversal, but after a climactic selloff the odds are good that there will be at least a two-legged move to at least the EMA that will allow them to place a profitable trade that will last from days to weeks.


顺便说一句，在处于强空头行情中的1分钟 Emini 图上，如果出现一根巨量K线（约25,000张合约），它不太可能成为空头行情的终点，但往往是回调即将到来的信号，通常是在成交量更小的一两个更低的低点之后（成交量背离 volume divergence）。你应当极少、甚至从不去看日内图上的成交量，因为成交量在5分钟图上的预测价值并不可靠——而5分钟图才是你交易时应当唯一使用的图。


> Incidentally, on a 1-minute Emini chart that is in a strong bear, if there is a huge volume bar (about 25,000 contracts), it is unlikely to be the end of the bear, but often is a sign that a pullback will come soon, usually after one or two Lower Lows on less volume (volume divergence). You should rarely if ever look at volume on intraday charts because of its unreliable predictive value on the 5-minute chart, which is the chart that you should be using exclusively for trading.


雷曼兄弟以巨大的跳空缺口在第3根K线低开，随后跌破了空头趋势通道线（图 13.8中从第1与第2根K线画出），但强劲反弹一直涨到收盘。成交量是前一天的3倍，约为过去一个月平均水平的10倍。有了这样一根强劲的多头趋势K线（在蜡烛图缩略图上看得更清楚），在收盘时买入是安全的，但更谨慎的交易者会等到市场打掉这根可能的信号K线的高点再动手。第二天市场跳空高开。交易者可以买开盘价，也可以等一次向下测试后买入新的日内高点，或者在5分钟图上寻找抛售、等回补缺口的尝试失败后买入那次向上反转。这种力度几乎总是会跟着至少两段上涨（涨到第6根K线的第二段，出现在第5根K线成功测试缺口形成的更高的低点之后）以及一次对均线的穿透。


> Lehman Brothers opened with a huge gap down on Bar 3 and then ran below a bear trend channel line (from Bars 1 and 2 in Figure 13.8) but rallied strongly into the close. Volume was three times that of the prior day and about 10 times that of the average of the past month. With such a strong bull trend bar (seen more clearly on the candle chart thumbnail), it was safe to buy at the close, but a more cautious trader would wait until the market took out the high of this possible signal bar. The market gapped up on the next day. A trader could either buy the open, wait for a test down and then buy a new intraday high, or look for a selloff on the 5-minute chart and buy the reversal up after the attempt to close the gap failed. This kind of strength is almost always followed by at least two legs up (the second leg up to Bar 6 occurred after the successful Bar 5 gap test Higher Low) and a penetration of the EMA.

截至今天，市场正在测试第3根K线的低点，试图守住其下方的止损并形成一个双底；但如果守不住，第3根K线低点下方很可能会出现恐慌性抛售——而那个低点在所有人眼里都是一个强劲的、放巨量的底部。


> As of today, the market is currently testing the Bar 3 low, attempting to defend the stops below it and form a Double Bottom, but if it fails, there will likely be panic selling below the Bar 3 low that everyone was seeing as a strong, high-volume bottom.


图 13.9中的贝尔斯登在一个星期五走出了一个巨大的空头趋势日，成交量约为平常一天的15倍，而这只股票在过去两周里已经跌掉了约70% 的市值。不过，成交量只是前一天的大约一倍半，而且只有很小的多头影线。价格行为对多头不利，因为跌破空头趋势通道之后并没有出现反转。事实上，那根巨大的空头趋势K线远远收在该线下方，证实了趋势通道线确实无力约束空头。这只股票在星期一开盘时（第3根K线）又跌了80%，但成交量略小。那些在星期五收盘时买入的交易者，以为一个高潮底部已经出现、以为这个国家第五大投资银行绝不可能再跌了，到了星期一便遭到了毁灭性的打击。在没有看涨价格行为配合的情况下，高潮式的成交量并不能成为反向操作一轮强空头趋势的理由。电视上的专家也许会推荐买入，但缺少价格行为的支持，这样做实在太冒险了。


> Bear Stearns in Figure 13.9 had a huge bear trend day on a Friday with volume that was about 15 times that of a typical day, and the stock lost about 70 percent of its value over the prior two weeks. However, the volume was only about one and a half times that of the day before, and there was only a minimal bull tail. The price action was against the longs since there was no reversal from the break of the bear trend channel. In fact, the huge bear trend bar closed well below the line, confirming the strength of the trend channel line failure to contain the bear. The stock lost another 80 percent when it opened on Monday (Bar 3), but traded slightly less volume. Traders who bought the Friday close, thinking that a climactic bottom was in and that there was no way that the country's fifth-largest investment bank could fall any further, were devastated come Monday. Climactic volume in the absence of bullish price action is no reason to fade a strong bear trend. A television pundit might recommend the purchase, but without supporting price action, it was simply too risky.


这张图与上面那张 LEH 图处在同一时期。不过，LEH 那张图一直没有跌破空头趋势通道线（第3根K线），直到星期一才跌破，并在当天伴随巨量向上反转。而在这张 BSC 图上，巨量日早了一天，它同样跌破了空头趋势通道线，但当天收盘接近低点，没有任何看涨的价格行为。它在第3根K线处跳空低开，和 LEH 一样（两只股票的第3根K线都是星期一），但 LEH 强劲上涨，而 BSC 几乎涨不起来。BSC 的第3根K线仍然是跌破空头趋势通道线之后的一根多头反转K线，但任何在那一天要在 LEH 和 BSC 之间做选择的交易者，显然都会更愿意买 LEH，因为它的多头反转K线非常强。即使交易者在第3根K线上方一个 tick 处买入 BSC，接下来三天他也能赚到超过100%，但 LEH 显然是一笔确定性高得多的多头押注。


> This chart is during the same time as the above LEH chart. However, the LEH chart did not break the bear trend channel line (Bar 3) until Monday, and it reversed up on that day on huge volume. Here, on the BSC chart, the huge volume day was a day earlier, and it also broke below the bear trend channel line, but the day closed near its low with no bullish price action. It gapped down on Bar 3, just like LEH (Bar 3 is the Monday for both stocks), but LEH rallied strongly whereas BSC could barely rally at all. Bar 3 for BSC was still a bull reversal bar following the break of a bear trend channel line, but any trader choosing between buying LEH and BSC on that day would obviously much rather buy LEH because of its very strong bull reversal bar. Even if a trader bought BSC at one tick above Bar 3, he would have made more than 100 percent over the next three days, but LEH was clearly a much more certain bull bet.

# 第 14 章　期权

*Chapter 14. Options*


日内交易者如果不做日线图上的交易，就会赚得更多，因为一旦他无法把全部注意力放在自己的日内交易上，他的总利润就很可能会被拖低。没错，靠期权赚钱很好玩，但你很可能要为这份好玩付出代价，代价就是那些因为你分了心而没能做成的日内交易本该带来的收入。每个月会有一两次，你可能看到一个买入期权的绝佳机会；但如果你是个日内交易者，做期权的频率还高于这个次数，那你大概因为错过日内交易而放弃了太多钱，多到这么做已经不值得。


> Aday trader will make more money if he does not trade off the daily charts because it is likely that his overall profit will be reduced by being unable to give his full attention to his day trades. Yes, it is fun to make money on options, but you will likely pay for that fun with income that you failed to make off day trades because you were distracted. There will be a couple of times a month when you might see a great opportunity for an options purchase, but if you are a day trader who is trading options more often than that, you are probably foregoing too much money on missed day trades to make it worthwhile.


虽然基于价格行为来交易期权有很多种方法，但如果你主要是个日内交易者，白天你就该把自己的思路限制在5分钟 Emini 小型合约图上。不过，在日线图上反向操作大行情时，你可以有节制地使用期权。最省事的做法是主要买入看跌期权（put）或看涨期权（call），有时卖出价差组合，并打算把交易持有一到几天。你可以容许市场对你的持仓创出一个新的不利极值，也可以愿意加仓，因为用这些策略，你的风险是完全已知、也是有上限的。在一个可能的顶部，你也可以干脆做空一小笔股票，但你可能往往会在白天盯它盯得太多，结果错过 Emini 上的日内交易，最终把股票交易的收益全部抵消。


> Although there are many ways to trade options based on price action, if you are primarily a day trader, you want to limit your thoughts to the 5- minute Emini chart during the day. However you can use options sparingly when fading big moves on the daily chart. It is easiest to mostly buy puts or calls and sometimes sell spreads and look to hold the trades for one to several days. You can allow one new extreme against your position, and you can be willing to add on because your risk is exactly known and limited with these strategies. At a possible top, you could also simply sell short a small stock position, but you might tend to watch it too much during the day, and this would cause you to miss day trades in the Eminis and ultimately negate any gains from the stock trade.


还有一种少见的情形，在盘中交易期权可能比交易期货和股票更可取。那就是市场正在巨幅自由落体、并且接近跌停的时候。如果出现一个可靠的反转形态，你可能会觉得此时买入的风险很小，哪怕只是一个小仓位；但即便是在一家声誉良好的经纪商那里，风险也可能相当大。怎么会这样？


> There is one other rare occasion in which intraday options can be preferable to futures and stocks. That is when the market is in a huge freefall and it is close to limit down. If a reliable reversal pattern sets up, you might think that the risk of buying is small, even if a small position, but it can be substantial even with a reputable broker. How can that be?


因为它们的系统可能过载，你的委托可能30分钟甚至更久都得不到处理。如果你刚买在自己以为是底部的位置，随后市场跌穿了你的保护性止损，你的委托可能30分钟内都不会被报告为成交，而且你不知道它什么时候才会成交。在 Emini 上，你很容易亏掉10点。另一个办法是买入看涨期权，这样你的风险就是确定的。


> Because their system can get overloaded and your orders might not get processed for 30 minutes or more. If you just bought what you thought was a bottom and then the market fell through your protective stop, your order might not get reported as filled for 30 minutes and you don't know when it will get filled. You could easily lose 10 points in the Emini. An alternative is to buy calls, so that you will be certain of your risk.


图 14.1中的 Chesapeake Energy 在过去四个月里上涨了85%，但在3月那波急剧抛售之后走出了许多小回调，这就提高了价格从新高处反转的概率。市场向上突破了连接第1根与第3根K线画出的趋势通道线，也突破了连接第3根与第5根K线画出的那条线。从第6根K线起画一条趋势线、并且只用实体的底端来看，多头行情最后六天形成了一个楔形。从第4根K线起有一段强劲上涨，之后又有两次冲向新高。第8根K线是一根小K线，以空头收盘。所有这些都是迹象，说明多头正在失去对市场的控制，而现在价格回调到20日均线（EMA）——就像第2根和第4根K线处那样——的可能性非常高，并且〔译注：原书此处文字被走势图截图碎片覆盖，句子未完〕有相当的机会去测试连接第2根与第4根K线画出的趋势线，甚至可能形成一次主要趋势反转。理想的反向操作，是在第8根K线当天买入看跌期权，或者等到第二天、当市场跌破第8根K线低点时再买，那会形成一个低2，也就是在新高处做空的第二次机会，一笔胜率非常高的交易。你应当买入近月的平值（at-the-money）看跌期权，因为它们的滑点最小（流动性最好），而且不必担心时间衰减，因为快速行情很可能出现。另一种做法是卖出一手平值看涨期权、同时买入高一档行权价的看涨期权，但这太复杂；再说下跌行情应该会很急，所以买入看跌期权提供了最好的风险回报比。到现在为止还没有出现过均线缺口K线回调，而这次抛售很可能会带来一次。随后它就会形成一波上涨行情，去测试第8根K线的高点。


> Chesapeake Energy in Figure 14. 1 rallied 85 percent in the past four months but developed many small pullbacks after the sharp selloff in March, increasing the odds of a reversal from a new high. The market broke above the trend channel line drawn across Bars 1 and 3, and the line drawn across Bars 3 and 5. The final six days of the bull formed a Wedge when looking at a trendline drawn from Bar 6 and using just the bottoms of the bodies. There was a strong move up from Bar 4 followed by two more runs to new highs. Bar 8 was a small bar with a bear close. All of these are signs that the bulls were losing control of the market and there was now a very high likelihood of a pullback to the 20-day EMA, as at Bars 2 and 4, and a reasonable chance of a test of the trendline drawn using Bars 2 and 4, and possibly a major trend reversal. The ideal fade was to buy puts during the day of Bar 8 or wait until the next day when the market traded below the low of Bar 8, forming a Low 2, which is a second-chance short entry at a new high, a very high probability trade. You would buy at-the-money puts in the front month because they would have the least slippage (most liquid) and not worry about time decay since a fast move was likely. An alternative trade would be to sell an at-the-money call and buy the call one strike higher, but this is too complicated, and the down move should be sharp so long puts offered the best risk-reward ratio. There has yet to be an EMA Gap Bar pullback, and this selloff is likely to produce one. It would then setup a rally to test the Bar 8 high.


![图 14.1](figures/fig-14-01.png)


**图 14.1　Chesapeake Energy，日线图**


图 14.2中的 Apple 在不到两年里上涨了300% 以上，随后在两个月里抛售了55%，在这张周线图上一直跌到第6根K线。在第5根K线处的低2买入看跌期权是一笔好交易，因为此前先有一段强劲下跌到第3根K线，跌破了从第1根K线画出的多头趋势线。另外，这个低2的入场K线是对从第3根K线画出的多头趋势线的第二次突破，也是一个两段式的更高的高点（两段行情常常终结一段走势）。跌向第1根和第3根K线的两次抛售都测试了20周均线，而且从第5根K线的高点起至少走出那么大一段修正的可能性很高，因为空头在这轮多头行情中已经两次表现出不错的实力。


> Apple in Figure 14.2 rallied over 300 percent in less than two years and then sold off 55 percent over two months down to Bar 6 on this weekly chart. Buying puts at the Low 2 at Bar 5 was a good trade since there was first a strong move down to Bar 3 that broke below a bull trendline from Bar 1. Also, this Low 2 entry bar was a second break of the bull trendline drawn from Bar 3, and a two-legged Higher High (two legs often end a move). Both the selloffs to Bars 1 and 3 tested the 20-week EMA, and the odds were high for at least that much of a correction off the high at Bar 5 since the bears had already demonstrated good strength twice before in this bull.


![图 14.2](figures/fig-14-02.png)


**图 14.2　AAPL，周线图**


第7根K线是一根均线缺口K线（EMA Gap 2 Bar），是第二次尝试上涨、去回补20周均线下方那个缺口。它还与第1根K线构成一个双底牛旗。最低目标是一次对均线的快速测试。结果这波上涨行情太强，更有可能继续向上回撤，出现第二段上涨的可能性也同样大。由于从第5根K线高点的这波下跌太强，在 AAPL 超过第5根K线高点之前，市场至少会尝试一次测试第6根K线低点，这个可能性很高。一个大型交易区间正在形成，但顶部可能已经到了。一旦出现信号K线，买入看跌期权就会是一笔合理的交易。


> Bar 7 was an EMA Gap 2 Bar, a second attempt to rally to close the gap below the 20-week EMA. It is also a Double Bottom Bull Flag with Bar l. A minimum target is a rapid test of the moving average. Instead, the rally was so strong that more retracement up was likely, as was a second leg up. Since the move down from the high at Bar 5 was so strong, the odds are high that there will be at least an attempt to test the lows of Bar 6 before AAPL exceeds the Bar 5 high. A large trading range is forming, but the top might be in. Once there is a signal bar, a put purchase would be a reasonable trade.


当行情这样剧烈时，市场就更难预测，风险也更大。想把风险限定住，一个好办法就是买入期权。


> When the moves are this violent, the market is less predictable, and risk is greater. A good way to have a defined risk is to buy options.


图 14.3中的 ANR 在日线图（小图）上处于一轮强多头行情，四天前向上突破了楔形的顶部。昨天它向上跳空，越过另一条趋势通道线，也越过了100——一个在心理上很重要的数字，因此是一个磁力位。5分钟图一开始下跌，一次对100的测试就很可能会发生。7月到期的100看跌期权本来可以以7.20的价格买入；合理的保护性出场，是在开盘时市场成交到交易区间顶部上方时离场，在那些看跌期权上大概冒着1美元左右的风险。到第2根K线时，这些看跌期权已经值8.80。这第一次停顿是分批止盈的绝佳位置，因为价格在测试到均线下方、也测试到100下方之后，有可能开盘反转、重新向上。不过，开盘后的这波下跌太强，很可能至少要走出两段下跌。如果交易者把止损移到7.30附近，这个止损永远不会被打掉，而到收盘时这些看跌期权已经值10.00以上。在日线图上，这一天变成了一根外包下跌K线。在强多头行情里，第二天通常没有多少后续行情（这里是一根小十字星日），因为那根大实体外包下跌K线很可能是一小段交易区间的起点。不过，近期很可能会测试不断上行的日线均线。当日内交易者靠期权赚到一笔意外之财时，最好平掉仓位，然后明天再去找其他机会。这个仓位大概已经赚不到什么了，把它留到第二天只会干扰日内交易。


> ANR in Figure 14.3 was in a strong bull on the daily chart (insert) and broke out of the top of a Wedge four days ago. Yesterday, it gapped above another trend channel line and above 100, a psychologically important number and therefore a magnet. As soon as the 5-minute chart started to come down, a test of 100 was likely. The July 100 puts could have been bought for 7.20, and a reasonable protective exit would be a trade above the top of the trading range at the open, risking maybe a dollar or so on the puts. At Bar 2, those puts were 8.80. This first pause was a great place to take partial profits because there could be an opening reversal back up after testing below the EMA and below 100. However, the move down off the open was so strong that there would likely be at least two legs down. If a trader moved his stop to around 7.30, it would never have been hit, and the puts were worth over 10.00 by the close. On the daily chart, the day turned into an outside down day. In strong bulls, there is usually not much follow-through on the next day (here, there was a small doji day), because the large outside down bar will likely be the start of a small trading range. However, a test of the rising daily EMA is likely in the near term. When a day trader makes windfall profits off options, it is best to close the position and then look for other opportunities tomorrow. There was likely little left to be gained from this position, and holding it into the next day would be a distraction from day trading.

在图 14.4中，当今天向下跳空、低于昨天的低点、也低于一条趋势通道线，然后以一次开盘反转向上反转时，交易者可以以5.70买入7月到期的170看涨期权；当时市场的成交量非常好，你可以在那个价位买50张合约，而买卖价差只有10美分（相当窄）。这就是交易大成交量股票的一个优势。你本可以在第5根K线测试第3根K线高点时，用限价单以9.20卖出一半。你本可以在第6根K线的双顶与更低的高点处，以同样的价格把剩下的一半卖掉。每张看涨期权赚150美元（不含手续费）。最初的买入价5.70是每张看涨期权570美元。由于这是一次极佳的入场，你本可以为每张看涨期权承担约200美元的风险（对应期权价格3.70），而且如果出现第二次做多入场，还能在回撤100美元时把仓位翻倍。既然第一次入场效果很好，这一步就没有必要了。


> In Figure 14.4, when today gapped below yesterday's low and below a trend channel line and reversed up in an Opening Reversal, a trader could buy July 170 calls for 5.70, and the market's volume was so good that you could buy 50 at that price, and the bid ask spread was a dime (fairly tight). That is an advantage of trading stocks with large volumes. You could have sold half at the Bar 5 test of the Bar 3 high for 9.20 on a limit order. You could have sold the balance on the Bar 6 Double Top and Lower High for the same price. That is a profit of $150 per call (less commissions). The initial purchase price of 5.70 was $570 per call. Since this is a great entry, you could risk about $200 per call (call price of 3.70) and double up on a $100 drawdown if there was a second long entry. This was not necessary since the first entry worked well.

# 第 15 章　最佳交易

*Chapter 15. Best Trades*


本章里的所有交易此前都已讨论过，这里再收录一些例子供复习。这些建仓形态每天都会有一个或多个出现在5分钟 Emini 图上，也出现在几乎每一个市场的5分钟图上。如果交易者有耐心，为一个形态的形成等上可能几个小时，并且把自己限制在只做本章里的这些交易，他会是一个非常成功的交易者。不过，学会把自己限制在最好的那些交易上，也许是交易中最难的部分。如果你目前还没赚到钱，这件事值得你认真考虑去试一试。赚钱的一个重要组成部分，是避开坏交易，它们无一例外会抹掉远多于你从好交易里赚到的东西。在你成为一个熟练、能盈利的交易者之前，最需要避开的那一笔交易就是铁丝网（Barb Wire），尤其是当它位于当日波动范围的中部、靠近 EMA 又处在 EMA 的错误一侧，而当天又并不是一个清晰而强烈的趋势日时。


> All of the trades in this chapter have already been discussed, and additional examples are included here for review. One or more of these setups occurs every day on the 5-minute Emini chart and on the 5- minute chart of just about every market. If a trader had the patience to wait possibly hours for one to develop and he restricted himself to only the trades in this chapter, he would be a very successful trader. However, learning to restrict yourself to the very best trades is perhaps the most difficult part of trading. If you are not making money yet, it is something that you seriously need to consider trying. One important component to making money is avoiding bad trades that invariably erase much more than what you Will have earned from your good trades. The single most important trade to avoid until you are a skilled, profitable trader is Barb Wire, especially when it is in the middle of the day's range, near the EMA and on the wrong side of the EMA, and the day is not a clear and strong trend day.


我们不妨从全书的第一张图看起，那张 AAPL 日线图上有好几个极好的入场，它们全都属于本章。本章会画出趋势线，让其中一些交易更容易看见、更容易理解。


> Let's start by going back to the very first chart in the book, where there were a number of excellent entries on the daily chart of AAPL, all of which belong in this chapter. This chapter shows trendlines to make some of the trades easier to see and understand.


图 15.1中的第1根K线是一次两段式回调（旗形、三角形、窄幅交易区间），回调到 EMA，带有高2买入信号。它是跌破一条陡峭趋势线之后的第一次回调。


> Bar 1 in Figure 15. 1 was a two-legged pullback (flag, triangle, Tight Trading Range) to the EMA with a High 2 buy signal. It was the First Pullback after breaking a steep trendline.


第2根K线是一笔楔形做空，也是一个小型扩张三角形。它出现在第1根K线处趋势线被跌破之后，所以是一笔可以接受的逆势入场；而在楔形之后，应该走出两段下跌（事实也确实如此）。


> Bar 2 was a Wedge short and also a small Expanding Triangle. It followed the Bar 1 break of a trendline and so was an acceptable Countertrend entry, and after a Wedge, it should have two legs down (and it did).


![图 15.1](figures/fig-15-01.png)


**图 15.1　AAPL 日线图，截至2008年6月10日**


第3根K线（编号标在这根K线上方很远）是一次 M2S（均线、二次入场、卖出），也是一次从楔形急速下跌之后的双顶熊旗，所以很可能走出第二段下跌；它与第1根K线还构成一个双底牛旗。


> Bar 3 (the number is well above the bar) was an M2S and a Double Top Bear Flag after a sharp down move from a Wedge, so a second leg down was likely, and a Double Bottom Bull Flag with Bar 1.


第4根K线是一个楔形，也是一笔均线缺口2做多，它在向下测试第1根K线旗形下方之后反转向上。


> Bar 4 was a Wedge and a Gap 2 long that reversed up after testing below the Bar 1 flag.


第5根K线是一笔高2做多的突破回测（回测的是对第2根K线上方的突破）。第6根K线是第4根K线处那条大型趋势线被跌破之后的一笔楔形做空。它通常会穿过 EMA，并且很可能走出两段。不过，这段下跌是高潮式的，它向下的幅度也算合理，但只用一段就走完了。


> Bar 5 was a High 2 long Breakout Test (of the breakout above Bar 2). Bar 6 was a Wedge short after the large trendline break at Bar 4. It normally would go through the EMA and likely have two legs. However, the down move was climactic, and it covered a reasonable distance down but did so in just one leg.


第7根K线是一笔均线缺口2做多，也是（与第5根K线构成的）双底牛旗，还是对第2根K线那次突破的第二次测试。它还在下探到第5根K线急速行情下方之后反转向上。虽然预期会有两段下跌，但这个建仓形态值得做一笔可交易的做多，计划是在市场测试第6根K线高点时找机会做空。


> Bar 7 was a Gap 2 long and a Double Bottom Bull Flag (with Bar 5) and a second test of the Bar 2 breakout. It also reversed up from dipping below the Bar 5 spike. Although two legs down are to be expected, this setup made a tradable long worthwhile, with the plan to look to short a test of the Bar 6 high.


第8根K线是一次小幅的两段式回落，此前有一个楔形（这条线没有画出来，但从第7根K线起的这波上涨行情是三次向上推进），它测试了第6根K线的高点；但在从第7根K线起出现这样一波大涨之后，更可能出现的是一次两段式的向上测试，去测试第6根K线的高点。第8根K线是跌破一条陡峭趋势线之后的第一次回调，也是一笔在 EMA 处反转的做多。这个位置很难做，正如在主要反转之前常常出现的那样。这种忽上忽下的走势反映了多空双方的情绪，而其中一方很快就会胜出。当一条大型趋势线被跌破（跌向第7根K线）之后出现一段忽上忽下的上涨行情时，空头的理由明显更强。


> Bar 8 was a small two-legged drop following a Wedge (the line is not drawn, but the rally up from Bar 7 had Three Pushes Up) test of the Bar 6 high, but a two-legged test up of the Bar 6 high was more likely after such a big rally up from Bar 7. Bar 8 was the First Pullback through a steep trendline and a EMA reversal long. This was tricky in here as is often the case just before a major reversal. The choppy movement is a reflection of the emotion on both sides, and one side will soon win out. The bearish case is clearly stronger when there is a choppy rally after a major trendline break (down to Bar 7).


第9根K线是一次两段式测试，测试第6根K线的高点，形成了更高的高点。它同时还发生在跌向第7根K线的那条趋势线被强势跌破之后，以及跌向第8根K线的那条更小趋势线被跌破之后。很可能至少会出现两段下跌。最后，它是一次向上突破楔形的失败，因此是一次二次入场。那个楔形向下跌破，在第8根K线处失败；随后它又向上突破，在第9根K线处朝相反方向失败。


> Bar 9 was a two-legged test of the Bar 6 high, forming a Higher High. It also followed the strong break of the trendline down to Bar 7 and the break of a smaller trendline down to Bar 8. At least two legs down are likely. Finally, it was a failed breakout above a Wedge, and therefore a second entry. The Wedge broke to the downside and failed at Bar 8. It then broke to the upside and failed at Bat 9 in the opposite direction.


第10根K线是一次 M2S 做空，出现在急速的第一段下跌之后。它也是一次突破回调，跟在跌破第8根K线、并跌破 EMA 之后。


> Bar 10 is an M2S short after a sharp first leg down. It is also a Breakout Pullback after breaking below Bar 8 and below the EMA.


第11根K线是一次双底回调（在这个例子里，是一个形态漂亮的头肩底），在趋势线突破之后形成一个更高的低点上的高2入场。它还在跌破第4根K线之前就反转向上，所以这是一个更高的低点，给了多头信心。最后，它是一次双底牛旗（与第4根K线构成），也是三次向下推进之后的一次突破回调，因此它至少还应该会有第二段上涨。


> Bar 11 is a Double Bottom Pullback (in this case, a good-looking Head and Shoulders Bottom), forming a High 2 entry in a Higher Low after a trendline break. It also reversed up before falling below Bar 4, so it is a Higher Low, giving confidence to the bull. Finally, it was a Double Bottom Bull Flag (with Bar 4) and a Breakout Pullback after Three Pushes Down, and it should therefore have at least a second leg up.


第12根K线是一笔 M2B（均线、二次入场、买入）做多，出现在陡峭趋势线被跌破之后的第一次回调处；它也是一次突破回调，跟在向上突破1月缺口之后。


> Bar 12 is an M2B long on the First Pullback after a steep trendline break, and it is a Breakout Pullback after breaking above the January gap.


第13根K线是一次小幅的两段式修正，也是一次失败的低2，因此实际上相当于一笔高2做多（两次向下的失败尝试，等同于一次向上的第二次尝试）。


> Bar 13 was a small two-legged correction and a failed Low 2, and therefore effectively a High 2 long (two failed attempts down is the same as a second attempt up).


第14根K线是一次楔形回调，测试 EMA，也是跌破一条陡峭趋势线之后的第一次回调。市场已接近第9根K线的高点，也许正处在一个新空头里第一次大回调（更低的高点）的顶部。不过，它也可能只是在测试一个大交易区间的顶部，或者是在奔向前高的途中的一次停顿。在跌向第11根K线的那次急速抛售之后，加上当前这波上涨行情相对偏弱，后一种情形最不可能。


> Bar 14 is a Wedge pullback test of the EMA and the First Pullback after breaking a steep trendline. The market is close to the Bar 9 high and maybe the top of the first big pullback (Lower High) in a new bear. However, it could also be just testing the top of a big trading range, or a pause en route to a new high. This latter scenario is the least likely after such a sharp selloff down to Bar 11 and the relatively weaker current rally.


记住，从第4根K线起的上升通道是一个回调目标，这个回调出现在第11根K线处，构成了那个双底牛旗。通道通常会导致一段交易区间，所以这波上涨行情很可能会在第9根K线高点一带失败，随后跟着另一段下跌。最终，市场会朝某一个方向突破出去。


> Remember that the channel up from Bar 4 was a target for a pullback, which occurred at Bar 11, forming the Double Bottom Bull Flag. A channel usually leads to a trading range so the rally up will likely fail in the area of the Bar 9 high and be followed by another move down. Eventually the market will break out in one direction or the other.


任何交易者尝试一种新方法时，第一件事都应该是把他打算交易的时间级别和市场的好几周图表打印出来，看看自己的建仓形态是否看起来有效。开始交易时，不管账户有多大，他都不该交易超过两张合约。只有在连续几周稳定盈利之后，他才应该开始增加仓位规模。不过，大多数交易者要花很多年才能做到稳定盈利。


> The first thing that any trader should do when trying a new approach is print out weeks of charts of the time frame and market he plans to trade and see if his setups appear to be valid. When he begins to trade, he should not trade more than two contracts, no matter how large his account is. Only after consistently making a profit for several weeks should he begin to increase his position size. However, most traders take many years to become consistently profitable.


交易中最难的部分，是判断一个建仓形态是否足够好、值得下一笔单。在实时行情里做这个判断尤其难：你总是觉得还需要再等一根K线才能确定，可那根K线一旦形成，最好的入场已经错过了。要看一眼图表就立刻看出正在发生什么，需要很多年的练习，而且即便到了那时，也从来没有任何事情是十足清楚的。不过，有些东西比另一些更容易辨认，新手明智的做法是只专注两三种容易预判的建仓形态。幸运的是，容易识别而成功概率又极高的建仓形态有很多。


> The most difficult part of trading is deciding whether a setup is good enough to warrant placing a trade. It is especially difficult to do real time when you always feel like you need one more bar to be sure, but once that bar forms, you've missed the best entry. It takes many years of practice to be able to look at a chart and instantly see what is happening, and even then nothing is ever perfectly clear. However, some things are easier to recognize than others, and a beginner is wise to focus on just a couple of setups that are easy to anticipate. Fortunately, there are many setups that are easy to spot and have excellent odds for success.


如果图形从左下角附近起步、走到右上角附近，而且中间没有任何一段空头行情段跌破屏幕的中点，或者图上出现了很多个波段、其中大量是多头趋势K线、而回调都很小，那么每一个信号K线触及或刺入 EMA 的高2，你都该买入。一旦做多、并且入场K线已经收盘，就把止损从信号K线下方一个 tick 移到入场K线下方一个 tick。先剥头皮止盈一半（这一比例可以随经验调整），然后把止损移到保本，或者也许挂到差一两个 tick 的位置。之后每出现一个新机会就加仓。大多数市场处在强趋势里的时间也许只有20% 或更少。


> If the chart starts near the lower left-hand comer and is near the upper right-hand comer and there have not been any bear legs that have dropped below the midpoint of the screen, or if there has been a number of swings with lots of bull trend bars and only small pullbacks, you should buy every High 2 where the setup bar touches or penetrates the EMA. Once long and once the entry bar closes, move your stop from one tick below the signal bar to one tick below the entry bar. Scalp out half (you can adjust this with experience), and then move your stop to breakeven or maybe a tick or two worse. Add on at every new opportunity. Most markets are in a strong trend maybe 20 percent of the time or less.


当市场没有明确趋势时，就去找新的摆动高点和新摆动低点处的二次入场做反向操作。这类交易日会出现好几个波段，每个持续5到10根或更多K线，随后趋势线被跌破，引出一段反向的波段。如果走向突破那一段行情的动能很强，就等二次入场，它通常会在五根K线左右之内出现。


> When the market is not clearly trending, look to fade second entries at new swing highs and lows. These days will have several swings lasting 5 to 10 or more bars, and then the trendline breaks, leading to an opposite swing. If the momentum on the move to the breakout is strong, wait for a second entry, which usually comes within five bars or so.


一旦你每天在 Emini 上稳定净赚两个点，或者在 AAPL 或某只其它主要股票上稳定净赚50美分到1美元，你就该专注于提高交易量，而不是不断增加大量新形态。这些才是最好的建仓形态；如果你交易25张 Emini 合约、每天净赚两个点，一年就能赚500,000美元。如果你交易100张合约、净赚四个点，一年就能赚5,000,000美元。像 AAPL、GS、RIMM 和 SKF 这样的许多股票，大多数时候都能承受3,000股或更多的股数而不出现明显的滑点。如果你在仅仅一只股票上、用3,000股平均每天赚50美分，一年大约就是300,000美元。


> Once you are consistently netting a couple points every day in the Emini or 50 cents or a dollar in AAPL or some other major stock, you should focus on increasing your volume rather than adding lots of new setups. These are the very best setups, and if you trade 25 Emini contracts and net just two points a day, you will make $500,000 a year. If you trade 100 contracts and net four points, you will make $5 million a year. Many stocks like AAPL, GS, RIMM, and SKF can handle 3,000 or more shares without significant slippage most of the time. If you average 50 cents a day on 3,000 shares of just one stock, that is about $300,000 a year.


取得一些成功后变得自信是很自然的，而且大多数交易者会开始在自己的武器库里增加更多建仓形态。另外，当他们看到眼前有大量能赚钱的剥头皮机会在不断展开时，他们讨厌为了等最好的建仓形态而干坐一两个小时。最糟糕透顶的做法，就是开始交易铁丝网。这些交易区间通常出现在盘中，就在你已经为找入场盯了一两个小时之后。它们通常位于区间的中部、靠近 EMA，而且看上去总是那么简单。不过，它们会伤害你的账户和你的心理。遗憾的是，大多数交易者觉得自己能看懂它们，于是就去交易，然后在月底纳闷自己怎么会亏掉几千美元。


> It is natural to get confident after some success, and most traders will start looking to add more setups to their arsenal. Also, they hate sitting for an hour or two while waiting for the best setups when they see lots of profitable scalps unfolding in front of them. The absolute worst thing to do is to start trading Barb Wire. These trading ranges typically occur in the middle of the day after you have been watching for an entry for a couple hours. They are usually in the middle of the range near the EMA, and they always look so simple. However, they will damage your account and your psyche. Unfortunately, most traders think that they can figure them out, and they trade them and wonder at the end of the month why they are down a couple of thousand dollars.


另一个常见的错误是去看1分钟图。一天结束时回头看，那些交易极其容易辨认，但大多数在实时行情里很难交易。如果你的目标是赚钱——这也应该是你的目标——那就只做最好的那些交易，避开铁丝网和1分钟图。反过来说，如果这只是你的一项刺激爱好，那就记住：爱好是要花钱的，说不定外面还有另一项爱好对你有同样的乐趣、却便宜得多。


> Another common mistake is to look at 1-minute charts. The trades are very easy to spot at the end of the day, but most are hard to trade real time. If your goal is to make money, and that should be your goal, only take the best trades, and avoid Barb Wire and 1-minute charts. If on the other hand this is just an exciting hobby for you, remember that hobbies cost money, and there may be another one out there for you that is just as much fun and much less expensive.


最好的反转形态之一是：一条趋势线带着强劲动能被跌破，随后出现一次两段式测试，并创出新的极值。走向这个新极值（更高的高点或更低的低点）的两段行情，实际上就是两次重建旧趋势的尝试——尽管趋势线已被强势跌破——而第二次尝试的失败，有很大概率引出一次强劲反转，这次反转应该至少有两段，而且常常会带来一段新的、方向相反的趋势。


> One of the best reversal patterns is a trendline break with strong momentum followed by a two-legged test that results in a new extreme. The two legs to the new extreme (a Higher High or Lower Low) are effectively two attempts to reestablish the old trend, despite the strong trendline break, and that failed second attempt has a high probability of leading to a strong reversal that should have at least two legs and often results in a new, opposite trend.


最后，在头一个小时左右交易个股，是交易中最容易赚钱的方式之一。把注意力放在昨日形态带来的突破失败和突破回调上。如果出现一根强劲的反转K线，就做第一次入场。如果有三根或更多大量重叠的K线，就等二次入场。当你有大约50美分到1美元的利润之后，把保护性止损移到保本。在1美元利润处止盈一半到三分之一，也许在2美元处再止盈四分之一。不过，始终要留至少四分之一的仓位继续跑，止损挂在保本处，或者一直持有到出现清晰而强烈的反向信号，因为趋势持续的距离，远比你认为可能的要长得多。


> Finally, trading stocks in the first hour or so is one of easiest ways to make money trading. Focus on Failed Breakouts and Breakout Pullbacks from patterns from yesterday. If there is a strong reversal bar, take the first entry. If there are three or more largely overlapping bars, wait for a second entry. After you have about 50 cents to 1 dollar profit, move the protective stop to breakeven. Take one-half to one-third off at one dollar profit and maybe take another quarter off at two dollars. However, always let at least a quarter of your position run with a breakeven stop or until there is a clear and strong opposite signal because trends last much further than you would ever think possible.


### 主要趋势反转


> MAJOR REVERSALS


主要反转所反转的，是一段已经持续了至少几个小时、而且常常持续了好几天的趋势。最好的趋势反转入场，在建仓形态之前都有一条重要趋势线被跌破，因为除非逆势交易者已经显示出某种控制市场的能力，否则你不想逆势入场。要在一次测试趋势极值的回调中入场。这次回调可以未及旧趋势极值（新空头里的更高的低点，或新多头里的更低的低点），也可以过靶（新空头里的更高的高点，或新多头里的更低的低点）；但如果过靶远远越过旧极值，趋势就已经恢复，你应该重新等一次新的趋势线突破。


> Major reversals reverse a trend that has been in effect for at least a couple of hours and often for several days. The best trend reversal entries have a break of a significant trendline before the setup, because you do not want to enter countertrend unless the countertrend traders have already shown some ability to control the market. Enter on a pullback that tests the trend extreme. The pullback can undershoot (a Lower High in a new bear or a Higher Low in a new bull) or overshoot (a Higher High in a new bear or a Lower Low in a new bull) the old trend extreme, but if an overshoot goes much beyond the old extreme, the trend has resumed, and you should wait again for a new trendline break.


趋势线突破之后的更低的低点（第9根K线）。图 15.2中的 GOOG 向下跳空，测试了这个缺口和陡峭的 EMA，然后向新低突破。第1根K线是一笔不错的做空（均线附近的一次低2缺口测试），但在向新低突破之后趋势更加确定，证据就是那两根带小影线的大实体空头趋势K线。最佳交易是第2根和第3根K线处的低2（M2S）入场。


> Lower Low (Bar 9) after a Trendline Break. GOOG gapped down in Figure 15.2, tested the gap and the steep EMA, and broke to a new low. Bar 1 was a good short (a Low 2 gap test near the EMA), but the trend was more certain after the breakout to a new low, as evidenced by the two large bear trend bars with small tails. The best trades were the Low 2 (M2S) entries at Bars 2 and 3.


第4根K线是反转那个楔形（空头趋势通道线）的第二次尝试，所以很可能引出两段上涨，事实也确实如此。信号K线是一根十字星，而十字星就是一根K线构成的交易区间，一般来说，在熊市交易区间的顶部买入并不明智但这是一次三次推进形态里的二次入场，同时也是一次最终旗形失败的反转——反转的是此前两根小实体K线，它们几乎构成了一个 ii形态（内包内包）。


> Bar 4 was a second attempt at reversing the Wedge (the bear trend channel line), so it was likely to result in two up legs and did. The signal bar was a doji, which is a one-bar trading range, and in general it is unwise to buy at the top of a bear trading range, but this was the second entry in a Three Push pattern and also a Failed Final Flag reversal (of the two prior small-bodied bars, which almost formed an ii).


![图 15.2](figures/fig-15-02.png)


**图 15.2　GOOG 5分钟图**


第5根K线勉强突破了一条从第1根和第3根K线画出的趋势线，但第7根K线的向上动能明显很强，它突破了那条趋势线，也突破了 EMA，让交易者准备好在一个测试第4根K线低点的位置做多。第7根K线是一笔可以接受的均线缺口做空，也是与第3根K线构成的双顶熊旗，还是空头里的两段上涨。记住，跌破趋势线不会把趋势变成多头。在市场测试完那个低点之前，它仍然是空头，所以你还是应该去找做空。


> Bar 5 barely broke a trendline from Bars 1 and 3, but Bar 7 clearly had strong momentum up, breaking the trendline and the EMA, making traders get ready for a long entry on a test of the Bar 4 low. Bar 7 was an acceptable EMA Gap short, a Double Top Bear Flag with Bar 3, and two legs up in a bear. Remember, breaking the trendline does not tum the trend into a bull. It is still a bear until after the market tests the low so you should still be looking for shorts.


第8根K线反转了当日低点，但跌向第8根K线的这波下跌很强，这就要求出现一次强反转，比如一根强劲的反转K线或一次二次入场。第8根K线是一根多头外包K线，当明显有交易者被套住时，它可以作为一个入场。当情况并不明显时，最好等待更多价格行为。


> Bar 8 reversed the low of the day, but the move down to Bar 8 was strong, which would require a strong reversal like a strong reversal bar or a second entry. Bar 8 was a bull outside bar, which can be an entry when there are clearly trapped traders. When it is not clear, it is better to wait for more price action.


第9根K线是反转那次向新低突破的第二次尝试，是对预期中两段上涨行情的一笔极好入场，也是当天最好的做多建仓形态，在向上到第7根K线的那次强势趋势线突破之后，它很容易被预判到。


> Bar 9 was a second attempt to reverse the breakout to the new low and was a great entry for an expected two-legged move up, and was the best long setup of the day and easily anticipated after the strong trendline break up to Bar 7.


第10根K线在第9根K线做多的信号K线上方八美分处反转向上（对一只500美元的股票来说，八美分很小），是一笔极好的突破回测、微型趋势线做多，也是一个更高的低点，让交易者可以在它的高点上方加仓。它还把多头关在了场外，这些多头现在会去追高。你始终要留意，去买入一次可能的、主要级别的更低的低点之后的第一个更高的低点。


> Bar 10 reversed back up at eight cents (eight cents is tiny for a $500 stock) above the signal bar for the Bar 9 long and was an excellent Breakout Test, Micro Trendline long, and Higher Low, allowing traders to add on above its high. It also trapped longs out, and they will now chase the market higher. You always need to be looking to buy that first Higher Low after a possible major Lower Low.


趋势线突破之后的更低的低点（图 15.3中的第13根K线），随后是更大一条趋势线突破之后的更高的低点（第17根K线）（那条趋势线未画出，但它横跨第1根和第11根K线的高点）。房屋建筑商 SPDR 正处在一段漫长的空头里。多头力量的第一迹象，是市场在第10根K线低点处从空头趋势通道线过靶中反弹。


> Lower Low (Bar 13 in Figure 15.3) after a trendline break and then a Higher Low (Bar 1 7) after a bigger trendline break (not shown but across the highs of Bars 1 and 1 1). The Homebuilders SPDR was in a protracted bear. The first sign of bullish strength were the rebound from bear trend channel line overshoots at the Bar 10 low.


第11根K线突破了一条主要的空头趋势线（这条趋势线也可以从第2、3或5根K线起画，几种画法都差不多），并且跳空到 EMA 上方。此时，交易者会开始准备在测试第10根K线低点时做多，不管那次测试是以更高的低点的形式、还是以更低的低点的形式出现；但在那之前，趋势仍然是向下的。


> Bar 1 1 broke a major bear trendline (the trendline could also be started at Bars 2, 3, or 5, and all would be similar) and gapped above the EMA. At this point, traders would begin looking to go long on a test of the Bar 10 low either in the form of a Higher Low or a Lower Low, but the trend is still down until then.


第13根K线形成了一个两段式的更低的低点，趋势常常就是这样结束的。第12根K线是第一次入场（它只比前一根K线高出七美分，在这张图上几乎看不出来），但向下的动能仍然很强，让大多数交易者在买入前等待更多价格行为。


> Bar 13 formed a two-legged Lower Low, which is often how trends end. Bar 12 was the first entry (it only went seven cents above the prior bar and is barely noticeable on this chart), but the down momentum was still strong, making most traders wait for more price action before buying.


两根K线之后，第13根K线在市场从第10根K线下方那个新低反转时，给出了第二次做多入场；而从第11根K线那波急冲算起，到这里正好是两段下跌。对于至少一段两段式上涨行情来说，这是一个完美的建仓形态。


> Two bars later, Bar 13 set up the second long entry on the reversal from the new low below Bar 10, and it was two legs down from the Bar 11 surge. This is a perfect setup for at least a two-legged rally.


第14根K线是一波非常强劲上涨行情的顶部，因此不太可能是这波上涨的终点。市场在跌破这波上涨行情的起点之前，先去测试第14根K线、并且很可能超越它的概率非常高（也就是第13根K线的低点，如果它再次回到那里）。


> Bar 14 was the top of a very strong rally and therefore unlikely to be the end of the move up. The odds were very high that the market would test Bar 14 and likely surpass it before falling below the start of the rally (the Bar 13 low, if it ever gets there again).


第15根K线是一次两段式回调，但不是强买入建仓形态，因为第14根K线是一次小幅的多头趋势通道线过靶（依据此前五根K线的高点），它很可能带来一波更大、在比例上更相称的抛售。


> Bar 15 was a two-legged pullback but not a strong buy setup because Bar 14 was a small bull trend channel overshoot (based on the highs of the prior five bars) and would be likely to have a bigger, more proportional selloff.

第17根K线是第二段下跌，带有高2买入建仓形态，也是一次对开启那波上涨行情的突破的测试。它还略微越过了斐波那契62% 的回撤位，但交易时不要去看斐波那契数字，因为它们很少比直接用眼睛估一个可以接受的回撤位置更好。它是一次回调到更高的低点的两段式回调，而那个更高的低点出现在一个更低的低点之后，因此可能是一段主要多头行情的起点。

It also went a little past a Fibonacci 62 percent retracement, but don't look at Fibonacci numbers when you trade because they are rarely any better than just an eyeball estimate of an acceptable level of retracement. It is a two-legged pullback to a Higher Low after a Lower Low and therefore a possible start of a major bull run.


第18根K线实现了创出高于第14根K线的高点这个目标，交易者显然在止盈。

Because of the strength through the trendline and EMA, traders will look to short a test of the high, especially a second entry, whether it forms a Higher High or a Lower High_ The rally to Bar 6 was strong, but there was no clear second entry on this test of the high.

第7根K线突破了一条更小的多头趋势线，说明空头力量进一步增强；随后在涨到第10根K线的那波上涨行情中，市场再次测试了第3根和第4根K线的高点。

第10根K线是从第7根K线起那波急速上涨行情的三次向上推进，而这始终必须被看作楔形反转形态的一种。第10根K线还与第6根K线构成了一个大致成立的双顶熊旗，也是对第3根和第4根K线高点的第二次测试。交易者能指望找到的二次入场做空，最好也就到这个程度了：在一条主要趋势线被跌破（跌到第5根K线）之后，一波两段式上涨行情去测试趋势高点（第4根K线），其中包含一个小楔形，由此构成的双顶熊旗——而这一切出现的时机，正是交易者在寻找一个能让他们以有限风险做空的建仓形态的时候。在主要反转之后，务必让一部分仓位做波段，哪怕你被止损打掉一两次，因为一次波段入场的盈利通常都会超过许多次剥头皮。


> Bar 10 was Three Pushes Up from a sharp rally off Bar 7, and this always has to be considered a form of a Wedge reversal pattern. This is as good a second entry short that a trader could hope to find: a Double Top Bear Flag made of a small Wedge in a two-legged rally to test the trend high (Bar 4) after a major trendline break (to Bar 5), all occurring at a time when traders were looking for a setup to allow them to go short with limited risk Always make sure to swing part of your position after a major reversal, even if you get stopped out once or twice, because a single swing entry will usually make more money than many scalps.

第9根K线是一个完美的例子，说明为什么跌破空头趋势线并不会把市场变成多头。它是一次漂亮的空头反转，一个双顶熊旗，两段上涨，还是空头里对铁丝网向上突破的失败，这些共同构成了一个很好的做空建仓形态。尽管第9根K线是一根十字星，它仍然是一根好的信号K线，因为它在趋势方向上给出入场，而且有好几个有利因素让这笔交易的成功概率极佳。


> Bar 9 is a perfect example of why the break of the bear trendline does not tum the market into a bull. It was a nice bear reversal, a Double Top Bear Flag, two legs up, and a failed upside breakout of Barb Wire in a bear, all setting up a good short trade. Even though Bar 9 was a doji, it is still a good signal bar since it is setting up an entry in the direction of the trend and there were several favorable factors that gave the trade an excellent chance of success.


趋势线突破之后的更高的高点（图 15.7中的第7根K线）。它也是在一个大型扩张三角形顶部（第1、2、3、4和第7根K线）上的一笔做空入场。

第7根K线是一笔最终旗形失败做空，出现在跌向第6根K线的趋势线突破之后。由于这个扩张三角形顶部用了10个月才形成，交易者应该预期多头不会很快放弃。不过，如果要出现一波主要下跌，第7根K线的高点就应该守住，而那里也正是初始保护性止损该放的位置。


> Bar 7 was a Failed Final Flag short after the trendline break down to Bar 6. Since the Expanding Triangle Top formed over 10 months, traders should expect that the bulls would not give up quickly. However, the Bar 7 high should hold if a major move down was to ensue, and that is where the initial protective stop belongs.


第8根K线是跌破第6根K线的那次急速抛售之后的一个更低的高点，也是一个把最后一批多头套住的绝佳建仓形态。它是对那笔做空的完美突破回测那笔做空位于第7根K线下方。在任何可能是主要反转的更高的高点之后，你始终必须准备去做空第一个更低的高点。


> Bar 8 was a Lower High after the sharp selloff below Bar 6 and a great setup to trap the final bulls. It was a perfect Breakout Test of the short below Bar 7. You always must look to short the first Lower High after a Higher High that could be a major reversal.
