急速与通道趋势中被跌破的通道，常常会修正到通道起点附近（这里是第10根K线），此时市场试图构筑一个新的区间，让下一步行情从这个区间突破出去（朝任何一个方向都可以）。


> A broken channel in a Spike and Channel trend often corrects to near the start of the channel (here, Bar 10) as the market attempts to create a new range from which the next move will break out (in either direction).


多完美的一天！看图 15.11右边那张5分钟图，它的形状对一次更高的低点空头趋势反转来说并不出奇，但如果你看右边的价格刻度，你会看到有些K线超过30个点高，而平常一天K线的平均区间大约只有2个点。这是2008年奥巴马崩盘那一周道指跌掉20% 之后，市场试图至少做出一个临时底部的动作。市场暴跌是因为害怕奥巴马的政策，不是次贷乱局，但这对交易来说无关紧要。一年多以来已经很清楚了：2008年市场应该会跌破10,000，因为它看起来可能已经进入了一个持续多年的交易区间。可能已经出现了一个重要顶部，而这轮抛售可能把价格带到低得多的地方，但交易区间是更常见、也因此更有可能的结果。全世界都在担心奥巴马的政策会因增加监管和成本而伤害企业，也在担心自由世界会不再有一个经济领袖，这种担心只是加快了这个过程。


> Such a perfect day! If you look at the 5-minute chart on the right in Figure 15. 11, the shape is unremarkable for a Higher Low bear trend reversal, but if you look at the price scale on the right, you can see that some of the bars were more than 30 points tall, in contrast to a normal day where the bars might have an average range of about 2 points. This is the market's attempt to put at least a temporary bottom in after the Dow lost 20 percent this week in the Obama Crash of 2008. The market tanked because of fear of Obama's policies, not the subprime mess, but that is irrelevant to trading. It's been clear for over a year that the market should fall below 10,000 in 2008 because it appeared that it might have entered a mUltiyear trading range. There may be a major top in place and the selling could lead to much lower prices, but a trading range is a more common and therefore more likely outcome. The worldwide fear that Obama's policies that will hurt businesses by increasing regulations and costs, and the fear that there would no longer be an economic leader of the free world, have just sped up the process.


![图 15.11](figures/fig-15-11.png)


**图 15.11　2008年奥巴马崩盘**


尽管今天道指有1,000点的区间，对价格行为交易者来说，这仍然不过是例行公事的一天。如果你不得不为每一笔 Emini 交易承担大约10个点的风险，因而把仓位规模削减到正常水平的20%，只要用4个点的止盈目标，你到收盘时仍然能赚到比平常一天更多的利润。另外，在这样的大行情日里，摆动你仓位中的一部分并且依靠保本止损非常重要，因为出现了许多20个点以上的波段。如果在你的保本止损被打掉之前出现了反向信号，就平仓，休息一下，感叹一下你刚刚赚到的、难以置信的利润。或者，如果你是一位格外优秀的交易者，就反手做单，把整个过程重复一遍。

Also, on huge days like this, it is very important to swing part of your position and rely on a breakeven stop because there were many swings of 20 points or more. If there is an opposite signal before your breakeven stop is hit, exit, take a break, and marvel at the unbelievable profit you just made. Or, if you are an unusually good trader, reverse and repeat the process.

### 交易区间日里的小级别反转剥头皮


> MINOR REVERSAL SCALPS DURING TRADING RANGE DAYS


如果各段波动只持续几根K线到一个小时左右，而且当天不是趋势日，那么在新摆动高点和低点反向操作是一种有效的剥头皮技法，它有时也能提供一些合理的波段。这些小的反转里最好的一类，是在新极值处的二次入场和楔形。有人可能会质疑：在这么多大好的波段交易面前，为什么还要做剥头皮？理由很简单。如果你做这笔交易能在 Emini 中赚到一个点的概率非常高，而市场又能承接巨大的成交量，那么仅靠这样一次一个点的剥头皮，你就能赚出全天的利润。


> If the swings are lasting for only a few bars to an hour or so, and the day is not a trend day, fading new swing highs and lows is an effective scalping technique, and it sometimes offers some reasonable swings as well. The very best of these minor reversals are second entries and Wedges at new extremes. One could question taking scalps when there are so many great swing trades, but the reason is simple. If there is a very high probability that you can make one point in the Emini by taking the trade, and the market can handle huge volume, you can make your entire day's profit off just one of these one-point scalps .

### 强趋势中的回调


> PULLBACKS IN A STRONG TREND


这套方法的关键前提（sine qua non），是你相信图表正处于强趋势之中。由于大多数交易者要等到头一两个小时之后才会意识到某个交易日的5分钟图正在走趋势，这些交易通常不会出现在头一个小时里。最好的建仓形态是回调到 EMA 的两段式回调。这种回调到 EMA 的走势通常看起来好像根本不可能发展成什么顺势行情，但行情总是会突破前一个趋势极值，并且走得远超你的想象。在强趋势日里，摆动每一笔顺势入场中的一部分很重要，即使这意味着你的保本止损有时会打在交易中的摆动部分上。不过，那些大行情会远远弥补这一点。每次出现新的建仓形态，你可以简单地把你那部分剥头皮的头寸加回来，也可以在现有未平仓的摆动持仓之上再建一个完整仓位。一旦你剥头皮出掉一部分，你的摆动部分就变成正常摆动规模的两倍（如果你在每一个新信号处都继续加仓，那就是三倍或四倍）。大多数交易者会发现，只把剥头皮的合约加回来更容易，否则他们最终会持有太多合约而不舒服，而不舒服会让你难以遵守自己的规则。


> The sine qua non of this approach is that you believe that the chart is in a strong trend. Since most traders will not recognize that a day is trending on a 5-minute chart until after the first hour or two, these trades will usually not be in the first hour. The best setup is a two-legged pullback to the EMA. The pullback to the EMA usually looks as though it could never lead to much of a With Trend move, but invariably the move will take out the old trend extreme and carry much further than you would ever imagine. It is important to swing part of every With Trend entry on a strong trend day, even though that means that sometimes your breakeven stop will be hit on the swing portion of your trade. However, the big runs will more than make up for this. At every new setup, you can either simply add back your scalp portion or instead place a full position on top of your current open swing position. Once you scalp out of part, your swing portion is then twice the size of your normal swing (or three or four times, if you keep adding on at every new signal). Most traders would find it easier just to add their scalp contracts back because otherwise they will have ended up with too many contracts to be comfortable, and discomfort makes it hard to follow your rules.


微型趋势线假突破在多头中形成高1做多入场，在空头中形成低1做空入场，它们也是绝佳的顺势建仓形态。如果入场在一两根K线之内失败，你就得到了一个失败之后的失败，也就是一段突破回调，这是另一个可靠的建仓形态。


> Micro Trendline failed breakouts form High 1 long entries in a bull and Low 1 short entries in bear and are also excellent With Trend setups. If the entry fails within a bar or two, you then have a failure of a failed breakout, which is a Breakout Pullback and another reliable setup.

当市场不再明确走趋势时，它就不再提供绝佳的交易。余下这段讨论是为了提醒交易者一些基本原则，而这里面的那些交易都不属于本章。〔译注：指这些交易达不到本章「最佳交易」的标准。〕-此时市场已经横盘，出现大量十字星，聪明的交易者会避开这类价格行为，因为出现亏损交易的风险太大，而出现大行情的可能性又不大。

由于下跌到第8根K线的那段走势中没有明确上涨行情，而且空头已经控制了一个多小时，去寻找一段第二段下跌（一个可能的空头急速行情与交易区间顶部）是合理的。第10根K线是一小段行情，第12根K线是第二段行情，而且它从第11根K线起的上升过程中还带有一个低2。另外，第12根K线是一根小小的K线，向上跳空到了 EMA 之上。这是为第二段下跌而做的一笔好做空。

Bar 10 was a small leg up, and Bar 12 was a second leg up, and it had a Low 2 on its rise from Bar 11. Also, Bar 12 was a small bar that gapped above the EMA. This is a good short for a second leg down.


第13根K线是第9根K线那次突破的突破回调，也是一根失败的多头反转K线，套住了多头。


> Bar 13 was a Breakout Pullback of the Bar 9 breakout and a failed bull reversal bar, trapping longs.


那么高概率的交易是哪些？强趋势中的第5和第6根K线是最好的，而如今处于横盘市场中的第12根K线做空也是一笔好交易。这笔做空是在突破多头趋势线之后的第二段行情，是第11根K线起第二段行情中的一个低4和一根均线缺口K线、且 EMA 走平，是对第7根K线信号K线下方那个做空入场的突破回测，也是第二次试图反转第10根K线摆动高点上方那次突破。然而，在窄幅交易区间里，只有非常有经验的交易者才应该考虑交易，而且即便是他们中的大多数人也会另找机会。不要在这里交易！如果你把自己限制在三类交易上，那么在5分钟图上交易股票就相当容易：强趋势中的 EMA 回调，主要趋势线突破之后明确而强劲的反转，以及头一个小时里对前一日形态的突破失败和突破回调。最佳交易出现在强趋势日里，那时大部分K线都在 EMA 的一侧，而且全天只有那么两三次 EMA 回调。在那些回调处入场，尤其是当它们是 M2B 或 M2S 建仓形态时，大概就是你能做的最好的单一股票日内交易。如果你跟踪一篮子大约五只股票——它们有巨大的成交量（每天成交量超过约500万股）、日均区间在3美元或以上——那么你每天应该都能做到一两笔交易，其中剥头皮部分能净赚1美元，而摆动部分通常赚得更多。入场之后，把保护性止损放在信号K线之外（你很少需要承担1美元以上的风险，通常在60美分以下），一直放到入场K线收盘，然后把止损移到刚好在入场K线之外。一旦股票朝你有利的方向走了大约60到80美分，就把止损移到保本位，或者再差几个最小报价单位。例如，如果你在120.10买入，而股票触及了120.80，就把止损移到120.07附近。在用限价单于1美元利润处平掉大约一半仓位之后，就依靠你的保本止损。让你的保护性止损跟着5分钟图上的摆动点移动，并在2美元利润处再平掉一点。在你止损被打掉之前，或者除非出现一个明确而强劲的反向信号，否则绝不要平掉最后一部分。这一类交易在前面那节里已经有好几个例子。


> So what were the high probability trades? Bars 5 and 6 in the strong trend were the best, and the Bar 12 short in the now sideways market was also a good trade. This short was a second leg up after breaking the bull trendline, a Low 4 and a Gap Bar in the second leg up from Bar 1 1 with a flat EMA, a Breakout Test of the short entry below the Bar 7 signal bar, and the second attempt to reverse the breakout above the Bar 10 swing high. However, only very experienced traders should be considering trades in Tight Trading Ranges and even most of them would look elsewhere. Do not trade here! Trading stocks on a 5-minute chart is fairly easy if you limit yourself to three types of trades: EMA pullbacks in strong trends, clear and strong reversals after major trendline breaks, and first hour failed breakouts and breakout pullbacks of patterns from the prior day. The best trades are on strong trend days where most of the bars are on one side of the EMA and there are only a couple of EMA pullbacks during the day. Entering on those pullbacks, especially if. they are M2B or M2S setups, is probably the single best stock day trade that you can make. If you follow a basket of about five stocks with large volume (over about 5 million shares traded each day) and an average daily range of three dollars or more, then you should be able to make one or two trades every day where you can net one dollar on the scalp portion of your trade and usually more on the swing portion. After entering, place a protective stop beyond the signal bar (you rarely will have to risk more than 1 dollar and usually under 60 cents) until the entry bar closes, and then move the stop to just beyond the entry bar. Once the stock moves about 60 to 80 cents in your direction, move the stop to breakeven and maybe a few pennies worse. For example, if you bought at 120.10 and the stock hit 120.80, move your stop to around 120.07. After you exit half or so of your trade on a limit order at 1 dollar of profit, rely on your breakeven stop. Trail your protective stop beyond swing points on the 5-minute chart and take a little more off at 2 dollars profit. Never exit the final portion until your stop is hit or unless a clear and strong opposite signal develops. There are several examples ofthis type of trade in the prior section.


第二类交易是趋势反转，但对初学者来说这些更麻烦，因为大多数反转都会失败，而初学者往往过于急切，在弱势建仓形态上就入场。做反转，必须有一次对主要趋势线的强劲突破，这段第一段反转行情要显示出大量动能并且有一根强反转K线。然后你要等待对趋势极值的测试，并在测试成功时入场（在市场顶部是更低的高点或更高的高点，在市场底部是更高的低点或更低的低点）。你希望信号K线是一根强反转K线。如果建仓形态缺少上面任何一条，就不要做这笔交易。止损管理与上面描述的趋势交易相同。


> The second type of trade is a trend reversal, but these are trickier for beginners because most reversals fail, and beginners tend to be overly eager and enter on weak setups. For a reversal, there has to be a strong break of a major trendline, with this first reversal leg showing a lot of momentum and having a strong reversal bar. You will then wait for a test of the trend's extreme and enter on a successful test (a Lower High or Higher High in a market top, or a Higher Low of a Lower Low in a market bottom). You want the signal bar to be a strong reversal bar. If the setup does not have every one of these components, do not take the trade. The stop management is the same as for the trend trades described above.


最后一类交易要求你在昨天的图表上寻找一个形态，比如旗形、摆动点或趋势线，然后在今天寻找一个突破失败或突破回调来入场。当日的最高点或最低点，常常就出现在这些开盘反转上。


> The final type of trade requires you to look for a pattern on yesterday's chart, like a flag, swing point, or trendline, and then today look to enter on a failed breakout or a breakout pullback. The high or low of the day commonly occurs on these opening reversals.


市场已经向下漂移了好几个小时，而且尚未回调到 EMA，所以这是一个非常强的空头趋势。最佳交易是图 15.18中第2根K线和第10根K线上的做空。


> The market has been drifting down for several hours and has yet to pull back to the EMA, so this is a very strong bear trend. The best trades are the shorts on Bars 2 and 10 in Figure 15. 18.


第2根K线的入场价是169.88，初始止损在入场K线上方170.38。入场K线是一根外包下跌K线，你应该在入场的那一刻、在它收盘之前就把止损放在它的高点之上。这是合理的，因为它界定了你的风险，而且如果市场立刻在该K线高点之上反转，你不会希望自己还拿着空单。如果它不是一根外包K线，你就会把止损放在信号K线之上。这里的初始风险是50美分。


> The Bar 2 entry price is 169.88, and the initial stop is above the entry bar at 170.38. The entry bar is an outside down bar, and you should place the stop above its high as soon as you enter, before the bar closes. This is reasonable because it defines your risk, and you would not want to be short if the market immediately reversed above the high of the bar. If it was not an outside bar, you would place your stop above the signal bar. The initial risk here is 50 cents.


第5根K线是一个高1，它向上越过了你的做空入场价7美分，但此时你还不会下移保护性止损，因为你最大的浮盈只有38美分，而你需要给自己的交易时间让它走。通常，在没有大约60到80美分的浮盈之前，你不应该把止损移到保本位。


> Bar 5 was a High 1 that ran 7 cents above your short entry price, but you would not yet have moved your protective stop down because your largest open profit was only 38 cents, and you need to give your trade time to work. Typically, you should not move your stop to breakeven until there has been about 60 to 80 cents of open profit.


到第6根K线时，你本可以用限价单在1美元利润处平掉一半股票（第6根K线的底部比你的入场价低1.07）。正如你能从这根K线的外包上涨性质看出的，许多交易者很可能也回补了部分或全部空单。此时把保护性止损移到保本位，或者再差几个最小报价单位（170.91是合理的，因为 AAPL 很少会让止损被打穿一个最小报价单位以上），并且除非出现一个明确而强劲的反转——在一段这么强的空头趋势日里这不太可能——否则不要平仓。预期回调会把弱势空头吓出去。例如，上涨到第9根K线的那段行情一个最小报价单位不差地打到了保本止损（170.88），随后又反转向下。


> On Bar 6, you would have been able to exit half of your shares with one dollar profit using a limit order (the bottom of Bar 6 was 1.07 below your entry price). As you can see by the outside up nature of the bar, lots of traders likely covered part or all of their shorts as well. At this point, move your protective stop to breakeven or maybe a few pennies worse (170.91 is reasonable, since AAPL rarely runs stops by more than a penny), and do not exit unless there is a clear and strong reversal, which is unlikely on such a strong bear trend day. Expect pullbacks to scare weak shorts out. For example, the rally to Bar 9 hit breakeven stops to the penny (170.88) and then reversed back down.

然而，在图 15.19那种第一根K线即趋势的空头行情里，只有第2根K线和第3根K线低点处那两次一根K线的上涨（而且那些上涨甚至从未接近 EMA），此前并没有显著的强劲买盘。仅仅突破一条趋势通道线，并不足以证明多头力量；在这种力量出现之前，任何逆势交易都只是剥头皮，而在面对强趋势时，这是一种赔钱的做法。


> However, in a Trend from the First Bar bear with only a couple of one bar rallies at the Bars 2 and 3 lows in"Figure 15. 19 (and those rallies never even got close to the EMA), there was no significant prior strong buying. Simply breaking a trend channel line is not a sufficient demonstration of bullish strength, and until that strength is present, any Countertrend trade is a scalp, which is a losing strategy against a strong trend.


如果你认为市场跌得太远、太快，该反弹了，那就看看下面这张图（K线编号相同）。一旦楔形底部失败，市场又跌了6美元！

除非建仓形态是完美的，否则绝不要做逆势交易。它既需要此前有一次强劲的趋势线突破，也需要一根强反转K线。


> Never trade Countertrend unless the setup is perfect. It needs both a prior strong trendline break and a strong reversal bar.

每一天，你都应该全天查看图表，尤其是在头几个小时，以判断当天是不是趋势日（主要的类型前面已经描述过）。如果是，你就不应该做逆势交易。像图 15.20这样的开盘即趋势日，是最容易看出来的那一种趋势日。到当天的第三根K线，你就该起疑了（一根大的空头趋势K线，从开盘价远远跌下来），而等到市场跌破第1根K线时，你就会非常有把握。


> Every day, you should be examining the chart throughout the day and especially in the first couple of hours to determine if the day is a trend day (the major types were described earlier). If it is, you should not be trading Countertrend. A Trend from the Open day like this in Figure 15.20 is the single easiest trend day to see. You would have suspected it by the third bar of the day (a large bear trend bar, dropping far from the open), and you would be very confident by the time the market broke below Bar l.


第1根K线的那段上涨是一根大空头趋势K线，它突破了一条趋势线。一个急切的交易者随后可能会在第2、第3和第4根K线反转K线之上买入，以为多头在那次趋势线突破中表现出了足够的力量。然而，从当天第三根K线起，市场就一直在 EMA 之下，交易者应该记住：在像这样的开盘即趋势日里，第一次上涨到 EMA 通常会失败，然后去测试低点。不要说服自己说市场跌得太远、该反弹了。按定义，你是在强趋势日里抱着逆势思路、寻找逆势剥头皮。你害怕在低点附近卖出，反而在指望一次趋势反转，而这是一个低概率的赌注。算算数学期望。大多数做多剥头皮都会失败，而你在每一次上亏掉的钱都会太多，一两次最终的赢单补不回来。


> The Bar 1 rally was a big bull trend bar, and it broke a trendline. An eager trader might then buy above the Bar 2, Bar 3, and Bar 4 reversal bars, thinking that the bulls showed adequate strength during that trendline break. However, the market has been below the EMA since the third bar of the day, and traders should remember that on Trend from the Open days like this, the first rally to the EMA usually fails and then tests the low. Don't convince yourself that the market has gone too far and is due for a rally. By definition, you are thinking Countertrend and looking for Countertrend scalps on a strong trend day. You are afraid to sell near the low and instead are hoping for a trend reversal, which is a low-probability bet. Do the math. Most long scalps will fail, and the amount you lose on each one will be too great to make up by the eventual winner or two.


另一方面，GS 全天都没有一个可交易的 M2S，所以急于获利的大多数初学者今天应该到别处去找最佳交易。不过，一位有经验的交易者会整天做空，哪怕是最小的回调，并靠典型的回调序列，在回调的上涨超过他所以为的可能幅度时把他救出来。每一次第一回调之后，通常都会跟着一次对趋势极值（这里就是当日低点）的测试。


> On the other hand, GS did not have a tradable M2S all day, so most beginners eager to make a profit should look elsewhere for the best trades today. However, an experienced trader would be shorting even the tiniest pullbacks all day long, relying on the typical pullback sequence to bail him out if a pullback went further up than he thought was likely. Every type of first pullback is usually followed by a test of the trend's extreme (here, the low of the day).

**图 15.21　开盘后的股票交易**


要始终留意突破回调和突破失败。图 15.21中的第1根K线是一笔突破失败做空。第2根K线是从对当日低点的测试反转向上的走势，也是第二次试图跌破昨日交易区间（突破失败）。当对任何事情的两番尝试都失败时，市场很可能会反着走（这里是上涨）。它同时也是一个楔形。


> Always look for breakout pullbacks and failed breakouts. Bar 1 in Figure 15.21 is a Failed Breakout short. Bar 2 is a reversal up from a test of today's low, and it was a second attempt to sell off below yesterday's trading range (Failed Breakout). When two attempts at anything fail, it is likely that the market will do the opposite (here, rally). It is also a Wedge.


第3根K线是昨日高点上方的一次突破失败。第4根K线在向上突破一条空头趋势线以及突破 EMA 上都失败了。第5根K线是从昨日低点下方的一个缺口反转向上的强反转K线（一次对昨日低点的突破失败）。


> Bar 3 is a Failed Breakout above yesterday's high. Bar 4 failed in its breakout above a bear trendline and above the EMA. Bar 5 was a strong reversal bar up from a gap below yesterday's low (a Failed Breakout below yesterday's low).


第6根K线是开盘那段突破昨日交易区间的上涨行情之后的突破回调。它同时也是一个位于 EMA 的更高的低点。


> Bar 6 was a Breakout Pullback from the opening rally that broke above yesterday's trading range. It was also a Higher Low at the EMA.


# 交易准则

*Trading Guidelines*


为什么讲准则，而不是规则？因为根本没有规则。


> Why guidelines and not rules? Because there are no rules.


1. 你看到的一切，都处在一团灰色迷雾里。没有什么东西是完美清晰的。接近，就已经足够接近了。如果某个东西看起来像一个可靠的形态，它很可能就会像可靠的形态那样走出行情。


> 1. Everything that you see is in a gray fog. Nothing is perfectly clear. Close is close enough. If something looks like a reliable pattern, it will likely trade like a reliable pattern.


2. 每一根K线都是两个方向的信号K线，市场在下一根K线就可以启动一段向上或向下的趋势。要对所有可能性保持开放；当意外出现时，不要质疑它，也不要否认它。读懂它，然后按它交易就好。


> 2. Every bar is a signal bar for both directions and the market can begin a trend up or down on the next bar. Be open to all possibilities and when the surprise happens, don't question or deny it. Just read it and trade it.


3. 一切都说得通。如果你懂得怎么读价格行为，就没有什么会让你意外，因为你会明白市场正在做什么。一天结束的时候，初学者在一张打印稿上也能看明白。目标是把读图练得足够快，快到能实时理解正在发生的事。


> 3. Everything makes sense. If you know how to read price action, nothing will surprise you because you will understand what the market is doing. Beginners can see it on a printout at the end of the day. The goal is to learn how to read fast enough so that you can understand what is happening real time.


4. 光是理解价格行为，并不足以让你赚钱。你必须学会怎么做最佳交易，并遵守自己的规则。


> 4. Simply understanding price action is not enough to make you profitable. You must learn how to take the best trades and follow your rules.


5. 交易是一份工作；如果你想赚到真正的大钱，就需要一份商业计划，就像经营任何别的生意都得有一样，而且你必须执行自己的计划。计划可以很简单，比如只在一张5分钟图上做两三种建仓形态：一半仓位做剥头皮，另一半用保本止损做波段。然而，你必须执行自己的计划。这一行的利润空间非常小，所以一天里哪怕有两三次纪律松懈，也能让你一直亏损。


> 5. Trading is a job, and if you expect to make serious money, you need a business plan, just as you would have with any other business, and you must follow your plan. The plan can be simple, such as only taking two or three types of setups off a single 5-minute chart, scalping half and swinging the other half with a breakeven stop. However, you must follow your plan. The profit margin is tiny in this business so even a couple lapses in discipline a day can keep you in the red.


6. 不要把市场变成赌场，因为那种数学期望冷酷无情、不可阻挡，会把你毁掉。很多策略的有效频率足够高，高到让你相信终有一天能靠它们谋生，但数学期望对你不利。在1分钟图上做交易，就是最经典的例子。你赢的次数足够多，多到让你相信自己终将把技术磨练到发大财的地步。而现实是：许多最佳交易发生得太快、根本抓不住，你只能在那些利润较差的交易里挑挑拣拣，赚到的钱比做5分钟图还少——如果你还能赚到钱的话。


> 6. Don't tum the market into a casino, because that kind of math is relentless and unstoppable and will destroy you. Many strategies work often enough to make you believe that you will eventually be able to make a living off of them, but the math is against you. Trading off the 1-minute chart is the classic example. You win often enough to believe that you will eventually hone your skills to the point that you will make a fortune. The reality is that many of the best trades happen too fast to catch and you will be left picking among the less profitable ones and make less than you would off the 5-minute, if you make anything at all.


7. 不存在可靠的逆势形态，所以绝不要做逆势交易，除非此前先出现过一次对重要趋势线的突破。即便到那时，也要先去找一笔顺势交易，它应当会带来一次对原趋势极值点的测试。如果市场在原极值附近再次反转，那么你就应该顺着新趋势的方向入场了。


> 7. There are no reliable Countertrend patterns, so never trade Countertrend unless there first has been a break of a significant trendline. And even then, first look for a With Trend trade that should lead to a test of the old trend's extreme. If the market once again reverses near the old extreme, then you should be entering in the direction of the new trend.


8. 所有形态都会失败，失败本身也常常失败；但一次失败后的失败，是原方向上的二次入场，成功概率很高。


> 8. All patterns fail, and the failures often fail, but a failed failure is a second entry in the original direction and has a high probability of success.


9. 当你看到某一方突然被套住时，反方向剥头皮的可靠性就会上升。那些被套的交易者会在你进场的同时被迫离场，而且他们很可能会等更多价格行为出现之后，才在自己原来的方向上再次入场，所以到最后，唯一还留在场内的，就是你这个方向上的交易者。


> 9. When you see that one side is suddenly trapped, the reliability of a scalp in the opposite dire"Ction goes up. Trapped traders will be forced out as you are getting in, and they will likely wait for more price action before entering again in their original direction, so the only traders left will be in your direction.


10. 看到交易者因为一次止损猎杀而被关在场外，和看到他们被套在场内一样，都是同样可靠的信号。如果市场突然扫掉止损、随后恢复原来的趋势，这就是一个可靠的建仓形态，至少够拿到一份剥头皮交易者的利润。


> 10. Seeing traders getting trapped out of a trade on a stop run is as reliable a signal as seeing them getting trapped in a trade. If the market suddenly runs stops and then resumes its trend, this is a reliable setup for at least a scalper's profit.


11. 许多初学者想要刺激，往往过度交易。许多伟大的交易者觉得交易孤独、无聊，但非常赚钱。


> 11. Many beginners want excitement and tend to overtrade. Many great traders find trading to be lonely and boring, but very profitable.


12. 简单更好。你不需要指标，而且你只该看一张图。如果没有任何指标、只靠一张图都赚不到钱，那么增加更多要分析的东西，只会让事情变得更难。另外，在你做到稳定盈利之前，只做最好的那些建仓形态。


> 12. Simple is better. You don't need indicators, and you should only look at one chart. If you can't make money off a single chart with no indicators, adding more things to analyze will only make it more difficult. Also, only trade the very best setups until you are consistently profitable.


13. 想清楚这到底是爱好还是工作。如果它是爱好，就换一个爱好，因为这一项太费钱，而且上瘾得危险。所有伟大的交易者很可能都是交易瘾君子，但大多数交易瘾君子要么已经破产，要么很可能会以破产收场。


> 13. Decide if this is a hobby or a job. If it is a hobby, find another one because this one will be too expensive and it is dangerously addictive. All great traders are likely trading addicts, but most trading addicts are or will likely end up broke.


14. 如果你连一个球都抛不稳，就别试着抛两个三个。如果你还没赚到钱，就先从一张图、一个市场、一个时间级别（5分钟图）和一个概念（价格行为，而不是指标）开始。


> 14. If you can't juggle one ball, don't try to juggle two or three. If you are not yet making money, start with one chart, one market, one time frame (the 5-minute), and one concept (price action and not indicators).


15. 一开始就用5分钟图交易、用止损单入场。在止盈目标处用限价单平掉一部分或全部仓位，然后把剩下合约的保护性止损移到保本位。


> 15. Begin trading using a 5-minute chart and entering on a stop. Take some or all off on a limit order at a profit target, and then move the protective stop to breakeven on any remaining contracts.


16. 初学者应该考虑做股票的波段交易，而不是在 Emini 上做剥头皮或波段，因为股票图通常更容易读，也往往趋势走得不错。当你的交易量大到在股票上拿不到好的成交价时，Emini 或者国债期货才会变得重要。


> 16. Beginners should consider swing trading stocks instead of scalping or swinging Eminis because stock charts are usually easier to read and often trend well. The Eminis or bond futures become important when your trading volume gets too large to allow for good fills in stocks.


17. 刚起步时，你应该考虑交易 SPY（标普500的 ETF），而不是 Emini。一张 Emini 合约等同于500股 SPY；交易300到500股 SPY，可以让你在把一部分仓位做波段的同时分批止盈，又不会承担太大风险。等你的规模到了1,000到1,500股 SPY，如果你想着要继续加大仓位规模，那就换成 Emini。到了那个规模，你可以在 Emini 上分批止盈，而且可以大幅提高仓位规模，滑点也不会成为明显问题。


> 17. When starting out, you should consider trading the SPY instead of the Emini. One Emini is identical to 500 SPY, and trading 300 to 500 SPY would allow you to scale out as you swing part of your trade, yet not incur much risk. Once you reach 1,000 to 1,500 SPY, if you are thinking that you will continue to increase your position size, then switch to the Emini. At that size, you can scale out of the Emini and you can increase your position size tremendously without slippage being a significant issue.


18. 如果你发现自己连续错过了两三次 Emini 交易，而它们都赚了钱，那很可能是你的仓位规模太大了。改为交易100到300股 SPY，做至少20到50美分的波段。虽然你不会因此发财，但至少能赚到一些钱，也能建立起信心。


> 18. If you find that you did not take a couple Emini trades in a row and they worked, you are likely trading too large a position size. Switch to trading 100 to 300 shares of SPY and swing for at least 20 to 50 cents. Even though you won't get rich, at least you will make some money and build your confidence.


19. 低买高卖——除了在清晰而强劲的趋势里（见讲趋势的章节）。在多头趋势里，即使高2建仓形态处在当日最高点，也要买入；在空头里，就卖出低2。不过，绝大多数时候市场都处在交易区间里。举例来说，如果市场已经上涨了几根K线，而现在这段上涨行情的顶部附近出现了一个买入信号，那就问问自己：你是否相信市场正处在本书描述过的某一种明确的强多头趋势形态里。如果你没法说服自己相信这一点，就不要买高——哪怕动能看上去很棒，因为很有可能你会被套住。


> 19. Buy low, sell high, except in a clear and strong trend (see chapter on trends). In a bull trend, buy High 2 setups even ifthey are at the high of the day, and in a bear, sell Low 2s. However, the market is in a trading range for the vast majority of the time. For example, if the market has been going up for a few bars and there is now a buy signal near the top of this leg up, ask yourself if you believe that the market is in one of the established clear and strong bull trend patterns described in this book. If you cannot convince yourself that it is, don't buy high, even if the momentum looks great, since the odds are great that you will be trapped.


20. 每张图上的每一段行情，通常都可以被归入不止一种形态，而且几乎总是所有形态都指向同一个方向。你只需要认出其中一个，就可以下单。举例来说，一笔最终熊旗失败做多，同时也可以是一个双底牛旗；它还可能是一次多头急速与交易区间反转——在过靶了一条趋势通道线和一条更大的多头趋势线之后反转向上的那种——并且它可以进一步演变成多头急速与通道行情。只要你能认出其中任何一个，你就可以下单，哪怕你没有看见其它所有形态。


> 20. Every segment of every chart commonly can be classified as more than one pattern, and almost always the patterns will point in the same direction. All you have to see is just one to place a trade. For example, a Failed Final Bear Flag long can also be a Double Bottom Bull Flag, and this might also be a Bull Spike and Trading Range Reversal that reversed up after overshooting a trend channel line and a larger bull trend line, and it can progress into a Spike and Channel Bull. If you recognize any of these, you can place a trade even if you do not see all of the others.


21. 好的成交，糟糕的交易。如果市场让你以比预期更好的价格进场或出场，永远要起疑；但如果建仓形态很好，那就做。反过来，糟糕的成交、好的交易这条推论，就没那么可靠了。


> 21. Good fill, bad trade. Always be suspicious if the market lets you in or out at a price that is better than you anticipated, but if the setup is good, take it. The corollary of bad fill, good trade is not as reliable.


22. 趋势总是在形成回调——它们看起来像糟糕的入场机会，却能赚钱；趋势也在形成反转——它们看起来很好，却是亏钱的交易。大多数趋势回调前面都只跟了恰到好处的一段高潮，刚好让交易者怀疑趋势是不是已经结束，并把交易者关在场外、无法在回调中入场。另外，这些趋势反转也足够好，正好能吸引并套住逆势交易者。如果你做逆势交易，你就是在赌博；虽然你会常常赢、也玩得开心，但数学期望对你不利，你会慢慢地、但必定会破产。强趋势里的逆势建仓形态几乎总是失败，然后变成绝佳的顺势建仓形态，在1分钟图上尤其如此。


> 22. Trends are always forming pullbacks that look like terrible entries but are profitable and reversals that look good but are losers. Most trend pullbacks follow just enough of a climax to make traders wonder if the trend has ended and trap traders out of entering on the pullback. Also, the trend reversals are just good enough to attract and trap Countertrend traders. If you trade Countertrend, you are gambling, and although you will often win and have fun, the math is against you, and you will slowly but surely go broke. Countertrend setups in strong trends almost always fail and become great With Trend setups, especially on the 1 minute chart.


23. 最容易赚钱的时段是头90分钟，而最容易看出来的交易，是前一天形态的突破失败和突破回调。初学者应该避免在交易日的中段交易，也避免在当日区间的中段交易。


> 23. The easiest time to make money is in the first 90 minutes, and some of the easiest trades to spot are failed breakouts and breakout pullbacks of patterns from the prior day. Beginners should avoid trading in the middle of the day and in the middle of the day's range.


24. 每次准备做一笔交易之前，永远要问自己：这个建仓形态是不是当天最好的那几个之一？这是不是机构等了一整天的那个机会？如果答案是“不是”，而你又还不是一位稳定盈利的交易者，那么这笔交易你也不该做。如果你在大约15分钟之内连续输了两笔，就问自己：这些是不是机构等了几个小时才做的交易？如果答案还是不是，那你就是在过度交易，你需要变得更有耐心。


> 24. When you are about to take any trade, always ask yourself if the setup is one of the best of the day. Is this the one that the institutions have been waiting for all day? If the answer is "no" and you are not a consistently profitable trader, then you should not take the trade either. If you have two consecutive losers within 15-minutes or so, ask yourself if those were trades that the institutions have been waiting hours to take. If the answer is no, you are overtrading, and you need to become more patient.


25. 会说的人不懂，懂的人不说。不要看电视，也不要看任何消息面。交易赚得最多的那些人，忙得没时间上电视。问自己一句：如果你在大仓位上、每天在 Emini 里哪怕只净赚两个点，你真愿意费心去上电视吗？那么，你为什么要从一个一天连两三个点都赚不到的人那里听交易思路呢？交易是一门生意，不是一种宗教，所以别去找什么交易救世主。


> 25. Those who talk don't know and those who know don't talk. Don't watch TV or read any news. The traders who are making the most money trading are too busy to be on TV. Ask yourself, if you are netting even just two points in the Emini a day on large positions, do you really want to bother with going on TV? So why are you listening for trading ideas from someone who can't even make a couple points a day? Trading is a business, not a religion, so don't look for a trading savior.


26. 每一根K线、每一系列K线，要么是趋势，要么是交易区间。选一个。整个交易日里，尤其是在上午8:30 PST 前后，你都需要不断判断：当天像不像本书描述过的某种趋势形态。如果像，而你又打算做交易，那么每一笔顺势交易你都必须做。如果你没有把所有的顺势交易都做上，就绝不要考虑做逆势交易。


> 26. Every bar and every series of bars is either a trend or a trading range. Pick one. Throughout the day and especially around 8:30 A.M. PST, you need to be deciding whether or not the day resembles any trend pattern described in this book. If it does and you are looking to take any trade, you must take every With Trend trade. Never consider taking a Countertrend trade if you haven't been taking all of the With Trend trades.


27. 最好的信号K线，是你交易方向上的趋势K线。十字星K线是一根K线构成的交易区间，因此是糟糕的信号K线。在空头里于交易区间上方买入，或者在多头里于交易区间下方卖出，你都会亏钱。


> 27. The best signal bars are trend bars in the direction of your trade. Doji bars are one bar trading ranges and therefore terrible signal bars. You will lose if you buy above a trading range in a bear or sell below one in a bull.


28. 除非你停止做逆势剥头皮，否则你赚不到稳定的钱。你会赢得足够频繁，频繁到让你一直想去改进技术；但随着时间推移，你的账户会慢慢消失。


> 28. You will not make consistent money until you stop trading Countertrend scalps. You will win often enough to keep you trying to improve your technique, but over time your account will slowly disappear.


29. 除非你开始做顺势回调，否则你赚不到钱。


> 29. You will not make money until you start trading With Trend pullbacks.


30. 除非你等到一次对重要趋势线的突破，然后等到在测试趋势极值点时出现一根强反转K线，否则你做反转赚不到钱。


> 30. You will not make money trading reversals until you wait for a break of a significant trendline and then for a strong reversal bar on a test of the trend's extreme.


31. 除非你知道自己在做什么，否则你赚不到钱。每天把5分钟 Emini 图打印出来（如果你做股票，也把股票图打印出来），把你看到的每一个建仓形态都写在图上。当你看到好几个价格行为特征时，把它们全都写在图上。每天都这样做，坚持好几年，直到你能看任意一张图的任意一段，并且瞬间就明白正在发生什么。


> 31. You will not make money unless you know what you are doing. Print out the 5-minute Emini chart every day (and stock charts, if you trade stocks) and write on the chart every setup that you see. When you see several price action features, write them all on the chart. Do this every day for years until you can look at any part of any chart and instantly understand what is happening.


32. 如果你连续输了两三笔交易，或者当天亏了钱，那你就是在过度交易、不够有耐心。你可能在骗自己，在1分钟或3分钟图上寻找“低风险”的提前入场，要么就是在做逆势交易，要么就是在铁丝网里交易。坏习惯抹掉的永远比你的盈利多。你正走在通往爆仓的路上，尽管你可能在那条路上走得很慢。但你终究会走到那里。


> 32. If you lost on two or three trades in a row or if you lost money on the day, you are overtrading and not being patient. You might be fooling yourself and looking for "low risk" early entries on the 1- or 3- minute charts, or you are trading Countertrend, or you are trading in Barb Wire. Bad habits always erase more than your winnings. You are on the path to a blown account, even though you might be moving slowly in that direction. But you will eventually get there.


33. 除非你足够了解自己的性格、找到一种与之相容的交易风格，否则长期下来你赚不到钱。你需要能够从容地遵守自己的规则，让你在进场和出场时几乎没有、或者完全没有犹豫和焦虑。一旦你掌握了某种交易方法，如果交易时仍然感到压力，那么要么是你还没找到属于自己的风格，要么是你还没找到自己。


> 33. You will not make money long term until you know enough about your personality to find a trading style that is compatible. You need to be able to follow your rules comfortably, allowing you to enter and exit trades with minimal or no uncertainty or anxiety. Once you have mastered a method of trading, if you feel stress while trading, then either you haven't yet found your style or yourself.


34. 永远要去找两段行情。另外，当市场两次尝试做同一件事、两次都失败时，这就是一个可靠的信号：它很可能成功地做出相反的事。


> 34. Always look for two legs. Also, when the market tries to do something twice and fails both times, that is a reliable signal that it will likely succeed in doing the opposite.


35. 绝不要挑樱桃，因为你总会挑到足够多的烂樱桃，最后变成一个输家。要么做波段交易、只取当天最佳建仓形态里最好的那两三个，要么做剥头皮、把每一个有效建仓形态都做上。不过，后者是更难的那条路，只适合性格非常不寻常的人（比我们其余这些交易者还要不寻常！）。


> 35. Never cherry pick because you will invariably pick enough rotten cherries to end up a loser. Either swing trade and look to take only the best two or three of the best setups of the day, or scalp and take every valid setup. That, however, is the more difficult alternative and is only for people with very unusual personalities (even more unusual than the rest of us traders!).


36. 初学者只该做最佳交易，而且要么做剥头皮，要么做波段。一次盯着屏幕两三个小时却不下单，这很难，但这是初学者赚钱最好的方式。如果你压倒一切的目标是赚钱，这就是你必须做的事。如果你没有这样做，那就说明你还有别的目标，它们在干扰那个本应是你唯一目标的目标。


> 36. Beginners should only take the best trades and either scalp or swing. It is difficult to watch a screen for two or three hours at a time and not place a trade, but this is the best way for beginners to make money. If your overriding goal is to make money, this is what you must do. If you do not, then you have other goals that are interfering with what should really be your only goal.


37. 纪律是赢家交易者身上最重要的那一个特质。交易理解起来容易，做起来难。要遵守简单的规则非常难，就连偶尔的自我放纵，都可能成为成功与失败的分界线。每个人都能像泰格·伍兹那样，在一杆上做到心理强悍；但很少有人能在一整轮里都那么强悍，并且在自己生命中的每一天、每一轮里都保持那样。每个人都知道什么是心理韧性和纪律，每个人每天都会在某些事情上表现出心理韧性和纪律；但很少有人真正体会到，要成为一名伟大的交易者，你必须极端到什么程度、必须毫不松懈到什么程度。培养只做最佳交易的纪律。


> 37. Discipline is the single most important characteristic of winning traders. Trading is easy to understand but difficult to do. It is very difficult to follow simple rules, and even occasional self-indulgences can be the difference between success and failure. Everyone can be as mentally tough as Tiger Woods for one shot, but few can be that tough for an entire round, and then be that way for a round every day of their lives. Everyone knows what mental toughness and discipline are, and everyone is mentally tough and disciplined in some activities every day, but few truly appreciate just how extreme and unrelenting you have to be to be a great trader. Develop the discipline to take only the best trades.


38. 伟大交易者第二重要的特质，是一次能好几个小时什么都不做。不要屈服于无聊，别让它说服你：距离上一笔交易已经过去太久了。


> 38. The second-most-important trait of great traders is the ability to do nothing for hours at a time. Don't succumb to boredom and let it convince you that it's been too long since the last trade.


39. 要把功夫下在提高仓位规模上，而不是下在交易次数、或者你用到的建仓形态种类上。你只需要每天在 Emini 上赚到一个点，就算做得很好（每天1个点、100份合约，一年就是七位数。）


> 39. Work on increasing your position size rather than on the number of trades or the variety of setups that you use. You only need to make one point in the Eminis a day to do well (100 contracts at 1 point a day is seven figures a year).


# 术语表

*Glossary*


本术语表中的所有词条都以便于交易者实际使用的方式来定义，而不一定采用技术分析师常见的理论化描述。


> All of these terms are defined in a practical way to be helpful to traders and not necessarily in the theoretical way often described by technicians.


- **2HM（两小时未触均线）**：市场已有两个小时或更久未触及均线。它是一个强趋势的标志，而且它不必是当天的头两个小时。


> - **2HM** The market has not touched the EMA for two or more hours. It is a sign of a strong trend, and it does not have to be the first two hours of the day.


- **Bar Pullback（K线回调）**：在上涨行情中，它是一根最低点低于前一根K线最低点的K线。在下跌行情中，它是一根最高点高于前一根K线最高点的K线。


> - **Bar Pullback** In an upswing, it is a bar with a low below the low of the prior bar. In a downswing, it is a bar with a high above that of the prior bar.


- **Barb Wire（铁丝网）**：一个由三根或更多K线构成的交易区间，这些K线大体上相互重叠，而且其中一根或更多是十字星。只考虑在它的极值附近反向操作小K线（尤其是在顺势的时候——例如，如果这个形态就在均线下方，就寻找做空机会），以及反向操作趋势K线的突破。


> - **Barb Wire** A trading range of three or more bars that largely overlap, and one or more is a doji. Only look to fade small bars near its extremes, especially if With Trend (for example, look to sell if the pattern is just below the EMA), and trend bar breakouts.


- **Bear Reversal（空头反转）**：趋势从上涨变为下跌（一段空头趋势）。


> - **Bear Reversal** A change in trend from up to down (a bear trend).


- **Breakout（突破）**：当前K线的最高点或最低点越过了此前某个重要价位，比如一个摆动高点或摆动低点、任何先前K线的最高点或最低点、一条趋势线，或者一个趋势通道。


> - **Breakout** The high or low of the current bar extends beyond some prior price of significance such as a swing high or low, the high or low of any prior bar, a trendline, or a trend channel.


- **Breakout Bar (or Bar Breakout)（突破K线）**：当前K线突破前一根K线——它的最高点延伸到前一根K线最高点之上，或者它的最低点延伸到前一根K线最低点之下。


> - **Breakout Bar (or Bar Breakout)** The current breaks out beyond the prior bar by having its high extend above the high of the prior bar or its low extend below the low of the prior bar.


- **Breakout Pullback（突破回调）**：突破之后几根K线之内出现的一次一到大约五根K线的小回调。它是一次失败后的失败，因为它是突破失败之后的再次失败。在两次失败之后，市场通常会走出一笔可靠的交易。


> - **Breakout Pullback** A small pullback of one to about five bars that occurs within a few bars after a breakout. It is a failed failure, since it is a breakout failure that failed. After two failures, the market usually produces a reliable trade.


- **Breakout Test（突破回测）**：一次接近最初入场价的突破回调。它可能过靶，也可能差几个 tick 未及靶位。它可能出现在入场后的一两根K线之内，也可能出现在一段延伸的走势之后（甚至在5分钟图上会是几个小时之后）。


> - **Breakout Test** A Breakout Pullback that comes close to the original entry price. It may overshoot or undershoot by a few ticks. It can occur within a bar or two of entry or after an extended move (even several hours later on a 5-minute chart).


- **Bull Reversal（多头反转）**：趋势从下跌变为上涨（一段多头趋势）。


> - **Bull Reversal** A change in trend from a down to up (a bull trend).


- **candle（蜡烛线）**：实体是这根K线开盘价与收盘价之间的区域。如果收盘价在上，它就是一根多头蜡烛线，在本书中显示为白色；如果收盘价在下，它就是一根空头蜡烛线，显示为黑色。实体上下两端的线叫影线，也叫灯芯或阴影。


> - **candle** The body is the area between the open and the close of the bar. If the close is above, it is a bull candle and shown as white in this book. If it is below, it is a bear candle and is black. The lines above and below are called tails, wicks, or shadows.


- **chart types（走势图类型）**：线图、K线图、蜡烛图、成交量图、tick 图，等等。


> - **chart types** Line, bar, candle, volume, tick, and so on.


- **climax（高潮）**：一段走得太远、太快，如今已经反转方向、转入交易区间或相反趋势的行情。大多数高潮都以趋势通道线过靶和反转收尾。


> - **climax** A move that has gone too far too fast and has now reversed directions to either a trading range or an opposite trend. Most climaxes end with trend channel overshoots and reversals.


- **Countertrend（逆势）**：方向与当前趋势相反的一笔交易或一个建仓形态。一般来说，应当把最近一次5分钟信号的方向假定为趋势的方向。另外，如果过去10根或20根K线中的大多数都位于均线之下，那么顺势的一方很可能在卖方。


> - **Countertrend** A trade or setup that is in the opposite direction from the current trend. In general, the direction of the most recent 5-minute signal should be as sumed to be the trend's direction. Also, if most of the past 10 or 20 bars are below the EMA, With Trend is likely on the sell side.


- **day trade（日内交易）**：打算在入场当天就离场的交易。


> - **day trade** A trade where the intent is to exit on the day of entry.


- **doji（十字星）**：实体很小、或者完全没有实体的一根蜡烛线。在5分钟图上，实体也就只有一两个 tick；但在日线图上，实体可能有10个或更多 tick，看起来却仍然几乎不存在。多头和空头都没能掌控这根K线。


> - **doji** A candle with a small body or no body at all. On a 5-minute chart, the body would be only 1 or 2 ticks, but on a daily chart, the body might be 10 or more ticks and still appear almost nonexistent. Neither the bulls nor the bears control the bar.


- **Double Bottom（双底）**：当前K线的最低点与先前某个摆动低点的最低点大致相同。那个先前的低点可能只早一根K线，也可能早20根甚至更多K线。它不必就是当天的最低点，而且它常常形成于牛旗之中（一个双底牛旗）。


> - **Double Bottom** The low of the current bar is about the same as the low of a prior swing low. That prior low can be just 1 bar earlier or 20 or more bars earlier. It does not have to be at the low of the day, and it commonly forms in bull flags (a Double Bottom Bull Flag).


- **Double Bottom Bull Flag（双底牛旗）**：多头趋势中的一次停顿或旗形，它两次向下急速推进到大致相同的价格，然后反转回到多头趋势。


> - **Double Bottom Bull Flag** A pause or flag in a bull trend that has two spikes down to around the same price and then reverses back into a bull trend.


- **Double Bottom Pullback（双底回调）**：一种买入建仓形态，由一次双底，加上其后一次形成更高的低点的深度回调构成。


> - **Double Bottom Pullback** A buy setup composed of a Double Bottom followed by a deep pullback that forms a Higher Low.


- **Double Bottom Twin（双底孪生）**：强空头行情中两根连续的K线，它们的最低点完全相同，影线很小或不存在。


> - **Double Bottom Twin** Two consecutive bars in a strong bear that have identical lows and small or nonexistent tails.


- **Double Top（双顶）**：当前K线的最高点与先前某个摆动高点的最高点大致相同。那个先前的高点可能只早一根K线，也可能早20根甚至更多K线。它不必就是当天的最高点，而且它常常形成于熊旗之中（一个双顶熊旗）。


> - **Double Top** The high of the current bar is about the same as the high of a prior swing high. That prior high can be just one bar earlier or 20 or more bars earlier. It does not have to be at the high of the day, and it commonly forms in a bear flag (Double Top Bear Flag).


- **Double Top Bear Flag（双顶熊旗）**：空头趋势中的一次停顿或旗形，它两次向上急速推进到大致相同的价格，然后反转回到空头趋势。


> - **Double Top Bear Flag** A pause or flag in a bear trend that has two spikes up to around the same price and then reverses back into a bear trend.


- **Double Top Pullback（双顶回调）**：一种卖出建仓形态，由一次双顶，加上其后一次形成更低的高点的深度回调构成。


> - **Double Top Pullback** A sell setup composed of a Double Top followed by a deep pullback that forms a Lower High.


- **Double Top Twin（双顶孪生）**：强多头行情中两根连续的K线，它们的最高点完全相同，影线很小或不存在。


> - **Double Top Twin** Two consecutive bars in a strong bull that have identical highs and small or nonexistent tails.


- **Down Up Twin（下跌上涨孪生）**：一种多头反转建仓形态：其中有两根相互重叠的K线，实体大小相近，第一根是空头趋势K线，第二根是多头趋势K线。


> - **Down Up Twin** A bull reversal setup where there are two overlapping bars that have bodies of similar size, and the first one is a bear trend bar, and the second is a bull trend bar.


- **early longs（提前入场的多头）**：在多头反转K线或趋势K线正在形成时就买入的交易者，而不是等它收盘后、再在其最高点上方一个 tick 处用买入止损单入场。


> - **early longs** Traders who buy as a bull reversal or trend bar is forming rather than waiting for it to close and then entering on a buy stop at one tick above its high.


- **early shorts（提前入场的空头）**：在空头反转K线或趋势K线正在形成时就卖出的交易者，而不是等它收盘后、再在其最低点下方一个 tick 处用卖出止损单入场。


> - **early shorts** Traders who sell as a bear reversal or trend bar is forming rather than waiting for it to close and then entering on a sell stop at one tick below its low.


- **EMA（指数移动平均线）**：本书中的走势图使用20根K线的指数移动平均线。


> - **EMA** The charts in this book use a 20-bar exponential moving average.


- **EMA Gap Bar（均线缺口K线）**：在走平或下跌的市场中，它是一根最低点位于均线上方的K线。在走平或上涨的市场中，它是一根最高点位于均线下方的K线。


> - **EMA Gap Bar** In a flat or down market, it is a bar with a low above the EMA. In a flat or up market, it is a bar with a high below the EMA.


- **entry bar（入场K线）**：一笔交易入场所在的那根K线。


> - **entry bar** The bar during which a trade is entered.


- **fade（反向操作）**：朝与趋势相反的方向下单交易（例如，卖出一次你预期会失败并反转向下的多头突破）。


> - **fade** Place a trade in the opposite direction of the trend (for example, selling a bull breakout that you expect to fail and reverse downward).


- **Failed Failure（失败后的失败）**：一次失败形态又失败了，行情恢复朝最初那次突破的方向运行。由于它是第二个信号，所以更可靠。


> - **Failed Failure** A failure that fails, resuming in the direction of the original break out. Since it is a second signal, it is more reliable.


- **Failure（失败形态）**：一段行情在剥头皮交易者的利润到手之前、或者在交易者的目标达到之前，保护性止损就先被打到，而且它通常会导致行情朝相反方向走，因为被套的交易者被迫亏损离场。目前，Emini 小型合约上剥头皮交易者4个 tick 的目标需要6个 tick 的运动，而 QQQQ（纳斯达克100的 ETF）上10个 tick 的目标需要12美分的运动。


> - **Failure** A move where the protective stop is hit before a scalper's profit is secured or before the trader's objective is reached, usually leading to a move in the opposite direction as trapped traders are forced to exit at a loss. Currently, a scalper's target in the Emini of 4 ticks requires a 6-tick move, and a target in the QQQQ of ten ticks requires a 12 cent move.


- **Five-Tick Failure（五个 tick 的失败）**：Emini 上的一种交易：行情走出信号K线之外五个 tick 后反转（例如，牛旗的一次突破跑出五个 tick，而一旦那根K线收盘，下一根K线的最低点就低于它）。它通常是朝相反方向交易的一个建仓形态。


> - **Five-Tick Failure** A trade in the Emini that reaches five ticks beyond the signal bar and then reverses (for example, a breakout of a bull flag runs five ticks, and once the bar closes, the next bar has a low that is lower). It is usually a setup for a trade in the opposite direction.


- **gap（缺口）**：缺口是走势图上任意两个价格之间的一段空隙。跳空开盘是常见现象：如果今天第一根K线的开盘价越过了前一根K线（昨天最后一根K线）的最高点或最低点，或者越过了整个前一天的最高点或最低点，就存在跳空开盘。当某根K线的最低点位于一条走平或下行的移动平均线上方，或者某根K线的最高点位于一条走平或上行的移动平均线下方时，就存在一个均线缺口。


> - **gap** A gap is a space between any two prices on the chart. An opening gap is a common occurrence and is present if the open of the first bar of today is beyond the high or low of the prior bar (the last bar of yesterday) or of the entire day. An EMA Gap is present when the low of a bar is above a flat or falling moving average, or the high of a bar is below a flat or rising moving average.


- **gap reversal（缺口反转）**：当当前K线越过前一根K线、朝缺口之内延伸了一个 tick 时，就存在一次缺口反转尝试。


> - **gap reversal** A gap reversal attempt is present when the current bar extends one tick beyond the prior bar into the gap.


- **Gap 2（缺口2）**：如果第一次缺口反转失败了，随后又出现第二次回补缺口的尝试，这第二次尝试就是缺口2。


> - **Gap 2** If the first gap reversal fails, and then a second attempt to close the gap develops, this second attempt is a Gap 2.


- **High 1, 2, 3, or 4（高1、高2、高3、高4）**：在上涨或横盘市场的一次修正中，高1是一根最高点高于前一根K线的K线。如果随后出现一根形成了更低的高点的K线（它可能出现在一根或几根K线之后），那么这次修正中最高点高于前一根K线最高点的下一根K线就是高2。第三、第四次出现就是高3和高4。此外还有其它变体。


> - **High 1, 2, 3, or 4** A High 1 is a bar with a high above the prior bar in a correction in an up or sideways market. If there is then a bar with a Lower High (it can occur one or several bars later), the next bar in this correction whose high is above the prior bar's high is a High 2. Third and fourth occurrences are a High 3 and 4. There are other variations as well.


- **High/Low 1 or 2（高1或高2，或低1或低2）**：要么是一个高1或高2，要么是一个低1或低2。


> - **High/Low 1 or 2** either a High 1 or 2, or a Low 1 or 2.


- **Higher High（更高的高点）**：比先前某个摆动高点更高的一个摆动高点。


> - **Higher High** A swing high that is higher than a previous swing high.


- **Higher Low（更高的低点）**：比先前某个摆动低点更高的一个摆动低点。


> - **Higher Low** A swing low that is higher than a previous swing low.


- **Higher Time Frame（更高的时间级别）**：一种走势图，它每一根K线代表的时长或成交笔数都多于当前走势图上的K线（例如，对任何K线为59分钟或更短的走势图来说，60分钟图都是更高的时间级别；月线图是最高级别的时间级别）。


> - **Higher Time Frame** A chart with each bar representing more time or trades than the bars on the current chart (for instance, a 60-minute chart is a higher time frame for all charts that have bars of 59 minutes or shorter; a monthly chart is the highest time frame).


- **ii（ii形态，内包内包）**：两根连续的内包K线，后一根位于前一根之内。在过度延伸的市场中，它往往是反转信号。可靠性较低的一个版本是：第二根实体位于第一根实体之内，而第一根实体又位于它之前那个实体之内（忽略影线）。


> - **ii** Consecutive inside bars, with the second being inside the first. It is often a reversal signal in an overextended market. A less reliable version is when the second body is inside the first body, which is inside the body before it (ignore tails).


- **iii（iii形态）**：连续三根内包K线，是一种比 ii 形态稍可靠一些的形态。


> - **iii** Three inside bars in a row and a somewhat more reliable pattern that an ii.


- **Inside Bar（内包K线）**：最高点等于或低于前一根K线最高点、同时最低点等于或高于前一根K线最低点的K线。


> - **Inside Bar** A bar with a high that is at or below the high of the prior bar and a low that is at or above the low of the prior bar.


- **ioi（ioi形态）**：一根外包K线，它前面和后面那两根K线的最高点都低于它的最高点、最低点都高于它的最低点。它往往是一个突破建仓形态，交易者会寻找在这根内包K线之上买入、或在其下方卖出的机会。


> - **ioi** Outside bar with the bars before it and after it having highs below its high and lows above its low. It is often a breakout setup where a trader looks to buy above the inside bar or sell below it.


- **leg（行情段）**：一段打破了任意规模趋势线的小型趋势；这个词只在图上至少存在两段时使用。它是更大趋势里的一段较小趋势，可以是一次回调（一段逆势运动），可以是趋势中或横盘市况中的一个波段，也可以是趋势中的一段顺趋势运动——它发生在该趋势内任意两次回调之间。


> - **leg** A small trend that breaks a trendline of any size, and the term is used only where there are at least two on the chart. It is any smaller trend that is part of a larger trend, and it can be a pullback (a Countertrend move), a swing in a trend or in a sideways market, or a With Trend move in a trend that occurs between any two pullbacks within the trend.


- **long（多头）**：在市场里买入持仓的人，或者那份持仓本身。


> - **long** A person who buys a position in a market or the actual position itself.


- **lot（交易单位）**：在一个市场里能够交易的最小仓位规模。就股票而言它是一股，就 Emini 而言是一张合约。


> - **lot** The smallest position size that can be traded in a market. It is a share when referring to stocks and a contract when referring to Eminis.


- **Low 1, 2, 3, or 4（低1、低2、低3、低4）**：在下跌或横盘市场的一次修正中，低1是一根最低点低于前一根K线的K线。如果随后出现一根形成了更高的低点的K线（它可能出现在一根或几根K线之后），那么这次修正中最低点低于前一根K线最低点的下一根K线就是低2。第三、第四次出现就是低3和低4。此外还有其它变体。


> - **Low 1, 2, 3, or 4** A Low 1 is a bar with a low below the prior bar in a correction in a down or sideways market. If there is then a bar with a Higher Low (it can occur one or several bars later), the next bar in this correction whose low is below the prior bar's low is a Low 2. Third and fourth occurrences are a Low 3 and 4. There are other variations as well.


- **Lower High（更低的高点）**：比先前某个摆动高点更低的一个摆动高点。


> - **Lower High** A swing high that is lower than a previous swing high.


- **Lower Low（更低的低点）**：比先前某个摆动低点更低的一个摆动低点。


> - **Lower Low** A swing low that is lower than a previous swing low.


- **M2B and M2S（M2B：均线、二次入场、买入；M2S：均线、二次入场、卖出）**：对均线的第二次回调。M2B 是多头中的一个高2，是一次买入建仓形态或买入入场；M2S 是空头中的一个低2，是一次卖出建仓形态或卖出入场。


> - **M2B and M2S** A second pullback to the EMA. An M2B is a High 2 in a bull and a buy setup or entry, and an M2S is a Low 2 in a bear and a sell setup or entry.


- **major trendline（主要趋势线）**：任何一条把屏幕上大部分价格行为都包含在内的趋势线，它通常是用至少相隔10根或20根K线的那些K线画出的。


> - **major trendline** Any trendline that contains most of the price action on the screen, and it will typically be drawn using bars that are at least 10 or 20 bars apart.


- **micro trendline（微型趋势线）**：任何时间级别上的一条趋势线，它横跨两根到大约10根K线画出，其中大多数K线碰到这条趋势线或贴近它，随后其中一根K线出现了一次穿越这条趋势线的假突破。这次假突破为一次顺势的高1/低1入场做好了铺垫。如果它在一两根K线之内失败，那么通常就会有一笔逆势交易（一次突破回调——由那次穿越趋势线的突破所引发）。


> - **micro trendline** A trendline on any time frame that is drawn across from 2 to about 10 bars where most of the bars touch or are close to the trendline, and then one of the bars has a false breakout through the trendline. This false breakout sets up a With Trend High/Low 1 entry. If it fails within a bar or two, then there is usually a Countertrend trade (a Breakout Pullback from the break beyond the trendline).


- **Money Stop（金额止损）**：一种基于固定金额或固定点数的止损，比如 Emini 上的两个点。


> - **Money Stop** A stop based on a fixed dollar amount or number of points, like two points in the Eminis.


- **Opening Reversal（开盘反转）**：头一个小时左右出现的一次反转。


> - **Opening Reversal** A reversal in the first hour or so.


- **Opposite Twins（相反孪生）**：一对上涨下跌孪生，或者一对下跌上涨孪生。


> - **Opposite Twins** An Up Down Twin or a Down Up Twin.


- **Outside Bar（外包K线）**：最高点高于（或者，极少情况下等于）前一根K线最高点、同时最低点低于（或者，极少情况下等于）前一根K线最低点的K线。


> - **Outside Bar** A bar with a high that is above (or, rarely, at) the high of the prior bar and a low that is below (or, rarely, at) the low of the prior bar.


- **overshoot（过靶）**：市场越过了先前某个重要价位，比如一个摆动点或一条趋势通道线。


> - **overshoot** The market surpasses a prior price of significance like a swing point or a trend channel line.


- **Pause Bar（停顿K线）**：一根没有延伸趋势的K线。在多头趋势中，停顿K线的最高点等于或低于前一根K线；或者，在前一根K线是一根强劲的多头趋势K线时，它是一根小K线、最高点只比前一根K线高一个 tick 左右。


> - **Pause Bar** A bar that does not extend the trend. In a bull, a pause bar has a high that is at or below the prior bar, or a small bar with a high that is only a tick or so higher than the previous bar when the previous bar is a strong bull trend bar.


- **Price Action（价格行为）**：任何走势图类型、任何时间级别上价格的任何变化。


> - **Price Action** Any change in price on any chart type or time frame.


- **pullback（回调）**：回调是一次暂时的逆势运动，它是趋势、波段或行情段的一部分，并且不会回撤到趋势、波段或行情段的起点之外。例如，多头回调是多头趋势、波段或行情段中一段横盘到向下的运动，它之后至少会跟随一次对先前高点的测试。


> - **pullback** A pullback is a temporary Countertrend move and is part of a trend, swing, or leg, and does not retrace beyond the start of the trend, swing, or leg. For example, a bull pullback is a sideways to downward move in a bull trend, swing, or leg that will be followed by at least a test of the prior high.


- **Pullback Bar（回调K线）**：一根至少把前一根K线反向一个 tick 的K线。在上涨趋势中，它是一根最低点低于前一根K线最低点的K线。


> - **Pullback Bar** A bar that reverses the prior bar by at least one tick. In an uptrend, it is a bar with a low below that of the prior bar.


- **Reversal（反转）**：从任意规模的趋势转入交易区间或相反趋势的一次反转。


> - **Reversal** A reversal from a trend of any size to a trading range or an opposite trend.


- **Reversal Bar（反转K线）**：方向与趋势相反的一根趋势K线。在空头行情中，多头趋势K线底部带影线，收盘价高于开盘价，而且收盘靠近最高点。空头反转K线顶部带影线，收盘价低于开盘价，而且收盘靠近最低点。


> - **Reversal Bar** A trend bar in the opposite direction of the trend. In a bear, a bull trend bar has a tail at the bottom and a close above the open and near the top. A bear reversal bar has a tail at the top and a close below the open and near the bottom.


- **scalp（剥头皮）**：一笔带着小额利润离场的交易，通常在任何回调出现之前就已离场。对 Emini 来说，止盈目标可能是四个或八个 tick，也可能是对先前极值的一次测试。对 SPY（标普500的 ETF）或股票来说，它可能是10或20美分。对更贵的股票，它可以是1美元或2美元。


> - **scalp** A trade that is exited with a small profit, usually before there are any pull backs. For the Eminis, the profit target might be four or eight ticks, or a test of the prior extreme. For the SPY or stocks, it might be 10 or 20 cents. For more expensive stocks, it can be $1 or $2.


- **scalper（剥头皮交易者）**：主要靠剥头皮赚取小额利润的交易者，通常使用很紧的止损。


> - **scalper** A trader who primarily scalps for small profit, usually using a tight stop.


- **scalper's profit（剥头皮交易者的利润）**：剥头皮交易者会瞄准的典型利润数额。


> - **scalper's profit** A typical amount of profit that a scalper would be targeting.


- **scratch（打平）**：一笔接近盈亏平衡的交易，要么是小额盈利，要么是小额亏损。


> - **scratch** A trade that is close to breakeven with either a small profit or loss.


- **second entry（二次入场）**：在第一次入场之后几根K线之内，第二次出现一根基于与第一次入场相同逻辑的入场K线（例如，三根或四根K线之内的第二次信号）。


> - **second entry** The second time within a few bars of the first entry that there is an entry bar based on the same logic as the first entry (for example, a second signal within three or four bars).


- **setup（建仓形态）**：由一根或多根K线构成的一种形态，交易者以它为依据挂出入场订单。如果入场订单成交，这个建仓形态的最后一根K线就成为信号K线。大多数建仓形态都只是单独一根K线。


> - **setup** A pattern of one or more bars used by traders as the basis to place entry orders. If an entry order is filled, the last bar of the setup becomes the signal bar. Most setups are just a single bar.


- **Shaved Body（平实体）**：一根在其中一端或两端都没有影线的蜡烛线。平顶就是顶部没有影线，平底就是底部没有影线。


> - **Shaved Body** A candle with no tail at one or both ends. A Shaved Top has no tail at the top, and a Shaved Bottom has no tail at the bottom.


- **short（做空）**：作动词时，指卖出股票或期货以建立一个新持仓（而不是把先前买入的持仓平掉）。作名词时，指做空的人，或者那份持仓本身。


> - **short** As a verb, to sell a stock or future to initiate a new position (not to exit a prior purchase). As a noun, it is a person who sells something short, or the actual position itself.


- **Shrinking Stairs（收缩型楼梯形态）**：一连串三个或更多趋势性高点（多头趋势中）或趋势性低点（空头趋势中），其中每一次突破创新极值所用的 tick 数量都比前一次突破更少，说明动能正在衰减。它可以是三次推进形态，但不必形似楔形，而且可以是趋势中任意一串宽幅波段。


> - **Shrinking Stairs** A series of three or more trending highs in a bull or lows in a bear where each breakout to a new extreme is by fewer ticks than the prior breakout, indicating waning momentum. It can be a Three Push pattern, but it does not have to resemble a Wedge and can be any broad swings in a trend.


- **Signal Bar（信号K线）**：入场订单成交的那根K线（入场K线）之前紧挨着的那根K线。它是建仓形态的最后一根K线。


> - **Signal Bar** The bar immediately before the entry bar (the bar in which an entry order is filled). It is the final bar of a setup.


- **smaller time frame（更小时间级别）**：每小时K线根数多于当前走势图的时间级别。如果走势图是基于时间的，那么每一根K线包含的时间更少（例如，对任何K线为四分钟或更长的走势图来说，3分钟图都是更小时间级别；每根K线只有一个 tick 的 tick 图是最小的时间级别）。


> - **smaller time frame** A time frame that has more bars per hour than the current chart. If the chart is based on time, each bar contains less time (for instance, a 3- minute chart is a smaller time frame for all charts that have bars of four minutes or longer; a tick chart with each bar being only a single tick is the smallest time frame).


- **Stairs（楼梯形态）**：一连串三个或更多趋势性波段，形似一个倾斜的交易区间，而且大体被包含在一个通道之中。此时存在双向成交，但其中一方控制力略强，这正是斜率形成的原因。


> - **Stairs** A series of three or more trending swings that resembles a sloping trading range and is roughly contained in a channel. Two-way trade is taking place, but one side is in slightly more control, accounting for the slope.


- **Swing（波段）**：一段打破了任意规模趋势线的较小趋势；这个词只在图上至少存在两个波段时才使用。它们可以出现在一个更大的趋势之中，也可以出现在横盘市况之中。


> - **Swing** A smaller trend that breaks a trendline of any size; the term is used only when there are at least two on the chart. They can occur within a larger trend or in a sideways market.


- **Swing High（摆动高点）**：一根在图上看起来像是向上的急速行情、并且向上延伸超出相邻K线的K线。它的最高点等于或高于前一根K线的最高点，也等于或高于后一根K线的最高点。


> - **Swing High** A bar that looks like a spike that extends up beyond the neighboring bars on the chart. Its high is at or above that of the bar before and the bar after it.


- **Swing High/Low（摆动高点或摆动低点）**：要么是一个摆动高点，要么是一个摆动低点。


> - **Swing High/Low** Either a swing high or a swing low.


- **Swing Low（摆动低点）**：一根在图上看起来像是向下的急速行情、并且向下延伸超出相邻K线的K线。它的最低点等于或低于前一根K线的最低点，也等于或低于后一根K线的最低点。


> - **Swing Low** A bar that looks like a spike that extends down beyond the neighboring bars on the chart. Its low is at or below that of the bar before and the bar after it.


- **Swing Point（摆动点）**：要么是一个摆动高点，要么是一个摆动低点。


> - **Swing Point** Either a swing high or low.


- **Swing Trade（波段交易）**：对使用5分钟图这类短期日内走势图的日内交易者来说，它是任何比剥头皮持续更久的交易，而且交易者会持有它穿过一次或多次回调。对使用更高时间级别走势图的交易者来说，它是一笔持续数小时到几天不等的交易。通常，这笔交易中至少有一部分持仓是不设止盈目标的，因为交易者期待一段延伸的行情。


> - **Swing Trade** For a day trader using a short-term intraday chart like the 5-minute, it is any trade that lasts longer than a scalp and the trader will hold through one or more pullbacks. For a trader using higher time frame charts, it is a trade that lasts for hours to several days. Typically, at least part of the trade is held without a profit target, since the trader is hoping for an extended move.


- **test（测试）**：市场接近先前某个重要价位，它可能突破这个价位，也可能失败并反转。这次失败可能是一次过靶，也可能是一次未及靶位。


> - **test** The market approaches a prior price of significance, and it may break through it or fail and reverse. The failure can be an overshoot or an undershoot.


- **Three Pushes（三次推进）**：三个摆动高点，其中每个摆动高点都更高；或者三个摆动低点，其中每个摆动低点都更低。它的交易方式与楔形相同，应当被看作楔形的一个变体。


> - **Three Pushes** Three swing highs where each swing high is higher or three swing lows where each swing low is lower. It trades the same as a Wedge and should be considered a variant.


- **tick（最小报价单位）**：价格变动的最小单位。对大多数股票来说，它是一个便士；对十年期美国国债期货来说，它是1/64点；对 Emini 来说，它是0.25点。在tick图上以及在成交明细表上，一个 tick 就是发生的每一笔交易，无论大小，甚至价格没有变化也算。如果你看一张成交明细表，当 TradeStation 图表软件生成tick图时，每一笔交易都被计作一个 tick。


> - **tick** The smallest unit of price movement. For most stocks, it is one penny, for Ten Year Note futures, it is l/64th of a point, and for Eminis, it is 0.25 points. On tick charts and on time and sales tables, a tick is every trade that takes place, no matter the size, and even if there is no price change. If you look at a time and sales table, every trade is counted as one tick when TradeStation charting software creates a tick chart.


- **Tight Trading Range（窄幅交易区间）**：由两根或更多K线构成的任何一种横盘运动，这些K线之间大量重叠。多头与空头处在平衡之中。


> - **Tight Trading Range** Any sideways movement of two or more bars with lots of overlap in the bars. The bulls and bears are in balance.


- **time frame（时间级别）**：走势图上一根K线所包含的时间长度（5分钟的时间级别由每五分钟收一次盘的K线构成）。它也可以指不基于时间的K线，比如基于成交量或成交的 tick 数量的K线。


> - **time frame** The length of time contained in one bar on the chart (a five-minute time frame is made of bars that close every five minutes). It can also refer to bars not based on time, such as those based on volume or the number of ticks traded.


- **tradable（可交易）**：这笔交易走得足够远，至少能完成一次有盈利的剥头皮。


> - **tradable** The trade moved far enough to make at least a profitable scalp.


- **Trading Range（交易区间）**：横盘运动，多头与空头都没有占据控制权。


> - **Trading Range** Sideways movement, and neither the bulls nor the bears are in control.


- **trap（陷阱）**：一次入场在剥头皮交易者的止盈目标达到之前就立刻反向运行，把交易者套在他们的新持仓里，最终迫使他们亏损平仓。它也可能把交易者吓得离开一笔好交易。


> - **trap** An entry that immediately reverses to the opposite direction before a scalper's profit target is reached, trapping traders in their new position, ultimately forcing them to cover at a loss. It can also scare traders out of a good trade.


- **Trapped in a Trade（被套在场内）**：一位交易者在一笔交易上有未平仓亏损，这笔交易没有带来剥头皮交易者的利润，而且如果出现一次越过入场K线或信号K线的回调，他很可能会认亏离场。


> - **Trapped in a Trade** A trader with an open loss on a trade that did not result in a scalper's profit, and if there is a pullback beyond the entry or signal bars, he will likely take his loss.


- **Trapped Out of a Trade（被关在场外）**：一次回调把交易者吓得退出一笔交易，但随后这次回调失败了。行情迅速恢复，重新朝这笔交易的方向运行，这就使交易者在情绪上很难在眼下这个更差的价格重新进场。他将不得不追着市场进场。


> - **Trapped Out of a Trade** A pullback that scares a trader into exiting a trade, but then the pullback fails. The market quickly resumes the move in the direction of the trade, making it difficult emotionally for the trader to get back in at the worse price that is now available. He will have to chase the market.


- **trend（趋势）**：一连串价格变化，它们要么大部分向上（一段多头趋势，或多头），要么大部分向下（一段空头趋势，或空头）。趋势有三个定义宽松的较小版本：波段、行情段和回调。一张走势图只会显示一到两个主要趋势。如果更多，那么用其它术语中的一个就更合适。


> - **trend** A series of price changes that are either mostly up (a bull trend or a bull) or down (a bear trend or a bear). There are three loosely defined smaller versions: swings, legs, and pullbacks. A chart will show only one or two major trends. If there are more, one of the other terms is more appropriate.


- **Trend Bar（趋势K线）**：一根有实体的K线，也就是说收盘价高于或低于开盘价，表明至少有程度较小的价格运动。


> - **Trend Bar** A bar with a body, which means that the close was above or below the open and is indicative of at least a minor price movement.


- **Trend Channel Line（趋势通道线）**：一条顺着趋势方向、但与趋势线相比画在K线另一侧的线。多头趋势通道线位于最高点上方，向右上方倾斜；空头趋势通道线位于最低点下方，向右下方倾斜。


> - **Trend Channel Line** A line in the direction of the trend but drawn on the opposite side of the bars compared to a trendline. A bull trend channel line is above the highs and rising to the right and a bear trend channel line is a line that falls to the right and is below the lows.


- **Trend Channel Line Overshoot（趋势通道线过靶）**：一根K线穿过趋势通道线。


> - **Trend Channel Line Overshoot** A bar penetrates a trend channel line.


- **Trend Channel Line Undershoot（趋势通道线未及靶位）**：一根K线接近趋势通道线，但市场没有穿过这条线、而是反转离开了它。


> - **Trend Channel Line Undershoot** A bar approaches a trend channel line, but the market reverses away from the line without penetrating it.


- **Trend from the Open or First Bar（开盘即趋势，或第一根K线即趋势）**：一种从当天第一根或第二根K线开始、延伸很多根K线而没有回调的趋势，而且这个趋势的起点在当天大部分时间、甚至全部时间里始终是当天的极值之一。


> - **Trend from the Open or First Bar** A trend that begins at the first or second bar of the day and extends for many bars without a pullback, and the start of the trend remains as one of the extremes of the day for much if not all of the day.


- **Trending Closes（趋势性收盘）**：三根或更多K线，它们的收盘价呈现趋势性变化。在多头趋势中，每一根的收盘价都高于前一根的收盘价；在空头趋势中，每一根都更低。如果这个形态延伸很多根K线，其中可以有一两根K线的收盘价不呈趋势性变化。


> - **Trending Closes** Three or more bars where the closes are trending. In a bull, each close is above the prior close and in a bear, each close is lower. If the pat tern extends for many bars, there can be one or two bars where the closes are not trending.


- **Trending Highs or Lows（趋势性高点或低点）**：与趋势性收盘相同，只是以K线的最高点或最低点为基础。


> - **Trending Highs or Lows** The same as trending closes except based on the highs or lows of the bars.


- **Trending Swings（趋势性波段）**：三个或更多波段，其中摆动高点和摆动低点都高于前一个摆动高点和摆动低点（趋势性多头波段），或者都更低（趋势性空头波段）。


> - **Trending Swings** Three or more swings where the swing highs and lows are both higher than the prior swing highs and lows (trending bull swings), or both lower (trending bear swings).


- **trendline（趋势线）**：一条顺着趋势方向画出的线。最常见的是用摆动高点或摆动低点来构造，但也可以基于线性回归，或者只是画一条最佳拟合线（凭眼睛看）。


> - **trendline** A line drawn in the direction of the trend. Most often, it is constructed from either swing highs or lows but can be based on linear regression or just a best fit (eyeballing).


- **Trend Reversal（趋势反转）**：一次从上涨到下跌、或者从下跌到上涨的趋势改变，或者从趋势变为交易区间。


> - **Trend Reversal** A trend change from up to down or down to up, or from a trend to a trading range.


- **twin（孪生）**：两根连续的K线，它们共有某种特征（比如上涨下跌K线，或者双底K线）。


> - **twin** Two consecutive bars that share some characteristic (like Up Down bars or Double Bottom bars).


- **undershoot（未及靶位）**：市场接近但并没有到达先前某个重要价位，比如一个摆动点或一条趋势线。


> - **undershoot** The market approaches but does not reach a prior price of signifi cance like a swing point or a trendline.


- **Up Down Twin（上涨下跌孪生）**：一种空头反转建仓形态：其中有两根相互重叠的K线，大小相近，第一根是多头趋势K线，第二根是空头趋势K线。


> - **Up Down Twin** A bear reversal setup where there are two overlapping bars that have similar size and the first one is a bull trend bar and the second is a bear trend bar.


- **Wedge（楔形）**：传统上指一次三次推进走势，其中每一次推进都延伸得更远，而且趋势线与趋势通道线至少在最低限度上相互收敛，形成一个上升或下降三角形，或者楔形形态。对交易者来说，楔形形状提高了交易成功的几率，但任何三次推进形态的交易方式都像楔形，都可以被当作楔形。


> - **Wedge** Traditionally it is a Three Push move with each push extending further, and the trendline and trend channel line are at least minimally convergent, cre ating a rising or descending triangle or Wedge-shaped pattern. For a trader, the Wedge shape increases the chances of a successful trade, but any Three Push pat tern trades like a Wedge and can be considered one.


- **With Trend（顺势）**：一笔顺着当前趋势方向的交易，或者一个顺着当前趋势方向的建仓形态。一般来说，应当把最近一次5分钟信号的方向假定为趋势的方向。另外，如果过去10根或20根K线中的大多数都位于均线上方，那么趋势建仓形态和交易很可能就在买方。


> - **With Trend** A trade or a setup that is in the direction of the prevailing trend. In general, the direction of the most recent 5-minute signal should be assumed to be the trend's direction. Also, if most of the past 10 or 20 bars are above the EMA, trend setups and trades are likely on the buy side.


# 作者简介

*About the Author*


阿尔·布鲁克斯（Al Brooks），医学博士，现年56岁，用自己的个人账户全职交易大约已有20年。他在新英格兰一个工薪家庭长大，以综合优等成绩和数学优等成绩毕业于三一学院（康涅狄格州），随后进入芝加哥大学医学院，并在那里完成了眼科住院医师培训。在芝加哥的那些年里，他一直琢磨自己是不是该退学，去 Merc 的交易大厅工作，但始终不敢冒这个险。住院医师培训结束后，他被选为 Heed Fellow——这是全国颁给顶尖新晋眼科医生的最有声望的奖项。此后他在埃默里大学医学院教了一年书，又在洛杉矶行医大约10年。在从事学术的那些年里，他发表了30多篇科学论文，并定期在全国性的眼科学术会议上报告自己的研究成果。在洛杉矶，他建起了加州最早一批获得 Medicare 批准的眼科手术中心之一，并在自己诊所的手术室里做了数千台手术。


> Al Brooks, MD is 56 years old and has been trading full-time for his personal account for about 20 years. After growing up in a workingclass family in New England and graduating with general honors and honors in math from Trinity College (Connecticut), he went to medical school at the University of Chicago where he also completed his ophthalmology residency. During his stay in Chicago, he always wondered if he should drop out and work on the floor of the Merc, but was too scared to take the chance. Upon completion of his residency, he was selected as a Heed Fellow, which is the most prestigious national award given to the top new ophthalmologists in the country. He then taught for a year at the Emory University School of Medicine and practiced in Los Angeles for about 10 years. During his academic years, he published more than 30 scientific papers and regularly presented his work at national ophthalmology meetings. In Los Angeles, he built one of the first Medicare-approved eye surgery centers in California and performed thousands of operations in his office OR.


1988年他的第一个孩子出生15个月后，他又添了一对同卵双胞胎女儿，这给了他一个离开医学的绝佳借口（三个女儿都不满15个月大）。他卖掉了诊所，搬到萨克拉门托郊外的一个小镇，留在家里带孩子，并开始做交易。他的女儿们现在都在上大学（两个在伯克利，一个在耶鲁），他过得很快乐，一个人住，安静地交易自己的个人账户。他和家人关系亲近，有几个一起飞蝇钓、打网球的朋友，还有一个女朋友，但他大部分时间都是一个人待着：要么做交易，要么研判图表，要么看新闻和政治脱口秀，要么自己运动或看体育比赛（尤其是田径和大学橄榄球）。


> Fifteen months after the birth of his first child in 1988, he had identical twin girls, and this gave him a great excuse to leave medicine (three girls under the age of 15 months). He sold his practice, moved to a small town outside of Sacramento, stayed home to raise his kids, and started trading. His girls are all in college now (two at Berkeley, one at Yale), and he is happy, living alone, and quietly trading his personal accounts. He is close to his family and has a couple fly fishing and tennis buddies and a girlfriend, but he spends most of his time alone, either trading, evaluating charts, watching news and political talk shows, or playing or watching sports (especially track and field and college football).


做交易的头10年，他花了10,000小时编写和测试指标与系统，把交易搞得远比逻辑告诉他的要复杂得多。大约10年前，他决定从最底层重新开始，只凭价格行为交易，打算日后按需要再逐步加入指标。他发现，单凭一张图读价格行为，就足以成为一名成功的交易者，因此他决定弃用指标，采用一种极简的交易观。


> For the first 10 years of trading, he spent 10,000 hours writing and testing indicators and systems, making trading far more complicated than what logic told him it should be. About 10 years ago, he decided to start over again from the bottom up and trade off just price action, with the intention of adding indicators as needed over time. What he discovered was that simply reading price action alone off a single chart was all that was needed to be a successful trader, and he therefore decided to eschew indicators and adopted a minimalist perspective on trading.


作为剥头皮交易者，他必须全神贯注于每一个最小报价单位（tick），不想有任何干扰。他的房间光线昏暗，所有窗帘都完全拉上，他靠一台笔记本电脑的屏幕做交易。他桌上还有另一台电脑，配着两台21英寸显示器，但交易日里他一直让它关着，从不用它交易。当他受到的干扰最少、面前只有一张不带指标（除了一条20根K线的EMA均线）的图、也没有额外的显示器时，他交易得最好。他目前用 TradeStation 看图表，大部分交易通过其他经纪商用价格阶梯下单，不使用任何能自动生成 OCO 止盈限价单和止损单的前端程序。几年前他曾短暂试用过一个前端程序，但用它违背了他把生活尽量简单化这条根本原则，于是他停用了。他坦然承认自己容易犯错，而犯错会让他亏钱，所以他的生活能安排得越简单，回吐出去的钱就越少。交易时他从不看电视，对经济报告的结果或专家们的观点也毫无兴趣。他也从不看报纸，所有消息都来自互联网。他只交易这些报告带来的价格行为，极少去弄清实际数字究竟是多少。尽管他智商很高，但他觉得自己实在不够快——来不及把一份报告的所有影响都消化掉、读5分钟图，再正确下单。他相信，当他只凭眼前这张5分钟图交易、忽略其他所有的输入和意见时，他的盈利要多得多。他也不关心市场明年、甚至下一个小时会走向哪里。他唯一想知道的，是自己在接下来1到10分钟里是否有80%的概率能在风险很小的情况下赚到钱。由于他所有的入场都靠止损单成交，他把自己看作趋势交易者，因为他是被市场扫进一笔交易的，而市场正朝着他盈利所需要的方向走。他更偏好反向操作，因为对他而言压力最小的交易，是那些他坚信交易者突然被套在错误的一边、必须离场的交易。不过，他也会在趋势中的回调里入场。如果趋势很弱，就有过早进入回调的风险。他觉得这比一次快速的反向操作更有压力——做快速反向操作时，他通常在几分钟内就剥头皮获利离场，而市场在奔向他的止盈目标的路上毫不迟疑。


> As a scalper, he needs to focus intensely on every tick, and he doesn't want distractions. His room is dimly lit, all of the shades are fully drawn, and he trades off a single notebook computer screen. He has another computer on his desk with two 21" monitors, but he keeps it off during the trading day and never uses it for trading. He trades best when he has minimal distractions and only a single chart with no indicators (other than a 20- bar EMA) and no additional monitors. He currently uses TradeStation for charting and places most of his trades through other brokers using price ladders without any front-end programs that automatically generate OCO profit limit orders and stop orders. He briefly tried a front-end program a few years ago, but using it violated his fundamental principle of keeping his life as simple as possible, so he stopped. He freely admits to being prone to making mistakes, and that costs him money, so the simpler he can structure his life, the less he gives back. He never watches TV while trading and has no interest in the results of economic reports or the opinions of experts. He also never reads newspapers, and he gets all of his news from the Internet. He just trades the price action that comes from those reports, rarely ever finding out what the actual numbers were. Although he has a high IQ, he feels that he simply is not fast enough to process all of the ramifications of a report, read the 5-minute chart, and place his orders correctly. He believes that he is far more profitable when he only trades off the 5-minute chart in front of him and ignores all other input and opinions. He also doesn't care where the market is going in the next year or even the next hour. All he wants to know is whether he has an 80 percent chance of making a profit in the next 1 to 10 minutes with little risk. Since all of his entries are on stops, he considers himself a trend trader because he gets swept into a trade by the market going in the direction he needs it to go to make a profit. He prefers fading moves because the least stressful trades for him are the ones where he strongly believes that traders are suddenly trapped on the wrong side and have to get out. However, he also enters on pullbacks in trends. If the trend is weak, there is a risk that he will be entering the pullback early. He finds this more stressful than a quick fade where he usually scalps out with a profit within a couple of minutes and the market does not hesitate at all on its path to his profit target.


他每周跑几天步，练举重，打网球，还喜欢骑自行车。他也喜欢飞蝇钓、徒步和滑雪，这就是他选择住在离太浩湖只有90英里处的原因（而且他喜欢这里离纳帕只有75英里、离旧金山100英里）。


> He runs several days a week, lifts weights, plays tennis, and enjoys bike riding. He also likes to fly fish, hike, and ski, which is why he chose to live only 90 miles from Lake Tahoe (and he likes being only 75 miles from Napa and 100 miles from San Francisco).

本表收录《逐棒读图》《趋势篇》《区间篇》《反转篇》四本书共用的 225 个核心术语。
「本书用词」是译文里实际使用的说法；「官方中文版用词」一列只填在该版正文中确实检索到的词（空白表示未见，不作推测）；凡两者不同，译文以更不易误读的一版为准，理由写在「说明」里。

|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | price action | **价格行为** | 价格行为 |  |

| 3 | candle | **蜡烛线** | 蜡烛线 | 与K线同义，作者偶尔换词，译文同样换词以示文风 |

| 6 | doji bar | **十字星K线** | 十字星K线 |  |

# 附录 B · 图内标注对照表

本书所有图表都保留 **Wiley 官方原图**（1920×1440，TradeStation 截图），图内标注是英文。
这张表把图上会出现的东西一次性讲清，读图时随时对照。表内术语与《附录 A · 核心术语对照表》一致。
注：图表角落里的 `WILEY` 是 Wiley 官方图库水印；`H1–H4 / L1–L4` 等标注经 OCR 实测确实出现在图面上。

## 一、K线编号与推进计数

| 图上标注 | 含义 | 本书中文说法 |
|---|---|---|
| `1 2 3 …`（数字+箭头） | K线序号，作者用来指代"第几根K线" | **第 3 根K线**（正文统一写法） |
| `H1` / `H2` / `H3` / `H4` | High 1/2/3/4：多头趋势中回撤后第一次/第二次…向上尝试突破 | **高1 / 高2 / 高3 / 高4** |
| `L1` / `L2` | Low 1/2：空头趋势中反弹后第一次/第二次…向下尝试突破 | **低1 / 低2** |
| `ii` | inside-inside：连续两根内包K线 | **ii 形态（内包内包）** |
| `ioi` | inside-outside-inside：内包—外包—内包 | **ioi 形态** |
| `DO` | doji（十字星） | **十字星** |
| `IB` | inside bar（内包K线） | **内包K线** |
| `OB` / `OU` / `OD` | outside bar / outside up / outside down | **外包K线 / 外包上涨 / 外包下跌** |

## 二、形态与结构

| 图上标注 | 含义 | 本书中文说法 |
|---|---|---|
| `BO` | breakout | **突破** |
| `PB` | pullback | **回调** |
| `BP` | breakout pullback | **突破回调** |
| `TR` | trading range | **交易区间** |
| `TTR` | tight trading range | **窄幅交易区间** |
| `BW` | barbwire | **铁丝网** |
| `TC` | trend channel（线） | **趋势通道线** |
| `TL` | trend line | **趋势线** |
| `MC` | micro channel | **微型通道** |
| `S&C`(偶见) | spike and channel | **急速与通道** |
| `EW` / `ZZ` | 画图软件波浪标注（艾略特波浪/锯齿） | 保留原标注，正文不引用 |
| `W` | wedge（三推楔形） | **楔形** |
| `DT` / `DB` | double top / double bottom | **双顶 / 双底** |
| `HS` / `IHS` | head and shoulders / 反转头肩 | **头肩顶 / 头肩底** |
| `MM` | measured move | **等距运动** |
| `GAP` | gap | **缺口** |

## 三、均线与指标

| 图上标注 | 含义 | 本书中文说法 |
|---|---|---|
| `EMA` | exponential moving average（本书只用 20 周期） | **指数平滑移动平均线（20EMA）** |
| `MA` | moving average | **移动平均线** |
| `VO` / `Vol` | volume 成交柱子 | **成交量** |
| `Time and Sales` | 逐笔成交窗口 | **成交明细表** |

## 四、图表外围信息

| 图上内容 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `5 min` / `1 min` / `Daily` | 图表时间级别 → **5分钟图 / 1分钟图 / 日线图** |
| 左上角 `D 08/20 15:45` 之类 | 合约月份与数据截止时间 → 保留原样，正文不引用 |
| 纵轴价格 `1,266.50` | 保留原数值；正文引用价格时同样保留 |
| 底部时间轴 `7:00 8:00 …` | 交易时段（美东/太平洋时间），保留原样 |
| 图上右上角 `WILEY` | Wiley 官方图库水印，非书内内容 |

## 五、读图三条铁律（本书特有）

1. **K线序号以图面标注为准**：正文说"第 14 根K线"，就找图上标 `14` 的那根——序号从当日第一根K线起算。
2. **`H2` 与"两段式回撤"是一回事**：高2 = 多头趋势中的第二次向上尝试；`L2` 同理。
3. **图上不标颜色含义**：本书用**收盘价高于开盘价即多头K线**的判读方式，颜色（红/绿）只反映软件默认设置，正文判断一律以"实体、影线、收盘位置"为准。
